en.header: Biden warned that a default on US debt could be an unprecedented disaster.
en.subheader: The President is going to discuss the debt ceiling issue with the Speaker of the House of Representatives
en.content: President Joe Biden warned that defaulting on a country's debt would be an unprecedented disaster. He made a statement at an event with city mayors, which he conveyed to Reuters. "Byden said that default on US debt would be a disaster that was never like anything that ever happened in the United States financially," noted in the paper. The President also promised to discuss the issue with the speaker of the House of Representatives, Kevin McCarthy. "The debt we are paying, and we are going to discuss it with the new majority leader in the House of Representatives, has accumulated over 200 years," said Biden. McCarthy, the newly appointed Speaker of the Republic, wants to link the vote to raise the debt ceiling to cut public spending. McCarthy himself tweeted to Biden that he "received an invitation to sit down and discuss a responsible increase in the debt ceiling to address irresponsible public spending." The White House representative, Karin Jean-Pierre, said that Biden was looking forward to meeting McCarthy. On January 19, the U.S. had reached the state debt ceiling of $31.4 trillion, an increase in the ceiling should be approved by Congress, but no agreement had yet been reached in Parliament.

record.header: The "ceiling" does not put pressure on the markets. The problem of public debt worries investors less than the Fed rate
record.subheader: The United States reached the debt ceiling much earlier than economists expected. How did the stock market react to this fact?
record.content: The US has reached the debt limit, but this news is still under political discussion. What concessions will the Democrats make to the Republicans to agree to raise the ceiling again? For investors, the key risk remains the further tightening of the US Fedreserve's monetary policy. The expensive dollar does not benefit US exporters, who account for a significant portion of S&P corporations. It does not benefit the commodity economies, because a strong dollar makes the goods less accessible to the issuers of other currencies. However, it does not look safe for markets to reach the limit. The US reached the cap on public debt on January 19, 2023. This was much earlier than the economists expected. Share markets reacted to the news with a moderate negative view of the fact as a new one. U.S. key stock indicators ended Thursday's trade session with a decline of 0.76-0.96 per cent. Much more investors are now concerned about the Fed's February meeting and the extent to which interest rates could be raised. But in the debt market, returns have crawled upward. US 10-year bond rates have risen by 0.89 per cent and now amount to 3.429 per cent. The debt, unlike shares, is not perceived by investors as a real asset. Experts believe that, as confidence in the states of developed countries increases, capital migrates in part. However, it is unlikely that the debt market will expect "the crisis of the century." But why does the entire financial world keep track of US debt? This "drama" repeats quite regularly, but each time the Data X triggers a surge in media activity. It is a dollar. U.S. dollar is the world's main reserve currency. If the US Treasury runs out of cash, the US will not be able to pay on debt. The loss of confidence in US debt is thus a price tag for a riskless asset for the world, leading to a surge in borrowing costs and a collapse in financial markets. The crisis will spread from financial markets to the real sector as well. So the US default will draw the world economy into a deep recession. For commodity economies, this will translate into a weakening of national currencies, an increase in inflation, a prolonged decline in production. A political performance called Data X once again raises the question of the role of the dollar in the global economy. Shouldn't the world financial system reduce the dollar's role in favour of other currencies tied to real assets? The answer to this question was the search for economists from the Swiss bank Credit Suisse. Shortly, the chances of a new hemonic currency are going to be zero. Credit Suisse, in a report entitled "The Future World Monetary System", considered three scenarios for the development of the financial system when the dollar loses its status as a key reserve currency. Not one of them is going to have to give up the dollar completely. Yes, its role may diminish, but it is unlikely to go out of international trade. It is enough to look at the share of the dollar in the world's foreign exchange reserves. As of the third quarter of 2022, the dollar accounts for 59.8 per cent of the reserve basket. According to Credit Suisse experts, it is most likely that a multipolar monetary system will emerge in the future. What is the next plan? After reaching the ceiling, further developments will develop in a well-known way. The US Department of Finance will begin to use "emergency measures" to continue payments on government obligations and delay the announcement of default. In Minfin's arsenal, not only accounting manoeuvres, but also the suspension of investments. In a letter to Congress dated 19 January, Minister Janet Yellen announced that the emergency measures would be in place until 5 June. This time, the Presidential Administration could use for negotiations that would end (under the law of genre) happy end, i.e. concessions by a party in exchange for a further increase in the borrowing limit. However, if agreement could not be reached, the Government would not be able to fulfil its obligations and would be forced to default. In the twentieth century, the United States announced a technical default twice - in 1933, in the period of Great Depression, and in 1971, when the gold-exchange standard was abolished. Since then, the US budget has almost always been scarce. Debt-control negotiations have always drawn attention to a possible economic disaster, encouraging Republicans to use it as leverage. In 2011, the Republicans and Democratics' fight for sovereign debt almost ended with a default.The S&P agency first lowered the long-term credit rating of the US to AA+ from the maximum AAA, drawing attention to the growing sovereign debt, as well as the insufficient effectiveness of the United States Government's debt-related measures. At that time, the country's debt was $14.3 trillion. As a result of long negotiations, US President Barack Obama agreed to limit future spending in exchange for the lifting of the cap. Since then, the government's debt limit has increased repeatedly and reached $31.4 trillion in 2022. On Thursday, January 19, 2023, this threshold was crossed. Both parties contributed to the budget drama. The Reds have repeatedly reduced taxes and the Blues have expanded spending programmes, increasing the federal budget deficit. Both parties have approved large economic assistance packages after the 2008 crisis and during the COVID-19 pandemic. Economists warn that the country risks a financial crisis and other immediate economic problems if legislators do not raise the limit before the Ministry of Finance has exhausted its opportunities to win more time. We wait until June for the responsibility for lifting or suspending the borrowing limit to the Congress, which must receive a simple majority in both the House of Representatives and the Senate to vote for any change in the debt limit. Republicans, who now control the House of Representatives, insist that the increase in the debt limit be linked to "structural expenditure reform". Many Republicans in the House of Representatives call the current level of spending and the US debt burden a threat to economic growth. The Reds have not yet made formal demands for an increase in the ceiling, but insist that it be linked to a significant reduction in expenditure and the adoption of a balanced budget. Meanwhile, the White House had stated that the debt ceiling should be increased without conditions, and management had made it clear that they would not negotiate on the issue. President Joe Biden of the United States stated that he would oppose any attempt to link spending cuts to debt ceilings. The White House Press Secretary, Karin Jean-Pierre, also reported that the White House would not negotiate, and for Congress "the resolution of issues with the ceiling of public debt is its basic responsibility". The White House's position increases the likelihood of long-term confrontation, but a compromise will eventually be found. Perhaps the US debt limit will be raised in the first half of this year. Meanwhile, while the next "Save America from Defolt" show is in progress, gold has become the main beneficiary of the events. As the Eugene Cogan investor noted, "the longer the kids will be scared, the more it will grow." The expert looks forward to the growth of the Dragmetals and their extracting companies, Newmont Goldcorp Corporation, Kinross Gold Corp, as well as the "gold" ETF (NUGT, JNUG), a couple of bitcoin/gold and other "useful" shiny things.

ru.header: Байден предупредил, что дефолт по долгам США может стать невиданным бедствием
ru.subheader: Президент собирается обсудить вопрос потолка госдолга со спикером палаты представителей
ru.content: Президент США Джо Байден предупредил, что дефолт по долгам страны стал бы невиданным бедствием. Соответствующее заявление он сделал на мероприятии с мэрами городов, его слова передает Reuters.«Байден сказал, что дефолт по долгам США станет бедствием, не похожим ни на что, когда-либо случавшееся в Соединенных Штатах в финансовом отношении», - отмечается в материале.Президент также пообещал обсудить вопрос с потолком госдолга со спикером палаты представителей Кевином Маккарти. «Долг, который мы выплачиваем, и мы собираемся обсудить его с новым лидером большинства в Палате представителей, накопился за 200 лет», — сказал Байден.В материале отмечается, что Маккарти, недавно назначенным спикером-республиканцем, хочет связать голосование за повышение потолка долга с сокращением государственных расходов.Сам Маккарти написал в твите, адресованном Байдену, что он «принял приглашение сесть и обсудить ответственное повышение потолка долга для решения проблемы безответственных государственных расходов». Представитель Белого дома Карин Жан-Пьер заявила, что Байден с нетерпением ждет встречи с Маккарти.США 19 января достигли установленного потолка госдолга на уровне 31,4 трлн долларов. Повышение потолка должен утвердить Конгресс, но соглашения по этому поводу в парламенте пока не достигнуто.

record.header: The "ceiling" does not put pressure on the markets. The problem of public debt worries investors less than the Fed rate
record.subheader: The United States reached the debt ceiling much earlier than economists expected. How did the stock market react to this fact?
record.content: The US has reached the debt limit, but this news is still under political discussion. What concessions will the Democrats make to the Republicans to agree to raise the ceiling again? For investors, the key risk remains the further tightening of the US Fedreserve's monetary policy. The expensive dollar does not benefit US exporters, who account for a significant portion of S&P corporations. It does not benefit the commodity economies, because a strong dollar makes the goods less accessible to the issuers of other currencies. However, it does not look safe for markets to reach the limit. The US reached the cap on public debt on January 19, 2023. This was much earlier than the economists expected. Share markets reacted to the news with a moderate negative view of the fact as a new one. U.S. key stock indicators ended Thursday's trade session with a decline of 0.76-0.96 per cent. Much more investors are now concerned about the Fed's February meeting and the extent to which interest rates could be raised. But in the debt market, returns have crawled upward. US 10-year bond rates have risen by 0.89 per cent and now amount to 3.429 per cent. The debt, unlike shares, is not perceived by investors as a real asset. Experts believe that, as confidence in the states of developed countries increases, capital migrates in part. However, it is unlikely that the debt market will expect "the crisis of the century." But why does the entire financial world keep track of US debt? This "drama" repeats quite regularly, but each time the Data X triggers a surge in media activity. It is a dollar. U.S. dollar is the world's main reserve currency. If the US Treasury runs out of cash, the US will not be able to pay on debt. The loss of confidence in US debt is thus a price tag for a riskless asset for the world, leading to a surge in borrowing costs and a collapse in financial markets. The crisis will spread from financial markets to the real sector as well. So the US default will draw the world economy into a deep recession. For commodity economies, this will translate into a weakening of national currencies, an increase in inflation, a prolonged decline in production. A political performance called Data X once again raises the question of the role of the dollar in the global economy. Shouldn't the world financial system reduce the dollar's role in favour of other currencies tied to real assets? The answer to this question was the search for economists from the Swiss bank Credit Suisse. Shortly, the chances of a new hemonic currency are going to be zero. Credit Suisse, in a report entitled "The Future World Monetary System", considered three scenarios for the development of the financial system when the dollar loses its status as a key reserve currency. Not one of them is going to have to give up the dollar completely. Yes, its role may diminish, but it is unlikely to go out of international trade. It is enough to look at the share of the dollar in the world's foreign exchange reserves. As of the third quarter of 2022, the dollar accounts for 59.8 per cent of the reserve basket. According to Credit Suisse experts, it is most likely that a multipolar monetary system will emerge in the future. What is the next plan? After reaching the ceiling, further developments will develop in a well-known way. The US Department of Finance will begin to use "emergency measures" to continue payments on government obligations and delay the announcement of default. In Minfin's arsenal, not only accounting manoeuvres, but also the suspension of investments. In a letter to Congress dated 19 January, Minister Janet Yellen announced that the emergency measures would be in place until 5 June. This time, the Presidential Administration could use for negotiations that would end (under the law of genre) happy end, i.e. concessions by a party in exchange for a further increase in the borrowing limit. However, if agreement could not be reached, the Government would not be able to fulfil its obligations and would be forced to default. In the twentieth century, the United States announced a technical default twice - in 1933, in the period of Great Depression, and in 1971, when the gold-exchange standard was abolished. Since then, the US budget has almost always been scarce. Debt-control negotiations have always drawn attention to a possible economic disaster, encouraging Republicans to use it as leverage. In 2011, the Republicans and Democratics' fight for sovereign debt almost ended with a default.The S&P agency first lowered the long-term credit rating of the US to AA+ from the maximum AAA, drawing attention to the growing sovereign debt, as well as the insufficient effectiveness of the United States Government's debt-related measures. At that time, the country's debt was $14.3 trillion. As a result of long negotiations, US President Barack Obama agreed to limit future spending in exchange for the lifting of the cap. Since then, the government's debt limit has increased repeatedly and reached $31.4 trillion in 2022. On Thursday, January 19, 2023, this threshold was crossed. Both parties contributed to the budget drama. The Reds have repeatedly reduced taxes and the Blues have expanded spending programmes, increasing the federal budget deficit. Both parties have approved large economic assistance packages after the 2008 crisis and during the COVID-19 pandemic. Economists warn that the country risks a financial crisis and other immediate economic problems if legislators do not raise the limit before the Ministry of Finance has exhausted its opportunities to win more time. We wait until June for the responsibility for lifting or suspending the borrowing limit to the Congress, which must receive a simple majority in both the House of Representatives and the Senate to vote for any change in the debt limit. Republicans, who now control the House of Representatives, insist that the increase in the debt limit be linked to "structural expenditure reform". Many Republicans in the House of Representatives call the current level of spending and the US debt burden a threat to economic growth. The Reds have not yet made formal demands for an increase in the ceiling, but insist that it be linked to a significant reduction in expenditure and the adoption of a balanced budget. Meanwhile, the White House had stated that the debt ceiling should be increased without conditions, and management had made it clear that they would not negotiate on the issue. President Joe Biden of the United States stated that he would oppose any attempt to link spending cuts to debt ceilings. The White House Press Secretary, Karin Jean-Pierre, also reported that the White House would not negotiate, and for Congress "the resolution of issues with the ceiling of public debt is its basic responsibility". The White House's position increases the likelihood of long-term confrontation, but a compromise will eventually be found. Perhaps the US debt limit will be raised in the first half of this year. Meanwhile, while the next "Save America from Defolt" show is in progress, gold has become the main beneficiary of the events. As the Eugene Cogan investor noted, "the longer the kids will be scared, the more it will grow." The expert looks forward to the growth of the Dragmetals and their extracting companies, Newmont Goldcorp Corporation, Kinross Gold Corp, as well as the "gold" ETF (NUGT, JNUG), a couple of bitcoin/gold and other "useful" shiny things.

en.header: Two districts of Volgograd were left without water due to a sewer break
en.content: The Video Governor of the Volgograd region, Andrei Bocharov, ordered a 24-hour restoration of the communal network in Volgograd, where residents of two districts were left without water, and the local head of the region reported the accident to the opera station. According to local publication V1.ru, on the night of 27 and 28 October, in the city, "on the slope of the flood [river], the Czars had a giant failure in the pahmutov Square, from which the flow of faecal waters and other sewage run-off was flooded." The impact of the breakthrough could not be eliminated immediately, as a result of which the flood washed the slope of the Cariza flood, flooded the child's railway, part of the new waterfront and other areas. Since yesterday, the emergency area has been under an ESS regime. Two areas, Soviet and Voroshilovsky, where more than 200,000 people live, have had to be removed from the water supply. The residents now have no water and heating, they have started buying large volumes of water. The local edition of Blocknot reports that a survey of the site of the accident revealed that both of the sewers had been damaged by a 150-metre section. The pipes installed in the 1970s had rotted, and they had also been made of metal not intended for collecting manifolds. The Water Concession and the local authorities are responsible for water supply in the city: the Prosecutor of the Volgograd Region, Denis Kostenko, requested that criminal proceedings be instituted against the municipal and company officials who had caused the accident, indicating V1.ru.

ru.header: Два района Волгограда остались без воды из-за прорыва канализации
ru.content: VideoГубернатор Волгоградской области Андрей Бочаров поручил за сутки восстановить работу коммунальной сети в Волгограде, где из-за прорыва канализации без водоснабжения остались жители двух районов. О прошедшем на месте аварии оперштабе под руководством главы региона сообщают в телеграм-канале местных властей.Как пишет местное издание V1.ru, в ночь с 27 на 28 октября в городе «на склоне поймы [реки] Царицы образовался гигантский провал в сквере Пахмутовой, откуда забил поток фекальных вод и прочих канализационных стоков». Ликвидировать последствия прорыва сразу не удалось, в итоге этот поток размыл склон поймы Царицы, затопил детскую железную дорогу, часть новой набережной и другие участки.Со вчерашнего дня в районе аварии действует режим ЧС. Для ремонта пришлось отключить от водоснабжения два района — Советский и Ворошиловский, где живут более 200 тыс. человек, указывает портал. У жителей теперь нет воды и отопления, они начали скупать бутылки воды большого объема.Местное издание «Блокнот» пишет, что в результате обследования участка аварии выяснилось, что повреждены обе нитки канализации на150-метровом отрезке. Трубы, установленные в 1970-х, прогнили, кроме того, они были сделаны из металла, не предназначенного для прокладки коллекторов. Власти не смогли оценить сроки ремонта, однако за сутки Бочаров потребовал запустить работу коллектора по временной схеме.За водоснабжение в городе ответственны «Концессии водоснабжения» и местные власти. Прокурор Волгоградской области Денис Костенко потребовал возбудить уголовное дело в отношении чиновников муниципалитета и данной компании, которые допустили аварию, указывает V1.ru.

en.header: Hot DAO Time Machine
en.subheader: A Ukrainian entrepreneur is trying to use a DAO to fund a Thai professor’s design to build a time machine.
en.content: Ever had a powerful and tragically unrealizable urge to go back in time and change things for the better? I have.Mine has been a life of abject, miserable failure, countless unforced errors, and if I could have just a second shot, as it were, maybe I would still be with her...So you can imagine my squeal of porcine delight when I came across a mysterious press release dispatched by one Alex Polischuk, a tech enthusiast based in Kyiv, advertising something that looked an awful lot like a solution to all my ills:“A Newly Created DAO Aims at Building a Time Machine,” the release began, understatedly. “The DAO’s core team intends to raise funds to enable a Thai professor to realize his invention.”It went on: “Quite recently, in 2022, a team of scientists from South East Asia invented a time machine, whose work is based on relativistic electrodynamics and quantum effects. The theory behind it is described in a few papers published in peer-reviewed journals (which means it has been approved by independent experts)."As an example of these independent expert reviews, the release linked to a paper in something called Chinese Optics Letters. (To be quite honest, I have no clue whether that paper has anything whatsoever to do with time travel.)Nevertheless, peer-reviewed! I exclaimed to myself and my empty life. The release described a full roadmap for the project.The first stage, it said, would be a prototype that “will be able to send to the future or to the past information rather than material objects,” costing around $3 million. Next, a “full-fledged time machine able to carry passengers will be built.”Supposedly, the machine is to be built in Thailand, where the 64-year-old professor behind the concept, Preecha Yupapin, is based. If enough fellow time machine enthusiasts can be enlisted, it would be co-owned and run by a decentralized autonomous organization.There is, of course, a token.  Twenty percent of the DAO’s treasury would remunerate the “core team” and “anybody from anywhere can contribute and thus become a co-owner of the first time machine in the history of humanity.”How much does the DAO seek to raise? Funny you should ask: “Due to the fact that only the cost of building the first time machine is known, the funding target is configured on Juicebox as ‘Indefinite.’”For the sake of due diligence I ran the attached paper by a scientist friend, who reliably informed me that its author was either a “crank or a fraud” and that the paper made no sense whatsoever. Thankfully, my desire for a scoop helped me overcome and entirely forget this minor issue.“Well!” I oinked to myself enthusiastically. “Count me in!”Desperate to redress life’s karmic injustices, I reached out to Polischuk, a Ukrainian who loves “observing tech progress.”He responded enthusiastically.“All processes in nature go with finite velocity, that of the speed of light,” he explained sagely after I asked him to unravel the mysteries of time travel. “If, by some technological trick, this speed is exceeded and the trajectory of motion is circular then you, as it were, go upstream the flow of events and you get to previous stages of the development of this system in the past.”Interesting!, I thought, pretending I had some clue what the hell he was going on about.The machine will be based on the so-called “Rabi cycle quantum concept,” meaning “energy levels are changed from lower to higher one and vice versa and all that,” until “quantum collapse” occurs and a “timeline opens to future or past depending on the frequency.”Asked about the project’s origins, he told me that it began on a time travel group on Facebook, where he had been introduced to the professor, Yupapin, who had previously outlined the blueprints of a machine based on Einstein's theory of relativity in the Journal of Industrial Technology and Innovation.Polischuk said he tried to verify Yupanin’s expertise by looking over a number of published papers; he assured me it was all above board. (For the record, I arranged to speak with Yupanin, but it didn't work out. Perhaps he was traveling in another era.)Polischuk agreed to support Yupapin financially—the only slight problem was that he didn’t have any money. He did have an idea, however: Launch a time machine DAO.He determined to crowdfund the thing and reached out to a number of Southeast Asia-based crypto guys via Facebook, a perfectly normal way to launch a complex new venture if there ever was one. The founders plan to launch the DAO after a marketing blitz coordinated via Reddit, YouTube and Twitter. (I resisted mentioning the precipitous drop in crypto prices in 2022.)Polischuk estimates it will take just 10-11 months to build. Fast!Now, the critical question: What sort of time travel are we talking about here? There are two major philosophical schools of time travel theory, one in which you can’t change the past and one in which you can. In the former, time is a closed loop—future, past and present are all inextricably linked, and going back to “change” the past is impossible; you can only go back and do the thing you had always done.Yupapin’s paper focuses on the second school of thought: that changing the past forks the timeline and produces a parallel spinoff with major differences. That means TimeMachineDAO’s machine will, in theory, allow users to change the past. So it’s a little alarming that use of the machine will also be in the hands of a bunch of token-incentivized crypto bros, who will, no doubt, use the opportunity to fill their bags with BTC circa 2009.That said, high-risk time travel ventures like killing Hitler are off the table, because Professor Yupapin is a very “ethical person” and “wouldn’t be glad,” the Ukrainian says. The more likely use for the machine will be something like “time travel tourism” or even time travel immigration for, I don’t know, hipsters who want to live in the 50s and smoke cigars without ostracization.“Many people would like to go to the past,” mused Polischuk. “Some for an excursion, while others want to stay there.” I certainly couldn’t disagree with that. I just hope the damn thing will be built soon, so I can go back to June 2018, when she still loved me and there was no such thing as Decrypt. Wen token?
en.summary: A Ukrainian entrepreneur is trying to use a DAO to fund a Thai professor’s design to build a time machine. The first stage, it said, would be a prototype that “will be able to send to the future or to the past information rather than material objects”

ru.header: Горячая машина времени ДАО
ru.subheader: Украинский предприниматель пытается использовать DAO для финансирования проекта тайского профессора по созданию машины времени.
ru.content: Ever had a powerful and tragically unrealizable urge to go back in time and change things for the better? I have.Mine has been a life of abject, miserable failure, countless unforced errors, and if I could have just a second shot, as it were, maybe I would still be with her...So you can imagine my squeal of porcine delight when I came across a mysterious press release dispatched by one Alex Polischuk, a tech enthusiast based in Kyiv, advertising something that looked an awful lot like a solution to all my ills:“A Newly Created DAO Aims at Building a Time Machine,” the release began, understatedly. “The DAO’s core team intends to raise funds to enable a Thai professor to realize his invention.”It went on: “Quite recently, in 2022, a team of scientists from South East Asia invented a time machine, whose work is based on relativistic electrodynamics and quantum effects. The theory behind it is described in a few papers published in peer-reviewed journals (which means it has been approved by independent experts)."As an example of these independent expert reviews, the release linked to a paper in something called Chinese Optics Letters. (To be quite honest, I have no clue whether that paper has anything whatsoever to do with time travel.)Nevertheless, peer-reviewed! I exclaimed to myself and my empty life. The release described a full roadmap for the project.The first stage, it said, would be a prototype that “will be able to send to the future or to the past information rather than material objects,” costing around $3 million. Next, a “full-fledged time machine able to carry passengers will be built.”Supposedly, the machine is to be built in Thailand, where the 64-year-old professor behind the concept, Preecha Yupapin, is based. If enough fellow time machine enthusiasts can be enlisted, it would be co-owned and run by a decentralized autonomous organization.There is, of course, a token.  Twenty percent of the DAO’s treasury would remunerate the “core team” and “anybody from anywhere can contribute and thus become a co-owner of the first time machine in the history of humanity.”How much does the DAO seek to raise? Funny you should ask: “Due to the fact that only the cost of building the first time machine is known, the funding target is configured on Juicebox as ‘Indefinite.’”For the sake of due diligence I ran the attached paper by a scientist friend, who reliably informed me that its author was either a “crank or a fraud” and that the paper made no sense whatsoever. Thankfully, my desire for a scoop helped me overcome and entirely forget this minor issue.“Well!” I oinked to myself enthusiastically. “Count me in!”Desperate to redress life’s karmic injustices, I reached out to Polischuk, a Ukrainian who loves “observing tech progress.”He responded enthusiastically.“All processes in nature go with finite velocity, that of the speed of light,” he explained sagely after I asked him to unravel the mysteries of time travel. “If, by some technological trick, this speed is exceeded and the trajectory of motion is circular then you, as it were, go upstream the flow of events and you get to previous stages of the development of this system in the past.”Interesting!, I thought, pretending I had some clue what the hell he was going on about.The machine will be based on the so-called “Rabi cycle quantum concept,” meaning “energy levels are changed from lower to higher one and vice versa and all that,” until “quantum collapse” occurs and a “timeline opens to future or past depending on the frequency.”Asked about the project’s origins, he told me that it began on a time travel group on Facebook, where he had been introduced to the professor, Yupapin, who had previously outlined the blueprints of a machine based on Einstein's theory of relativity in the Journal of Industrial Technology and Innovation.Polischuk said he tried to verify Yupanin’s expertise by looking over a number of published papers; he assured me it was all above board. (For the record, I arranged to speak with Yupanin, but it didn't work out. Perhaps he was traveling in another era.)Polischuk agreed to support Yupapin financially—the only slight problem was that he didn’t have any money. He did have an idea, however: Launch a time machine DAO.He determined to crowdfund the thing and reached out to a number of Southeast Asia-based crypto guys via Facebook, a perfectly normal way to launch a complex new venture if there ever was one. The founders plan to launch the DAO after a marketing blitz coordinated via Reddit, YouTube and Twitter. (I resisted mentioning the precipitous drop in crypto prices in 2022.)Polischuk estimates it will take just 10-11 months to build. Fast!Now, the critical question: What sort of time travel are we talking about here? There are two major philosophical schools of time travel theory, one in which you can’t change the past and one in which you can. In the former, time is a closed loop—future, past and present are all inextricably linked, and going back to “change” the past is impossible; you can only go back and do the thing you had always done.Yupapin’s paper focuses on the second school of thought: that changing the past forks the timeline and produces a parallel spinoff with major differences. That means TimeMachineDAO’s machine will, in theory, allow users to change the past. So it’s a little alarming that use of the machine will also be in the hands of a bunch of token-incentivized crypto bros, who will, no doubt, use the opportunity to fill their bags with BTC circa 2009.That said, high-risk time travel ventures like killing Hitler are off the table, because Professor Yupapin is a very “ethical person” and “wouldn’t be glad,” the Ukrainian says. The more likely use for the machine will be something like “time travel tourism” or even time travel immigration for, I don’t know, hipsters who want to live in the 50s and smoke cigars without ostracization.“Many people would like to go to the past,” mused Polischuk. “Some for an excursion, while others want to stay there.” I certainly couldn’t disagree with that. I just hope the damn thing will be built soon, so I can go back to June 2018, when she still loved me and there was no such thing as Decrypt. Wen token?

en.header: Musk said that about 2,300 active working employees remain on Twitter.
en.subheader: Twitter employs less than 10 people from other Musk companies
en.content: Twitter owner Ilon Mask reported that some 2,300 active employees remain in the company. He wrote about this in his social media account. CNBC previously quoted the company's internal documents, according to which the number of Twitter staff had dropped by 80 per cent, to some 1,300 active employees. According to the news channel, there are "some 1,400 non-working Twitter workers who are still being paid but are no longer expected to perform their old duties in the company." As noted in the material, many of them resigned after Mask sent out a statement demanding staff to devote themselves to "hardcore" work on Twitter 2.0. Sam Ilon Mask wrote on this subject: "The note is not true. On Twitter, about 2,300 active employees are still working on trust and security for hundreds of employees... fewer than 10 people from my other companies work on Twitter."*The message is information, is not an individual investment recommendation or an offer to purchase the said securities or assets. The acquisition of foreign securities carries additional risks.

record.header: The staff of Twitter after the arrival of Mask was reduced by 80%
record.subheader: There are about 1300 active employees left in the company
record.content: Twitter staff have been reduced by 80 per cent since the arrival of the new owner, Ilon Maska, and broadcast to CNBC. "According to internal documents, the number of full-time Twitter staff has been reduced to about 1,300 active employees, including less than 550 full-time engineers. About 75 of the 1,300 employees of the company are on leave, including about 40 engineers." According to the material, there are also "some 1,400 non-working Twitter staff who are still being paid but no longer expected to perform their old duties in the company." Many of them resigned after Mask had sent out a statement demanding staff to dedicate themselves to "hardcore" Twitter 2.0. Before Mask bought Twitter last year, the number of staff was about 7,500. There were rumours of terminations within the company, and it was expected that they would take place whether or not Mascom would buy the company. However, Mask has reduced Twitter staff much more than many expected, or around 80 per cent, by adding a television channel.* The message is informative, not an individual investment recommendation or an offer to purchase the said securities. en.header: Bitcoin due new 'big rally' as RSI copies 2018 bear market recovery
en.subheader: There is plenty to be optimistic about when it comes to further BTC price gains, RSI analysis concludes.
en.content: There is plenty to be optimistic about when it comes to further BTC price gains, RSI analysis concludes.Markets NewsOwn this piece of historyCollect this article as an NFTBitcoin (BTC) is in for a new “big rally” as market strength copies conditions from after the 2018 bear market.According to the latest analysis, BTC/USD will continue to head higher “after some consolidation” thanks to key signals from its relative strength index (RSI).Bitcoin prints never-before-seen bullish divergenceWith the BTC price gains still coming, Bitcoin bulls are feeling increasingly confident despite widespread mistrust of the longevity of the current rally.For popular trader Crypto Wolf, a key phenomenon now underway sets Bitcoin’s latest recovery apart from all others.RSI, he noted on Jan. 18, had printed a long-awaited bullish divergence on weekly timeframes — something which has never happened before.“BTC printed a rare weekly RSI bullish divergence. Never happened in BTC history, a once in a life opportunity,” he summarized on Jan. 21.RSI is a fundamental gauge used by traders to determine whether an asset is overbought or oversold at a given price. The weekly print has been long in the making, with Cointelegraph reporting on its arrival in advance at the end of last year.“Technicals were there, charts were screaming bottom but as usual majority was in full bear mode,” Wolf added.Analyst: "Some consolidation" will precede upsideWith that, Bitcoin is beginning to repeat the kind of renaissance last seen at the end of its previous bear market in early 2019.Trader and analyst Trader Tardigrade, also known as Alan on social media, thus predicts that the good times will continue for a while to come.“BTC has been repeating the pattern in RSI and Price Action to 2019 bottom,” he told followers last week.“On daily chart, 1. RSI Strong uptrend to overbought zone 2. $BTC had a significant drop before that 3. Sudden buyers bought up $BTC. Big rally will be following after some consolidation.”Daily RSI stood at near 87 at the time of writing, Data from Cointelegraph Markets Pro and TradingView showed.This is its highest since January 2021, months before BTC/USD set new all-time highs of $58,000 in April and $69,000 in November.
en.summary: There is plenty to be optimistic about when it comes to further BTC price gains, RSI analysis concludes. RSI has printed a long-awaited bullish divergence on weekly timeframes — something which has never happened before.

record.header: Here’s the Bitcoin price signal to watch for part two of bullish rally
record.subheader: As the bullish rally starts to wind down, Bitcoin investors and traders are looking for signs of its next extension.
record.content: As the bullish streak for Bitcoin (BTC) is starting to wind down, and the price moves into a sideways pattern, crypto traders and investors are looking at signs that could indicate when the next extension of the rally for the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization can be expected.Looking at the chart patterns, there are certain signals that stand out, allowing analysts to make reasonable assumptions about the price of Bitcoin for the near future, including the observations by the crypto analytics team TradingShot using the TradingView platform on January 20.The analysts first drew attention to the application of the Adam and Eve (A&E) pattern (a bullish double bottom pattern with twin bottoms at around the same price) that started forming since the FTX implosion in November and which was accurate with its target, even though it “went under the radar.”“As you see, Wednesday’s peak wasn’t just a consequence of the $21,500 resistance that was formed by the November 5 top but also completed a +18.00% rise from the December 14 high, which was a proportional rise (18%) from the November 21 low.”According to the analysis, Bitcoin is currently trading sideways and moving to test the four-hour moving average on 50 data points (4H MA50) for the first time since January 6. Furthermore, “a break can seek the 4H MA200 as its last support.”What to look for?On the basis of these movements, confirmations can be looked for “that will either lead to that correction or the extension of the rally,” or more precisely, the moving average convergence divergence (MACD) and relative strength index (RSI) indicators, as follows:“First, keep an eye on the 4H MACD. A bullish cross will be a signal to buy into round 2 of the rally. The 4H RSI has a clear higher lows trend-line as its support, and a lower highs trend-line is leading it there. A break above the lower highs earlier will again be a buy signal.”As a reminder, a bullish crossover happens when the MACD line crosses above the signal line presenting an entry point or buy opportunity for traders, as opposed to the bearish crossover that occurs when the MACD line crosses below the signal line indicating a sell opportunity or an exit point.Bitcoin price analysisMeanwhile, the flagship decentralized finance (DeFi) asset was at press time changing hands at the price of $21,104, up 1.79% across the previous 24 hours, as well as increasing 11.83% over the past week, adding up to the cumulative gains of 25.14% on its monthly chart.In the meantime, the crypto community at CoinMarketCap is bearish about BTC for the end of January, currently projecting it would be trading at the average price of $19.390 on January 31, which represents a drop of 8.09% from its current price.

ru.header: Bitcoin ожидает нового "большого ралли", поскольку RSI копирует восстановление медвежьего рынка в 2018 году
ru.subheader: Анализ RSI показывает, что есть много поводов для оптимизма, когда речь заходит о дальнейшем росте цен на BTC.
ru.content: There is plenty to be optimistic about when it comes to further BTC price gains, RSI analysis concludes.Markets NewsOwn this piece of historyCollect this article as an NFTBitcoin (BTC) is in for a new “big rally” as market strength copies conditions from after the 2018 bear market.According to the latest analysis, BTC/USD will continue to head higher “after some consolidation” thanks to key signals from its relative strength index (RSI).Bitcoin prints never-before-seen bullish divergenceWith the BTC price gains still coming, Bitcoin bulls are feeling increasingly confident despite widespread mistrust of the longevity of the current rally.For popular trader Crypto Wolf, a key phenomenon now underway sets Bitcoin’s latest recovery apart from all others.RSI, he noted on Jan. 18, had printed a long-awaited bullish divergence on weekly timeframes — something which has never happened before.“BTC printed a rare weekly RSI bullish divergence. Never happened in BTC history, a once in a life opportunity,” he summarized on Jan. 21.RSI is a fundamental gauge used by traders to determine whether an asset is overbought or oversold at a given price. The weekly print has been long in the making, with Cointelegraph reporting on its arrival in advance at the end of last year.“Technicals were there, charts were screaming bottom but as usual majority was in full bear mode,” Wolf added.Analyst: "Some consolidation" will precede upsideWith that, Bitcoin is beginning to repeat the kind of renaissance last seen at the end of its previous bear market in early 2019.Trader and analyst Trader Tardigrade, also known as Alan on social media, thus predicts that the good times will continue for a while to come.“BTC has been repeating the pattern in RSI and Price Action to 2019 bottom,” he told followers last week.“On daily chart, 1. RSI Strong uptrend to overbought zone 2. $BTC had a significant drop before that 3. Sudden buyers bought up $BTC. Big rally will be following after some consolidation.”Daily RSI stood at near 87 at the time of writing, Data from Cointelegraph Markets Pro and TradingView showed.This is its highest since January 2021, months before BTC/USD set new all-time highs of $58,000 in April and $69,000 in November.
ru.summary: Анализ RSI показывает, что есть много поводов для оптимизма, когда речь заходит о дальнейшем росте цен на BTC. RSI показал долгожданную бычью дивергенцию на недельных таймфреймах — чего раньше никогда не случалось.

en.header: The EU condemned the suppression of demonstrations by Peruvian security forces
en.content: On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU, the European Foreign Service (EU) official in connection with clashes in Peru between protesters and the police, stated that social and political crises should be overcome with full respect for constitutional order, the rule of law, human rights and the prevention of violence. "In recent days, violent clashes between protesters and the police have continued in Peru. The European Union regrets the very high number of victims since the start of the protests. Peaceful social protests that respect the rule of law are legitimate in a democratic society." According to a communiqué issued on Saturday in Brussels by the representative of EMU, "EU reiterates its condemnation of the widespread acts of violence as well as the disproportionate use of force by security forces". He said that the European Union welcomed the recent visit to Peru by representatives of the Inter-American Court of Human Rights to monitor the situation in the context of the current institutional crisis and social protests, and hoped that "national authorities would investigate and bring to justice those responsible for human rights abuses or violations." The European Union called on the Government and all political actors to take urgent measures to restore calm and ensure an inclusive dialogue involving civil society and affected communities in order to overcome the crisis, as stated in the communiqué, that protests had begun in Peru as a result of the crisis of power in early December, and that they had reached 11 regions of the country, demanding the resignation of President Dina Bolwarte, the dissolution of Parliament, the holding of general elections in 2023 and the convening of a constitutional assembly.

record.header: The President of Peru expressed readiness to continue the dialogue with the protesters
record.subheader: Peru's president, Dina Boluarte, stated in a televised message to fellow citizens that she was still counting on a dialogue with protesters who were demanding her resignation, and that she was passing on Radioprogramas del Peru.
record.content: Moscow. On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU, President of Peru, Dina Boluarta, in a televised message to fellow citizens, stated that she was still counting on a dialogue with protesters who were demanding her resignation, transmitting Radioprogramas del Peru. Her address was broadcast on 19 January, the evening of mass protests, including in Lima. "I do not intend to refuse dialogue. Those who make demands, I will not be tired of speaking, let us work for the country," said Bolwart. She added that all those who were observed to have been vandalized during the protests would receive a well-deserved punishment. "Our National Intelligence Agency is acting firmly, and soon, together with the Public Prosecutor's Office, we will receive confirmation and initiate trials against those who commit acts of violence, destroy private and public property," she said. Bolwarte also denied the information on her plans to resign on social media. On Friday night, protests in Lima broke into clashes with the police and riots. The police used tear gas. According to recent reports, one person was killed in the capital and about 40 were injured. According to AR, 55 people died in Peru since the start of the protests. The protests began in the country in early December following the removal of President Pedro Castillo, his supporters demand the resignation of Bolwart, who was formerly the Vice-President of the country, and they also demand the dissolution of Parliament and the holding of extraordinary general elections.

ru.header: ЕС осудил подавление демонстраций силами безопасности Перу
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Официальный представитель Европейской внешнеполитической службы (ЕВС) в связи со столкновениями в Перу протестующих и полиции заявил, что социальные и политические кризисы следует преодолевать при полном соблюдении конституционного порядка, верховенства права, прав человека и не допускать насилия."В последние дни в Перу продолжаются ожесточенные столкновения между протестующими и полицией. Европейский союз сожалеет об очень большом количестве жертв с начала протестов. Мирные социальные протесты, уважающие верховенство права, законны в демократическом обществе", - говорится в коммюнике, опубликованном в субботу в Брюсселе.Как отметил представитель ЕВС, "ЕС вновь заявляет о своем осуждении широко распространенных актов насилия, а также непропорционального применения силы подразделениями безопасности".Он сообщил, что в Евросоюзе приветствуют недавний визит в Перу представителей Межамериканского суда по правам человека для наблюдения за ситуацией в контексте нынешнего институционального кризиса и социальных протестов. В Брюсселе рассчитывают, что "национальные органы проведут расследование и привлекут к ответственности виновных в злоупотреблениях или нарушениях прав человека.ЕС призывает правительство и всех политических игроков принять срочные меры для восстановления спокойствия и обеспечения инклюзивного диалога с участием гражданского общества и затронутых сообществ с целью выхода из кризиса, сказано в коммюнике.Протесты начались в Перу вследствие кризиса власти в начале декабря. Они охватили 11 регионов страны.Участники акций требуют отставки президента страны Дины Болуарте, роспуска парламента, проведения всеобщих выборов в течение 2023 года и созыва конституционной ассамблеи.

en.header: The Czech presidential candidate received a letter with a live cartridge and threats
en.subheader: The former Prime Minister of the Czech Republic, presidential candidate Andrei Babis said that the guards handed him a letter addressed to his wife Monica.
en.content: Moscow. On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU, former Czech Prime Minister, presidential candidate Andrei Babish, reported that the guards had given him a letter addressed to his wife Monica. He said that the letter contained threats and a live ammunition in the envelope. The incident was reported by the media, in particular idnes.cz and Ceske Noviny. "It is about the intimidation of the presidential candidate and his family, which should not be in a free society", said Babish at a press conference, in which he refused to share other details with journalists. The atmosphere in social media and in society as a whole in the run-up to the second round, he said, was becoming increasingly radical; the police reported that an investigation was under way; that Babish had received a letter on Thursday; that the first round of elections had taken place in the Czech Republic on 13 and 14 January; that the former head of the NATO military committee, General Peter Pavel, had received 35.4 per cent of the votes in the reserve; that the dollar billionaire Babish, from 34.99 per cent, had taken second place; that the second round, which would determine the winner of the presidential race, would take place on 27 and 28 January; and that Babish had served as Prime Minister of the Czech Republic in 2017 and 2021.9 January 2023, the Prague Court acquitted Babish of the case concerning the illegal use of the 2 million euro grant from the EU. He was accused of illegally obtaining funds for the construction of the Stork's Nest centre.

record.header: Sandu said that Moldova will ask Romania for help in case of a military threat.
record.subheader: The crises that Moldova is currently facing are a heavy burden for the country, which it "cannot bear alone," said Moldovan President Sandu.
record.content: The crises that Moldova is currently facing represent a heavy burden for a country that it "can't bear alone", said Moldovan President Sandumaya Sandumaya Sandumoldavia, asking the allies for help in the event of a military conflict with Russia, as announced by Moldovan President Maya Sanda at a press conference in Bucharest, transmitting Digi24. "If Russia attempts to attack the Republic of Moldova, we will obviously turn for help", she said. Moldova feels a security threat, as the "Russian-Ukrainen Front" is approaching the border of the Republic. "The number of provocations by internal forces aimed at destabilizing the situation in Moldova will increase", she added. The Moldovan institutions closely monitor the situation in Transdniestria and analyse the risks. "We're concerned. We accept all scenarios, including the most pessimistic ones. We're preparing for all the scenarios," she concluded. The President of Romania, Klaus Johannis, in turn, stressed that Chishinev and Bucharest remained "the closest" partners and that Romania "will not give up" its neighbour, regardless of his situation. The Transdniestrian Republic of Moldova (MMR) announced its separation from Moldova in 1990. Until 1992, there was fighting, which ended with the signing of the truce. There are about 1,000 Russian peacekeepers on the territory of Transdniestria as part of the Russian Task Force. PACE recognized the region "occupied by Russia" on 15 March and the conflict on the territory of Transdniestria in 1992 considered Russia to be "a military act of aggression" against Moldova. In the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the wording of PACE was referred to as "unacceptable".The head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the unrecognized Republic of Vitaly Ignatiev, on 21 July, stated that Moldova's withdrawal from the 1992 agreement could be a prerequisite for the start of hostilities in Transdniestria and expressed the hope that Moldova would be able to resolve the issue with Transdniestria, since "membership in the EU without a solution to territorial and legal issues" and the country, together with Ukraine, had been granted the status of a candidate for the union at the end of June, and Ignatiev had not seen the possibility of settling the conflict by negotiation, since the "European perspective" of Moldova ran counter to the will of the inhabitants of the Transdniestrian. Tiraspol intends to seek independence with subsequent accession to Russia, he stressed, and since then Russian President Dmitry Peskov ' s press secretary has stated that the Kremlin has seen media reports about the Transdniestrian ' s plans to join Russia, but does not know what these publications have to do with.

ru.header: Кандидату в президенты Чехии пришло письмо с боевым патроном и угрозами
ru.subheader: Бывший премьер-министр Чехии, кандидат в президенты Андрей Бабиш сообщил, что охрана передала ему письмо на имя его супруги Моники.
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Бывший премьер-министр Чехии, кандидат в президенты Андрей Бабиш сообщил, что охрана передала ему письмо на имя его супруги Моники. В тексте письма, по его словам, содержались угрозы, а в конверт был вложен боевой патрон. Об инциденте сообщают СМИ, в частности, idnes.cz и Ceske Noviny."Речь идет о запугивании кандидата в президенты и членов его семьи, чего не должно быть в свободном обществе", - сказал Бабиш на пресс-конференции. При это он отказался делиться с журналистами другими подробностями.Атмосфера в социальных сетях и в целом в обществе в преддверии второго тура, по его словам, становится все более радикальной.В полиции сообщили, что ведется расследование. Там уточнили, что письмо Бабиш получил в четверг.В Чехии 13-14 января состоялся первый тур выборов. Бывший глава военного комитета НАТО генерал армии в запасе Петр Павел получил 35,4% голосов избирателей. Долларовый миллиардер Бабиш с 34,99% занял второе место. Второй тур выборов, который определит победителя президентской гонки, состоится 27-28 января.Бабиш занимал пост премьер-министра Чехии в 2017-2021 годах.9 января 2023 года пражский суд оправдал Бабиша по делу о незаконном использовании субсидии в 2 млн евро от ЕС. Он обвинялся в том, что нелегальным путем получил средства на строительство центра Stork's Nest.

en.header: The former chief economist of the IMF predicted "incredible poverty" in Russia
en.subheader: Russia is moving towards becoming a "giant Iran," the economist believes
en.content: Professor of Economics at Harvard University, former IMF chief economist Kenneth Rogoff had predicted "unbelievable poverty" in Russia. He made a statement at a forum in Davos. "Look at Iran, North Korea, Cuba, Venezuela – that's where Russia is going. She's going to become Cuba, "Gigant Iran." Incredible poverty compared to what Russians used to be," Rogoff said.
en.summary: Russia is moving towards a "giant Iran," the Harvard economist said. According to him, this will happen if there is no economic growth in the country.

record.header: The situation in the global economy is better than expected, but risks remain - IMF Chief
record.content: Moscow – January 20, INTERFAX.RU – The world economy does not feel as bad as expected a few months ago, but this does not mean that it is in good condition, said the Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), Kristalina Georgieva, in his address to the World Economic Forum in Davos. "Inflation seems to have begun to move in the right direction, i.e. declining, especially with regard to basic inflation", Georgiev said, and noted that the removal of quarantine restrictions in China, which should support global growth, is also a positive factor for the world economy. "Let us recall that in 2022, the GDP growth rate of the PRC for the first time in 40 years was lower than the world average," she said. Now that the Chinese economy is reopened, the IMF expects its growth rate again to exceed the world average this year." We are projecting a 2.7 per cent increase in global GDP in 2023, which could be slightly adjusted in the coming days. We expect the Chinese economy to rise by 4.4 per cent this year," Georgiev stated. As a positive factor for the global economy, it also noted a significant increase in the labour markets of many countries. This, she said, supported consumer spending and thus the economy as a whole. "What should we worry about? First, the economy's growth rate of 2.7 per cent cannot be considered outstanding - the weakest increase in GDP in recent decades, apart from the period of the global financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic," said Georgiev. Second, there is no certainty as to how inflation will behave. "What if the good news of faster growth in the Chinese economy turns out to be a surge in oil and gas prices that will increase inflation?", she pointed out. As a third negative factor, Georgiev highlighted the situation in Ukraine, highlighting the risks it posed for Europe.

ru.header: Бывший главный экономист МВФ предрек «невероятную бедность» в России
ru.subheader: Россия движется к тому, чтобы стать "гигантским Ираном", считает экономист
ru.content: Профессор экономики Гарвардского университета, бывший главный экономист МВФ Кеннет Рогофф предрек «невероятную бедность» в России. Соответствующее заявление он сделал, выступая на форуме в Давосе.«Посмотрите на Иран, на Северную Корею, на Кубу, на Венесуэлу – вот куда идет Россия. Она идет к тому, чтобы стать Кубой, «гигантским Ираном». Невероятная бедность по сравнению с тем, к чему привыкли россияне», - заявил Рогофф.
ru.summary: Россия движется к «гигантскому Ирану», — заявил экономист Гарварда. По его словам, это произойдет в том случае, если в стране не будет экономического роста.

en.header: The Bulgarian Ministry of Defense has denied data on the sale of the Su-25 to Ukraine
en.subheader: The Bulgarian Defense Ministry denied Bloomberg's information about the sale of 14 Su-25 aircraft for Kiev.
en.content: The Bulgarian Ministry of Defence denied the information of Bloomberg that the country had handed over 14 Soo-25 aircraft to Ukraine through intermediaries, reports Novinite. "The Ministry of Defence has not sold or provided to the States of NATO the Soo-25 aircraft destined for Ukraine," says the statement. Earlier, the head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bulgaria, Nikolai Milkov, stated that he had no information on the transfer to Ukraine of 14 Soviet assaulters.
en.summary: The Bulgarian Ministry of Defense has denied information that Bulgaria handed over 14 Su-25 fighters to Ukraine. According to Bulgarian Defense Minister Boyko Borisov, this is not true.

record.header: The Russian Foreign Ministry announced that the UN was distorting the facts about the implementation of the Black Sea Initiative
record.content: Moscow: On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU - Russia does not confirm the data published by the UN Secretariat on the "black Sea Initiative": 64 vessels are parked in Ukrainian ports and in inspection zones; the trans-shipment of ammonia through the "Toliatti-Odessa" pipeline was to begin as part of the implementation of the "black Sea Initiative" without additional agreements; the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation informs the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation. "In connection with the report to the media on the "black Sea Initiative" published by the UN Secretariat, it is in fact a matter of manipulation and reversal of the facts, which requires the provision of real data and assessments by Russia as a party (unlike the United Nations) to the two agreements concluded in Istanbul on 22 July 2022," the report published on Saturday on the website of the Russian foreign policy office. On Smolen Square, 668 vessels with 18,224,860 tons of food on board were said to have left the ports of Odessa, Black Sea and South (as of 20 January) as part of the Black Sea Initiative. "In the cargo range, 46.1 per cent is occupied by feed corn, 5.9 per cent by shroth, 5.5 per cent by rape and other animal feed crops, the proportion of wheat is only 27.57 per cent, but it is emphasized in the United Nations bulletin. "The clear aim is to provide "right" humanitarian figures on recipients of "emerging economies" (a total of 64 per cent) for some reason to include States such as Israel, South Korea and the Gulf monarchies, which are clearly not experiencing difficulties in the development of the economy or food security", the report states. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs added that "the real geography of Ukrainian food recipients is as follows: high-income countries (EU, Great Britain, etc.) received 8.6 million tons of cargo (47 per cent), higher-middle income (China, Jordan, Malaysia, etc.) 6.1 million tons (33 per cent), lower-middle-income countries (Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, Pakistan, etc.) 2.9 million tons (16 per cent). Only 551,527 tons (3 per cent) were sent to countries in need (Somalia, Ethiopia, the Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan and Djibouti), including 396,169 tons (2 per cent) by vessels chartered by WFP." The Russian foreign policy department added: "It is noteworthy that the share of these States in general statistics is declining - almost 4 per cent in the first 120 days of the initiative, now 3 per cent. It should be noted that it is for this reason that the United Nations quickly reclassified the "black Sea Initiative" from humanitarian to commercial and refused to publish information on the recipients of cargo under the pretext of commercial secrecy." "There is also no evidence from the United Nations press release that more than 100 vessels are located in Turkish territorial waters and connected to the initiative, as well as an average waiting time of 21 days. At present, 64 vessels are parked in Ukrainian ports and inspection zones, the list of priorities for their checks and passage is drawn up by the Ukrainian side, and the Russian representatives have no influence over it," stated to the Ministry. "At the same time, attention has been drawn on several occasions to the problem of artificial accumulation of dry cargo in the port of Istanbul, which is being created by Ukrainian traders chartering vessels without taking into account agreed rules and the timing of registration and participation in the initiative," is noted on Smallen Square. In the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Russian Federation stressed that "until such vessels are included in the initiative, they cannot be considered participants and the Joint Coordination Centre in Istanbul is not responsible for them". The Ministry added that the United Nations communication specifically referred to the task of resuming the export of ammonia from the port of the South as set out in the Black Sea Initiative. "Despite the fact that such removal of fertilizers, including ammonia, should have started at the same time as the transport of Ukrainian food, the document vaguely reported some discussions between certain parties with a view to reaching an agreement", added there. "Russian position on this matter has been repeatedly and in detail communicated to the United Nations - the trans-shipment of ammonia should have started as part of the implementation of the "black Sea Initiative." No additional arrangements should be required in this regard. The technical possibilities for resuscitating the pipeline are available. Just as the willingness of the companies servicing it has been expressed by the Russian agency." "Only and exclusively, Kiev's consent is lacking, blocking the supply of fertilizer raw materials (sufficient to provide food to 200 million people), leaving them with a set of political preconditions from the release of prisoners of war to assistance in the sale of stolen goods. The United Nations, which is actively calling for the expansion of Ukrainian grain exports, is not working specifically on this issue. They're referring to some kind of negotiation. It is not clear, the truth is, between whom and what, since Russian representatives are not involved in any such contacts," the report says. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs ' fertilisers ' exports stressed that "at the very end of the UN ' s information sheet, literally in one paragraph, reference is made to the second document, signed in Istanbul on 22 July 2022, on the normalization of Russian exports of agricultural products and fertilizers". "It is silent, however, that both arrangements are integral parts of the same "package" proposed by Antonio Guterrish and should be implemented in conjunction with each other," was added at the Ministry. The Russian Federation considers that the implementation of Moscow's proposal for the donation of 262,000 tons of fertilizer to the poorest countries to be particularly indicative in this regard. "The official appeal to the UN Secretary of State on 7 September 2022, provided all the necessary information and information," was added. "The first and only shipment of 20,000 tons of produce was sent from the Netherlands to Malawi on 28 November 2022. The Russian side further assumed all the costs of delivering and transporting the goods, as well as paying the "intermediation services" of the UN/WFP in the amount of $200,000. "Even though it is a humanitarian operation and assistance to those in need in the run-up to the new planting season," the report states. "The revenues to the port of Mozambique on 28 December 2022 and must now be on the way to Malawi. Thus, it took almost five months for only one and a small portion of the United Nations-sponsored fertilizer to be shipped and the cargo had not yet reached the recipient," was added to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation. In Smolen Square, it is believed that "if the implementation of this purely humanitarian initiative is progressing so hard and twirling, we clearly do not have to talk about normalizing our exports of agricultural products and fertilizers with the help of the United Nations".

ru.header: Минобороны Болгарии опровергло данные о продаже Су-25 для Украины
ru.subheader: Минобороны Болгарии опровергло информацию Bloomberg о продаже 14 самолетов Су-25 для Киева
ru.content: Министерство обороны Болгарии опровергло информацию Bloomberg, что страна передала 14 самолетов Су-25 Украине через посредников, сообщает Novinite.«Министерство обороны не продавало и не предоставляло государствам НАТО самолеты Су-25, предназначенные для Украины», — говорится в заявлении.Ранее и.о. главы МИД Болгарии Николай Милков заявил, что у него нет информации о передаче Украине 14 штурмовиков советского производства.Ранее агентство Bloomberg сообщило, что Болгария продала другим странам НАТО 14 штурмовиков Су-25, которые были позже переданы Украине. Агентство написало об этом 15 января со ссылкой на нидерландскую аналитическую компанию Oryx.
ru.summary: Болгарское министерство обороны опровергло информацию о том, что Болгария передала Украине 14 истребителей Су-25. По словам министра обороны Болгарии Бойко Борисова, это не соответствует действительности.

en.header: Cardano (ADA) Might Become 10x More Resource-efficient With This Release
en.subheader: New programming language Aiken is set to make Cardano (ADA) development more efficient than ever before
en.content: Cardano (ADA) staking enthusiasts shared details of an upcoming development in the Cardano (ADA) ecosystem. Its new programming language might change the narrative in the way Cardano (ADA) leverages its resources.New programming language for cheaper, smaller and resource-efficient smart contractsThe Cardano (ADA) staking team Cardano Fans (pool ticker CRFA) took to Twitter to share stress-testing details of a new programming language that could replace Plutus in the ecosystem.1/ @berry_ales re-wrote Nebula from PlutusTx to Aiken. Numbers are shocking.This is not even funny. When we say that Aiken is one of Cardano's dark horse for 2023 - what we mean is not only an easier development experience (c-alike functional syntax without mutability) but also: pic.twitter.com/ZjgkVQ1Y27— $matiwinnetou | C₳rdano F₳ns (CRF₳): INDY/FRL (@matiwinnetou) January 20, 2023According to its statement, Cardano (ADA) enthusiast Alessandro Konrad (@berry_ales on Twitter), CEO and co-founder of the SpaceBudz collection, creator of Nami Wallet and operator of Berry Pool, just rewrote the Nebula app in the Aiken language and tested its resource-efficiency.When it comes to memory usage, CPU resources consumption and network fees, all operations with Aiken (token buying, token selling, order cancellation and so on) were up to 10x more effective than with Plutus.Cardano (ADA) enthusiasts cannot hide their excitement and are sure that this release will be a game changer in the Cardano (ADA) ecosystem in the coming months:Numbers are shocking. This is not even funny. When we say that Aiken is one of Cardano's dark horse for 2023As covered by U.Today previously, Plutus is a Haskell-style Cardano-specific smart contract language optimized for decentralized applications.Enhancing developer experience for Cardano (ADA) dAppsDevelopers are also sure that "more advanced smart contract scripts" will be released with Aiken. As of mid-January 2023, the language is approaching Alpha release.Last week, Cardano (ADA) developers already made headlines by releasing the first version of Cardano (ADA) smart contracts in Eopsin, a novel Pythonic programming language.This development is set to introduce Cardano (ADA) to all enthusiasts of Python, which is considered the go-to language for newbies in programming.
en.summary: New programming language Aiken is set to make Cardano (ADA) development more efficient than ever before. New programming language for cheaper, smaller and resource-efficient smart contracts. Aiken could replace Plutus in the ecosystem.

record.header: Cardano Update To Happen In Feb, ADA Price Rallies Nearly 2%
record.content: The crypto world woke up to the year’s first bankruptcy case filed by Genesis Global. This bankruptcy case happens to be a major blow to Barry Silbert’s Digital Currency Group as well. However, the crypto market is showing mixed signals.The world’s first cryptocurrency, Bitcoin is selling at $20,951 with a surge of 0.88% in the last 24hrs. The similar pattern is followed by other altcoins including Cardano which has gained nearly 2% in the last 24hrs. The experts claim that the upcoming updates of Cardano network will fuel ADA prices.As per the reports, the update is scheduled to take place on Feb 11 and is set to happen on test networks. While immediately after three days, that is Feb 14 the next update will be introduced. Once the update is successful, the smart contract developers on Plutus will have multi-threshold signature designs.Cardano network’s IOHK Tim Harrison has shared the data related to upcoming updates on the network. This upgrade is focused on improving its interoperability along with supporting decentralized cross-chain applications.The cross-chain applications will be supported once the update influences cryptographic primitives that are used on the network. This can be done when the common digital signature standards are introduced in the Plutus smart contract platform.Next, Harrison describes the current issues with the algorithms which require more time, effort and are also expensive when connected with other blockchain networks like Bitcoin. Hence, the embedded features have to be introduced to support Cardano’s main digital signature called Ed25519 along with ECDSA and Schmitt signatures.
