en.header: The ambassador denied the call to the Canadian Foreign Ministry because of Lavrov's words about the "Russian issue"
en.subheader: Ambassador to Canada Stepanov: the call to the Foreign Ministry was connected with what happened in the Dnieper
en.content: Oleg Stepanov Wizards of Russia's Ambassador to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Canada was solely connected with the destruction of a residential home in Dniepre, where more than 40 people died, Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov's remarks were not discussed, told the head of the Russian Dypmission Oleg Stepanov himself, transmitting "RIA Novosti." Earlier, the head of the Canadian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Melanie Joli, stated that Stepanov had been called to discuss, among other things, Lavrov's statement, which called the West's goal "the final decision of the "Russian question" and compared the action to create a Russian coalition with the actions of Adolf Hitler. "I also saw this statement by Joli, in fact, post-factum, after the meeting. He was a little surprised because this invitation to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs was for the Canadian side to make a demarche about the tragedy in Dnipropetrovsk. He said it was exclusively about that." He added that he rejected the Canadian side's attempts to hold Russia responsible for what had happened in Dniepre. According to Stepanov, the tragedy had been caused by the deployment of military infrastructure in residential areas by Ukrainian forces, which he had pointed out to the Canadian authorities. In the Kremlin, the Russian military stated that they did not attack residential homes and social infrastructure. "The strikes are directed at military targets that are obvious and disguised," said the press secretary of Russian President Dmitry Peskov. The Russian post in the United Nations, Vasili Nebenzia, referred to what happened in Dniepre, stated that the Russian missile had been hit by Ukrainian air defence equipment. The former freelance adviser of the Ukrainian President's office, Alexei Arrestovich, had previously reported the same. He later named his words "an earlier false version" and apologized. He also resigned from the office of the Ukrainian leader.
en.summary: Russian Ambassador to Canada Oleg Stepanov said that the call to the Russian Foreign Ministry was connected with the death of more than 40 people in the Dnieper as a result of the collapse of a residential building.

record.header: The Russian Foreign Ministry announced that the UN was distorting the facts about the implementation of the Black Sea Initiative
record.content: Moscow: On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU - Russia does not confirm the data published by the UN Secretariat on the "black Sea Initiative": 64 vessels are parked in Ukrainian ports and in inspection zones; the trans-shipment of ammonia through the "Toliatti-Odessa" pipeline was to begin as part of the implementation of the "black Sea Initiative" without additional agreements; the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation informs the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation. "In connection with the report to the media on the "black Sea Initiative" published by the UN Secretariat, it is in fact a matter of manipulation and reversal of the facts, which requires the provision of real data and assessments by Russia as a party (unlike the United Nations) to the two agreements concluded in Istanbul on 22 July 2022," the report published on Saturday on the website of the Russian foreign policy office. On Smolen Square, 668 vessels with 18,224,860 tons of food on board were said to have left the ports of Odessa, Black Sea and South (as of 20 January) as part of the Black Sea Initiative. "In the cargo range, 46.1 per cent is occupied by feed corn, 5.9 per cent by shroth, 5.5 per cent by rape and other animal feed crops, the proportion of wheat is only 27.57 per cent, but it is emphasized in the United Nations bulletin. "The clear aim is to provide "right" humanitarian figures on recipients of "emerging economies" (a total of 64 per cent) for some reason to include States such as Israel, South Korea and the Gulf monarchies, which are clearly not experiencing difficulties in the development of the economy or food security", the report states. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs added that "the real geography of Ukrainian food recipients is as follows: high-income countries (EU, Great Britain, etc.) received 8.6 million tons of cargo (47 per cent), higher-middle income (China, Jordan, Malaysia, etc.) 6.1 million tons (33 per cent), lower-middle-income countries (Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, Pakistan, etc.) 2.9 million tons (16 per cent). Only 551,527 tons (3 per cent) were sent to countries in need (Somalia, Ethiopia, the Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan and Djibouti), including 396,169 tons (2 per cent) by vessels chartered by WFP." The Russian foreign policy department added: "It is noteworthy that the share of these States in general statistics is declining - almost 4 per cent in the first 120 days of the initiative, now 3 per cent. It should be noted that it is for this reason that the United Nations quickly reclassified the "black Sea Initiative" from humanitarian to commercial and refused to publish information on the recipients of cargo under the pretext of commercial secrecy." "There is also no evidence from the United Nations press release that more than 100 vessels are located in Turkish territorial waters and connected to the initiative, as well as an average waiting time of 21 days. At present, 64 vessels are parked in Ukrainian ports and inspection zones, the list of priorities for their checks and passage is drawn up by the Ukrainian side, and the Russian representatives have no influence over it," stated to the Ministry. "At the same time, attention has been drawn on several occasions to the problem of artificial accumulation of dry cargo in the port of Istanbul, which is being created by Ukrainian traders chartering vessels without taking into account agreed rules and the timing of registration and participation in the initiative," is noted on Smallen Square. In the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Russian Federation stressed that "until such vessels are included in the initiative, they cannot be considered participants and the Joint Coordination Centre in Istanbul is not responsible for them". The Ministry added that the United Nations communication specifically referred to the task of resuming the export of ammonia from the port of the South as set out in the Black Sea Initiative. "Despite the fact that such removal of fertilizers, including ammonia, should have started at the same time as the transport of Ukrainian food, the document vaguely reported some discussions between certain parties with a view to reaching an agreement", added there. "Russian position on this matter has been repeatedly and in detail communicated to the United Nations - the trans-shipment of ammonia should have started as part of the implementation of the "black Sea Initiative." No additional arrangements should be required in this regard. The technical possibilities for resuscitating the pipeline are available. Just as the willingness of the companies servicing it has been expressed by the Russian agency." "Only and exclusively, Kiev's consent is lacking, blocking the supply of fertilizer raw materials (sufficient to provide food to 200 million people), leaving them with a set of political preconditions from the release of prisoners of war to assistance in the sale of stolen goods. The United Nations, which is actively calling for the expansion of Ukrainian grain exports, is not working specifically on this issue. They're referring to some kind of negotiation. It is not clear, the truth is, between whom and what, since Russian representatives are not involved in any such contacts," the report says. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs ' fertilisers ' exports stressed that "at the very end of the UN ' s information sheet, literally in one paragraph, reference is made to the second document, signed in Istanbul on 22 July 2022, on the normalization of Russian exports of agricultural products and fertilizers". "It is silent, however, that both arrangements are integral parts of the same "package" proposed by Antonio Guterrish and should be implemented in conjunction with each other," was added at the Ministry. The Russian Federation considers that the implementation of Moscow's proposal for the donation of 262,000 tons of fertilizer to the poorest countries to be particularly indicative in this regard. "The official appeal to the UN Secretary of State on 7 September 2022, provided all the necessary information and information," was added. "The first and only shipment of 20,000 tons of produce was sent from the Netherlands to Malawi on 28 November 2022. The Russian side further assumed all the costs of delivering and transporting the goods, as well as paying the "intermediation services" of the UN/WFP in the amount of $200,000. "Even though it is a humanitarian operation and assistance to those in need in the run-up to the new planting season," the report states. "The revenues to the port of Mozambique on 28 December 2022 and must now be on the way to Malawi. Thus, it took almost five months for only one and a small portion of the United Nations-sponsored fertilizer to be shipped and the cargo had not yet reached the recipient," was added to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation. In Smolen Square, it is believed that "if the implementation of this purely humanitarian initiative is progressing so hard and twirling, we clearly do not have to talk about normalizing our exports of agricultural products and fertilizers with the help of the United Nations".

ru.header: Посол опроверг вызов в МИД Канады из-за слов Лаврова о «русском вопросе»
ru.subheader: Посол в Канаде Степанов: вызов в МИД был связан с произошедшим в Днепре
ru.content: Олег СтепановВызов посла России в МИД Канады был связан исключительно с разрушением жилого дома в Днепре, где погибли более 40 человек, высказывания российского министра иностранных дел Сергея Лаврова не обсуждались, рассказал сам глава российской дипмиссии Олег Степанов, передает «РИА Новости».Ранее глава канадского МИДа Мелани Жоли заявила, что Степанова вызвали, чтобы в том числе обсудить заявление Лаврова, который назвал целью Запада «окончательное решение «русского вопроса» и сравнил действия по созданию противостоящей России коалиции с поступками Адольфа Гитлера.«Я тоже увидел это заявление Жоли, по сути, постфактум — после встречи. Немножко удивился, потому что это приглашение в МИД было для того, чтобы канадская сторона сделала мне демарш по поводу трагедии в Днепропетровске. Речь шла исключительно об этом», — сказал Степанов.Он добавил, что отверг попытки канадской стороны возложить на Россию ответственность за произошедшее в Днепре. По словам Степанова, трагедия произошла из-за размещения военной инфраструктуры в жилых кварталах украинскими силами, на что он и указал канадским властям.Речь идет о взрыве в многоэтажке в Днепре 14 января, в результате которого обрушился подъезд. Перед этим по всей стране была объявлена воздушная тревога, власти сообщали о работе ПВО. По словам мэра Бориса Филатова, тогда погибли 44 человека. Киев обвинил в произошедшем Москву.В Кремле заявили, что российские военные не наносят ударов по жилым домам и по объектам социальной инфраструктуры. «Удары наносятся по военным целям, очевидным и замаскированным», — сказал пресс-секретарь российского президента Дмитрий Песков.Постпред России при ООН Василий Небензя, говоря о произошедшем в Днепре, заявил, что российская ракета была подбита средствами ПВО Украины. До этого о том же сообщил бывший внештатный советник офиса украинского президента Алексей Арестович. Позднее он назвал свои слова «преждевременной ошибочной версией» и извинился. Кроме того, Арестович подал в отставку. В офисе украинского лидера ее приняли.
ru.summary: Посол России в Канаде Олег Степанов заявил, что вызов в МИД России был связан с гибелью в Днепре более 40 человек в результате обрушения жилого дома.

record.header: The Russian Foreign Ministry announced that the UN was distorting the facts about the implementation of the Black Sea Initiative
record.content: Moscow: On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU - Russia does not confirm the data published by the UN Secretariat on the "black Sea Initiative": 64 vessels are parked in Ukrainian ports and in inspection zones; the trans-shipment of ammonia through the "Toliatti-Odessa" pipeline was to begin as part of the implementation of the "black Sea Initiative" without additional agreements; the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation informs the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation. "In connection with the report to the media on the "black Sea Initiative" published by the UN Secretariat, it is in fact a matter of manipulation and reversal of the facts, which requires the provision of real data and assessments by Russia as a party (unlike the United Nations) to the two agreements concluded in Istanbul on 22 July 2022," the report published on Saturday on the website of the Russian foreign policy office. On Smolen Square, 668 vessels with 18,224,860 tons of food on board were said to have left the ports of Odessa, Black Sea and South (as of 20 January) as part of the Black Sea Initiative. "In the cargo range, 46.1 per cent is occupied by feed corn, 5.9 per cent by shroth, 5.5 per cent by rape and other animal feed crops, the proportion of wheat is only 27.57 per cent, but it is emphasized in the United Nations bulletin. "The clear aim is to provide "right" humanitarian figures on recipients of "emerging economies" (a total of 64 per cent) for some reason to include States such as Israel, South Korea and the Gulf monarchies, which are clearly not experiencing difficulties in the development of the economy or food security", the report states. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs added that "the real geography of Ukrainian food recipients is as follows: high-income countries (EU, Great Britain, etc.) received 8.6 million tons of cargo (47 per cent), higher-middle income (China, Jordan, Malaysia, etc.) 6.1 million tons (33 per cent), lower-middle-income countries (Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, Pakistan, etc.) 2.9 million tons (16 per cent). Only 551,527 tons (3 per cent) were sent to countries in need (Somalia, Ethiopia, the Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan and Djibouti), including 396,169 tons (2 per cent) by vessels chartered by WFP." The Russian foreign policy department added: "It is noteworthy that the share of these States in general statistics is declining - almost 4 per cent in the first 120 days of the initiative, now 3 per cent. It should be noted that it is for this reason that the United Nations quickly reclassified the "black Sea Initiative" from humanitarian to commercial and refused to publish information on the recipients of cargo under the pretext of commercial secrecy." "There is also no evidence from the United Nations press release that more than 100 vessels are located in Turkish territorial waters and connected to the initiative, as well as an average waiting time of 21 days. At present, 64 vessels are parked in Ukrainian ports and inspection zones, the list of priorities for their checks and passage is drawn up by the Ukrainian side, and the Russian representatives have no influence over it," stated to the Ministry. "At the same time, attention has been drawn on several occasions to the problem of artificial accumulation of dry cargo in the port of Istanbul, which is being created by Ukrainian traders chartering vessels without taking into account agreed rules and the timing of registration and participation in the initiative," is noted on Smallen Square. In the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Russian Federation stressed that "until such vessels are included in the initiative, they cannot be considered participants and the Joint Coordination Centre in Istanbul is not responsible for them". The Ministry added that the United Nations communication specifically referred to the task of resuming the export of ammonia from the port of the South as set out in the Black Sea Initiative. "Despite the fact that such removal of fertilizers, including ammonia, should have started at the same time as the transport of Ukrainian food, the document vaguely reported some discussions between certain parties with a view to reaching an agreement", added there. "Russian position on this matter has been repeatedly and in detail communicated to the United Nations - the trans-shipment of ammonia should have started as part of the implementation of the "black Sea Initiative." No additional arrangements should be required in this regard. The technical possibilities for resuscitating the pipeline are available. Just as the willingness of the companies servicing it has been expressed by the Russian agency." "Only and exclusively, Kiev's consent is lacking, blocking the supply of fertilizer raw materials (sufficient to provide food to 200 million people), leaving them with a set of political preconditions from the release of prisoners of war to assistance in the sale of stolen goods. The United Nations, which is actively calling for the expansion of Ukrainian grain exports, is not working specifically on this issue. They're referring to some kind of negotiation. It is not clear, the truth is, between whom and what, since Russian representatives are not involved in any such contacts," the report says. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs ' fertilisers ' exports stressed that "at the very end of the UN ' s information sheet, literally in one paragraph, reference is made to the second document, signed in Istanbul on 22 July 2022, on the normalization of Russian exports of agricultural products and fertilizers". "It is silent, however, that both arrangements are integral parts of the same "package" proposed by Antonio Guterrish and should be implemented in conjunction with each other," was added at the Ministry. The Russian Federation considers that the implementation of Moscow's proposal for the donation of 262,000 tons of fertilizer to the poorest countries to be particularly indicative in this regard. "The official appeal to the UN Secretary of State on 7 September 2022, provided all the necessary information and information," was added. "The first and only shipment of 20,000 tons of produce was sent from the Netherlands to Malawi on 28 November 2022. The Russian side further assumed all the costs of delivering and transporting the goods, as well as paying the "intermediation services" of the UN/WFP in the amount of $200,000. "Even though it is a humanitarian operation and assistance to those in need in the run-up to the new planting season," the report states. "The revenues to the port of Mozambique on 28 December 2022 and must now be on the way to Malawi. Thus, it took almost five months for only one and a small portion of the United Nations-sponsored fertilizer to be shipped and the cargo had not yet reached the recipient," was added to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation. In Smolen Square, it is believed that "if the implementation of this purely humanitarian initiative is progressing so hard and twirling, we clearly do not have to talk about normalizing our exports of agricultural products and fertilizers with the help of the United Nations".

en.header: Elon Musk & Billy Markus Criticize SBF Following $700M Seizure
en.content: In the early hours today, the US Federal prosecutors seized nearly $700 million in cash and assets which are in connection with FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried. As per the reports most of these assets were in the form of Robinhood shares held by SBF. Earlier in May Sam Bankman-Fried had claimed to have acquired a 7.6% stake in Robinhood.As per the court filings made on Jan 20, federal investigations in the Southern District of New York have taken hold of FTX’s assets. Also the US prosecutor mentioned 10 accounts which have shares, cash and cryptocurrency.Federal Prosecutors Seize $700M From SBFFollowing the seizure of $700M from SBF, Dogecoin co-founder Billy Markus and Twitter head Elon Musk have taken this opportunity to criticize SBF and his stance. Billy Markus penned a sarcastic quote pointing towards SBF’s earlier claim where SBF had claimed to have left with only $100K.In reply to Billy Markus’ post, Elon Musk was quick enough to comment with two ROFL emojis. Since the time FTX went into bankruptcy, Elon Musk and Billy Markus have been condemning SBF for misleading investors.FTX filed its bankruptcy in November 2022 after SBF was charged with using USD that belonged to FTX customers. However, he pleaded not guilty to those charges and is currently under house arrest at his parents’ place. His next trial is scheduled for October, 2023. Earlier this week the federal prosecutors had seized $100 million from SBF’s Silvergate Bank which was linked to Bahamas FTX Digital Markets.
en.summary: Federal prosecutors seized nearly $700 million in cash and assets. SBF had claimed to have acquired a 7.6% stake in FTX

record.header: U.S. Lays Claim to $700 Million of Assets Linked to Bankman-Fried, FTX
record.subheader: The U.S. seized $700 million of former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried’s assets and is now seeking their forfeiture.
record.content: The U.S. government wants to take control of nearly $700 million of assets it seized earlier this month from former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried, according to court filings Friday.Included in the property are over 55 million Robinhood shares worth about $525 million. Bought with borrowed Alameda money, those shares were at the center of a fight between Bankman-Fried, FTX Group and BlockFi. Officials are also moving to claim $171 million in cash from a series of bank accounts linked to Bankman-Fried’s web of companies.The government seized those assets and more in early January and are now seeking their forfeiture, per a bill of particulars filed late Friday in Bankman-Fried’s criminal case.“We believe that these assets are not property in the bankruptcy estate” or are subject to exemptions, meaning they don't have to be frozen like most FTX assets are, pending wind-up, a government lawyer previously told the judge in this case.

en.header: A three-day mourning period was announced in Brovary after the helicopter crash
en.subheader: Three days of mourning were announced in Brovary after the helicopter crash with the head of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Ukraine
en.content: Flowers and toys placed near the crash site.In the Ukrainian city of Brovara, where a helicopter crashed on the morning of 18 January with Denis of Monastyrsky, head of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Ukraine, a three-day mourning was announced from 19 to 21 January. This was reported by the mayor of Igor Sapojko on television channel. "In connection with the tragedy that took place today in Brovar, 19, 20 and 21 January, a day of mourning was declared," he wrote. The helicopter, which flew with the other leaders of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, fell in Brovary on the morning of 18 January. After the helicopter crash, there was an explosion and a fire. According to the Ministry, Monastyrsky himself, his deputy Evgeny Yenin, the State Secretary of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Ukraine, Yuri Lubkovic, and four other Ministry staff members died in an aircraft crash, and a helicopter commander, a pilot, an on-board mechanic and several civilians, including children on the ground, were killed. The Ukrainian State Security Service confirmed the death of a total of 14 persons. More than 20 others were injured.
en.summary: In the Ukrainian city of Brovary, mourning has been declared for those killed in a helicopter crash with the Minister of Internal Affairs of Ukraine Arsen Avakov.

record.header: Erdogan told Zelensky about his readiness to contribute to the settlement in Ukraine
record.subheader: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan discussed by phone with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky the prospects for resolving the Ukrainian conflict, Anadolu reports.
record.content: On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU, the President of Turkey, Recep Tayip Erdoğan, discussed by telephone with the President of Ukraine Vladimir Zelensky the prospects for a solution to the Ukrainian conflict, Anadolu reports. In particular, Erdoğan noted "the readiness of Ankara for a diplomatic contribution to the long-term peace between Moscow and Kiev." He also expressed his condolences to Zelensky for the crash in Kiev of a helicopter carrying Denis Monastyrsky, head of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Ukraine.

ru.header: В Броварах объявили трехдневный траур после крушения вертолета
ru.subheader: В Броварах объявили трехдневный траур после крушения вертолета с главой МВД Украины
ru.content: Цветы и игрушки, возложенные вблизи места крушения вертолетаВ украинском городе Бровары, где утром 18 января разбился вертолет с главой МВД Украины Денисом Монастырским, объявлен трехдневный траур с 19 по 21 января. Об этом сообщил в телеграм-канале мэр города Игорь Сапожко.«В связи с трагедией, произошедшей сегодня в Броварах, 19, 20 и 21 января объявлены днями траура», — написал он.Вертолет, на котором летел Монастырский вместе с другими руководителями МВД, упал в Броварах утром 18 января. Он потерпел крушение недалеко от жилого дома и детского сада. После падения вертолета произошел взрыв и начался пожар.В авиакатастрофе, по данным ведомства, погиб сам Монастырский, его заместитель Евгений Енин, государственный секретарь МВД Украины Юрий Лубкович и еще четыре сотрудника министерства. Также погибли командир вертолета, пилот, бортовой механик и несколько гражданских лиц, в том числе находившиеся на земле дети. Госслужба по ЧС Украины подтвердила гибель в общей сложности 14 человек. Еще более 20 человек пострадали.Президент Украины Владимир Зеленский назвал происшествие «ужасной трагедией». Власти сформировали специальную комиссию для расследования причин крушения. Служба безопасности Украины (СБУ) рассматривает три версии катастрофы — нарушение правил полета, техническая неисправность и умышленные действия в целях уничтожения воздушного транспорта.
ru.summary: В украинском Броварах объявлен траур по погибшим при крушении вертолета с министром внутренних дел Украины Арсеном Аваковым.

en.header: Bitcoin's 20% Pump A Result of Reduced Consumer Index - Crypto Exec
en.subheader: Bitcoin's recent 20% pump from a price of $16,000 to $21,425 signifies that investors are, once again, renewing their interest and confidence
en.content: Bitcoin’s recent 20% pump from a price of $16,000 to $21,425 signifies that investors are, once again, renewing their interest and confidence in cryptocurrencies, and comes after the latest inflation data showed a fall of 0.1% in the consumer price index during December 2022.According to the CEO of the Bitcoins-rewards app Lolli Alex Adelman, the cryptocurrency is about to see better days in the coming weeks and months.“This new downward trend “for inflation suggests that FED may ease off of increased interest rates and loosen monetary policy in the coming months, which will continue to boost investor confidence and interest in Bitcoin,” he said.Bitcoin’s recent sustained price rally, which started on the 8th of this month and touched a 4-month high of $21,425 is far from stalling. Before then, the cryptocurrency industry had a tough 2022, with the price of one Bitcoin falling to as low as $16,291 in November 2022. The collapse of FTX, increased FED interest rates, and sustained inflation worsened crypto markets as investors stayed away.Adelman said last week’s rally also signifies that the markets were recovering from the anxieties caused by the FTX collapse in which thousands of investors lost their money.“We are likely to see Bitcoin continue to trade higher in the first part of 2023, particularly as the FTX debacle has highlighted the fundamental differences between Bitcoin and cryptocurrencies that are not secure stores of value,” he said. “The adoption of Bitcoin by leading firms like Blackrock that we saw in 2022 showed us that mainstream interest in Bitcoin is here to stay. As Bitcoin’s increased price holds, we will see new levels of adoption among retail and institutional investors this year.He is optimistic that Bitcoin will remain strong moving into next month as more investors turn to it as a more secure and digital-age-relevant store of value.However, many other experts have expressed an opposing view that the price rally could only be short-lived. CakeDEFI CEO Dr Julian Hosp, for instance, said last week that there currently is a lack of substance for a real uptrend in crypto prices.Hosp said the current crypto price uptrend may only be a result of short-term factors and is characterized by, among others, thin trading volumes, many bankrupt trading desks, market manipulation by some crypto firms, market hopium, pent-up liquidity from holidays, and short-selling, which could pull down the prices in due course.
en.summary: Bitcoin’s recent 20% pump from a price of $16,000 to $21,425 signifies that investors are, once again, renewing their interest and confidence in cryptocurrencies. Comes after the latest inflation data showed a fall of 0.1% in the consumer price index during December 2022.

record.header: Bitcoin Surges to Five-Month Peak Above $22,500 as Market Rebounds
record.subheader: This week's Bitcoin pump reaches new recent heights, plus Ethereum, Solana, Dogecoin, and others are also soaring.
record.content: This week’s crypto market rebound got another jolt on Friday afternoon as Bitcoin (BTC) blasted off to heights unseen since August 2022, with fellow market leaders like Ethereum (ETH) and Solana (SOL) also posting sizable gains.Bitcoin has peaked as high as $22,687 so far this afternoon, per data from CoinGecko, and at a current price of $22,613 has risen almost 8% over the past 24 hours. The last time that Bitcoin traded that high was on August 18, 2022, well before November’s collapse of exchange FTX sent the leading cryptocurrency’s price plummeting below the $16,000 mark.Today’s sudden pump pushes Bitcoin’s seven-day gains to 20%, with a 34% jump registered over the last 30 days. Bitcoin remains down 68% from its all-time high price above $69,000 set in November 2021, but the recent gains show a crypto market on the rise after a brutal 2022.The price of Ethereum, the second-largest cryptocurrency by total market cap, has climbed almost 7% today to $1,656, marking a four-month peak for the coin. It last traded this high in September 2022, according to CoinGecko. ETH is now up 17% on the week, with a sizable 30-day increase of 36%.Overall, the cryptocurrency market has seen a 6% boost in value over the past 24 hours, with coins like Dogecoin (DOGE), Cardano (ADA), and Ripple’s XRP posting similar gains during the span.Solana (SOL), however, is skyrocketing compared to most of the rest of the crypto market this week. The coin, which fell to a nearly two-year low of just above $8 in late December, has climbed 18% today to a current price above $25.It’s the highest price tracked for Solana since the market declined amid November’s FTX uncertainty, and marks a 52% rise for SOL this week alone. Solana has more than doubled in price over the last 30 days, including the aforementioned dip into single digits. It’s now the 10th-largest coin by market cap after briefly falling out of the top 20 in December.

en.header: Patriarch Kirill urged Orthodox parishioners to help the participants of their
en.subheader: Patriarch Kirill of Moscow and All Russia said that every Orthodox parish should help participants in a special military operation.
en.content: Moscow, 21 January: INTERFAX.RU, the Patriarch of Moscow and all of Rusi Cyril, said that every Orthodox parish should help the participants in a special military operation. "If we say that the Church is with its people, then each parish should help those on the line of fire. We need to mobilize our parishioners to gather things, food," said the Patriarchs at a brotherly table with the clergy of Moscow on the occasion of the Lord's Baptism. The text of his address was published on Saturday on the website of the Moscow Patriarchate. The Church is already doing a great deal to help the military, but it is not enough, the Patriarch Kirill added. As he concluded, "the time has come for us to be with our suffering people and, above all, those who, at the cost of their lives, protect our Orthodox people on Donbas".

record.header: Peskov called for Putin's words about partial mobilization
record.subheader: The Kremlin calls for partial mobilization to be guided by the words of Russian President Vladimir Putin, who declared its conclusion.
record.content: On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU, in the Kremlin, is being called upon to look at the words of Russian President Vladimir Putin, who declared its conclusion. On Friday, in a conversation with journalists, the press secretary of the Head of State, Dmitry Peskov, was asked to comment on the situation with a request to the administration of the President of the Pskov Regional Assembly, Arthur Gayduk, requesting the Head of State to issue a decree to end partial mobilization. As part of the partial mobilization, the number that was planned to be mobilized was secured, and the call for an emergency service began. It was mentioned several times by the President and suggested that we should focus on it." Peskov said. He explained what was meant by the President's response to the deputy, which says that "the action of the decree is continuing." "I think it will be more likely that this is a legal feature. I am not ready to answer you right now. I will also clarify the situation. But here is the main point: I call once again for a reference to President Putin's statement," said Peskov. Putin signed a decree on 21 September to begin partial mobilization. The head of the Ministry of Defence, Sergei Shoig, said that 300,000 people had to be called on on 9 December 2022. Putin stated that there were no factors for the resumption of partial mobilization to date on 4 November. Putin reported that 318,000 people had been mobilized to participate in the SVB, taking into account volunteers. On 7 December, he said that only 150,000 of those mobilized were in the zone of special military operation, 77,000 of them directly in military units, while the rest were serving as territorial defence troops or were undergoing additional training. According to Putin, a special military operation in Ukraine could be a long-term process.

ru.header: Патриарх Кирилл призвал православных прихожан помогать участникам СВО
ru.subheader: Патриарх Московский и всея Руси Кирилл заявил, что каждый православный приход должен помогать участникам специальной военной операции.
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Патриарх Московский и всея Руси Кирилл заявил, что каждый православный приход должен помогать участникам специальной военной операции."Если мы говорим, что Церковь - со своим народом, то каждый приход должен помогать тем, кто на линии огня. Нам нужно мобилизовать наших прихожан, чтобы они собирали вещи, продукты", - сказал патриарх на братской трапезе с духовенством Москвы по случаю праздника Крещения Господня.Текст его обращения опубликован в субботу на сайте Московского патриархата.Церковь уже многое делает для помощи военнослужащим, однако этого еще недостаточно, добавил патриарх Кирилл. Как он заключил, "настало время, когда мы должны быть вместе с нашим страждущим народом и в первую очередь с теми, кто ценой жизни защищает наших православных людей на Донбассе".

en.header: Genesis Officially Joins Growing List of Bankrupt Crypto Companies
en.subheader: On Saturday, Bitcoin and Ether, the two biggest crypto assets by market capitalization, saw additional gains as the broader
en.content: Genesis Global Holding Corporation has officially filed for chapter 11 bankruptcy. The trading and lending subsidiary of Digital Currency Group submitted filings late Thursday night at the New York Southern District Bankruptcy Court, bringing the toll of top-tier bankrupt crypto companies to 10.The company first disclosed plans to declare insolvency after news of FTX’s collapse hit the mainstream late last year. It had been badly affected to the tune of $175 million.Combined losses from investments in FTX and the now-defunct Three Arrow’s Capital, which went down last year, hit $1.3 billion, forcing the trading desk to fold up. In the weeks before the announcement, the Barry Silbert-owned exchange had tried to stay afloat by cutting back 30% of its workforce, even as pressures mounted from the US Security and Exchange Commission (SEC) and its industry partner, Gemini.The SEC accused Genesis and Gemini of creating and trading unauthorised crypto assets. The partner program designed to reward depositors a 7.4% interest went awry as Genesis battled to account for over $900 million of deposited customer assets from Gemini.Genesis will have to settle over $9 billion in debts, with a third going to the top 50 creditors.Another One Bites The DustGenesis is the latest in a growing list of crypto companies going bankrupt. Voyager, Celsius, Terraform, BlockFi, Babel Finance, FTX, Zipmex, and Hodlnaut have all thrown in the towel over the last year in what many described as the coldest crypto winter ever. The ripple effect of these moribund companies is yet to be fully determined, as many other crypto companies are believed to be affected by the contagion, just like Genesis.However, crypto communities remain optimistic about the possible survival of other DCG subsidiaries. Established in 2015, Genesis is the oldest of seven major DCG sub-divisions, CoinDesk, Grayscale, Foundry, Luno, HQ and Tradeblock.Bankruptcy Without DelayIn a written statement following the filing, Genesis Interim CEO Islim Derar remarked that the company’s “goal is to move through the Chapter 11 process as quickly and efficiently as possible while reaching the best outcome and emerging well-positioned for the future.Over the years, time-to-settlement for bankruptcy proceedings in the crypto sector and traditional finance has continued to increase, leaving creditors confused and in limbo. The failed founders of the defunct Three Arrows Capital recently sought to solve this problem by creating a claim-based crypto exchange, GTX, for bankruptcy victims. However, there is still a lot of scepticism given their records of failure.
en.summary: Trading and lending subsidiary of Digital Currency Group. Bitcoin and Ether see further gains after Genesis filing.

record.header: The crypto-nosed broker Genesis has declared bankruptcy.
record.subheader: The cryptomer broker Genesis initiated bankruptcy proceedings, becoming another victim of a crisis in the sector caused by the collapse of the FTX exchange.
record.content: On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU, a Kryptonized broker of Genesis, initiated bankruptcy proceedings, becoming another victim of a crisis in the sector caused by the collapse of the FTX.Genesis stock exchange, filed a lawsuit with the Court of the Southern District of New York under article 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code. This allows the company to continue working during the restructuring period. Genesis and its parent company, Digital Currency Group, have been negotiating with creditors since November. "Restructuring is the most effective way to preserve assets and achieve the best result for all interested parties", stated the interim CEO Genesis Derar Islim. Both Genesis assets and liabilities are listed in $1-10 billion. Earlier in January, the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filed a lawsuit against Genesis Global Capital and Gemini Trust Company, considering that their cryptative credit scheme violated investors ' rights. The Gemini Earn programme allowed clients of the Gemini Crime Exchange to borrow Genesis assets at a rate of 8 per cent. Geminis received loan fees up to 4.29 per cent approved by SEC. According to the regulator, Genesis should have registered the product, which would have required it to disclose detailed financial information to its clients. Genesis and Geminis began offering participation to individual investors in February 2021 and was able to attract hundreds of thousands of investors in billions of dollars. In November 2022, Genesis suddenly stopped the withdrawal of funds from the programme because it was unable to respond to their requests, which increased sharply after the collapse of the FTX crypton exchange. At that time, the Gemini Earn programme had seized the assets of 340,000 investors for a total value of $900 million, according to data from SEC.19 January, another cryptative creditor, Nexo Capital, agreed to pay $45 million to settle SEC claims arising from the lack of registration of a similar product advanced by the company.

en.header: A helicopter flew to Sochi to rescue tourists hovering in a balloon
en.subheader: Rescuers decided to send a helicopter to rescue tourists hovering in a balloon in Sochi, the Southern Regional Search and Rescue Squad of the Russian Emergencies Ministry told Interfax on Saturday.
en.content: Moscow. On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU - Rescuers decided to send tourists who were hanging in an air balloon in Sochi, a helicopter, to report to Interfax on Saturday in the Southern Regional Search and Rescue Unit of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs. "The helicopter flew to save people," said a representative of the MES. Early in the Russian MES Press Service, Interfax reported that five people, including three minors, were in the area of the Soloh Aul settlement on Saturday afternoon in Sochi, in the Lazarev district. They're in contact, they're in good condition, rescue personnel are on their way to the scene, and there was a Ka-32 helicopter on standby.
en.summary: The Mi-8 helicopter of the Russian Emergencies Ministry with Russians on board flew to Sochi to rescue tourists stuck in the mountains.

record.header: Passengers of the liner damaged in Turkey will be sent to the Russian Federation by planes
record.content: Moscow. On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU - Lyner Astoria Grande, who had been damaged in an attempt to dock at a Turkish port in a storm, would remain in Turkey for repair, Russian passengers would be sent to Sochi by flights, informed the "Interfax" representative of the shipowner in Sochi. "People will send the planes, we will send them all today and tomorrow. Ship's shipment has already begun. Ship's departure for repairs in Turkey," he said. According to the shipowner's representative, another cruise from Sochi on the Astoria Grande ship scheduled for 21 January, will therefore be cancelled. The company operator is prepared to return the money to the tourists who booked the tours. He added that the cruise programme was scheduled to continue in April: on 18 January, a cruise ship, Astoria Grande, in an attempt to dock in the storm, was hit by the cruise protection of the dock of the Turkish port of Amasra. The port was located in northern Turkey in Bartin province. 385 Russian tourists and 283 crew members were on board, none of whom were injured. For a while, the cruiser drifted near the harbour to wait the weather, he was able to dock at the port on 19 January. According to the Turkish agency Anadolu, an insurance company following an inspection of the vessel following an incident in Amasra, stated that it was not safe for passengers to continue to travel. "In this connection, it was decided to send 385 Russian passengers to Sochi by special flights. They are scheduled to take place on Friday and Saturday from Merzifon International Airport in Amassie or Zonguldak Airport," says the agency. According to the publication, the airliner will be refurbished at Tuzla Shipyard in Istanbul. Since July 2022, Astoria Grande has been performing cruises from Sochi to Turkey's coast.

ru.header: В Сочи на спасение зависших на воздушном шаре туристов вылетел вертолет
ru.subheader: Спасатели приняли решение направить на спасение туристов, зависших на воздушном шаре в Сочи, вертолет, сообщили "Интерфаксу" в субботу в Южном региональном поисково-спасательном отряде МЧС России.
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Спасатели приняли решение направить на спасение туристов, зависших на воздушном шаре в Сочи, вертолет, сообщили "Интерфаксу" в субботу в Южном региональном поисково-спасательном отряде МЧС России."Вертолет вылетел на спасение людей", - сказал представитель отряда МЧС.Ранее в пресс-службе МЧС РФ "Интерфаксу" сообщали, что днем в субботу в Сочи, в Лазаревском районе, в районе поселка Солох-аул, завис воздушный шар, застрявший на дереве, в нем находятся пять человек, в том числе трое несовершеннолетних. Связь с ними есть, их состояние нормальное.Спасатели выдвинулись к месту происшествия. В готовности был вертолет Ка-32.
ru.summary: Вертолет Ми-8 МЧС России с россиянами на борту вылетел в Сочи для спасения туристов, застрявших в горах.

en.header: Kiev accused Russia of delays in inspections of vessels on the grain deal
en.subheader: In Ukraine, they say that one vessel has been awaiting passage through the straits since November. Russia has repeatedly pointed out that the deal is not working properly — Russian ships with fertilizers and grain are still subject to restrictions
en.content: In Ukraine, it is alleged that one vessel has been waiting for passage through the straits since November. Russia has repeatedly indicated that the deal is not working properly: Russian vessels with fertilizers and grains are still subject to restrictions by the Administration of Maritime Ports of Ukraine (AMPU) published on Facebook (the social media owner Meta is recognized by an extremist organization in Russia and is prohibited) a report accusing Russia of creating a long line of vessels moving along the grain corridor. According to the Ukrainian authorities, a total of 94 vessels were awaiting inspection, 25 of which were loaded with agro-products. RBC sent requests to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Defence of Russia. Vladimir Zelensky accused the Russian Federation at the end of October of creating an artificial line at the entrance to the Straits, saying that 150 vessels were on the line. The grain deal concluded separately in July by Russia and Ukraine with Turkey and the United Nations included two parts. The first concerned the safe removal of grains from Ukrainian Black Sea ports, the second concerned the removal of restrictions on exports of Russian products — grains, fertilizers, etc. In Moscow, it has been pointed out on several occasions that the deal is bad: Ukraine is leaving the ship and the second part of the deal is not working; as Russian President Dmitry Peskov ' s press secretary pointed out in late December, so far only one vessel with Russian fertilizers has been able to be shipped; at the end of November, it left the Netherlands, and 20,000 tons of fertilizer were sent to the African State of Malawi.

record.header: The Kremlin indicated legal restrictions on the transfer of Russian weapons to Ukraine
record.content: On January 20, INTERFAX.RU - In the Kremlin, the legal restrictions on recipient countries of Russian weapons were recalled against the background of the Pentagon's attempts to persuade Latin American countries to hand over Russian weapons to Ukraine. President Dmitry Peskov's spokesperson was asked to comment on the Pentagon's statement that the United States was working with nine Latin American countries, in particular Cuba, Venezuela and Nicaragua, to get them to hand over Russian-made weapons to Ukraine. "In our time, it is difficult to imagine what might be a surprise," the President's spokesperson said. "The legal and legal restrictions on transfers to third countries are very important, because any transfers are subject to certain obligations of those countries that receive military products," he stressed.

ru.header: Киев обвинил Россию в задержках проверок судов по зерновой сделке
ru.subheader: На Украине заявляют, что одно судно ожидает прохода через проливы с ноября. Россия неоднократно указывала, что сделка работает неполноценно — российские суда с удобрениями и зерном по-прежнему подпадают под ограничения
ru.content: На Украине заявляют, что одно судно ожидает прохода через проливы с ноября. Россия неоднократно указывала, что сделка работает неполноценно — российские суда с удобрениями и зерном по-прежнему подпадают под ограниченияАдминистрация морских портов Украины (АМПУ) опубликовала в Facebook (владелец соцсети компания Meta признана в России экстремистской организацией и запрещена) сообщение, в котором обвинила Россию в создании длинной очереди судов, которые двигаются по зерновому коридору.В сообщении утверждается, что Москва «тормозит проведение инспекций судов, из-за чего им приходится ждать своей очереди в среднем месяц». При этом в АМПУ привели в пример балкер T-Med с пшеницей на борту, который не может преодолеть черноморские проливы с ноября.По данным украинского ведомства, в общей сложности инспекции ожидают 94 судна, 25 из которых загружены агропродукцией.РБК направил запросы в МИД и Минобороны России.В конце октября в создании искусственной очереди на входе в проливы Россию обвинял Владимир Зеленский. Тогда, по его словам, очередь составляла 150 судов.Зерновая сделка, заключенная в июле по отдельности Россией и Украиной с Турцией и ООН, включала в себя две части. Первая касалась безопасного вывоза зерна из украинских портов по Черному морю, вторая — снятия ограничений с экспорта российской продукции — зерна, удобрений и пр.В Москве не раз указывали, что сделка действует плохо: Украину корабли покидают, а вторая часть сделки не работает. Как отметил в конце декабря пресс-секретарь российского президента Дмитрий Песков, пока удалось добиться отправки только одного судна с российскими удобрениями. В конце ноября оно вышло из Нидерландов, 20 тыс. т удобрений направили в африканское государство Малави.

en.header: Bitcoin Targets $25,000 In Ultra-Bullish Breakout as Whales Double Down On Gigantic BTC Buys
en.subheader: On Saturday, Bitcoin and Ether, the two biggest crypto assets by market capitalization, saw additional gains as the broader
en.content: On Saturday, Bitcoin and Ether, the two biggest crypto assets by market capitalization, saw additional gains as the broader crypto industry kept on its unforeseen surge this year.At press time, Bitcoin was holding steady at about $22,821 after growing over 10% in the past 24 hours. Bitcoin’s epic surge comes after it encountered minor resistance at around $21,500 on Jan 17, recoiling back to $20,480 mid-week. On the other hand, Ether was trading at $1,670 after posting over 7% gains in the same period.Other cryptos followed suit, with Solana posting the most gains among the top ten categories of coins by market cap. At press time, SOL was trading at $25.16, up over 18% over the past day, as seen on CoinMarketCap. Cardano, DOGE, XRP and BNB followed closely, gaining about 9%, 7.63%, 5.28% and 5.68% in the same period.The overnight surge in crypto prices led to 66,850 short traders being liquidated. At press time, the total number of liquidations in the past 24 hours stood at $299.48 million, according to data from Coinglass. Notably, the global crypto market cap grew over 6% overnight to tap $1.04T after losing the $1 trillion threshold last November.The surge comes despite fears that a raft of evidence that conditions are still not ready to settle down will deter crypto investors. This week, Genesis Trading became the latest casualty of the industry’s woes, filing for bankruptcy protection after suffering crippling losses following the collapse of FTX and hedge fund Three Arrows capital. Genesis is part of Digital Currency Group, a conglomerate helmed by Barry Silbert, which has been fighting to keep its head up in recent months amid fraud allegations by Gemini.Despite the bad news, onchain metrics suggest investors are moving past bad narratives and have started positioning themselves for the next bull rally.Earlier today, crypto analytics platform Santiment attributed Bitcoin’s overnight spike to a wall of money put into purchasing the asset by whales.“Bitcoin has now surpassed $22.7k for the first time since August 18, 2022. The price rise has come as the large whale tier group of addresses holding 1,000 to 10,000 BTC has collectively accumulated 64,638 ($1.46 billion) BTC in the past 15 days,” the firm tweeted.Pierre Rochard, Vice President of Research at Riot Platforms, noted that Bitcoin’s value was likely to keep increasing towards $25,000 as fundamentals keep improving, especially on a relative basis.“Bullish scenario: we’re exiting disillusionment, getting ready for next year’s halving, bitcoin doing its own thing regardless of macro,” he said. He states, “given the impossibility of predicting BTC’s volatile exchange rate, steady long-term accumulation is the way.”
en.summary: On Saturday, Bitcoin and Ether, the two biggest crypto assets by market capitalization, saw additional gains. At press time, Bitcoin was holding steady at about $22,821 after growing over 10% in the past 24 hours. Other cryptos followed suit, with Solana posting the most gains among the top ten categories of coins by market cap.

record.header: Bitcoin Surges to Five-Month Peak Above $22,500 as Market Rebounds
record.subheader: This week's Bitcoin pump reaches new recent heights, plus Ethereum, Solana, Dogecoin, and others are also soaring.
record.content: This week’s crypto market rebound got another jolt on Friday afternoon as Bitcoin (BTC) blasted off to heights unseen since August 2022, with fellow market leaders like Ethereum (ETH) and Solana (SOL) also posting sizable gains.Bitcoin has peaked as high as $22,687 so far this afternoon, per data from CoinGecko, and at a current price of $22,613 has risen almost 8% over the past 24 hours. The last time that Bitcoin traded that high was on August 18, 2022, well before November’s collapse of exchange FTX sent the leading cryptocurrency’s price plummeting below the $16,000 mark.Today’s sudden pump pushes Bitcoin’s seven-day gains to 20%, with a 34% jump registered over the last 30 days. Bitcoin remains down 68% from its all-time high price above $69,000 set in November 2021, but the recent gains show a crypto market on the rise after a brutal 2022.The price of Ethereum, the second-largest cryptocurrency by total market cap, has climbed almost 7% today to $1,656, marking a four-month peak for the coin. It last traded this high in September 2022, according to CoinGecko. ETH is now up 17% on the week, with a sizable 30-day increase of 36%.Overall, the cryptocurrency market has seen a 6% boost in value over the past 24 hours, with coins like Dogecoin (DOGE), Cardano (ADA), and Ripple’s XRP posting similar gains during the span.Solana (SOL), however, is skyrocketing compared to most of the rest of the crypto market this week. The coin, which fell to a nearly two-year low of just above $8 in late December, has climbed 18% today to a current price above $25.It’s the highest price tracked for Solana since the market declined amid November’s FTX uncertainty, and marks a 52% rise for SOL this week alone. Solana has more than doubled in price over the last 30 days, including the aforementioned dip into single digits. It’s now the 10th-largest coin by market cap after briefly falling out of the top 20 in December.

en.subheader: SHIB and BONE prices have jumped, while BONE has reached an important milestone and SHIB just keeps rising
en.content: Over the past 24 hours and also in the past week overall, two major tokens of the Shiba Inu ecosystem, SHIB and BONE, have demonstrated a substantial rise, pushing the new local highs.SHIB has hit the $0.000012 level, while the ShibaSwap Bone token surged to the $1.50 mark. SHIB has grown 6.40% since last morning and is now trading in the green at $0.00001221.BONE price jumps driven by these stimuliBONE has shown a little pullback from the $1.50 level by now, exchanging hands at $1.48. Currently, the token's rise in the past 24 hours constitutes 3.66%.Various factors have impacted the recent growth of these two meme coins, but the biggest one is that recently the upcoming launch of Shibarium beta version was announced by the SHIB developer team. Shibarium is the Layer-2 solution that allows users to conduct a bigger number of transfers on the network without any congestion, transact at low fees and at much higher speed than before.BONE is meant to be the token to pay transaction fees on Shibarium with. This is why it has jumped in price significantly since the recent announcement about the beta release. Besides, as reported by U.Today earlier this week, the holder count of BONE reached the 67,000 mark, and now it has grown to 68,000+ as users have been stocking up on this token.SHIB price goes up on Shibarium expectationsShiba Inu price growth has been generally stimulated by the upcoming Shibarium launch. The SHIB army has been looking forward to it throughout entire 2022. One of the reasons for that is the expected price growth of SHIB.Shibarium developers plan to convert part of transaction fees into SHIB and then burn these meme tokens. The community hopes that this way trillions of Shiba Inu will be removed from the circulating supply, thus making the token more scarce and pushing it to the much-anticipated $1 level.Currently, SHIB burning is not going as well as many would like it to. According to a recent tweet by the Shibburn tracker, over the past 24 hours, the SHIB army has managed to burn only as little as 18,434,272 meme tokens. This is 23% less than the amount of SHIB burned yesterday.
en.summary: BONE has surpassed the $1.50 mark, while SHIB has hit the $0.000012 level.

en.header: Switzerland Less Affected by Crypto Industry Crisis, Study Finds – Economics Bitcoin News
en.subheader: While the global crypto industry is losing funds and jobs, Switzerland seems to be weathering the storm relatively well, research claims.
en.content: While the global industry built around digital assets is losing funds and jobs are dropping off, Switzerland seems to be weathering the storm relatively well, one piece of research claims. In fact, more crypto companies settled in the country during the past turbulent year than those that left it, or the business altogether.Crypto Valley in Switzerland Maintains Number of Residents Despite Crypto WinterThe market downturn and the collapse of platforms like cryptocurrency exchange FTX and the Terra-luna ecosystem sent shockwaves through the industry. The negative events of 2022 led to losses for investors, customers, and companies while major players like Coinbase and Genesis announced layoffs.However, data compiled by the venture capital firm CV VC shows that crypto-friendly Switzerland hasn’t witnessed anything too spectacular, Swissinfo reported. According to its ‘Top 50’ report, 183 Swiss blockchain businesses went bust last year, but 190 startups and foreign companies opened new offices.The researchers also found that the Swiss Crypto Valley, centered in the canton of Zug, now has approximately the same number of entities as in 2021 — currently 1,135. They employ 5,766 people, which is only around 4% less than before the crypto winter started.The most prominent Swiss-registered companies that went under were FTX Europe and the crypto asset manager Covario. “The Swiss branch of U.K.-based crypto lender Nexo is also under the microscope after the company’s Bulgarian offices were searched,” the news portal remarks.Meanwhile, none of the other big names has admitted to being severely impacted by the ongoing volatility in the sector. One of the reasons for that, the article points out, is the attitude of Swiss authorities regarding potentially corrupt enterprises.For example, Switzerland’s Financial Market Supervisory Authority blocked an attempt by the FTX subsidiary to acquire the Swiss Neue Privat Bank, citing insufficient regulatory oversight over the group’s other global activities.The CV VC study also shows that the valuation of the top 24 blockchain companies increased 55% to $9.7 billion despite crypto assets losing significant value. The biggest gainers among them are 21Shares, an issuer of crypto-backed exchange traded certificates, and Gnosis Safe, which manages Ethereum-based assets. Both have been valued at over $1 billion, according to the report.
en.summary: Crypto Valley in Switzerland Maintains Number of Residents Despite Crypto Winter. 183 Swiss blockchain businesses went bust last year, but 190 startups and foreign companies opened new offices. The valuation of the top 24 blockchain companies increased 55% to $9.7 billion.

record.header: Today in Crypto: Car Crashed Into Sam Bankman-Fried's House Barricade, Ransomware Payments Fell 40% in 2022, Crypto Became the Second Most Widely Owned Asset Class for Women
record.subheader: Get your daily, bite-sized digest of cryptoasset and blockchain-related news – investigating the stories flying under the radar of today's crypto news.
record.content: Crime newsA car "recently" intentionally rammed into a metal barricade outside the California, USA, home where FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried is serving out his house arrest, the New York Post reported, citing the former CEO’s lawyers. Allegedly, three men exited the car and told a security guard: “You won’t be able to keep us out,” the attorneys claimed in a Manhattan federal court filing on Thursday.Ransomware payments are down 40%, with attackers extorting at least $456.8 million in funds in 2022, compared to $765.6 million in 2021, according to a new report by blockchain forensics firm Chainalysis. "That doesn't mean attacks are down, or at least not as much as the drastic dropoff in payments would suggest," it said. "Instead, we believe that much of the decline is due to victim organizations increasingly refusing to pay ransomware attackers."Crypto is now the second most widely owned asset class for women after cash, “suggesting it is succeeding where traditional financial markets have sometimes failed in bringing more women to the table,” said an eToro report. The female ownership of crypto jumped from 29% in Q3 to 34% in Q4 2022, whilst men saw only a 1 percentage point rise from 42% to 43% of the surveyed investors.Global offshore law firm Harneys acted as Cayman Islands counsel to HashKey Capital, a global asset manager specializing in blockchain and crypto, on the successful $500 million closing of its third fund, HashKey FinTech Investment Fund III, said a press release. The “new fund will further advance crypto and blockchain initiatives worldwide, with a focus on emerging markets,” it added.Xclaim, an independent trading platform for cryptoassets locked by bankruptcy, announced that thousands of customers of several bankrupt crypto exchanges, including FTX, BlockFi, Celsius, and Voyager, have listed their accounts for sale, representing more than $200 million of cryptoassets. Xclaim enables crypto account holders to recover the market value of accounts that are inaccessible during the pendency of a bankruptcy, said the press release.Bitcoin miner CleanSpark announced a nearly $16 million expansion, with projected completion in late spring, holding up to 16,000 miners. Per the press release, it started construction on the second phase of one of its newest sites in Washington, Georgia, USA, consisting of Antminer S19j Pro and Antminer S19 XP machines. Upon completion, the new phase will add up to 2.2 exahashes per second (EH/s) of computing power to the company’s mining capacity.Layer 1 blockchain Fantom launched a decentralized funding mechanism to finance blockchain projects through a community-driven governance process. The so-called Ecosystem Vault is an on-chain fund financed by 10% of the transaction fees on Fantom and controlled by the community, providing an opportunity for projects to secure funding in their efforts to build decentralized apps (dapps) on the blockchain, a blog post said.AllianceBlock, which builds gateways between traditional finance (TradFi) and decentralized finance (DeFi) through decentralized and trustless infrastructure, announced a strategic partnership with ARTBANX, a customizable and secure collection management system for collectors, art professionals, and financial institutions. Per a press release, this partnership is a first of its kind. ARTBANX enables art to become a bankable asset class, which will be expanded with a marketplace built on blockchain technology. AllianceBlock, with Nexera Protocol’s infrastructure and NexeraID’s identity management toolkit, will allow the tokenization of physical artworks and facilitate a marketplace for art, it said.Blockchain technology company Native announced the launch of its project-owned decentralized exchange (DEX) layer for crypto. Per the press release, “Native created this technology because the crypto ecosystem has become too reliant on exchanges and market makers.” This technology enables any project to become its own DEX, they added.

en.header: Bitcoin’s Fate Depends on the Federal Reserve’s Next Move - Will It Crash or Hit New All-Time Highs?
en.content: Experts speculate on the probable influence of the upcoming monetary policy adjustments by the Federal Reserve on the cryptocurrency market, particularly on the price of Bitcoin, as it nears $23,000 and the majority of the crypto market remains in green with the global crypto market moving over $1 trillion for the first time in what has been a while.What Will Bitcoin’s Fate Be?Given the dollar’s status as the world’s reserve currency, it comes as no surprise that the price of bitcoin is highly sensitive to fluctuations in the availability of US dollars across the world.The market’s recent performance indicates that participants are expecting the Federal Reserve to change its stance on monetary policy. If the Federal Reserve follows through with a policy move, some analysts believe it might sustain the current advance in Bitcoin and spark a secular bull market.One thing is certain as the world watches the future of monetary policy and its possible influence on the crypto market: Bitcoin and digital currencies are in a state of constant development, with substantial room for both volatility and growth.Traders paved the way for the new Bitcoin gains amid worries of a severe drop, and Bitcoin prices kept rising to new multi-month highs. Bitcoin’s value has increased by nearly 9% in the last twenty-four hours and 11.5% in the last seven days, to a current price of $$22,848 as of this writing.Analytics tool built directly upon the blockchain Meanwhile, yesterday’s removal of ask liquidity on Binance was spotted by Material Indicators, paving the way for Bitcoin’s debut surge beyond the $22,000 barrier.Some familiar voices like Toni Ghinea are still warning traders to brace for the worst, while others are saying that this is only the beginning of a lengthy bull run, proving that Bitcoin is never beyond suspicion at its highs. Which one is it going to be? All we can do is wait and see.
en.summary: Analysts expect the U.S. central bank to change its stance on monetary policy.

However, before being optimistic about the upcoming bull run, here are the possibilities of the rally being programmed and could be executed shortly.An extract replication of 2019-2020 rally is underway where-in the first leg bouncer off from 200-day WMA initially and later the Q1 2024 crash may begin. A popular analyst, forecasts the Bitcoin price prediction for 2023 and says that the price may reach $25,000 in the next few weeks which will be followed by a massive pullback in February.Referring to the above chart, the analyst says, there could be a continuation to $23,100 which could be followed by a pullback to $22,000. Therefore, it may not be considered a normal price jump if the volume does not appear to be real. Hence, a well-known analyst, il Capo of Crypto says that this could be the biggest bull trap ever which may foresee a major impact soon.I've been checking charts all this time, avoiding noise from Twitter. record.subheader: After multiple tries, Bitcoin has finally conquered the $20,000 mark. Is it safe to trade the giants?
record.content: After a strong rally, Bitcoin has managed to reclaim the $20,000 level. It came after a long sideways consolidation that tested the patience of many traders.Is this the breakout we have all been waiting for? At the moment, the trend seems perfect. Therefore, in this week's analysis, we will observe what coins have the potential to outperform the market.In the chart above, the sideways consolidation that started in November is clearly visible. After continuously failing to break above the resistance level in December, BTC finally succeeded last week. This led to a strong price move in the upward direction, and the price went above $20,000 in no time.After a strong trend, it looks like BTC will stay in the $20,500-$21,800 range for a while before the next move. Traders can expect some sideways movement (movement within the range) for the next few days. It is crucial for BTC to hold the support at $19,850 for a continuation of the uptrend.Once the final resistance at $21,800 is broken, expect the the next resistance to be at $24,400.Also Read: A Complete Guide to Death Cross and Golden Cross?ETH has go up by over 35% this month, and it looks like this could just be the start of the rally!ETH broke the strong resistances at $1,420 and $1,520 easily and is currently consolidating after a strong rally. If the momentum is maintained, traders can expect the price to break the supply zone (resistance) at $1,650 soon. Once the supply zone is broken, a clear path to $1,811 can be seen.This view is only valid if the price is able to break the supply zone/resistance at $1,650.Also Read: Breakout vs Fakeout (False Breakout) — Spot the Difference and Increase AccuracyNEAR has doubled in price this month after it rallied from $1.2 to $2.4 in just half a month.It seems like NEAR will now retest the support line at $1.8 before rallying further. Therefore, traders should wait before taking long positions. If the retest is successful, traders can expect the price to test the supply zone/resistance at $2.8 soon.Also Read: What Is Fundamental Analysis in Cryptocurrency and Stocks?ADA has formed a bullish pattern with a round bottom as can be seen in the chart above. It finally broke the resistance at $0.33 after multiple trying multiple times in December.At the time of writing, the price is trading close to the support zone and is on the verge of falling below the support line. Therefore, traders should wait until the price is able to recover back to $0.37 before taking long positions.FTM seems to be retesting the support at $0.29 after a very strong rally in the past few weeks. If this retest is successful, we may see a strong price move up to $0.36 in the coming week.In the chart above, we can see that AVAX is consolidating under the resistance at $19. Traders should note that if the price falls below $14, AVAX may find it difficult to go up again in the short term. A move to $20 can be expected once the consolidation is over.Also Read: What Is Crypto Options Trading?A quick recap of all the coins:BTC is consolidating.ETH is trading near the support.NEAR’s price has almost doubled.ADA is trading close to the support.FTM is retesting the support.AVAX has to trade above the support.Remember that this is all based on the subjective views of the writer. As always, DYOR!
