en.header: Confident Bitcoin Whales, Surging Ethereum Validators, Capturing Bitzlato and 20 Crypto Jokes
en.subheader: A weekly round-up of top crypto news from Cryptonews.com and a collection of 20 hand-picked crypto jokes.
en.content: This week in crypto: bitcoin whales showed confidence in the latest rally as they refused to sell, the number of Ethereum network validators surged to 500,000 as Shanghai fever grew, and the number of Ethereum addresses holding a non-zero balance hit a new record high of 92.5 million. We looked to see if bitcoin entered its next bull market cycle, if a US debt default would derail a crypto price rally or embolden it, if magical thinking born of a financial crisis fueled the rise of crypto, and if a clear-out of crypto moguls and their centralized companies would be good for the digital asset class. Meanwhile, brokerage firm Bernstein advised institutions to dabble into crypto and give up their "zero crypto allocation" strategy.US authorities arrested Russian co-founder of the Bitzlato exchange on suspicion of laundering illegal gambling and drug money, Binance was identified as a counterparty to Bitzlato, authorities claimed that Sam Bankman-Fried siphoned billions of dollars in customer funds from FTX, FTX Japan was expected to resume withdrawals starting in February, Monex Group suggested that it may move to buy FTX Japan, and Silvergate shares moved higher after it had assured investors it was taking steps to weather the FTX collapse despite posting a $1 billion loss in Q4 2022. Genesis filed for bankruptcy, the founders of now-bankrupt Three Arrows Capital and troubled CoinFlex teamed up to create a new exchange GTX, Coinbase said it was exiting Japan due to market conditions, Genesis may be getting ready to declare bankruptcy, and CoinDesk has tapped advisors at Lazard to explore a full or partial sale of its business. On the other hand, German digital bank N26 said it's increasing the number of nations where its clients are allowed to trade crypto. Also, speaking of legal, South Korean prosecutors will seek to convict 20 people for conducting $3.2 billion worth of illegal crypto transactions.Meanwhile, Tokyo Electric Power explained how it plans to use surplus renewable electricity to power its crypto mining operations, mining firm Hive Blockchain shares were up more than 100% since the year began while it recently deployed its first machines based on Intel's Blockscale chips, Nubank’s decision to list MATIC and UNI on its banking app was met with enthusiasm from the crypto community, and a number of South Korean firms are preparing to launch security token offering-related services this year, looking at regulators for the green light. Kevin O'Leary said crypto is getting "very interesting" as recent events forced lawmakers to push for a solid regulatory framework, a CFTC commissioner warned lawmakers against self-certification of product listings by exchanges,  and the Japanese tax body signaled an intention to tax NFT sales and the profits earned by crypto and blockchain gamers.Let’s laugh at some jokes now.Good morning, crypto Twitter, what’s up?It was a painful year, yeah...The week started well. Not for the bears, though.Don't stand too close, you never know when it'll jump.Which one are you?OK, sit down, let me tell you a story.Why not.Halvenating.All good. Also, shut up.What's money?But what if...Unbulletprooflessfull.Found’im!The year's biggest catch!Abe knew.Confidence.But have you seen our crypto wallets? Of course not, it's private.Here’s a classic.It's a different game, mate.And a documentary for the end.
en.summary: This week in crypto: bitcoin whales showed confidence in the latest rally as they refused to sell. US authorities arrested Russian co-founder of the Bitzlato exchange on suspicion of laundering illegal gambling and drug money. South Korean prosecutors will seek to convict 20 people for conducting $3.2 billion worth of illegal crypto transactions.

record.header: Today in Crypto: Car Crashed Into Sam Bankman-Fried's House Barricade, Ransomware Payments Fell 40% in 2022, Crypto Became the Second Most Widely Owned Asset Class for Women
record.subheader: Get your daily, bite-sized digest of cryptoasset and blockchain-related news – investigating the stories flying under the radar of today's crypto news.
record.content: Crime newsA car "recently" intentionally rammed into a metal barricade outside the California, USA, home where FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried is serving out his house arrest, the New York Post reported, citing the former CEO’s lawyers. Allegedly, three men exited the car and told a security guard: “You won’t be able to keep us out,” the attorneys claimed in a Manhattan federal court filing on Thursday.Ransomware payments are down 40%, with attackers extorting at least $456.8 million in funds in 2022, compared to $765.6 million in 2021, according to a new report by blockchain forensics firm Chainalysis. "That doesn't mean attacks are down, or at least not as much as the drastic dropoff in payments would suggest," it said. "Instead, we believe that much of the decline is due to victim organizations increasingly refusing to pay ransomware attackers."Crypto is now the second most widely owned asset class for women after cash, “suggesting it is succeeding where traditional financial markets have sometimes failed in bringing more women to the table,” said an eToro report. The female ownership of crypto jumped from 29% in Q3 to 34% in Q4 2022, whilst men saw only a 1 percentage point rise from 42% to 43% of the surveyed investors.Global offshore law firm Harneys acted as Cayman Islands counsel to HashKey Capital, a global asset manager specializing in blockchain and crypto, on the successful $500 million closing of its third fund, HashKey FinTech Investment Fund III, said a press release. The “new fund will further advance crypto and blockchain initiatives worldwide, with a focus on emerging markets,” it added.Xclaim, an independent trading platform for cryptoassets locked by bankruptcy, announced that thousands of customers of several bankrupt crypto exchanges, including FTX, BlockFi, Celsius, and Voyager, have listed their accounts for sale, representing more than $200 million of cryptoassets. Xclaim enables crypto account holders to recover the market value of accounts that are inaccessible during the pendency of a bankruptcy, said the press release.Bitcoin miner CleanSpark announced a nearly $16 million expansion, with projected completion in late spring, holding up to 16,000 miners. Per the press release, it started construction on the second phase of one of its newest sites in Washington, Georgia, USA, consisting of Antminer S19j Pro and Antminer S19 XP machines. Upon completion, the new phase will add up to 2.2 exahashes per second (EH/s) of computing power to the company’s mining capacity.Layer 1 blockchain Fantom launched a decentralized funding mechanism to finance blockchain projects through a community-driven governance process. The so-called Ecosystem Vault is an on-chain fund financed by 10% of the transaction fees on Fantom and controlled by the community, providing an opportunity for projects to secure funding in their efforts to build decentralized apps (dapps) on the blockchain, a blog post said.AllianceBlock, which builds gateways between traditional finance (TradFi) and decentralized finance (DeFi) through decentralized and trustless infrastructure, announced a strategic partnership with ARTBANX, a customizable and secure collection management system for collectors, art professionals, and financial institutions. Per a press release, this partnership is a first of its kind. ARTBANX enables art to become a bankable asset class, which will be expanded with a marketplace built on blockchain technology. AllianceBlock, with Nexera Protocol’s infrastructure and NexeraID’s identity management toolkit, will allow the tokenization of physical artworks and facilitate a marketplace for art, it said.Blockchain technology company Native announced the launch of its project-owned decentralized exchange (DEX) layer for crypto. Per the press release, “Native created this technology because the crypto ecosystem has become too reliant on exchanges and market makers.” This technology enables any project to become its own DEX, they added.

en.header: Decentraland Founders Are Creditors of Bankrupt Genesis - How Much Are They Owed?
en.subheader: Three Decentraland executives, including two co-founders and the platform's CFO, are named among the top creditors of now-bankrupt cryptocurrency lender Genesis Global.
en.content: Three Decentraland executives, including two co-founders and the platform's CFO, are named among the top creditors of now-bankrupt cryptocurrency lender Genesis Global.Decentraland co-founders Esteban Ordano and Ari Meilich and the platform's CFO Santiago Esponda are listed among the 50 largest non-insider unsecured claims against Genesis, which filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the US on Thursday.The crypto lender revealed the names of its largest creditors on the same day that it filed for bankruptcy, which included crypto exchange Gemini, trading giant Cumberland, Mirana, MoonAlpha Finance, and VanEck’s New Finance Income Fund.A company called Heliva International Corp also appeared on the list with a $55 million claim. The firm listed Decentraland’s CFO Santiago Esponda as a contact pointAside from Esponda, a closer look at the document reveals that Decentraland's two co-founders are also listed with non-Decentraland email addresses.Ordano, who is currently an advisor at Decentraland, is listed as the contact for another company called Winah Securities, to which Genisis owes around $27 million. Notably, the document shows that Winah is located on the same floor in the same building as Heliva.And finally, Genesis owes $20 million to Meilich's gaming company Big Time Studios. According to his LinkedIn profile, Ari Meilich was a co-founder of Decentraland and worked there until April 2020 as project lead when he left the platform to establish his own company Big Time Studios. He also remains a Decentraland adviser.Genesis eventually filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on Thursday after weeks of speculation about the crypto lender's financial health. Genesis Global Holdco LLC, plus subsidiaries Genesis Global Capital LLC and Genesis Asia Pacific Pte, were included in the bankruptcy filing.In the filing, Genesis estimated more than 100,000 creditors and between $1 billion and $10 billion in liabilities, as well as assets. The two other entities, Genesis Global Capital LLC and Genesis Asia Pacific Pte, estimated their assets and liabilities in the $100 million and $500 million range, respectively.According to a Bloomberg report, Genesis aims to use the Chapter 11 process to raise funds or sell assets. If these efforts turn out to be unfruitful, creditors will end up owning the reorganized business. The company also has $150 million of cash on hand that would be used to fund the bankruptcy process.As a reminder, Genesis announced that it was suspending redemptions and new loan originations in mid-November last year following the collapse of crypto exchange FTX, saying that the “abnormal withdrawal requests” exceeded its “current liquidity.”Meanwhile, Genesis has been in the middle of a public dispute with major crypto exchange Gemini, founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss. The twins are owed more than $900 million by Genesis. However, the due is not consent with how DCG CEO Barry Silbert has been handling things and even called for his removal as the CEO of Digital Currency Group.
en.summary: Decentraland co-founders Esteban Ordano and Ari Meilich and the platform's CFO Santiago Esponda are listed among the 50 largest non-insider unsecured claims against Genesis. The crypto lender revealed the names of its largest creditors on the same day that it filed for bankruptcy.

record.header: Here's How Much Genesis Owes Creditors Like Gemini, Mirana, VanEck and Others
record.subheader: Bankruptcy of Genesis was most likely inevitable, but lack of reaction from market is concerning
record.content: One of the most feared bankruptcies on the market happened: Genesis filed for bankruptcy protection on Thursday in the Southern District of New York. Apparently, the firm failed to raise enough funding to cover lending operations, in addition to cutting a large portion of its staff.The company had no other choice but to terminate its lending operations and eventually file for bankruptcy, as the FTX fallout led to an unbearable liquidity crisis, in addition to the collapse of Three Arrows Capital.According to the filing, the biggest creditors that Genesis owes money to is Gemini. The prominent cryptocurrency exchange will have to somehow collect the $765 million dedicated to the victims of the Gemini Earn program who invested their money to generate interest.Mirana venture investment company, which owns numerous large crypto-related projects in the space, has also confirmed that Genesis owes them $151 million collateralized with $120 million, which has already been liquidated.More "local" crypto companies also appeared on the list. Decentraland, for example, invested around $55 million in Genesis. However, the sum exceeds the value set on the official treasury page by two times.Long-forgotten Stellar Foundation also made it into the filing, with $13 million that it provided at the start of Genesis and that has not been returned to the company after the implosion of FTX.The lack of reaction and price action on the market gives us an extremely important signal: the cryptocurrency industry is exhausted after the implosion of FTX, the bankruptcy of 3AC and other events that happened in 2022.Hopefully, Genesis' filing will be the conclusion of one of the worst periods in the history of the digital assets industry.

ru.header: Основатели Decentraland Являются Кредиторами Обанкротившегося Генезиса - Сколько Они Должны?
ru.subheader: Три руководителя Decentraland, в том числе два соучредителя и финансовый директор платформы, названы в числе главных кредиторов ныне обанкротившегося криптовалютного кредитора Genesis Global.
ru.content: Three Decentraland executives, including two co-founders and the platform's CFO, are named among the top creditors of now-bankrupt cryptocurrency lender Genesis Global.Decentraland co-founders Esteban Ordano and Ari Meilich and the platform's CFO Santiago Esponda are listed among the 50 largest non-insider unsecured claims against Genesis, which filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the US on Thursday.The crypto lender revealed the names of its largest creditors on the same day that it filed for bankruptcy, which included crypto exchange Gemini, trading giant Cumberland, Mirana, MoonAlpha Finance, and VanEck’s New Finance Income Fund.A company called Heliva International Corp also appeared on the list with a $55 million claim. The firm listed Decentraland’s CFO Santiago Esponda as a contact pointAside from Esponda, a closer look at the document reveals that Decentraland's two co-founders are also listed with non-Decentraland email addresses.Ordano, who is currently an advisor at Decentraland, is listed as the contact for another company called Winah Securities, to which Genisis owes around $27 million. Notably, the document shows that Winah is located on the same floor in the same building as Heliva.And finally, Genesis owes $20 million to Meilich's gaming company Big Time Studios. According to his LinkedIn profile, Ari Meilich was a co-founder of Decentraland and worked there until April 2020 as project lead when he left the platform to establish his own company Big Time Studios. He also remains a Decentraland adviser.Genesis eventually filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on Thursday after weeks of speculation about the crypto lender's financial health. Genesis Global Holdco LLC, plus subsidiaries Genesis Global Capital LLC and Genesis Asia Pacific Pte, were included in the bankruptcy filing.In the filing, Genesis estimated more than 100,000 creditors and between $1 billion and $10 billion in liabilities, as well as assets. The two other entities, Genesis Global Capital LLC and Genesis Asia Pacific Pte, estimated their assets and liabilities in the $100 million and $500 million range, respectively.According to a Bloomberg report, Genesis aims to use the Chapter 11 process to raise funds or sell assets. If these efforts turn out to be unfruitful, creditors will end up owning the reorganized business. The company also has $150 million of cash on hand that would be used to fund the bankruptcy process.As a reminder, Genesis announced that it was suspending redemptions and new loan originations in mid-November last year following the collapse of crypto exchange FTX, saying that the “abnormal withdrawal requests” exceeded its “current liquidity.”Meanwhile, Genesis has been in the middle of a public dispute with major crypto exchange Gemini, founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss. The twins are owed more than $900 million by Genesis. However, the due is not consent with how DCG CEO Barry Silbert has been handling things and even called for his removal as the CEO of Digital Currency Group.
ru.summary: Соучредители Decentraland Эстебан Ордано и Ари Мейлич, а также финансовый директор платформы Сантьяго Эспонда входят в число 50 крупнейших необеспеченных претензий к Genesis, не связанных с инсайдерской информацией. Кредитор, занимающийся криптой, раскрыл имена своих крупнейших кредиторов в тот же день, когда подал заявление о банкротстве.

record.header: Here's How Much Genesis Owes Creditors Like Gemini, Mirana, VanEck and Others
record.subheader: Bankruptcy of Genesis was most likely inevitable, but lack of reaction from market is concerning
record.content: One of the most feared bankruptcies on the market happened: Genesis filed for bankruptcy protection on Thursday in the Southern District of New York. Apparently, the firm failed to raise enough funding to cover lending operations, in addition to cutting a large portion of its staff.The company had no other choice but to terminate its lending operations and eventually file for bankruptcy, as the FTX fallout led to an unbearable liquidity crisis, in addition to the collapse of Three Arrows Capital.According to the filing, the biggest creditors that Genesis owes money to is Gemini. The prominent cryptocurrency exchange will have to somehow collect the $765 million dedicated to the victims of the Gemini Earn program who invested their money to generate interest.Mirana venture investment company, which owns numerous large crypto-related projects in the space, has also confirmed that Genesis owes them $151 million collateralized with $120 million, which has already been liquidated.More "local" crypto companies also appeared on the list. Decentraland, for example, invested around $55 million in Genesis. However, the sum exceeds the value set on the official treasury page by two times.Long-forgotten Stellar Foundation also made it into the filing, with $13 million that it provided at the start of Genesis and that has not been returned to the company after the implosion of FTX.The lack of reaction and price action on the market gives us an extremely important signal: the cryptocurrency industry is exhausted after the implosion of FTX, the bankruptcy of 3AC and other events that happened in 2022.Hopefully, Genesis' filing will be the conclusion of one of the worst periods in the history of the digital assets industry.

en.header: Ripple Vs SEC Lawsuit Takes a Positive Turn: Here's What Next
en.content: In the ongoing Ripple-SEC case, all motions have been thoroughly briefed, and the judge’s judgment is expected, according to James K. Filan’s most recent updates. Ripple and the SEC submitted their final round of briefs in December, requesting the court to grant them summary judgment.Omnibus applications to seal documents related to the summary judgment motions have also been filed by both parties as the motions for summary judgment and those to exclude expert witnesses have now both been completely briefed.The CEO of Ripple, Brad Garlinghouse, expressed hope at Davos that the company’s legal dispute with the Securities and Exchange Commission will be resolved in 2023, perhaps as early as this year.He said, “We are optimistic that this will definitely be fixed in 2023, and possibly the first half. So we’ll see how it plays out from here. But I feel very good about where we are with respect to the law and the facts.”In his subsequent statement, he says that he expects a decision to be made “sometime in the following single-digit months” – maybe as early as June. The dispute over whether XRP should be considered a security will have significant effects on both Ripple and the greater crypto market.Garlinghouse then added, “We’ve always said we’d love to oblige, but it requires one very important thing, and that is that looking forward, it is clear that XRP is not a security. The SEC and Gary Gensler have openly stated that they view almost all cryptocurrencies as a security. And so that leaves very little room in the Venn diagram for settling.”Gary Gensler, the chairman of the Securities and Exchange Commission, previously stated his views on cryptocurrencies, particularly Bitcoin, in a CNBC interview with the host of Mad Money Jim Cramer. Gensler specifically contends that cryptocurrencies are a very speculative asset class. In fact, the SEC chairman was quick to point out this speculative asset class’ ups and downs.
en.summary: Judge Filan expects summary judgment by end of March. CEO of Ripple says dispute with SEC will be resolved in 2023

record.header: CoinMarketCap News, Jan 20: Today's Top Story Was Pretty Inevitable, Really | CoinMarketCap
record.subheader: After multiple body blows during the 2022 bear market, Genesis finally throws in the towel. What's next?
record.content: Genesis files for bankruptcy ❌We knew this was coming. Genesis has filed for bankruptcy after suffering multiple body blows during the bear market. As well as nursing heavy losses following the collapse of Three Arrows Capital and FTX, it owes $900 million to 340,000 Gemini Earn customers. Estimates suggest Genesis has 100,000 creditors — and the 50 biggest are owed $3.5 billion. Gemini's co-founder Cameron Winklevoss says the Chapter 11 proceedings are a "crucial step" in recovering funds for his customers. He once again claimed that Digital Currency Group's CEO, Barry Silbert, has refused to offer creditors a fair deal — and threatened to file a lawsuit imminently. Welcoming the involvement of a court, he added: "Sunlight is the best disinfectant."FTX could reopen, new CEO says 👀FTX International could be revived, according to its new CEO. John Ray told The Wall Street Journal that a taskforce is looking into this idea. But it's unknown whether users would put their trust in this business again after billions of dollars of customer funds were misused by Alameda Research. Ray thinks reopening FTX could allow creditors to get more of their funds back. He attacked Sam Bankman-Fried for questioning his judgements on Substack, saying: "We don't need to be dialoguing with him. He hasn't told us anything that I don't already know." Ray also defended charging $1,300 per hour, saying: "Crime is very expensive. It does a lot of damage to people. And one of the damages is that people like me have to come in and fix it."SBF's family suffer security incident 🚨Sam Bankman-Fried has claimed there was a security incident outside his parent's property, where he is under house arrest on a $250 million bond. His lawyers say a black car drove into metal barricades outside the house in Palo Alto, adding: "Three men got out of the car. When the security guard on duty confronted them, the men said something to the effect of: 'You won't be able to keep us out.' The men got back in the car and quickly drove away before the security guard was able to see the license plate." SBF's legal team have previously warned that his parents have "received a steady stream of threatening correspondence, including communications expressing a desire that they suffer physical harm."Andrew Tate's detention extended 🚓Andrew Tate is going to remain behind bars until 27 February. The influencer and crypto trader was arrested in Romania late last year — alongside his brother and two women. They're accused of human trafficking, rape, and forming an organized crime group. Tate was initially detained for 30 days amid fears he could be a flight risk, but a Romanian court has now extended this deadline. The additional detention is designed to give police time to build a case against him. Tate — or his supporters — have been using his Twitter account to protest his innocence. A recent post said: "Solitary confinement provides the perfect environment to meditate and hone my dragon fist. Once they fail to kill me, I will emerge. Perpetrators beware."Jamie Dimon: Bitcoin is 'hyped-up fraud' 😡JPMorgan's CEO has long been a critic of Bitcoin — and it looks like he won't be changing his mind anytime soon. During a CNBC interview in Davos, Jamie Dimon said the world's biggest cryptocurrency was a "hyped-up fraud" and a "pet rock." He went on to suggest that Bitcoin's fixed supply of 21 million could be changed — with Satoshi Nakamoto withdrawing billions of dollars. Dimon said financial journalists are "wasting their breath" by covering the crypto space — and it seems he's getting pretty fed up with being asked about it. Growing increasingly exasperated as his views on digital assets were challenged, the banker growled: "I don't care about Bitcoin so we should just drop the subject."Ransomware revenues are plunging 📉Some rare good news in the battle against ransomware — according to Chainalysis, the amount extorted by attackers in 2022 actually tumbled by 40% compared with the year before. The blockchain analytics firm says it's been an "impactful year" in tackling those who deceive victims, encrypt files, and then demand cryptocurrency in exchange for unlocking them. Estimates from Chainalysis claim $457 million was extorted by ransomware attackers in 2022. In both 2020 and 2021, this figure stood roughly at $765 million. The driving force behind declining revenues for attackers is pretty interesting; Chainalysis believes victims are refusing to pay. Whereas 76% ended up submitting to a ransom in 2019, this dwindled to 41% in 2022.

en.header: The Mercury corvette carried out shooting in the Baltic Sea as part of state tests
en.subheader: Artillery firing at a naval target was carried out by the Mercury corvette of project 20380, which is on state tests, the Baltic Fleet said on Saturday.
en.content: Moscow: On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU - Artillery shootings on a maritime target were conducted by the State-tested Mercure Corvette of Project 20380, reported to the Baltic fleet on Saturday. "The ship's shield was used as a target. According to objective monitoring, the shootings have been successfully carried out", a report states that the shootings were carried out in the Baltic Sea from the artillery ship's A-190. It is noted that at the completion of the maritime part of the test programme an audit of the ship's equipment will be carried out. "The manufacturer will carry out a verification autopsy of the machinery and instruments, the experts and the members of the State Commission will assess the overall condition of the corvette, its equipment and all the funds on it. Following the signing of the receiving act with the customer and the approval of the act by Navy Chief Admiral Nikolai Evmenov, a date will be set for the admission of the Corvette into the Navy and the rise of the Andreev Flag, as stated in the report. Mercure, a Russian corvette with a controlled missile weapon, the fifth ship of Project 20380, is intended to patrol the near- and far-sea zone, combat submarines, submarines and enemy aircraft.

record.header: Yerevan rejects accusations of transporting mines to Nagorno-Karabakh
record.content: Moscow. On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU - Armenia, in self-defence following the escalation of the conflict with Azerbaijan in 2021, carried out mine clearance only on its territory, declared that the movement of mines along the Lachin corridor into the territory of Nagorny Karabakh was unfounded, declared the head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Armenia, Arrat Mirzoyan. "Armenia carried out mine clearance only on the sovereign territory of the Republic of Armenia and did so solely in self-defence, since in 2021 it was subjected to military aggression by Azerbaijan in May, November 2021 and September 2022. The threat of new military aggression against the sovereign territory of Armenia also remains high," Mirzoyan told the State Information Agency "Armenpress". Thus, he commented on Baku's statements that the closure of the Lachin corridor was also due to "the transport of mines from Armenia to Nagorny Karabakh", which Azerbaijan transmitted to Russia. According to him, the mines referred to by Baku were found on the Azerbaijani side "in the territories of Armenia occupied as a result of the Azerbaijani aggression against the Republic of Armenia between 2021 and 2022". The head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic reiterated that Yerevan had no role in ensuring the smooth functioning of the Lachin corridor linking Nagorny Karabakh to Armenia, which had been closed by the Azerbaijani side since 12 December, and that the situation there was approaching a humanitarian disaster." We have said many times that article 6 of the tripartite declaration (the heads of Armenia, the Russian Federation and Azerbaijan on Karabakh-IF) of 9 November 2020 governing the Lachin corridor does not provide any function for Armenia to ensure the smooth operation of the corridor. The smooth functioning of the corridor is the responsibility of the peace-keeping forces of the Russian Federation and Azerbaijan, and issues related to the internal life of Nagorny Karabakh are under the control of the authorities of Nagorny Karabakh, and the Armenian authorities have no function here either." He said. He said that the humanitarian crisis in Nagorny Karabakh caused by the blocking of the Lachin corridor is already approaching a humanitarian disaster, "and if the corridor is not immediately opened, there is an urgent need for humanitarian intervention by the international community, including, first of all, the United Nations." The Lachin corridor is the only road that connects Armenia with Nagorny Karabakh. Since December 12, it has been blocked. In Baku, they insist that this is not a blockade, but a protest against illegal mining in the region, with Russian peacekeepers, the Red Cross and "local residents of Armenian origin" travelling on both tracks. Earlier in January, the President of Azerbaijan, Ilham Aliev, stated that the Armenian side had been using the Lachin road for more than two years to transport mines, weapons and ammunition and military personnel. On 18 January, the head of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Sergei Lavrov, reported that the Russian military had received this information and was studying it.

ru.header: Корвет "Меркурий" провел стрельбы на Балтике в рамках госиспытаний
ru.subheader: Артиллерийские стрельбы по морской цели провел находящийся на государственных испытаниях корвет "Меркурий" проекта 20380, сообщил Балтийский флот в субботу.
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Артиллерийские стрельбы по морской цели провел находящийся на государственных испытаниях корвет "Меркурий" проекта 20380, сообщил Балтийский флот в субботу."В качестве мишени использовался корабельный щит. По данным объективного контроля, стрельбы выполнены успешно", - говорится в сообщении.Стрельбы выполнялись в Балтийском море из артиллерийской корабельной установки А-190.Отмечается, что по завершению морской части программы испытаний будет произведена ревизия оборудования корабля."Заводом-изготовителем будет проведено контрольное вскрытие механизмов и приборов, специалисты и члены госкомиссии оценят общее состояние корвета, его оборудования и всех имеющихся на нем средств. После подписания приемопередаточного акта с заказчиком и утверждения акта главкомом ВМФ Адмиралом Николаем Евменовым будет определена дата приема корвета в состав Военно-морского флота и подъема Андреевского Флага", - говорится в сообщении."Меркурий"- российский корвет с управляемым ракетным оружием, пятый корабль проекта 20380. Предназначен для патрулирования ближней и дальней морской зоны, борьбы с надводными кораблями, подводными лодками и самолетами противника.

en.subheader: SOL has doubled its price since mid-December
en.content: SOL, the native currency of the Solana blockchain, is up a whopping 20% in the last 24 hours at a current price of $25.16. Solana is outperforming the top 10 cryptocurrencies in daily and weekly gains, having gained 12.73% since the past week.According to Santiment, an on-chain analytics firm, the current price increase for Solana is supported by volume upticks. In a chart posted, Santiment wrote that traders are showing major FOMO (fear of missing out) on Solana and three other altcoins, owing to Friday's huge pump.🥳 #Equities soared Friday, and #crypto erupted with them as many #altcoins are seeing big returns. Volume upticks are supporting prices rises for:📌 @hedera $HBAR (+33%)📌 @SkaleNetwork $SKL (+16%)📌 @solana $SOL (+11%)📌 @decentraland $MANA (+11%)https://t.co/4oc7JGm1py pic.twitter.com/VcQHV6axoH— Santiment (@santimentfeed) January 20, 2023This is seen in the trading volume, which is up a whopping 170% in the last 24 hours, according to CoinMarketCap data. Increased volumes typically coincide with higher volatility as traders jump in to capture profits.The rally started after a positive tweet by Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin, expressing "hope" that Solana "gets its fair chance to thrive," shortly after SOL had plunged to a record low of $8.19 in the wake of the FTX fiasco. FTX co-founder Sam Bankman-Fried was a strong backer of Solana.SOL has doubled its price since mid-December, reaching as high as $25.86 at press time, and is up 107% this year alone.New ray of hope for SolanaThe price rebound of SOL has brought about renewed optimism over the long-term future of the blockchain.1/ A new report by @ElectricCapital shows that Solana is the fastest growing developer ecosystem, surpassing 2,000 total developers in 2022. Also, the developer count increased by 83% between December 2021 and December 2022.Along with an increase in developers, Solana has seen a remarkable increase in the adoption of priority fees and local fee markets. This was seen throughout the network at the dApp and wallet levels.

en.header: UAE Sees Key Role For Crypto As Gulf State Eyes To Boost Trading Policies
en.content: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) is looking to adopt cryptocurrency in a ‘major role’ in its trading policies, according to a report by Bloomberg.Speaking with Bloomberg Television in Davos, Switzerland – where the World Economic Forum is currently being held – UAE’s minister of state for foreign trade, Thani Al-Zeyoudi, made some positive statements on the potential role of cryptocurrency in the economy of the gulf nation.“Crypto will play a major role for UAE trade going forward,” said Al-Zeyoudi. For years now, the UAE government has been working on transforming the nation into a global crypto hub, mainly by implementing crypto-friendly policies with the goal of attracting the big guns in the $1 trillion industry.Al-Zeyoudi discussed this project with Bloomberg stating UAE’s plan of a collaborative effort with these companies in creating the required legal framework for the expansion of cryptocurrency operations within the Middle Eastern state.“The most important thing is that we ensure global governance when it comes to cryptocurrencies and crypto companies,” he said.“We started attracting some of the companies to the country with the aim that we’ll build together the right governance and legal system, which are needed,” he told Bloomberg in his interview on Friday.UAE Expresses Support For Crypto Amid Market WoesJust a day before Al-Zeyoudi’s interview, the UAE’s minister for Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy, and Remote Work Application Omar Sultan Al Olama, who is also representing the Emirates at the World Economic Forum, stated that the nation remained committed to its goal of becoming the world’s cryptocurrency hub regardless of the recent market crash.While participating as a speaker in a panel discussion titled “Finding The Right Balance For Crypto,” Sultan Al Olama made these claims while saying that crypto companies already referring to the UAE as home was a positive thing to note.Last November, the crypto market recorded heavy losses following the shocking collapse of the FTX exchange. Although the market is still far from a full recovery, there have been steady gains in the last few weeks.For example, Bitcoin, the crypto market leader and the world’s biggest digital asset, has recorded an increase of 37.40% in its value since the beginning of 2023. According to data from CoinMarketCap, BTC is trading at $22,621.05 per unit with a market cap of $435.9 billion.BTC Trading at $22712.00 | Source: BTCUSD chart on Tradingview.comCould UAE Become The Crypto Capital Of The World?At multiple times in the last few years, the Middle Eastern nation has stated its desire to become the global central hub for cryptocurrency operations. To this end, the nation’s government has continuously introduced several policies aimed at encouraging the activities of blockchain-based businesses in the country.So far, these efforts have been a massive success, with over 400 active crypto businesses currently operating in the UAE. Furthermore, due to a friendly regulatory framework, several exchanges, including Binance, OKX, BitOasis, etc., have all acquired licenses to operate in the country.Dubai, the country’s commercial hub, has also played host to prominent cryptocurrency festivals, including the World Blockchain Summit, Crypto Expo Dubai, CryptoFest, etc.Clearly, the United Arab Emirates is on the right trajectory to achieve its lofty goal. Although the nation still faces several challenges, including the constant risk of fraud and growing competition from other nations with similar goals, (e.g., Bahrain, Qatar, Egypt, etc.), the UAE is currently the leading contender to become the crypto capital of the world.

record.header: UAE and India are discussing the issue of non-oil trade in rupees and dirhams - UAE Minister
record.subheader: According to Bloomberg, the total volume of bilateral trade between the UAE and India amounted to almost $64 billion in 2021.
record.content: MOSCOW, 20 January - RIA News/Prime. The United Arab Emirates and India are still discussing ways to stimulate non-oil trade in rupees and dirhams, as reported by the Foreign Trade Minister of the United Arab Emirates, Tani Al-Zeyudi. "We are still at an early stage of discussing with India the issue of trade in dirhams and rupees... it is only non-oil trade," said the Minister to the Bloomberg Agency. Bloomberg explains that the third-largest OPEC manufacturer has long supported the currency-to-dollar linkage, and most of the trade in the Persian Gulf is in United States currency. According to data collected by Bloomberg, the total bilateral trade between UAE and India amounted to nearly $64 billion in 2021, and the United Arab Emirates was seeking to increase trade with key partners and had signed several economic pacts last year with countries such as India, Indonesia, Turkey, Israel and Ukraine. Tani Al-Zeyoudi added that in the coming months the UAE expected similar agreements with Cambodia and Georgia; economic agreements would increase the country ' s GDP by 3.4 to 3.8 per cent by 2030; the Minister also reported that the cryptators would play an important role in future UAE trade; and that the Emirates, in particular Dubai, were working to attract the world ' s largest companies to adopt its favourable policies.

ru.summary: Объединенные Арабские Эмираты (ОАЭ) стремятся использовать криптовалюту в качестве "главной роли" в своей торговой политике. Государственный министр внешней торговли ОАЭ Тани Аль-Зейуди сделала несколько позитивных заявлений о потенциальной роли криптовалюты в экономике страны Персидского залива. Вот уже много лет правительство ОАЭ работает над преобразованием

record.header: UAE and India are discussing the issue of non-oil trade in rupees and dirhams - UAE Minister
record.subheader: According to Bloomberg, the total volume of bilateral trade between the UAE and India amounted to almost $64 billion in 2021.
record.content: MOSCOW, 20 January - RIA News/Prime. The United Arab Emirates and India are still discussing ways to stimulate non-oil trade in rupees and dirhams, as reported by the Foreign Trade Minister of the United Arab Emirates, Tani Al-Zeyudi. "We are still at an early stage of discussing with India the issue of trade in dirhams and rupees... it is only non-oil trade," said the Minister to the Bloomberg Agency. Bloomberg explains that the third-largest OPEC manufacturer has long supported the currency-to-dollar linkage, and most of the trade in the Persian Gulf is in United States currency. According to data collected by Bloomberg, the total bilateral trade between UAE and India amounted to nearly $64 billion in 2021, and the United Arab Emirates was seeking to increase trade with key partners and had signed several economic pacts last year with countries such as India, Indonesia, Turkey, Israel and Ukraine. Tani Al-Zeyoudi added that in the coming months the UAE expected similar agreements with Cambodia and Georgia; economic agreements would increase the country ' s GDP by 3.4 to 3.8 per cent by 2030; the Minister also reported that the cryptators would play an important role in future UAE trade; and that the Emirates, in particular Dubai, were working to attract the world ' s largest companies to adopt its favourable policies.

en.header: Buzova declared her readiness to negotiate with the invader of the bank branch
en.content: Olga Bouzova Thelvete-Olga Bouzova stated that she would have come to a meeting with the man who had taken hostages at the Alpha Bank office in Moscow if it had been necessary. She had told the account in Instagram about this. Previously, a source of the RBC in the law enforcement agencies had reported that the invader had requested an opportunity to see Buzova. The news of the hostage-taking had shocked her. "I want to say that I would have come at any time to a meeting, to talk to a terrorist, if it had been necessary from me, and I would have been approached by the law enforcement agencies if I could help," Bouzova said. She also thanked the law enforcement officers for their work, and the man took hostages at the Alpha Bank office on Earth Val Street in Moscow and threatened to blow up the building. Several people were able to leave the office. The RBC source reported that one bank client remained hostage. Then the invader was detained. As a result, no one was injured. The UK initiated criminal proceedings. The capital head of the Ministry of Internal Affairs noted that the invader had come to Moscow from another Russian region.

ru.header: Бузова заявила о готовности к переговорам с захватчиком отделения банка
ru.content: Ольга БузоваТелеведущая Ольга Бузова заявила, что приехала бы на встречу с мужчиной, захватившим заложников в отделении Альфа-банка в Москве, если бы это потребовалось. Об этом она рассказала в аккаунте в Instagram. Ранее источник РБК в правоохранительных органах сообщал, что захватчик требовал возможности увидеть Бузову.Телеведущая отметила, что новость о захвате заложников повергла ее в шок. «Хочу сказать, что я бы приехала в любой момент на встречу, разговор с террористом, если бы от меня это нужно было и ко мне бы обратились правоохранительные органы, если бы я могла помочь», — заявила Бузова. Она также поблагодарила правоохранителей за работу.Мужчина захватил заложников в отделении Альфа-банка на улице Земляной Вал в Москве и угрожал взорвать здание. Несколько человек смогли покинуть отделение. Источник РБК сообщал, что в заложниках остался один клиент банка. Затем захватчика задержали. В результате никто не пострадал. СК возбудил уголовное дело.В столичном главке МВД отметили, что захватчик приехал в Москву из другого российского региона. Источник РБК сообщил, что его зовут Алексей Барышников и ему меньше 30 лет.

en.header: A referendum on early parliamentary elections is being held in Slovakia
en.content: Moscow: 21 January: INTERFAX.RU - In Slovakia, a national referendum is being held on Saturday to amend the country's Constitution to allow for early elections and the termination of the powers of the current Parliament, written by Associated Press. Citizens are asked to answer the question in the form whether they agree to the amendment of the Constitution allowing for early elections if approved by Parliament or by referendum. At present, the Slovak Constitution does not offer this possibility. The results of the referendum can be voted until 21:00 (23:00 Moscow) at local time on 22 January. In order for the referendum to have legal effect, it must be 50 per cent; the President of the country, Zuzan Chaputov, decided to hold a national referendum last year after the three opposition parties of Slovakia collected more than 380,000 votes in support of this vote. In mid-December 2022, the Slovak Parliament expressed its mistrust to the coalition government of Heger. Chaputova asked Heger to remain in office with limited powers until the new elections were held. The parliamentary elections in Slovakia were scheduled to take place in 2024. According to the polls, the opposition had a good chance of winning early elections, the agency noted.

record.header: CEC is preparing for presidential elections in 2024
record.subheader: The Russian Central Assembly is preparing for the election of the President of the Russian Federation, scheduled to take place in March 2024, and informed the chairman of the Commission, Ella Pamfilov, at a meeting with journalists.
record.content: Moscow. On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU, the Central Bureau of Russia, was preparing for the election of the President of the Russian Federation, scheduled to take place in March 2024, reported to the journalists at a meeting with the Chairman of the Commission, Ella Pamfilov. "Of course we are preparing (for the presidential campaign)," said Pamfilov at a meeting with journalists at the CEC. She said that the Central Bureau was currently preparing for the election of the President in all technical, digital, methodological, organizational and human resources areas. She also said that the Russian electoral system had sufficient protection against DDoS-atak. "As long as we all endure, the digital analogy of the CEO system of Elections, which we are now creating, is also autonomous from the global network, which means absolutely invincible," said the head of the commission, and presidential elections in Russia are due to take place on 17 March 2024.

ru.header: В Словакии проходит референдум о досрочных парламентских выборах
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - В Словакии в субботу проходит общенациональный референдум о внесении поправок в Конституцию страны для проведения досрочных выборов и прекращении полномочий нынешнего парламента, пишет агентство Associated Press.Гражданам страны предлагается ответить на вопрос в бланке, согласны ли они с внесением поправок в Конституцию, позволяющих провести досрочные выборы, если они будут одобрены парламентом или на референдуме. В настоящее время Конституция Словакии не предлагает такой возможности.Проголосовать можно до 21:00 (23:00 по Москве) по местному времени, результаты референдума будут известны 22 января. Чтобы референдум имел юридическую силу, явка на нем должна составить порядка 50%.Решение о проведении общенационального референдума приняла президент страны Зузана Чапутова в прошлом году после того, как три оппозиционные партии Словакии собрали более 380 тыс. голосов в поддержку этого голосования. Премьер Эдуард Хегер заявил, что не будет голосовать, по его мнению, это не имеет смысла.В середине декабря 2022 года парламент Словакии выразил недоверие коалиционному правительству Хегера. Чапутова попросила Хегера оставаться на посту с ограниченными полномочиями до проведения новых выборов.Парламентские выборы в Словакии должны были состояться по плану в 2024 году. Согласно опросам, у оппозиции неплохие шансы победить на досрочных выборах, отмечает агентство.

en.header: The RCN announced the compliance of Telegram with the criteria for banning the transfer of payment documents by banks
en.content: On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU - Telegram was defined as a foreign minister whose use in the provision of banking and public services was prohibited as of 1 March for the transmission of payment documents and personal data to a particular user of the programme was reported in Roskomnadzor (RCN). "As the main criteria for the classification of the computer programme into foreign moders, at 8th article 10.1 of FZ N149 "On information", it was determined: the possibility of transmitting messages to a particular user of the programme; the programme is owned by a foreign person", that Interfax at RKN was reminded that under article 2, paragraph 1, of the Federal Act of 29 December 2022 No. 584-FZ, which amends the Information Act, as of 1 March 2023, a number of organizations in Russia "will be prohibited from using such messengers for the transmission of payment documents and personal data in the provision of services". The RTC left without comment the question of whether Telegram would be included in the Register of Foreign Messengers to be published on the Service ' s website, as required by law. In the meantime, Telegram is used to exchange messages between its users, and the company is listed as a foreign company operating on the Internet on the territory of the Russian Federation, established under the law on the "landing" of foreign IT giants. On 29 December, Russian President Vladimir Putin signed a law prohibiting banks and non-crediting financial organizations from using foreign ministers to convey certain information to clients. The list of Massengers will be prepared and posted on its website. Since March 1, 2023. Banks, non-credited financial organizations (traders in the securities market, CC, investors, NPFs, custodians, etc.) d. ) will not be able to use foreign ministers in the provision of services for the transmission of payment documents, the provision of information containing personal data of citizens of the Russian Federation for the transmission of data on transfers of money in the framework of non-cash payments, and the transmission of information necessary for the payment of payments or information on the accounts or deposits of citizens of the Russian Federation in banks will be prohibited. In addition, it will be prohibited to transmit information through foreign ministers in the provision of public and municipal services or in the performance of a public or municipal task.
en.summary: Since March 1, 2018, the concept of "foreign messenger" has been introduced in Russia and a ban on its use in Russia has been introduced.

record.header: New conditions for acceptable agreements between banks and insurers will be introduced from September
record.subheader: From September 1, 2023, the Russian government introduces new conditions for acceptable agreements between banks and insurers.
record.content: On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU, the Government of the Russian Federation, with effect from 1 September 2023, introduced new conditions for permissible agreements between banks and insurers, as stipulated in the Decision "On cases where agreements between credit and insurance organizations, as well as foreign insurance organizations, and on the recognition of certain acts and a separate provision of the act of the Government of the Russian Federation," published on the State Legal Information Portal, the Government Decision will be in force until 1 September 2025. The main changes to the choice of partner banks of insurers are, according to the document, related to certain standardization of such approaches. The main criterion for the selection and accreditation of an insurers by banks will be the existence of a certain level of ratings. The insurance company is considered to be compliant with the bank's requirements when selecting partners for risk insurance of fellow borrowers "in the case of an insurance organization having a credit rating on the national rating scale for the Russian Federation set by the credit organization for each credit rating agency included in the register of credit rating agencies of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation". However, as noted in the document, the credit rating of the national rating of the insurance organization cannot be lower than BB and higher than A. According to the regulation, an agreement is permissible if the bank accepts the insurance policies of any insurance company that meets the requirements of the credit organization for insurers, and at the same time fulfils the conditions specified by the Government. The bank must inform borrowers of their right to choose any insurance company that meets the requirements of the credit institution. It may not "limit the number of insurance contracts that an insured person who meets the requirements of a credit institution may enter into with the borrower, the amount of the insurance and the amount of the premium" is noted in the Ordinance. The document also sets out the parameters of the unacceptable terms of the agreement between the bank and the insurers, such as those that impose restrictions on the conclusion of similar agreements with other credit and insurance organizations; the bank may not require the borrower to insurance the risks of a single insurance company for the duration of the loan or to impose insurance on risks other than credit; in addition, the bank may not "require the insurers to place money on deposits and securities of the bank, to maintain the credit organization's account balances in a certain amount, and to maintain the turnover of the funds on account of the accounts calculated" by the regulation; the bank may not force the customer to insurance its risks in an insurance company belonging to the same group as a matter of priority. In addition, the document notes the conditions that the agreement must contain in order to ensure competition; for example, the bank is obliged to adopt an insurance policy for any insurance company that meets the requirements of the loan organization chosen by the borrower, as well as the interest rate on the loan contract (the loan contract) should not depend on the name of the insurance provider with which the borrower or bank enters into the insurance contract; it is reported that the draft decree was drafted by the Russian Federation; earlier, commenting on the draft government decree being prepared, the Deputy Head of the Financial Market Control Department of the Russian Federation, Marina Pischulina, stated that the new procedure would reduce the flow of documents and the costs to banks in organizing the verification of the partner insurers.

ru.header: В РКН заявили о соответствии Telegram критериям для запрета на передачу банками платежных документов
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Telegram подпадает под определение иностранного мессенджера, использование которых с 1 марта для передачи платежных документов и персональных данных при предоставлении банковских и государственных услуг запрещено, сообщили в Роскомнадзоре (РКН)."В качестве основных критериев, позволяющих отнести программу для ЭВМ к иностранным мессенджерам, ч. 8 ст. 10.1 ФЗ N149 "Об информации" определила: возможность передавать сообщения конкретному пользователю программы; программой владеет иностранное лицо", - сообщили "Интерфаксу" в РКН.В службе напомнили, что в соответствии с ч. 1 ст. 2 федерального закона от 29 декабря 2022 No 584-ФЗ, который вносит поправки в закон "Об информации", с 1 марта 2023 года ряду организаций в России "будет запрещено использовать такие мессенджеры для передачи платежных документов и персональных данных при предоставлении услуг".В РКН оставили без комментариев вопрос, будет ли Telegram включен в реестр иностранных мессенджеров, который должен быть опубликован на сайте службы, как того требует закон.Между тем платформа Telegram используется для обмена сообщениями между её пользователями, а сама компания внесена в перечень иностранных компаний, осуществляющих деятельность в интернете на территории РФ, созданный в рамках закона о "приземлении" иностранных IT-гигантов.Президент РФ Владимир Путин 29 декабря подписал закон, запрещающий банкам и некредитным финансовым организациям использовать иностранные мессенджеры для передачи клиентам определенной информации. Перечень мессенджеров подготовит и разместит на своем сайте РКН.С 1 марта 2023 г. банки, некредитные финансовые организации (профучастники рынка ценных бумаг, УК, инвестфонды, НПФы, депозитарии и т.д.) не смогут при предоставлении услуг использовать иностранные мессенджеры для передачи платежных документов, предоставления информации, содержащей персональные данные граждан РФ, для передачи данных о переводах денежных средств в рамках безналичных расчетов, под запрет попадет передача сведений, необходимых для осуществления платежей, или сведений о счетах (вкладах) граждан РФ в банках.Кроме того, будет запрещено передавать информацию через иностранные мессенджеры при предоставлении государственных и муниципальных услуг, выполнении государственного или муниципального задания.
ru.summary: С 1 марта 2018 года в России вводится понятие «иностранный мессенджер» и вводится запрет на его использование в России.

en.header: A balloon with six adults and children caught on a tree and hovered on a mountain in Sochi
en.subheader: The balloon, in which there are six people, suspended movement and hovered on the mountain at the level of two thousand meters, the emergency services of the region told Interfax on Saturday.
en.content: Moscow. On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU - Aerostat, which contained six people who had suspended movement and hung on a mountain of 2,000 metres, reported to Interfax on Saturday in the emergency services of the region. "In Sochi, in the Lazarev district, in the village of Soloh Aul, the balloon stuck on a tree, on a mountain of 2,000 metres," said the agency's interviewer, "There are three adults and three children on the balloon.

record.header: There was a fire on the Mozir NPP at the hydrocracking complex.
record.subheader: On the night of Friday, a fire broke out at the H-Oil heavy oil residue hydrocracking complex of the Mozir NPP, which had already been put out, reported to the MES of Belarus.
record.content: Moscow: January 20, INTERFAX.RU - On Friday night, a fire occurred at the Mozir NPP's Heavy Oil Residues Hydrocracking Complex (H-Oil), which had already been put out, reported by the MES of Belarus. "In 23:41 January, rescuers were informed of the release of hydrogenisate, followed by combustion as a result of the defrosting of the filter of the combined heavy oil hydrocracking plant (not in operation, ballast work is under way) on the territory of the OAO "Mozir NPP", a press release. The fire did not disrupt the work of the NPP. The hydrocracking of heavy oil residues at the Mozir NPP began to be built in mid-2017. The cost of the project exceeds $1.45 billion. The complex includes a combination of a heavy-oil hydrocracking plant with a capacity of more than 3 million tons per year, hydrogen production and sulphur production. The installation of the plant will allow the plant to increase the depth of oil processing to 88-90 per cent, the selection of light petroleum products to 66 per cent.The launch of the complex has been postponed several times.The management of the plant reported in the autumn of 2021 that the equipment is ready for 99 per cent. The Mozir NPP is prepared by the Government of Belarus (42.76% shares), the NGC Slavneft (42.58%), the MNPP Plus (12.25 per cent) and Physis (2.41 per cent). The oil processing plant has a capacity of 12 million tons per year, and it has previously been reported that both of Belarus ' NHPs in 2022 drastically reduced the amount of refined oil as a result of the sanctions ban on the export of petroleum products to western countries.

ru.header: Воздушный шар с шестью взрослыми и детьми зацепился за дерево и завис на горе в Сочи
ru.subheader: Аэростат, в котором находятся шесть человек приостановил движение и завис на горе на уровне двух тысяч метров, сообщили "Интерфаксу" в субботу в экстренных службах региона.
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Аэростат, в котором находятся шесть человек приостановил движение и завис на горе на уровне двух тысяч метров, сообщили "Интерфаксу" в субботу в экстренных службах региона."В Сочи, в Лазаревском районе, поселке Солох-аул, завис воздушный шар, застрявший на дереве, на горе на уровне 2000 метров", - сказал собеседник агентства.По его словам, на воздушном шаре трое взрослых и трое детей.

The installation of the plant will allow the plant to increase the depth of oil processing to 88-90 per cent, the selection of light petroleum products to 66 per cent.The launch of the complex has been postponed several times.The management of the plant reported in the autumn of 2021 that the equipment is ready for 99 per cent. The Mozir NPP is prepared by the Government of Belarus (42.76% shares), the NGC Slavneft (42.58%), the MNPP Plus (12.25 per cent) and Physis (2.41 per cent). The oil processing plant has a capacity of 12 million tons per year, and it has previously been reported that both of Belarus ' NHPs in 2022 drastically reduced the amount of refined oil as a result of the sanctions ban on the export of petroleum products to western countries.

en.header: Will Genesis Bankruptcy Spell Disaster for Grayscale's GBTC and DCG?
en.content: The cryptocurrency lending platform, Genesis Global Capital, which is owned and operated by Digital Currency Group, has filed for bankruptcy.This raises concerns about the potential impact on other companies and services provided by the parent company, as is commonly seen in such circumstances.What Happens to GBTC?One of the businesses in question is Grayscale Bitcoin Trust (GBTC), the crypto investment product created by Grayscale, a subsidiary of Digital Currency Group (DCG). In a public statement on January 20, DCG’s owner, Barry Silbert, emphasized that all of the company’s other subsidiaries, including Grayscale, are unaffected by Genesis Global Capital’s financial situation and that this will not change in any manner.Silbert went on to state that DCG will continue to conduct business as usual and that there will be no disruptions. However, the company owes Genesis roughly $526 million, which is due in May 2023, as well as $1.1 billion that is owed based on a promissory note that is due in June 2032. Silbert also stated that DCG has every intention of meeting its commitments to Genesis even after the company undergoes restructuring.According to DCG, Genesis has its own independent management team, legal counsel, and financial consultants. DCG also formed a special committee of independent directors, who are in charge of the company’s reorganization, and who suggested and determined that it file for chapter 11 bankruptcy.The statement also clarified that “neither DCG nor any of its employees, including those who sit on the Genesis board of directors, were involved in the decision to file for bankruptcy.”
en.summary: Genesis Global Capital, owned and operated by Digital Currency Group, has filed for bankruptcy. This raises concerns about the potential impact on other companies and services provided by the parent company. One of the businesses in question is Grayscale Bitcoin Trust (GBTC)

record.header: Genesis' bankruptcy filing was decided by independent committee according to DCG
record.subheader: A special committee of independent directors recommended and decided to file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.
record.content: A special committee of independent directors recommended and decided to file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.NewsOwn this piece of historyCollect this article as an NFTGenesis Capital's parent company Digital Currency Group (DCG) denied involvement in Genesis' bankruptcy filing in a statement on Jan. 20. According to DCG, a special committee of independent directors recommended and decided to file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.Filing for Chapter 11 will allow Genesis to seek the reorganization of debts, assets and other business activities. The company estimated liabilities of $1 billion to $10 billion, along with assets in the same range. DCG noted in the statement that:"Genesis has its own independent management team, legal counsel, and financial advisors, and appointed a special committee of independent directors, who are in charge of the Genesis Capital restructuring, and who recommended and decided that Genesis Capital file chapter 11. Neither DCG nor any of its employees, including those who sit on the Genesis board of directors, were involved in the decision to file for bankruptcy."Only Genesis lending entities (Genesis Global Holdco, Genesis Global Capital, and Genesis Asia Pacific - collectively known as “Genesis Capital”) have filed for bankruptcy protection. Genesis Global Trading and Genesis’ spot and derivatives trading entity will remain operational.DCG Statement on Genesis Capital Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Filing: https://t.co/6SsWj4zo3R pic.twitter.com/j9e8R3mMZv— Digital Currency Group (@DCGco) January 20, 2023DCG said it intends continue to operate as usual, as per the statement, along with its other subsidiaries, including Grayscale Investments, Foundry Digital, Lino Group Holdings, CoinDesk, and TradeBlock Corporation.In a letter sent to shareholders on Jan. 17, DCG confirmed it owes "$526 million due in May 2023 and $1.1 billion under a promissory note due in June 2032." The company noted that it intends to address obligations to Genesis Capital in the course of a restructuring. The letter also announced a halt to quarterly dividend payments to preserve liquidity, Cointelegraph reported.Genesis' problems became apparent after the withdrawal halt in November, which it blamed on "unprecedented market turmoil" that followed the collapse of FTX. The company later disclosed to have $175 million stuck in a FTX account. The withdrawal halt affected clients' of the crypto exchange Gemini, and prompted calls for DCG's board to remove Barry Silbert as CEO of the firm.

en.header: The Indian authorities have banned the Perm-Goa aircraft from entering the country's airspace
en.content: Moscow: On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU, an Azur Air flight from Permi to Goa, will continue its flight at 1700 hours in Moscow following an unplanned landing at the airport of the city of Termes (Uzbekistan), reported to Interfax at the airline's press service on Saturday. "The Indian authorities banned Flight 2463 Perm-Goa from entering the country's airspace half an hour before the planned border crossing of India", said the agency's counterpart. Commenting on this information, the airline's press service reported that no dangerous substances or devices had been found on board. "The airline is making every effort to place passengers in a hotel while waiting for their flight to Goa, which is scheduled for 17:00 Moscow time," the spokesperson added.
en.summary: Azur Air has cancelled its flight from Moscow to Goa due to an emergency situation on board.

record.header: Passengers of the liner damaged in Turkey will be sent to the Russian Federation by planes
record.content: Moscow. On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU - Lyner Astoria Grande, who had been damaged in an attempt to dock at a Turkish port in a storm, would remain in Turkey for repair, Russian passengers would be sent to Sochi by flights, informed the "Interfax" representative of the shipowner in Sochi. "People will send the planes, we will send them all today and tomorrow. Ship's shipment has already begun. Ship's departure for repairs in Turkey," he said. According to the shipowner's representative, another cruise from Sochi on the Astoria Grande ship scheduled for 21 January, will therefore be cancelled. The company operator is prepared to return the money to the tourists who booked the tours. He added that the cruise programme was scheduled to continue in April: on 18 January, a cruise ship, Astoria Grande, in an attempt to dock in the storm, was hit by the cruise protection of the dock of the Turkish port of Amasra. The port was located in northern Turkey in Bartin province. 385 Russian tourists and 283 crew members were on board, none of whom were injured. For a while, the cruiser drifted near the harbour to wait the weather, he was able to dock at the port on 19 January. According to the Turkish agency Anadolu, an insurance company following an inspection of the vessel following an incident in Amasra, stated that it was not safe for passengers to continue to travel. "In this connection, it was decided to send 385 Russian passengers to Sochi by special flights. They are scheduled to take place on Friday and Saturday from Merzifon International Airport in Amassie or Zonguldak Airport," says the agency. According to the publication, the airliner will be refurbished at Tuzla Shipyard in Istanbul. Since July 2022, Astoria Grande has been performing cruises from Sochi to Turkey's coast.

ru.header: Власти Индии запретили самолету "Пермь-Гоа" вход в воздушное пространство страны
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Самолет авиакомпании Azur Air, выполнявший рейс из Перми в Гоа, продолжит перелет в 17:00 по Москве после незапланированной посадки в аэропорту города Термез (Узбекистан), сообщили "Интерфаксу" в пресс-службе авиакомпании в субботу."Индийские власти запретили рейсу 2463 Пермь - Гоа вход в воздушное пространство страны - за полчаса до планируемого пересечения границы Индии", - сказал собеседник агентства.В связи с этим самолет сел на запасном аэродроме - в международном аэропорту Термез.В субботу ряд телеграм-каналов сообщили, что вынужденная посадка самолета связана с якобы поступившим сообщением о минировании.Комментируя эту информацию, в пресс-службе авиакомпании сообщили, что опасных веществ или устройств на борту не обнаружено. "Авиакомпания предпринимает все возможные усилия, чтобы разместить пассажиров в гостинице на время ожидания вылета в Гоа. Он запланирован на 17:00 по московскому времени", - добавил представитель пресс-службы.
ru.summary: Авиакомпания Azur Air отменила свой рейс из Москвы в Гоа из-за нештатной ситуации на борту.

en.header: The United States announced work on neutralizing the Wagner PMCs
en.subheader: Wagner's PMC is trying to recruit fighters in Serbia and other countries, and the United States intends to prevent this by "putting an end" to its activity, the State Department said, expressing hope for joint work in this direction with Belgrade.
en.content: MER Wagner tried to recruit fighters in Serbia and other states, and in the United States intended to prevent it by "ending" its activities, told the State Department, expressing the hope of working with Belgrade in this direction, Private Military Company (PVC) Wagner's activities are a matter of concern to the U.S. authorities, and Washington is working to neutralize its activities, said State Department adviser Derek Schalle during his visit to Serbia, transmitting ABC. He pointed out that the FAC was seeking to recruit fighters in Serbia and other countries, and the United States authorities believed that that should not be allowed to happen. "I don't know if there's any fear [in Serbia about PMK Wagner], we talked about our fears, and we look forward to working with the government here in Belgrade and elsewhere where [MER] Wagner is active to put an end to their activities," he added. Serbia's legislation prohibits citizens from taking part in hostilities in other countries, provides for punishment not only for combatants but also for "recruiting or encouraging" such activities, notes the Serbian newspaper Danas. Earlier, the newspaper Politico, referring to data obtained from diplomatic correspondence, wrote that "United States officials are increasingly monitoring the movements and actions of MERs outside Ukraine", including in Serbia and the Central African Republic. The U.S. authorities view MER Wagner as the "final military user", which prohibits it from supplying a number of technology and goods produced anywhere with United States equipment. Wagner's MER has been under American sanctions since 2017. In the White House, it is believed that the founder of the PMC, Wagner Evgeny Prigozhin, is now "disposed" of taking Artemovsk because of the presence of a large number of mines near the city, seeking to control the extraction of plaster and salt in the region, wrote Reuters in early January with a reference to the source. "In order that there may be no conversation in America about us fighting for salt, I will hand over the salt of Ukraine to the mountain specialist <...> Soledar when you go through, will you leave it there, okay?" said the Prigozhin, symbolically handing over a pack of salt to the PKK fighter. At the end of December last year, the National Security Council's Communications Coordinator, John Kirby, informed Reuters Agency that in Washington, he was concerned about the supply of weapons from the DPRK to Wagner group. Earlier in November, he claimed that North Korea had sent large quantities of artillery shells to Russia early in the fall. CNN reported that such data were also available to American intelligence. Russia and the DPRK denied this information, the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesman Maria Zaharov called Kirby's statement a lie. "No clear justification for these allegations has been provided, nor could it have been, since everything the American representatives said was a lie from beginning to end," she said at the time.

record.subheader: The White House has declared Wagner's PMC a transnational criminal organization
record.content: The U.S. defines PMC Wagner as a transnational criminal organization, the Ministry of Finance will impose additional sanctions against it, reports the White House, and the material is being supplemented.

ru.header: США заявили о работе по нейтрализации ЧВК Вагнера
ru.subheader: ЧВК Вагнера пытается вербовать бойцов в Сербии и других государствах, в США намерены этому помешать, «положив конец» ее активности, рассказали в Госдепартаменте, выразив надежду на совместную работу в этом направлении с Белградом
ru.content: ЧВК Вагнера пытается вербовать бойцов в Сербии и других государствах, в США намерены этому помешать, «положив конец» ее активности, рассказали в Госдепартаменте, выразив надежду на совместную работу в этом направлении с БелградомДеятельность частной военной компании (ЧВК) Вагнера вызывает беспокойство у властей США, в связи с чем Вашингтон ведет работу по нейтрализации ее деятельности, заявил в ходе своего визита в Сербию советник Госдепартамента Дерек Шолле, передает ABC.Он указал, что ЧВК стремится вербовать бойцов в Сербии и других странах, американские власти считают, что этого допускать нельзя.«Я не знаю, есть ли опасения [в Сербии насчет ЧВК Вагнера], мы говорили о наших опасениях, и мы с нетерпением ждем совместной работы с правительством здесь, в Белграде, и в других местах, где [ЧВК] Вагнера активна, чтобы положить конец их деятельности», — добавил Шолле.Законодательство Сербии запрещает гражданам участвовать в боевых действиях в других странах, наказание предусмотрено не только для участников боев, но и для «вербующих или поощряющих» такую деятельность, отмечает сербская газета Danas.Ранее газета Politico со ссылкой на данные, полученные из дипломатической переписки, писала, что «должностные лица США все больше отслеживают передвижения и действия ЧВК за пределами Украины», в том числе в Сербии и Центральноафриканской Республике.Власти США рассматривают ЧВК Вагнера в качестве «конечного военного пользователя», что запрещает поставку ей ряда технологий и товаров, произведенных где-либо с использованием американского оборудования. ЧВК Вагнера находится под американскими санкциями с 2017 года.В Белом доме полагают, что основатель ЧВК Вагнера Евгений Пригожин сейчас «одержим» взятием Артемовска из-за наличия близ города большого количества шахт, стремясь взять под контроль добычу в регионе гипса и соли, писал Reuters в начале января со ссылкой на источник. «Чтобы разговоров не было в Америке о том, что мы за соль боремся, я специалисту горному передаю соль украинскую. <...> Соледар когда пройдете, оставишь там, ладно?», — сказал затем Пригожин, символически передавая бойцу ЧВК пачку соли.В конце декабря прошлого года координатор по коммуникациям Совета национальной безопасности США Джон Кирби сообщил агентству Reuters, что в Вашингтоне обеспокоены поставками оружия из КНДР группе Вагнера. До этого, в ноябре, он заявил, что Северная Корея в начале осени направила в Россию значительные партии артиллерийских снарядов. CNN сообщал, что такие данные есть и у американской разведки.Россия и КНДР опровергали эту информацию, представитель российского МИДа Мария Захарова назвала ложью заявления Кирби. «Никакого внятного обоснования этих утверждений представлено не было, да и не могло быть, поскольку все сказанное американскими представителями — ложь от начала до конца», — сказала она тогда.
