en.header: Pushkin and Gagarin streets will be renamed in the Odessa region
en.subheader: Dumskaya: streets named after Pushkin and Gagarin will be renamed in the Odessa region
en.content: In the three villages of Odessa province, they decided to rename the streets named after Russian writers and cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin, a project published on the Black Sea Council website, the publication "Dumska" reported that the decision had already been taken; in the village of Alexandrovka, the street and alley of Alexandra Pushkin would be renamed after "the defenders of Ukraine"; the name would also touch the alley and street of the cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin, which would be named after the cosmonaut of Ukrainian origin Leonid Kadenyuk; the street and alley would be named after Mikhail Lermontov; the street and alley would be known as the Unity; the street of Lváv Tolstoy would become Greek; and the street of the poet Vladimir Mayakovsky would be called European; in the village of Malodolin the street and alley of the marine officer Petra Schmidt would be renamed "Cultural". In Burlacchia Balka, the street of the poet Sergei Jessenin will become Portova. The replacement of the signs with names will be organized by local heads after the lifting of martial law, concluded "Dumny." With the start of Russia's military special operation in Ukraine, initiatives to rename "Russian" toponyms and other objects related to Russia, as well as to dismantle the monuments of Soviet time.The Ministry of Culture of Ukraine has established a special Council for Derusification, De-Communization and Decolonization, which coordinates "the dismantling or transfer of monuments and other objects of the Soviet past." The Mayor of Kiev, Vitaly Klićko, promised in April to rename all the capital streets, prospectus and stations whose names are linked to the USSR or Russia.
en.summary: In Odessa, streets will be renamed in honor of Russian and Soviet writers and cosmonauts, in three villages — in honor of Soviet and Russian cosmonauts. The corresponding bill was submitted to the Odessa City Council.

record.header: Pykhtino station in Moscow began to be decorated in the style of Soviet aviation
record.content: In the near future, at the Pyhtino station, which, together with Vnukovo, closes up the solar branch extension of the metro, will begin to install decorative panels with images of aircraft. Zammer Moskva, on urban policy and construction, reported that the design of the station was dedicated to the history of aviation and, in particular, to the national air structure. This is also due to the proximity of the Pichtinos to the airport of Vnukovo, where the last yellow branch of the metro will be installed, and the geography of the village of Pichtino itself, near the subway, is located on the streets of the Gretsitz flighter, the Ulyvan pilot and the Avia-constructor of Petlyak. If the passenger walks on the platform, he can trace the history of the airline in Russia from the ANT-3 (one of Tupolev's first children from the 1920's) to the Tou-214 (highway narrow-fuse liner, one of the latest developments of the Tupole PAO). Another 144-series "cat" on a reduced scale will meet passengers above the escalator. Over its ribbon are mounted a "light well" in the form of aluminum panels, a kind of window into the sky, inside which the Tu-144 model will be placed. This was explained by Yuri Kravtsov, Director General of Engineering Holding, Mosing Project, who is the general designer and general contractor for the construction of the Moscow subway. Krabtsov also noted that a window would be placed on the wall opposite to the air pane, opening a view of the Lykova valley. He reported that 90 per cent of the wall had been granited, adding that it was also being finished in the offices of Pyhtino and that engineering systems were being installed. "Pythino", the penultimate station for the forward-looking continuation of the solar branch (before the "Vnukovo"), is located along the Borov Highway near the village of the same name and the ZK "Solar Park". It is a small-scale station with one ground lobby, and because of its difficult terrain, it has different travel walls: one with panoramic glazing. Trains will be "sniffing" here to the surface and will sail to the metrobridge across the River Likova, which will be Moscow's 12th metrobridge, the second longest after Luzhnec. Previously, the building complex of the capital described a public space project on the roof of the platform section of the station. A view of the valley of the Likova River and surrounding natural landscapes will be opened from this unusual rest area. A recreational zone is envisaged along the river and will be followed by convenient stairwells and a network of trails from the Pyhtino station's "roof". "Pythino" is the first stop of the Kalininsky-Sultz Line on its extension in New Moscow after the already in force. The total length of the added track should be 5 km. The second stop of the yellow branch will be the station "Vnukovo", which will be fully ground, located in the airport parking area and the first subway station in Russia directly in the airhavani. Previously, in the Stroycomplex of the capital, it was reported that the construction of both stations was planned to be completed in 2023.

ru.header: В Одесской области переименуют улицы Пушкина и Гагарина
ru.subheader: «Думская»: в Одесской области переименуют названные в честь Пушкина и Гагарина улицы
ru.content: В трех селах Одесской области решили переименовать улицы, названные в честь российских писателей и космонавта Юрия Гагарина. Соответствующий проект опубликован на сайте Черноморского горсовета, издание «Думская» сообщило, что решение уже принято.В селе Александровка улицу и переулок Александра Пушкина переименуют в честь «защитников Украины». Переименование также коснется переулка и улицы имени космонавта Юрия Гагарина — их назовут именем космонавта украинского происхождения Леонида Каденюка.Названные в честь Михаила Лермонтова улица и переулок получат название Единства, улица Льва Толстого станет Греческой, а улица поэта Владимира Маяковского — Европейской.В Малодолинском селе улицу и переулок морского офицера Петра Шмидта, переименуют в Культурные. В Бурлачьей Балке улица поэта Сергея Есенина станет Портовой. Замена табличек с названиями будет организована местными главами после снятия военного положения, заключила «Думская».В связи с началом военной спецоперации России на Украине в стране активизировались инициативы по переименованию «российских» топонимов и других объектов, связанных с Россией, а также по демонтажу памятников советского времени. Минкультуры Украины создало специальный Совет по вопросам дерусификации, декоммунизации и деколонизации, который занимается координацией «демонтажа или переноса памятников и других объектов советского прошлого». Мэр Киева Виталий Кличко в апреле пообещал переименовать все столичные улицы, проспекты и станции, названия которых связаны с СССР или Россией.
ru.summary: В Одессе переименуют улицы в честь российских и советских писателей и космонавтов, в трех селах — в честь советских и российских космонавтов. Соответствующий законопроект был внесен в Одесский горсовет.

At the moment, Bitcoin (BTC) bulls are attempting to help hold support above the $21,000 level, with the digital currency exhibiting general strengths despite the crypto space being plagued by more bankruptcy news alongside renewed talks on strict regulations.Notably, Bitcoin’s upward movement elevated it to a four-month high on January 17, and BTC remains among the assets to buy for the weekend, with analysts noting that the asset is under the firm control of the bulls. At the moment, SHIB is capitalizing on the ongoing market rally, with investors increasingly showing interest in the token. The token is also building optimism from ongoing network development initiatives like the upcoming layer 2 blockchain dubbed Shibarium.Currently, SHIB is trading at $0.0000114 with weekly gains of about 20%.XRPAlthough XRP has failed to find a bullish trigger from the ongoing Ripple and Securities Exchange Commission (SEC) case, the token capitalizes on the overall market sentiment. XRP might look forward to building on the news that Ripple continues to expand globally despite the United States regulatory scrutiny.Currently, XRP is targeting breaching the $0.40 resistance level, making the token an ideal asset to purchase over the weekend, with the possibility of hitting the level backed by sustained gains in recent days. In particular, XRP is currently changing hands at $0.39 after rallying almost 5% in the last week.Kava (KAVA)Kava (KAVA), a layer-one blockchain, has been experiencing a bullish trendline in recent days, standing out among altcoins with a price breakout. The Kava community will be hoping Coinbase’s listing sparks organic growth for the platform.Part of the ongoing development focuses on establishing KAVA’s proof-of-stake (PoS) layer-one blockchain, aiming to revolutionize the decentralized finance (DeFi) space. On the weekly chart, KAVA has rallied over 30%, trading at $1.02 by press time.Aptos (APT)The Aptos (APT) project, designed by the failed Meta cryptocurrency initiative, has seen investors bet on its long-term future based on funding from venture capitalists. With APT remaining relatively cheap, the token could rally in the future once it attains real-world use cases for its scalability solution.However, the platform’s failure to roll out use cases has recently resulted in speculation among community members. en.header: Turkey cancels visit of Swedish Defense Minister
en.content: On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU, the Turkish Minister of Defence, Julusi Akar, called the 27 January visit of the head of the Swedish Ministry of Defence, Paul Johnson, to Turkey, decided to cancel it, handed it over on Saturday to Anadolu. "In the current situation, Ankara decided to cancel the visit of the Swedish Minister," he informed journalists. Earlier in January, a group of activists close to the RPK distributed a video showing the Turkish President Recep Erdoğan dummy hanging on one of the bridges of Stockholm, which caused the Swedish Ambassador to be summoned to the Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. This event took place at a time when Turkey was blocking the admission to the North Atlantic Alliance of Sweden and Finland, accusing them of harbouring RPK members and solidarity organizations that Ankara regarded as terrorist.

record.header: Turkey announced a more difficult situation with the negotiations between Russia and Ukraine
record.subheader: The conflict has dragged on and it has become more difficult to negotiate, Turkish Foreign Minister Mevlut Cavusoglu said.
record.content: The conflict has been protracted and more difficult to negotiate, the head of the Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Mevluth Chavushoglum Mevlüt ChavushogluV, at the beginning of last spring, was able to make significant progress in the negotiations between Russia and Ukraine, but then the conflict has been prolonged and the dialogue between the parties has become more complicated, the Turkish Foreign Minister, Mevluth Chavushoglu, during his visit to the United States, sends the newspaper Yeni Akit. "We have made good progress at the beginning [on mediation between Russia and Ukraine]. In fact, you are aware that the parties were approaching at least a truce. But now the conflict has been prolonged, the circumstances have changed, he said, noting that there have been many different aspects that need to be discussed. Turkey continues its mediation efforts, the grain deal concluded last year works "gladko", the exchange of prisoners between Moscow and Kiev continues, and there are no risks against the Zaporozh nuclear power plant now, as reported by the Turkish Minister. Active talks between Russia and Ukraine in February and March 2022, including at the site in Istanbul, went down last May. After the inclusion of Donetsk and Luhansk People's Republics Republics, as well as the Herson and Zaporozh regions, the President of Ukraine, Vladimir Zelensky, signed a decree refusing to negotiate with Russia while Vladimir Putin was President. Later, the Ukrainian leader allowed dialogue on the terms of the "formula of peace", which called for the cessation of hostilities and the withdrawal of Russian troops. In the Kremlin, it was noted that the Ukrainian leadership should take into account the current realities and the emergence of new actors in Russia; among other requirements of Moscow, the non-nuclear-weapon-free, non-blocked and neutral status of Ukraine was stated in the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

ru.header: Турция отменила визит министра обороны Швеции
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Министр обороны Турции Хулуси Акар назвал "бессмысленным" намеченный на 27 января визит главы Минобороны Швеции Пола Йонсона в Турцию, Анкара приняла решение его отменить, передает в субботу агентство "Анадолу"."В сложившейся ситуации Анкара приняла решение отменить визит шведского министра", - сообщил Акар журналистам.Он отметил, что Турция считает недопустимой позицию властей Швеции, игнорирующих антитурецкие акции, проходящие в этой стране.Как сказал турецкий министр, "ожидаем от Стокгольма принятия мер и конкретных шагов в данном направлении".Ожидается, что в субботу в Швеции пройдет акция сторонников Рабочей партии Курдистана (РПК). Ранее в январе группа близких к РПК активистов распространила видео, где показан повешенным на одном из мостов Стокгольма манекен, изображающий президента Турции Реджепа Эрдогана. Из-за этого инцидента посол Швеции был вызван в турецкий МИД.Это событие произошло в то время, когда Турция блокирует прием в Североатлантический альянс Швеции и Финляндии, обвиняя их в предоставлении убежища членам РПК и солидарным с этой партией организаций, которые Анкара расценивает как террористические.

en.header: Cardano's Charles Hoskinson Shuts Down The Idea of ADA Token Burning: Here's why
en.content: It looks like the crypto market is all set to enjoy a bullish weekend as the star cryptocurrency, Bitcoin has surpassed yet another important resistance of $22,000 area. Ethereum is on a similar pace leading other top ten altcoins including BNB, XRP, Cardano and others.Among these altcoins, Cardano is considered to be among the top currencies that will enter the bullish momentum. Cardano’s ADA attained its ATH in 2021 and since then the altcoin has not spiked that level. However, the Cardano network’s boosts of strong fundamental and development activity.Meanwhile, the experts claim that the upcoming updates of Cardano network will fuel ADA prices. As per the reports, the update is scheduled to take place on Feb 11 and is set to happen on test networks. While immediately after three days, that is Feb 14 the next update will be introduced. Once the update is successful, the smart contract developers on Plutus will have multi-threshold signature designs.Charles Hoskinson : Token Burn Increase Market VolatilityOn the other hand, Cardano has a total supply of 45 billion ADA which is more than Bitcoin’s supply positioned at 21 million. Hence, the community is under discussion regarding token burn which will push ADA’s price rally.This token burning is a method used to reduce the total supply of a particular currency so that it creates demand. This in turn will fuel the currency’s price action. However, even though this method has helped many currencies, Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson has opposed token burning.This is because he believes this method doesn’t create any fundamental value to the network and also he views this method as manipulative. Moreover, Hoskinson claims token burn will bring down liquidity and increase market volatility impacting investors.Hence, the Cardano network mainly focuses on upgrading its technology rather than token burning which is a short term solution.
en.summary: Bitcoin has surpassed another important resistance of $22,000 area. Ethereum is on a similar pace leading other top tens including Cardano

record.header: Cardano's Charles Hoskinson Comments on the CoinDesk Selling Rumors
record.subheader: The exec said that he will review the financial data before making a decision.
record.content: Charles Hoskinson, CEO of Input Output Global, the firm behind the Cardano blockchain, is interested in purchasing the crypto news website CoinDesk.The latter is exploring a potential sale as its sister firm slid into bankruptcy. CoinDesk’s Kevin Worth recently asserted that the publication was receiving “numerous inbound indications of interest.”On Potential CoinDesk Acquisition and Journalistic IntegrityIn the latest livestream, Hoskinson said his media interest is broad and would like to “figure out how to get to journalistic integrity again.” The exec highlighted the need to find a way for a strong media outlet. He even suggested ways to have a financial incentive to be truthful instead of pushing specific agendas.The IOHK supremo previously criticized the mainstream media for directing negativity toward the Cardano ecosystem. With the potential acquisition of the media arm of the struggling Digital Currency Group, Hoskinson seeks to restore journalistic integrity in terms of reporting on the crypto and blockchain industry.Turning various news pieces into NFTs, thereby making it possible for the readers to interact with them, was another point made by Hoskinson.The exec is yet to check CoinDesk’s books or financials, but he believes that the asking price of $200 million is a “bit overpriced.” DCG acquired the media company for roughly $500,000 in 2016.CoinDesk Exploring OptionsThe publication reportedly hired advisors at Lazard as it explored ways to move away from Barry Silbert’s Digital Currency Group.Launched in 2013, CoinDesk was the first to break the story about potential balance sheet improprieties at Sam Bankman-Fried’s Alameda Research. It ultimately triggered a downward spiral at FTX, leading to the collapse of the crypto exchange and the subsequent arrest of Bankman-Fried, as well as multiple regulatory probes.The contagion hit home when its sister company, Genesis, suspended withdrawals on its lending side because its derivatives business had $175 million exposure to FTX. Also, a DCG subsidiary, Genesis, had already suffered losses of several hundred million dollars due to its exposure to fallen crypto hedge fund Three Arrows Capital (3AC).After struggling to raise funds, Genesis became the latest casualty of the crypto meltdown, filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on January 19th.

record.header: The "ceiling" does not put pressure on the markets. The problem of public debt worries investors less than the Fed rate
record.subheader: The United States reached the debt ceiling much earlier than economists expected. How did the stock market react to this fact?
record.content: The US has reached the debt limit, but this news is still under political discussion. What concessions will the Democrats make to the Republicans to agree to raise the ceiling again? For investors, the key risk remains the further tightening of the US Fedreserve's monetary policy. The expensive dollar does not benefit US exporters, who account for a significant portion of S&P corporations. It does not benefit the commodity economies, because a strong dollar makes the goods less accessible to the issuers of other currencies. However, it does not look safe for markets to reach the limit. The US reached the cap on public debt on January 19, 2023. This was much earlier than the economists expected. Share markets reacted to the news with a moderate negative view of the fact as a new one. U.S. key stock indicators ended Thursday's trade session with a decline of 0.76-0.96 per cent. Much more investors are now concerned about the Fed's February meeting and the extent to which interest rates could be raised. But in the debt market, returns have crawled upward. US 10-year bond rates have risen by 0.89 per cent and now amount to 3.429 per cent. The debt, unlike shares, is not perceived by investors as a real asset. Experts believe that, as confidence in the states of developed countries increases, capital migrates in part. However, it is unlikely that the debt market will expect "the crisis of the century." But why does the entire financial world keep track of US debt? This "drama" repeats quite regularly, but each time the Data X triggers a surge in media activity. It is a dollar. U.S. dollar is the world's main reserve currency. If the US Treasury runs out of cash, the US will not be able to pay on debt. The loss of confidence in US debt is thus a price tag for a riskless asset for the world, leading to a surge in borrowing costs and a collapse in financial markets. The crisis will spread from financial markets to the real sector as well. So the US default will draw the world economy into a deep recession. For commodity economies, this will translate into a weakening of national currencies, an increase in inflation, a prolonged decline in production. A political performance called Data X once again raises the question of the role of the dollar in the global economy. Shouldn't the world financial system reduce the dollar's role in favour of other currencies tied to real assets? The answer to this question was the search for economists from the Swiss bank Credit Suisse. Shortly, the chances of a new hemonic currency are going to be zero. Credit Suisse, in a report entitled "The Future World Monetary System", considered three scenarios for the development of the financial system when the dollar loses its status as a key reserve currency. Not one of them is going to have to give up the dollar completely. Yes, its role may diminish, but it is unlikely to go out of international trade. It is enough to look at the share of the dollar in the world's foreign exchange reserves. As of the third quarter of 2022, the dollar accounts for 59.8 per cent of the reserve basket. According to Credit Suisse experts, it is most likely that a multipolar monetary system will emerge in the future. What is the next plan? After reaching the ceiling, further developments will develop in a well-known way. The US Department of Finance will begin to use "emergency measures" to continue payments on government obligations and delay the announcement of default. In Minfin's arsenal, not only accounting manoeuvres, but also the suspension of investments. In a letter to Congress dated 19 January, Minister Janet Yellen announced that the emergency measures would be in place until 5 June. This time, the Presidential Administration could use for negotiations that would end (under the law of genre) happy end, i.e. concessions by a party in exchange for a further increase in the borrowing limit. However, if agreement could not be reached, the Government would not be able to fulfil its obligations and would be forced to default. In the twentieth century, the United States announced a technical default twice - in 1933, in the period of Great Depression, and in 1971, when the gold-exchange standard was abolished. Since then, the US budget has almost always been scarce. Debt-control negotiations have always drawn attention to a possible economic disaster, encouraging Republicans to use it as leverage. In 2011, the Republicans and Democratics' fight for sovereign debt almost ended with a default.The S&P agency first lowered the long-term credit rating of the US to AA+ from the maximum AAA, drawing attention to the growing sovereign debt, as well as the insufficient effectiveness of the United States Government's debt-related measures. At that time, the country's debt was $14.3 trillion. As a result of long negotiations, US President Barack Obama agreed to limit future spending in exchange for the lifting of the cap. Since then, the government's debt limit has increased repeatedly and reached $31.4 trillion in 2022. On Thursday, January 19, 2023, this threshold was crossed. Both parties contributed to the budget drama. The Reds have repeatedly reduced taxes and the Blues have expanded spending programmes, increasing the federal budget deficit. Both parties have approved large economic assistance packages after the 2008 crisis and during the COVID-19 pandemic. Economists warn that the country risks a financial crisis and other immediate economic problems if legislators do not raise the limit before the Ministry of Finance has exhausted its opportunities to win more time. We wait until June for the responsibility for lifting or suspending the borrowing limit to the Congress, which must receive a simple majority in both the House of Representatives and the Senate to vote for any change in the debt limit. Republicans, who now control the House of Representatives, insist that the increase in the debt limit be linked to "structural expenditure reform". Many Republicans in the House of Representatives call the current level of spending and the US debt burden a threat to economic growth. The Reds have not yet made formal demands for an increase in the ceiling, but insist that it be linked to a significant reduction in expenditure and the adoption of a balanced budget. ru.header: Индекс S&P может уйти к уровню 3750
ru.subheader: Конец января - февраль будут весьма турбулентными в геополитике, в экономике и на рынках
ru.content: По горячим следам: пару слов о рынках.Коррекция, которая как бы началась в четверг, переросла в бурный рост в пятницу.В четверг фиксировал шортовые инструменты.В пятницу вечером уже откупал их обратно на 5-10% дешевле.Что думаю о дальнейшем?На мой взгляд, и я об этом неоднократно говорил, рост рынка носил исключительно спекулятивный характер и был скорее связан с действиями крупных игроков, активно задействованных на рынке деривативов.Вчера заканчивались опционы на очень внушительные объёмы. Как мы с вами отмечали в четверг утром: «Баланс интересов крупняка видится на уровне 4000 по S&P 500.» Туда собственно почти и пришли. Рынок закрылся на уровне 3972. Так что ларчик открывался достаточно просто. (В принципе, большие открытые позиции были как вокруг уровня как 3900, так и 4000, и до закрытия рынка в пятницу игроки сыграли на повышение... Где мы их и ждали)Продолжится ли творческий порыв и энтузиазм далее?Не уверен. Небольшого дополнительного инерционного движения к уровню 4000 или чуть выше по S&P 500 не исключу. А вот далее – вообще не факт. Скорее, жду продолжения движения рынков вниз.1. Доходности UST-10 потихоньку начали расти. С 3,32% по минимуму 2 дня назад они поднялись почти до 3,50%. Это более логично на фоне продолжающейся риторики ФРС.2. Увольнения в крупных компаниях набирают обороты. Скоро почувствуем резкое сокращение потребительского спроса.3. Отчеты корпораций носят смешанный характер и в принципе намекают нам о приближении рецессии.Мои мысли по рынку?- Некоторая коррекция по товарным рынкам и драгметаллам.- Вероятна коррекция вниз по тренду индекса DXY. Доллар может возобновить свой рост относительно большинства валют.- Доходности по UST-10 пойдут на уровень 3,60-3,70% или немного выше.- По S&P 500 жду 3850 как первой цели движения вниз.Вскоре после этого – уровень 3740-3750. Там подумаем.Пока восстановил большую часть шортовых позиций. Вполне возможно, что в понедельник продолжу увеличивать шорт.Жду ли чего-то более жесткого, чем поход на 3750?Народ вовсю интересуется – когда наконец 3500, а то и 3200 обещанные увидим?Пока не знаю. Думаю, что конец января-февраль, а возможно и март будут весьма турбулентными и в геополитике, и в экономике и на рынках. Не исключу в этот период времени ничего. Но пока прогнозировать так далеко достаточно сложно.Посмотрим. Будем действовать по ситуации.Источник

record.header: The "ceiling" does not put pressure on the markets. The problem of public debt worries investors less than the Fed rate
record.subheader: The United States reached the debt ceiling much earlier than economists expected. How did the stock market react to this fact?
record.content: The US has reached the debt limit, but this news is still under political discussion. What concessions will the Democrats make to the Republicans to agree to raise the ceiling again? For investors, the key risk remains the further tightening of the US Fedreserve's monetary policy. The expensive dollar does not benefit US exporters, who account for a significant portion of S&P corporations. It does not benefit the commodity economies, because a strong dollar makes the goods less accessible to the issuers of other currencies. However, it does not look safe for markets to reach the limit. The US reached the cap on public debt on January 19, 2023. This was much earlier than the economists expected. Share markets reacted to the news with a moderate negative view of the fact as a new one. U.S. key stock indicators ended Thursday's trade session with a decline of 0.76-0.96 per cent. Much more investors are now concerned about the Fed's February meeting and the extent to which interest rates could be raised. But in the debt market, returns have crawled upward. US 10-year bond rates have risen by 0.89 per cent and now amount to 3.429 per cent. The debt, unlike shares, is not perceived by investors as a real asset. Experts believe that, as confidence in the states of developed countries increases, capital migrates in part. However, it is unlikely that the debt market will expect "the crisis of the century." But why does the entire financial world keep track of US debt? This "drama" repeats quite regularly, but each time the Data X triggers a surge in media activity. It is a dollar. U.S. dollar is the world's main reserve currency. If the US Treasury runs out of cash, the US will not be able to pay on debt. The loss of confidence in US debt is thus a price tag for a riskless asset for the world, leading to a surge in borrowing costs and a collapse in financial markets. The crisis will spread from financial markets to the real sector as well. So the US default will draw the world economy into a deep recession. For commodity economies, this will translate into a weakening of national currencies, an increase in inflation, a prolonged decline in production. A political performance called Data X once again raises the question of the role of the dollar in the global economy. Shouldn't the world financial system reduce the dollar's role in favour of other currencies tied to real assets? The answer to this question was the search for economists from the Swiss bank Credit Suisse. Shortly, the chances of a new hemonic currency are going to be zero. Credit Suisse, in a report entitled "The Future World Monetary System", considered three scenarios for the development of the financial system when the dollar loses its status as a key reserve currency. Not one of them is going to have to give up the dollar completely. Yes, its role may diminish, but it is unlikely to go out of international trade. It is enough to look at the share of the dollar in the world's foreign exchange reserves. As of the third quarter of 2022, the dollar accounts for 59.8 per cent of the reserve basket. According to Credit Suisse experts, it is most likely that a multipolar monetary system will emerge in the future. What is the next plan? After reaching the ceiling, further developments will develop in a well-known way. The US Department of Finance will begin to use "emergency measures" to continue payments on government obligations and delay the announcement of default. In Minfin's arsenal, not only accounting manoeuvres, but also the suspension of investments. In a letter to Congress dated 19 January, Minister Janet Yellen announced that the emergency measures would be in place until 5 June. This time, the Presidential Administration could use for negotiations that would end (under the law of genre) happy end, i.e. concessions by a party in exchange for a further increase in the borrowing limit. However, if agreement could not be reached, the Government would not be able to fulfil its obligations and would be forced to default. In the twentieth century, the United States announced a technical default twice - in 1933, in the period of Great Depression, and in 1971, when the gold-exchange standard was abolished. Since then, the US budget has almost always been scarce. Debt-control negotiations have always drawn attention to a possible economic disaster, encouraging Republicans to use it as leverage. In 2011, the Republicans and Democratics' fight for sovereign debt almost ended with a default.The S&P agency first lowered the long-term credit rating of the US to AA+ from the maximum AAA, drawing attention to the growing sovereign debt, as well as the insufficient effectiveness of the United States Government's debt-related measures. At that time, the country's debt was $14.3 trillion. As a result of long negotiations, US President Barack Obama agreed to limit future spending in exchange for the lifting of the cap. Since then, the government's debt limit has increased repeatedly and reached $31.4 trillion in 2022. On Thursday, January 19, 2023, this threshold was crossed. Both parties contributed to the budget drama. The Reds have repeatedly reduced taxes and the Blues have expanded spending programmes, increasing the federal budget deficit. Both parties have approved large economic assistance packages after the 2008 crisis and during the COVID-19 pandemic. Economists warn that the country risks a financial crisis and other immediate economic problems if legislators do not raise the limit before the Ministry of Finance has exhausted its opportunities to win more time. We wait until June for the responsibility for lifting or suspending the borrowing limit to the Congress, which must receive a simple majority in both the House of Representatives and the Senate to vote for any change in the debt limit. Republicans, who now control the House of Representatives, insist that the increase in the debt limit be linked to "structural expenditure reform". Many Republicans in the House of Representatives call the current level of spending and the US debt burden a threat to economic growth. The Reds have not yet made formal demands for an increase in the ceiling, but insist that it be linked to a significant reduction in expenditure and the adoption of a balanced budget. Meanwhile, the White House had stated that the debt ceiling should be increased without conditions, and management had made it clear that they would not negotiate on the issue. The White House Press Secretary, Karin Jean-Pierre, also reported that the White House would not negotiate, and for Congress "the resolution of issues with the ceiling of public debt is its basic responsibility". The White House's position increases the likelihood of long-term confrontation, but a compromise will eventually be found. Perhaps the US debt limit will be raised in the first half of this year. en.header: Genesis Capital Faces Bankruptcy Hearing on January 23: What's at stake?
en.content: Digital currency trading firm Genesis Global filed for bankruptcy on Jan 20, 2023, citing ‘adverse market conditions’. They are likely to complete their bankruptcy by this year May 19. This filing only applies to certain branches of the company and its Global trading and spot and derivatives trading arms are still operational and unaffected. This news has created a stir in the market and the next hearing is on Jan 23.Background on Genesis Global Trading Bankruptcy FilingGenesis Global Trading is a digital currency trading firm that was founded in 2013. It grew as a reputed OTC (Over-the-counter) trading firm in the crypto market. On Jan 20, it filed for chapter 11 bankruptcy which causes a stir in the crypto industry. The company is likely to liquidate its assets to pay off the creditors.Digital Currency Group Denies InvolvementDigital Currency Group (DCG) is a venture capital firm founded by Barry Silbert and has invested in a number of crypto-related companies. The DCG is also the parent company of Genesis Global Trading. DCG responded to the bankruptcy filing stating that it has no involvement in the filing and the decision was made independently by the Genesis management team.In the statement, they further clarified that DCG still owes Genesis Capital a lot of money. $526 million is due in May 2023 and another $1.1 billion is due in June 2032. DCG said they will help Genesis pay back its creditors very soon.DCG has also responded to the false accusations made by Gemini related to the Gemini Earn program. They said that the threat of a lawsuit by Gemini is another publicity stunt from Cameron Winklevoss to remove the blame from himself and Gemini. They have also stated that any suggestion of wrongdoing by DCG or any of its employees is baseless and completely false. DCG assured that they will continue to engage in constructive negotiations with Genesis and its creditors with the goal of arriving at a solution that works for all parties.The Stellar Development Foundation, which is one of Genesis’s biggest creditors, claimed almost $13 million from Genesis. However, the foundation stated that this amount is small compared to its overall assets. The Stellar treasury currently holds around 30 billion XLM tokens, which are worth over $200 million. Therefore, the foundation will not be affected by Genesis’s bankruptcy filing.Impact on the Crypto MarketThe bankruptcy filing of Genesis Global Trading has raised a number of questions about the stability of the crypto market. Some have pointed out that the filing is a sign that the market is still in its early stages and that there are still a lot of risks involved. The hearing for this case is set to take place on January 23rd and it will be interesting to see how this plays out and what the ultimate impact on the crypto market will

record.header: Genesis' bankruptcy filing was decided by independent committee according to DCG
record.subheader: A special committee of independent directors recommended and decided to file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.
record.content: A special committee of independent directors recommended and decided to file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.NewsOwn this piece of historyCollect this article as an NFTGenesis Capital's parent company Digital Currency Group (DCG) denied involvement in Genesis' bankruptcy filing in a statement on Jan. 20. According to DCG, a special committee of independent directors recommended and decided to file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.Filing for Chapter 11 will allow Genesis to seek the reorganization of debts, assets and other business activities. The company estimated liabilities of $1 billion to $10 billion, along with assets in the same range. DCG noted in the statement that:"Genesis has its own independent management team, legal counsel, and financial advisors, and appointed a special committee of independent directors, who are in charge of the Genesis Capital restructuring, and who recommended and decided that Genesis Capital file chapter 11. Neither DCG nor any of its employees, including those who sit on the Genesis board of directors, were involved in the decision to file for bankruptcy."Only Genesis lending entities (Genesis Global Holdco, Genesis Global Capital, and Genesis Asia Pacific - collectively known as “Genesis Capital”) have filed for bankruptcy protection. Genesis Global Trading and Genesis’ spot and derivatives trading entity will remain operational.DCG Statement on Genesis Capital Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Filing: https://t.co/6SsWj4zo3R pic.twitter.com/j9e8R3mMZv— Digital Currency Group (@DCGco) January 20, 2023DCG said it intends continue to operate as usual, as per the statement, along with its other subsidiaries, including Grayscale Investments, Foundry Digital, Lino Group Holdings, CoinDesk, and TradeBlock Corporation.In a letter sent to shareholders on Jan. 17, DCG confirmed it owes "$526 million due in May 2023 and $1.1 billion under a promissory note due in June 2032." The company noted that it intends to address obligations to Genesis Capital in the course of a restructuring. The letter also announced a halt to quarterly dividend payments to preserve liquidity, Cointelegraph reported.Genesis' problems became apparent after the withdrawal halt in November, which it blamed on "unprecedented market turmoil" that followed the collapse of FTX. The company later disclosed to have $175 million stuck in a FTX account. The withdrawal halt affected clients' of the crypto exchange Gemini, and prompted calls for DCG's board to remove Barry Silbert as CEO of the firm.

en.header: Golikova said that the level of registered unemployment in the Russian Federation is 0.7%
en.content: Moscow. On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU, the labour market situation in the Russian Federation remains stable, with a registered unemployment rate of 0.7 per cent, reported Vice-Premier Tatiana Golikova following a meeting of an interdepartmental working group on labour market rehabilitation. "The situation in the labour market remains stable. The number of registered unemployed persons has not changed in a week to 561,000. The rate of registered unemployment is 0.7 per cent," said Golicov, quoted in the office of the Vice-Premier.

record.header: The Russian equity market opened up a 0.3% increase in the RTAs index
record.content: Moscow. January 20th. INTERFAX. RU - The Russian Federation's stock market opened on Friday with mixed price movements of blue chips on positive signals from external stock sites and increased oil; the RTAs index rose by 0.3 per cent in a minute of trade against the backdrop of the strengthening of the ruble, and the Mosbirgi index has not changed markedly. By 10:01 Moscow time, the MosBirzy index was 2,169.68 points (+0.04%), the RTAs index was 996.27 points (+0.3%), and the prices of most blue chips on the Moscow exchange changed to within 0.9%. The dollar lived to 68.65 rubles (-0.15 rubles). Polymetal (+0.9 per cent), ALROSA (+0.6 per cent), Surputneftegas (+0.5 per cent), PAO Polius (+0.5 per cent), NOATEC (+0.4 per cent), Nornikel (+0.4 per cent), Rosnefti (+0.3 per cent), Sberbank (+0.3 per cent), Tatnefti (+0.3 per cent), VTB (+0.3 per cent), CMI (+0.3 per cent), Moscow Exchange (+0.1 per cent), Gazprom Oil (+0.1 per cent), RusHidro (+0.1 per cent), TCS Group (+0.1 per cent). The shares of Aeroflot (-0.9 per cent), Yandex (-0.5 per cent), OZON (-0.5 per cent), Gazprom paper (-0.3 per cent), Surgitneftegaza (-0.3 per cent), MTS (-0.3 per cent), Magnita (-0.3 per cent), North Stal (-0.2 per cent), AFK "The System" (-0.2 per cent), UK Rusal (-0.2 per cent), LUKYLa (-0.1 per cent), Inter RAO (-0.1 per cent). According to BCS Investment World analysts, without substantial drivers and liquidity inflows, the Russian equity market cannot grow. The main local indices are likely to be traded in a wide sidewall in the short term. Risks remain on the global floor, so the US market has every chance of further decline, because the Fed meeting in February, where the regulator will continue to raise the rate. The very warm weather during most of the heating season in Europe is rapidly deteriorating the prospects for Gazprom's gas exports to the region in 2023, noted BCS experts. According to the Promszzzbank analysts, the Mosbirji index will be moving in the range of 2150 to 2,200 points on Friday. Market support can come from a 20-day moving average. However, the greatest risk is the lack of ideas for purchasing oil and gas companies' paper, which will put pressure on the entire Russian stock market. According to the leading research analyst Andrei Kochetkov on global research, the external background on Friday is positive: the PRC authorities claim that the most difficult period in the fight against the coronavirus has passed. Asian markets are mostly trading in the "plus" in the hope of a rapid recovery of the Chinese economy. For the Russian market, this is also a positive signal. Accordingly, the MosBirgi index can increase its chances of recovery if it can close the bidding on Friday above 100-day and 50-day sliding lines. The Ruble can try to strengthen against the dollar and the euro against the background of precious oil and metals. In the world, the United States on the day before, equity indices fell by 0.8-1 per cent, Dow Jones (-0.8 per cent) and S&P500 (-0.8 per cent) completed the "minus" third consecutive session against the backdrop of mixed statistics and corporate reporting. In the past few weeks, most analysts have changed the forecast of the change in profits of companies from the S&P 500 index in the first and second quarters from growth to decline. It is now expected that the figure will decline by 0.6 per cent on average in January and March, by 0.7 per cent in April and June, according to the results of the FactSet survey. The number of new structures in the United States in December fell by 1.4 per cent relative to the previous month and amounted to 1.382 million per annum, reported to the Department of Commerce on Thursday. The experts predicted a decrease of 1.359 million, according to Trade Economics. The number of first-time applicants for unemployment benefits fell by 15,000 to 190,000 last week, according to the Ministry of Labour. Analytics expected to grow to an average of 214,000 productive activity in Philadelphia in January, up to 4.9 points from minus 0.9 points a month ago. Experts assumed that the indicator would rise to 3.5 points. The negative index value indicates a weakening of the region's productive activity, positive growth, while in Asia the positive performance of the equity indices (Japan's Nikkei 225 increased by 0.6 per cent, South Korean Kospi by 0.6 per cent, Chinese Shanghai Composite by 0.7 per cent, Hong Kong's Hang Seng adds 1.4 per cent), "plus" American stock futures (the contract for the S&P500 index rose by 0.2 per cent). The inflation rate in Japan in December was 4 per cent in annual terms, accelerating from 3.8 per cent in November. The People ' s Bank of China (NBC, Central Bank of China) is expected to maintain the basic interest rate on loans (LPR) for a period of one year at a rate of 3.65% annually; the five-year rate has remained at a rate of 4.3 per cent per annum, as stated in the NBC ' s report; therefore, the NBC does not change them for the fifth consecutive month; in addition, the NBC has continued to introduce liquidity into the financial system through open-market operations; the Chinese Bank has provided 62 billion renminbi in 7-day reverse operations to banks at an annual rate of 2 per cent; for 14-day operations, 319 billion renminbi at an annual rate of 2.15 per cent. Retail sales in the United Kingdom declined by 1 per cent in December compared to the previous month, according to data from the National Statistical Office (ONS) of the country. Experts interviewed by Bloomberg expected an average growth of 0.5 per cent, as did respondents to Trading Economics. Oil prices on the oil market rose moderately on the morning of Friday, completing the second consecutive week of growth in Chinese commodity demand. The cost of the March futures on Brent by 10:01 Moscow time was $86.42 per barrel (+0.3 per cent and +1.4 per cent on Thursday), the February price of WTI is $80.76 per barrel (+0.2 per cent and +1.1 per cent the day before). Petroleum processing companies in the PRC are increasing oil purchases, counting on an increase in energy consumption in the country following the removal of quarantine restrictions, Bloomberg notes. The United States Minergo data released the previous day showed an unexpected and dramatic increase in oil reserves in the United States, an increase of 8.41 million barrels, while the experts interviewed by Bloomberg expected a decrease of 3 million barrels, while the stock of petrol increased by 3.48 million barrels, with an expected increase of 2.4 million barrels.

ru.header: Голикова заявила, что уровень регистрируемой безработицы в РФ составляет 0,7%

record.header: The Russian equity market opened up a 0.3% increase in the RTAs index
record.content: Moscow. January 20th. INTERFAX. RU - The Russian Federation's stock market opened on Friday with mixed price movements of blue chips on positive signals from external stock sites and increased oil; the RTAs index rose by 0.3 per cent in a minute of trade against the backdrop of the strengthening of the ruble, and the Mosbirgi index has not changed markedly. By 10:01 Moscow time, the MosBirzy index was 2,169.68 points (+0.04%), the RTAs index was 996.27 points (+0.3%), and the prices of most blue chips on the Moscow exchange changed to within 0.9%. The dollar lived to 68.65 rubles (-0.15 rubles). Polymetal (+0.9 per cent), ALROSA (+0.6 per cent), Surputneftegas (+0.5 per cent), PAO Polius (+0.5 per cent), NOATEC (+0.4 per cent), Nornikel (+0.4 per cent), Rosnefti (+0.3 per cent), Sberbank (+0.3 per cent), Tatnefti (+0.3 per cent), VTB (+0.3 per cent), CMI (+0.3 per cent), Moscow Exchange (+0.1 per cent), Gazprom Oil (+0.1 per cent), RusHidro (+0.1 per cent), TCS Group (+0.1 per cent). The shares of Aeroflot (-0.9 per cent), Yandex (-0.5 per cent), OZON (-0.5 per cent), Gazprom paper (-0.3 per cent), Surgitneftegaza (-0.3 per cent), MTS (-0.3 per cent), Magnita (-0.3 per cent), North Stal (-0.2 per cent), AFK "The System" (-0.2 per cent), UK Rusal (-0.2 per cent), LUKYLa (-0.1 per cent), Inter RAO (-0.1 per cent). According to BCS Investment World analysts, without substantial drivers and liquidity inflows, the Russian equity market cannot grow. The main local indices are likely to be traded in a wide sidewall in the short term. Risks remain on the global floor, so the US market has every chance of further decline, because the Fed meeting in February, where the regulator will continue to raise the rate. The very warm weather during most of the heating season in Europe is rapidly deteriorating the prospects for Gazprom's gas exports to the region in 2023, noted BCS experts. According to the Promszzzbank analysts, the Mosbirji index will be moving in the range of 2150 to 2,200 points on Friday. Market support can come from a 20-day moving average. However, the greatest risk is the lack of ideas for purchasing oil and gas companies' paper, which will put pressure on the entire Russian stock market. According to the leading research analyst Andrei Kochetkov on global research, the external background on Friday is positive: the PRC authorities claim that the most difficult period in the fight against the coronavirus has passed. Asian markets are mostly trading in the "plus" in the hope of a rapid recovery of the Chinese economy. For the Russian market, this is also a positive signal. Accordingly, the MosBirgi index can increase its chances of recovery if it can close the bidding on Friday above 100-day and 50-day sliding lines. The Ruble can try to strengthen against the dollar and the euro against the background of precious oil and metals. In the world, the United States on the day before, equity indices fell by 0.8-1 per cent, Dow Jones (-0.8 per cent) and S&P500 (-0.8 per cent) completed the "minus" third consecutive session against the backdrop of mixed statistics and corporate reporting. In the past few weeks, most analysts have changed the forecast of the change in profits of companies from the S&P 500 index in the first and second quarters from growth to decline. It is now expected that the figure will decline by 0.6 per cent on average in January and March, by 0.7 per cent in April and June, according to the results of the FactSet survey. The number of new structures in the United States in December fell by 1.4 per cent relative to the previous month and amounted to 1.382 million per annum, reported to the Department of Commerce on Thursday. The experts predicted a decrease of 1.359 million, according to Trade Economics. The number of first-time applicants for unemployment benefits fell by 15,000 to 190,000 last week, according to the Ministry of Labour. Analytics expected to grow to an average of 214,000 productive activity in Philadelphia in January, up to 4.9 points from minus 0.9 points a month ago. Experts assumed that the indicator would rise to 3.5 points. The negative index value indicates a weakening of the region's productive activity, positive growth, while in Asia the positive performance of the equity indices (Japan's Nikkei 225 increased by 0.6 per cent, South Korean Kospi by 0.6 per cent, Chinese Shanghai Composite by 0.7 per cent, Hong Kong's Hang Seng adds 1.4 per cent), "plus" American stock futures (the contract for the S&P500 index rose by 0.2 per cent). The inflation rate in Japan in December was 4 per cent in annual terms, accelerating from 3.8 per cent in November. The People ' s Bank of China (NBC, Central Bank of China) is expected to maintain the basic interest rate on loans (LPR) for a period of one year at a rate of 3.65% annually; the five-year rate has remained at a rate of 4.3 per cent per annum, as stated in the NBC ' s report; therefore, the NBC does not change them for the fifth consecutive month; in addition, the NBC has continued to introduce liquidity into the financial system through open-market operations; the Chinese Bank has provided 62 billion renminbi in 7-day reverse operations to banks at an annual rate of 2 per cent; for 14-day operations, 319 billion renminbi at an annual rate of 2.15 per cent. Experts interviewed by Bloomberg expected an average growth of 0.5 per cent, as did respondents to Trading Economics. Oil prices on the oil market rose moderately on the morning of Friday, completing the second consecutive week of growth in Chinese commodity demand. The cost of the March futures on Brent by 10:01 Moscow time was $86.42 per barrel (+0.3 per cent and +1.4 per cent on Thursday), the February price of WTI is $80.76 per barrel (+0.2 per cent and +1.1 per cent the day before). Petroleum processing companies in the PRC are increasing oil purchases, counting on an increase in energy consumption in the country following the removal of quarantine restrictions, Bloomberg notes. The United States Minergo data released the previous day showed an unexpected and dramatic increase in oil reserves in the United States, an increase of 8.41 million barrels, while the experts interviewed by Bloomberg expected a decrease of 3 million barrels, while the stock of petrol increased by 3.48 million barrels, with an expected increase of 2.4 million barrels.

en.header: Genesis Capital Faces Bankruptcy Hearing on January 23: What's at stake?
en.content: Digital currency trading firm Genesis Global filed for bankruptcy on Jan 20, 2023, citing ‘adverse market conditions’. They are likely to complete their bankruptcy by this year May 19. This filing only applies to certain branches of the company and its Global trading and spot and derivatives trading arms are still operational and unaffected. This news has created a stir in the market and the next hearing is on Jan 23.Background on Genesis Global Trading Bankruptcy FilingGenesis Global Trading is a digital currency trading firm that was founded in 2013. It grew as a reputed OTC (Over-the-counter) trading firm in the crypto market. On Jan 20, it filed for chapter 11 bankruptcy which causes a stir in the crypto industry. The company is likely to liquidate its assets to pay off the creditors.Digital Currency Group Denies InvolvementDigital Currency Group (DCG) is a venture capital firm founded by Barry Silbert and has invested in a number of crypto-related companies. The DCG is also the parent company of Genesis Global Trading. DCG responded to the bankruptcy filing stating that it has no involvement in the filing and the decision was made independently by the Genesis management team.In the statement, they further clarified that DCG still owes Genesis Capital a lot of money. $526 million is due in May 2023 and another $1.1 billion is due in June 2032. DCG said they will help Genesis pay back its creditors very soon.DCG has also responded to the false accusations made by Gemini related to the Gemini Earn program. They said that the threat of a lawsuit by Gemini is another publicity stunt from Cameron Winklevoss to remove the blame from himself and Gemini. They have also stated that any suggestion of wrongdoing by DCG or any of its employees is baseless and completely false. DCG assured that they will continue to engage in constructive negotiations with Genesis and its creditors with the goal of arriving at a solution that works for all parties.The Stellar Development Foundation, which is one of Genesis’s biggest creditors, claimed almost $13 million from Genesis. However, the foundation stated that this amount is small compared to its overall assets. The Stellar treasury currently holds around 30 billion XLM tokens, which are worth over $200 million. Therefore, the foundation will not be affected by Genesis’s bankruptcy filing.Impact on the Crypto MarketThe bankruptcy filing of Genesis Global Trading has raised a number of questions about the stability of the crypto market. Some have pointed out that the filing is a sign that the market is still in its early stages and that there are still a lot of risks involved. The hearing for this case is set to take place on January 23rd and it will be interesting to see how this plays out and what the ultimate impact on the crypto market will
en.summary: Genesis Global filed for chapter 11 bankruptcy on Jan 20. The company is likely to liquidate its assets to pay off creditors.

en.header: 5 Blockchain Games To Play And Earn This Week
en.subheader: Play-to-earn games are decentralized games in which players earn rewards by completing tasks, battling other players, and progressing through various game levels.
en.content: Play And Earn Games: The gaming industry has developed beyond pay-to-play and free-to-play games to include games that allow players to earn cryptocurrency while playing. However, the native tokens supporting game economies can be found in these special games. With these in-game currencies, users can trade, buy, sell, and play. Blockchain technology is used in the play to earn games to give players the opportunity to earn cryptocurrency rewards for their skill and effort.Here are 5 Blockchain Games to Play and Earn This WeekIt’s not shocking that play-to-earn gaming has taken over the cryptocurrency world. Here are the top 5 play-to-earn games of the week:The SandboxStar AtlasDecentralandAxie InfinityMy Neighbor Alice1. The SandboxOne of the top blockchain games for creative people to earn money is The Sandbox. An open-world game powered by Ethereum was created as The Sandbox. Since then, the game has switched to Polygon’s layer 2, primarily to decrease its carbon footprint and fees, and increase speed. The game most resembles Roblox or Minecraft, and it is a well-known GameFi crypto token project. In the social center, users can create their own games, worlds, and adventures. The most valuable resource in the Sandbox is LAND. Each LAND is an NFT that represents virtual land ownership.2. Star AtlasStar Atlas is redefining what a play-to-earn game can be thanks to its robust metaverse. It is based on blockchain technology. However, the Solana protocol enables a mostly serverless and secure gaming experience. The year 2620 is the setting for this multiplayer online game. In the game, an alliance of extraterrestrial species, sentient robots, and humans are the three main groups that have emerged and are competing for resources. Deflationary mechanics are incorporated into the game, whereby resources used to produce objects are destroyed when a new one is created.3. DecentralandDecentraland is a virtual world built on the Ethereum blockchain in which players can earn NFTs by playing.  In the Decentraland universe, various businesses are opening shops and selling land as NFTs. This includes companies like Samsung, DKNY, Selfridges, and even sportswear companies like Sketchers. However, in Decentraland, players can try to make money by buying MANA tokens and hoping that the value will rise or by buying LAND, which is represented by NFT plots. It is one of the best play-to-earn games.4. Axie InfinityAxie Infinity allows players to control and run a portion of the game. This game was inspired by Nintendo’s Pokémon franchise. Players can acquire AXS tokens by participating in the game. Also, they can then use these tokens to change the course of the game. Players will gather creatures during gameplay and engage them in combat. However, players will receive cryptocurrency tokens as compensation for killing monsters and finishing tasks. Players will own Axie NFTs, and they will be able to resell them hope for a profit. The game runs on the Ethereum blockchain using Ronin, a sidechain that aids in lowering transaction costs and latency.5. My Neighbor AliceMy Neighbor Alice is a well-designed animated world where players can farm, fish, socialize, and keep bees, among other things. However, in order to enter Alice World, players must first purchase a plot of land, the cheapest of which is 247 ALICE ($260). After the initial purchase, it’s just a matter of living and taking care of daily tasks. But being a good neighbor and assisting Alice with her tasks is the key to earning rewards. Players receive rewards from this, which players can trade for things that can use on players’ lands. However, players looking for casual blockchain gaming with the knowledge to take part in this realistic simulation are the target audience.Also Read: Is ChatGPT The New Google? en.summary: Top 5 play-to-earn games of the week are powered by blockchain technology.

en.header: Sberbank has installed ATMs in Yalta, Sevastopol and Simferopol
en.subheader: Sberbank has installed ATMs on the territory of the Crimean peninsula in Yalta, Sevastopol and Simferopol, as well as the village of Landslide, the press service of the bank told reporters.
en.content: On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU-Sberbank set up ATMs on the Crimea peninsula in Yalta, Sevastopol and Simferopol, as well as in the village of Opolznevoy, informed journalists at the bank ' s press service. In cities, ATMs have been installed in mobile offices (cars) and in rural areas in the premises. On 18 January, 2023 Sberbank began working in Crimeuchit further this week. There are now a limited number of banks in Crimea, all under external restrictions for many years, the largest Russian banks have repeatedly stated that they are not prepared to open offices on the peninsula because of the imminent threat of severe sanctions by the US and the EU.

record.header: Moonstone Bank is Closing the Accounts of its Crypto Clients to ’Refocus on Community Bank Role’
record.subheader: Moonstone Bank, a digital bank focused on serving high-net-worth individuals, has revealed that it is exiting the crypto space and will be refocusing on the "community bank" role.
record.content: Moonstone Bank, a digital bank focused on serving high-net-worth individuals, has revealed that it is exiting the crypto space and will be refocusing on the "community bank" role.In a Thursday press release, the bank said it is halting plans to develop banking services for innovative industries like crypto. Moonstone cited the recent developments in the industry and the subsequent rise in regulatory scrutiny as the reason for its decision. It said:"The change in strategy reflects the impact of recent events in the crypto assets industry and the resultant changing regulatory environment relating to crypto asset businesses."As part of this change, the bank will no longer use the name Moonstone Bank and will be rebranding and re-adopting the Farmington State Bank name, known in the local community for 135 years.Moonstone was reportedly acquired by Jean Chalopin, the Bahamas-based chairman of Deltec, another FTX banking partner in 2020. He allegedly aimed to turn Moonstone into a crypto-focused financial services firm.Chalopin secured an $11.5 million investment from Alameda Research, the trading arm of Sam Bankman-Fried's crypto exchange FTX, in early 2022. He has also inked several other deals with FTX, and also maintained close ties with executives there.Meanwhile, Moonstone has also been dragged into the FTX saga. In a December 7 letter sent to Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell, Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Acting Chair Martin Gruenberg, and Acting Comptroller of the Currency Michael Hsu, Senators Elizabeth Warren and Tina Smith sought details about Moonstone's exposure to Alameda.''While the banking system has so far been relatively unscathed by the latest crypto crash, FTX's collapse shows that crypto may be more integrated into the banking system than regulators are aware,'' the letter said.In a December court filing, Bahamas liquidators revealed that Moonstone held nearly $50 million in FTX funds across two accounts, the status of which is unknown. Moonstone executives have allegedly declined to provide Bahamian investigators with details about the accounts when asked to do so.Aside from Moonstone, other FTX-linked banks have also faced troubles over the past couple of months following the exchange's implosion. As reported, Silvergate Capital, a crypto-focused bank, suffered a bank run following the FTX collapse, which forced the company to sell assets at a significant loss in order to honor $8.1 billion worth of customer withdrawals.Signature Bank, another FTX financier, has also secured billions of dollars in loans from the Federal Home Loan Bank of New York. The bank has reportedly received $11.3 billion in loans from the consortium.

ru.header: Сбербанк установил банкоматы в Ялте, Севастополе и Симферополе
ru.subheader: Сбербанк установил банкоматы на территории полуострова Крым в Ялте, Севастополе и Симферополе, а также селе Оползневое, сообщили журналистам в пресс-службе банка.
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Сбербанк установил банкоматы на территории полуострова Крым в Ялте, Севастополе и Симферополе, а также селе Оползневое, сообщили журналистам в пресс-службе банка.В городах банкоматы установлены в мобильных офисах (автомобилях), в селе - в помещении.Экономика18 января 2023Сбербанк начал работать в КрымуЧитать подробнееСбербанк на этой неделе объявил о начале работы в Крыму. В течение 2023 года банк планирует распространить свою сеть устройств самообслуживания на всем полуострове. Офисы кредитная организация собирается открывать постепенно: первые из них в крупнейших городах начнут работать в первом полугодии.Сейчас в Крыму работает ограниченное количество банков, все они уже много лет находятся под внешними ограничениями. Крупнейшие российские банки ранее неоднократно заявляли, что не готовы открывать отделения на полуострове из-за неминуемой угрозы введения жестких санкций со стороны США и ЕС.Сбербанк в начале апреля 2022 года подпал под блокирующие санкции США. Аналогичные ограничения в отношении Сбербанка позже ввели и некоторые другие страны.
