en.header: NBC reported searches in Vekselberg-related homes in the United States
en.subheader: Employees of the FBI and the Department of Homeland Security were seen at an apartment in a building in Manhattan and an estate in Southampton, New York, as well as at a house in Fisher Island in Miami, which are associated with a businessman.
en.content: FBI and Homeland Security officers were seen at an apartment in Manhattan and a estate in Southampton, New York, as well as at a house in Fisher Island, Miami, linked to a businessman.Victor Wexelberg, FBI and US Homeland Security staff are conducting real estate searches allegedly linked to Russian businessman Victor Wexelberg (under American sanctions), reporting to NBC with reference to sources. According to the television channel, on Thursday morning, FBI agents were seen at a multi-storey house in Manhattan Park and a estate in Southampton, New York State, which the authorities claim are linked to Wexelberg. According to the sources, the agents searched the house in Fisher Island in Miami, which the authorities claim is also linked to Russian. From the house in Park Avenue in New York, allegedly linked to Wexelberg, they took out five boxes and two safes, handed over RIA Novosti with a reference to a reporter. The representative of Wexelberg did not respond to a request from RBC. Early in April, the U.S. Department of Justice reported the arrest in Spain of a Tango yacht at the request of the United States party. The agency claimed that it owned the founder of the Renova Vexelberg group. After Wexelberg was sanctioned in April 2018, he and his trustees "continued to make dollar payments through U.S. banks for the maintenance of Tango", including for mooring, approved by the agency. Wexelberg was included in the Specially Designed Nationals (SDN) list of the Ministry of Finance, which provides for the freezing of assets and isolation from the dollar system. There is also a group of Renova. In 2014, RBC wrote about the New York offices or apartment of a businessman in connection with a claim by Senator Leonid Lebedev at the time against Wexelberg and Leonard Blavatnik, former joint owners of TNCs-BP. The court couriers then tried to track him down to give him notice of the lawsuit against him. In particular, reference was made to an apartment at Park Avenue, 1009 in Manhattan, where one of the couriers visited several times. The concierge told him that Wexelberg was a "new tenant" of apartment 5A, but that there was no one in it now. The New York StreetEasy housing database showed that Wexelberg was renting apartment 5A/6A in the 1920s building house since February 2014, seven rooms (including four bedrooms) and six toilets.
en.summary: Employees of the FBI and the US Department of Homeland Security were spotted at a house in New York and at a house in Miami in connection with a money laundering case.

record.header: The United States accused two businessmen of withdrawing Vekselberg's yacht from sanctions
record.subheader: The US Department of Justice accused two businessmen of trying to withdraw Vekselberg's yacht from sanctions
record.content: The U.S. Department of Justice charged a 51-year-old Russian businessman, Vladislav Osipov, and a 52-year-old British businessman, Richard Masters, with attempting to exonerate a Tango yacht, which allegedly belongs to a sanctioned Russian businessman, Victor Wexelberg. According to a report on the agency's website, businessmen tried to hide the yacht and exploit it through the company and the U.S. financial system. Masters was detained in Spain and threatened with extradition. A Russian arrest warrant has been issued against him. "Today's indictments and arrests by Spanish law enforcement agencies show the FBI's constant attention to tracking and bringing to justice those who assist Russian oligarches who have been sanctioned," said Deputy Director Paul Abbate of the FBI. The material is being supplemented.

ru.header: NBC сообщил об обысках в связанных с Вексельбергом домах в США
ru.subheader: Сотрудников ФБР и Министерства внутренней безопасности видели у квартиры в доме на Манхэттене и поместья в Саутгемптоне (штат Нью-Йорк), а также у дома в Фишер-Айленде в Майами, которые связывают с бизнесменом
ru.content: Сотрудников ФБР и Министерства внутренней безопасности видели у квартиры в доме на Манхэттене и поместья в Саутгемптоне (штат Нью-Йорк), а также у дома в Фишер-Айленде в Майами, которые связывают с бизнесменомВиктор ВексельбергСотрудники ФБР и Министерства внутренней безопасности США проводят обыски в объектах недвижимости, предположительно, связанных с российским бизнесменом Виктором Вексельбергом (находится под американскими санкциями), сообщает телеканал NBC со ссылкой на источники.По данным телеканала, в четверг утром агентов ФБР видели у квартиры в многоэтажном доме на Парк-авеню на Манхэттене и поместья в Саутгемптоне (штат Нью-Йорк), которые, по утверждению властей, связаны с Вексельбергом.По словам источников, агенты проводили обыск и в доме в Фишер-Айленде в Майами, который, как утверждают власти, также связан с россиянином.Из дома на Парк-авеню в Нью-Йорке, предположительно, связанного с Вексельбергом, вынесли пять коробок и два сейфа, передает «РИА Новости» со ссылкой на корреспондента.Представитель Вексельберга не ответил на запрос РБК.В начале апреля Минюст США сообщил об аресте в Испании яхты Tango по запросу американской стороны. Как утверждает ведомство, ею владеет основатель группы «Ренова» Вексельберг. Tango, как следовало из ордера на арест, «подлежала конфискации» на основании нарушения законов США об отмывании денег, мошенничестве в банковской сфере и нарушении санкций. По мнению Минюста, бизнесмен использовал подставные компании, чтобы скрыть операции, связанные с судном. После того как Вексельберг попал под санкции в апреле 2018 года, он и его доверенные лица «продолжили проводить долларовые платежи через банки США за техническое обслуживание Tango», в том числе за швартовку, утверждало ведомство.Вексельберг был включен в список Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) Минфина, который предполагает блокировку активов и изоляцию от долларовой системы. В нем же находится и группа «Ренова».В 2014 году РБК писал о нью-йоркских офисах или апартаментах бизнесмена в связи с иском на тот момент сенатора Леонида Лебедева, который тот подал против Вексельберга и Леонарда Блаватника — бывших совладельцев ТНК-BP. Судебные курьеры тогда пытались его отыскать, чтобы вручить ему извещение о поданном против него иске. В частности, упоминалась квартира по адресу: Парк-авеню, 1009, на Манхэттене, куда несколько раз наведывался один из курьеров. Консьерж говорил ему, что Вексельберг — «новый жилец» квартиры 5A, но сейчас в ней идет ремонт, дома никого нет. Из базы данных по жилой недвижимости Нью-Йорка StreetEasy на тот момент следовало, что Вексельберг снимает квартиру 5A/6A в доме 1920-х годов постройки с февраля 2014 года, в ней семь комнат (в том числе четыре спальни) и шесть санузлов. Апартаменты предлагались квартиросъемщикам по $36,5 тыс. в месяц, писал РБК.
ru.summary: Сотрудники ФБР и министерства внутренней безопасности США были замечены у дома в Нью-Йорке и в доме в Майами в связи с делом об отмывании денег.

record.header: The United States accused two businessmen of withdrawing Vekselberg's yacht from sanctions
record.subheader: The US Department of Justice accused two businessmen of trying to withdraw Vekselberg's yacht from sanctions
record.content: The U.S. Department of Justice charged a 51-year-old Russian businessman, Vladislav Osipov, and a 52-year-old British businessman, Richard Masters, with attempting to exonerate a Tango yacht, which allegedly belongs to a sanctioned Russian businessman, Victor Wexelberg. According to a report on the agency's website, businessmen tried to hide the yacht and exploit it through the company and the U.S. financial system. Masters was detained in Spain and threatened with extradition. A Russian arrest warrant has been issued against him. "Today's indictments and arrests by Spanish law enforcement agencies show the FBI's constant attention to tracking and bringing to justice those who assist Russian oligarches who have been sanctioned," said Deputy Director Paul Abbate of the FBI. The material is being supplemented.

record.header: Borrell stated that the EU does not want to be a party to the conflict in Ukraine
record.subheader: Josep Borrel recalled Russia's struggle with Hitler and Napoleon and called for arming Ukraine
record.content: Joseph Borrel Europe is not a party to the conflict in Ukraine, despite the military support provided by Kiev, stated the EU's supreme representative for foreign affairs and security policy, José Borrel, at the award ceremony of the Forum "New Economy" in Madrid. The event was broadcast on YouTube. "EU is not involved in the war in Ukraine. We are not [its] party, we do not want to be it," he said. As Europa Press says, the diplomat also said that "it is now time to continue arming Ukraine." "Russia is a great country, a great nation that is used to fighting to the end," he said and recalled how Russia opposed Napoleon and Adolf Hitler. Borrell said that Moscow still had "great forces and opportunities to continue" to fight. That is why the West should not stop supporting Ukraine, he said. Borrel added that after the end of the conflict victory should not be for Russia, otherwise Ukraine would, according to him, become a puppet State. "The Ukraine must be equipped with the necessary weapons not only to fight back, as they do, but also to recover the land," he added Borrel (quota on The Objective). In this connection, he pointed out that Kiev needed to be given "the heavy weapons, the battle tanks that he was asking for. Borrel also appreciated the EU military assistance provided to Ukraine in Y10 billion. In Moscow, it was repeatedly pointed out that the West was at least indirectly involved in hostilities in Ukraine because it was sending weapons; for example, the post-Russian Ambassador to the United Nations, Vasily Nebenzia, claimed that the Ukrainian conflict was a "proxi-war collective West with Russia." Commenting on the West's plans to hand over tanks to Ukraine (with this intention already expressed by Poland, Great Britain, France), Russian President Dmitry Peskov, noted that this assistance would "add pressure" to Ukraine, but "nothing would change in terms of the Russian side's progress towards achieving its objectives".

ru.header: Журналистка Оксана Баулина погибла в Киеве
ru.subheader: Вместе с Баулиной под обстрелом погиб еще один человек, двое ее сопровождавших госпитализированы. После отъезда из России журналистка делала репортажи из Киева и Львова
ru.content: Вместе с Баулиной под обстрелом погиб еще один человек, двое ее сопровождавших госпитализированы. После отъезда из России журналистка делала репортажи из Киева и ЛьвоваОксана БаулинаЖурналистка The Insider (признан иноагентом) Оксана Баулина погибла под обстрелом в Киеве, сообщило издание.«Журналистка The Insider Оксана Баулина погибла под обстрелом в Киеве при выполнении редакционного задания», — говорится в сообщении на сайте издания.Вместе с ней при ракетном обстреле погиб еще один человек, двое ее сопровождавших госпитализированы, сообщило издание.До прихода в The Insider Баулина работала в ФБК, но после того, как российский суд признал фонд экстремистской организацией и запретил его деятельность в России, она уехала из страны и начала делать репортажи из Львова и Киева.Согласно данным на странице Баулиной в Facebook (его деятельность признана экстремистской и запрещена в России), она родилась в городе Красная Пресня Красноярского края 1 ноября 1979 года. Последним местом проживания Баулиной указана Варшава.В середине марта под Киевом погиб американский журналист Брент Рено. Он работал на Украине для проекта журнала Time о беженцах. До этого Рено много лет сотрудничал с газетой The New York Times, в разное время работал на телеканалы NBC и HBO.14 марта ранение в районе Киева получил журналист Fox News Бенджамин Холл, который освещал события на Украине.С 24 февраля Россия проводит спецоперацию по «демилитаризации» и «денацификации» Украины. Вооруженные силы России наносят удары только по украинским военным объектам и авиации, гражданскому населению ничего не угрожает, подчеркивали в Минобороны.Украина в ответ на спецоперацию разорвала дипломатические отношения с Россией, объявила военное положение и всеобщую мобилизацию.К 25 февраля Вооруженные силы России блокировали Киев с западной стороны, к 17 марта в Киевской области выставили посты ВДВ.
ru.summary: Журналистка «Новой газеты» Анна Баулина погибла в результате минометного обстрела украинскими силовиками города Горловка. В результате обстрела погиб один человек, еще двое получили ранения.

en.header: FTX: U.S. Authorities Seize Nearly $700 Million Of Sam Bankman-Fried’s Assets
en.content: The FTX brouhaha continues and this time, unsurprisingly, millions of dollars in cash and assets belonging to the crypto exchange’s former big boss has been confiscated by United States authorities.Federal authorities have seized $150 million in assets related to FTX co-founder and former CEO Sam Bankman-Fried, a large chunk of which comes in the form of Robinhood stock, a court filing revealed Friday.Stocks, cash, and other assets totaling almost $700 million have now been seized by U.S. officials in connection with the ongoing probe.The U.S. Department of Justice disclosed the confiscation of Robinhood shares earlier this month, but on Friday it presented a more comprehensive list of sequestered assets, including cash held at several banks and assets placed at the cryptocurrency exchange Binance.New FTX CEO Has His Hands FullJohn Ray, who replaced Bankman-Fried as CEO to oversee FTX’s rehabilitation, is attempting to recover the funds that the cryptocurrency exchange’s depositors lost when the company collapsed in November.In December of last year, Bankman-Fried was charged with eight charges of money laundering and fraud, to which he pled not guilty. Two of his sidekicks at FTX have pled guilty to fraud charges and are collaborating with federal authorities.In addition, prosecutors seized almost $6 million in assets from Silvergate Bank accounts and another $50 million from a Moonstone Bank account. Undisclosed amounts were seized from Binance and Binance.US accounts, court documents reveal.The ownership of the seized Robinhood shares, estimated at around $525 million, has been contested by Bankman-Fried, FTX, and the insolvent cryptocurrency lender BlockFi.SBF Anonymous Bail DonorsIn December, Bankman-Fried was arrested on fraud charges and released on a $250 million bond pending trial. He has denied embezzlement of customer assets.A subsequent Insider report indicated that two unnamed individuals raised approximately $700,000 for SBF’s bail bond. One individual offered $200,000, while the other secured $500,000 in funding.The court withheld these persons’ names when SBF’s attorneys expressed fears for their safety.Bankman-Fried said in a recent blog post that he had “offered to donate nearly all of my personal Robinhood shares to customers.”Federal authorities claim that the shares in Robinhood were purchased with consumer cash that were stolen.In May 2022, SBF acquired 7.8% of the company through the purchase of shares in the financial platform. Moreover, he was the sole owner and director of the stock acquired through Emergent Fidelity Technologies.Meanwhile, the DOJ has launched an inquiry into the disappearance of $370 million in FTX assets hours after the exchange filed for bankruptcy.
en.summary: FTX co-founder and former CEO Sam Bankman-Fried. Authorities seize $150 million in assets related to Bankman-Fried

record.header: U.S. Lays Claim to $700 Million of Assets Linked to Bankman-Fried, FTX
record.subheader: The U.S. seized $700 million of former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried’s assets and is now seeking their forfeiture.
record.content: The U.S. government wants to take control of nearly $700 million of assets it seized earlier this month from former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried, according to court filings Friday.Included in the property are over 55 million Robinhood shares worth about $525 million. Bought with borrowed Alameda money, those shares were at the center of a fight between Bankman-Fried, FTX Group and BlockFi. Officials are also moving to claim $171 million in cash from a series of bank accounts linked to Bankman-Fried’s web of companies.The government seized those assets and more in early January and are now seeking their forfeiture, per a bill of particulars filed late Friday in Bankman-Fried’s criminal case.“We believe that these assets are not property in the bankruptcy estate” or are subject to exemptions, meaning they don't have to be frozen like most FTX assets are, pending wind-up, a government lawyer previously told the judge in this case.

en.content: The shops that the Spanish group Inditex, which owns the fashion-brands of Zara and Massimo Dutti, sold to the Lebanese company Daher Group, may open in Russia under its own brands in the spring of 2023, report "Commersanth" with reference to a source in the market and two real estate consultants. record.header: Wednesday helped Netflix beat forecasts
record.subheader: The series "Wednesday" became the third in the internal popularity rating in the entire history of the company
record.content: Netflix (NFLX) reported better than expected for the fourth quarter of 2022, but we maintain a neutral projection of the movement of quotations. Reed Hastings, who founded Netflix in 1997, resigns from the post of CEO, which he shared with Ted Sarandos, and will become Executive Chairman of the Board of Directors. Sarandos will continue to run the company with Greg Peters, who formerly held the position of operations director. We assume that nothing will change in the company's strategy because all changes in the management team look like long-term planned actions. Netflix's loan increased by 1.9 g/g, to $7.852 billion (consensus projection: $7.84 billion). Management noted that without the influence of a strong US dollar, sales would have increased by more than 10 per cent g/g by increasing the number of subscribers by 4 per cent and increasing ARM (the average income per customer) by 5 per cent. The fairly robust pace of business expansion continues to be masked by the firm's unfavourable strengthening of the United States dollar in 2022. The EPS GAAP dropped to $0.12 last year's $1.33, but it is worth noting that the result was affected by the negative revaluation of the euro-nominated debt, which reduced the GAP profit by $462 million. Reduction of operating margins by 1.2 p.m. (c) The right to freedom of opinion and expression (art. g/g was due to the strengthening of the dollar: almost all of the company ' s expenditures are nominated in that currency, while 60 per cent of the revenue is generated abroad. In 2022, the operational margin was 18%, compared to 21% in 2021. However, given the adjustment for currency fluctuations and the one-time costs of restructuring experienced in the second quarter of 2022, the margin result coincided with the upper limit of the target management range set in January 2022 (20 per cent). Thus, investors were further confirmed that the company's management could effectively control costs even under conditions of high inflation. The increase of 7.66 million subscribers far exceeded the expectations of investors (4.57 million). It is noteworthy that the expansion of the audience was recorded in all geographical segments. The series and films were quite successful in the past quarter. The new "Wensday" series, which became the third-highest in the company's history, was launched in November in 12 countries (including the United States). Management is satisfied with the primary results, highlighting three points: - the tendency to switch from more expensive subscriptions to BWA is still low; - the youth economy in BWA meets expectations, that is, it is no worse than that of subscriptions without advertising; - the involvement of BWA subscribers is comparable to other categories of users, indicating a good perception of advertising. In our view, these three factors confirm that the long-term development initiative in advertising revenue is promising, and its speed encourages investors (from the minimum of 2022 shares doubled), but the predictability of future advertising revenues remains extremely low due to the lack of disclosure by the company. We are also concerned that Netflix's transition to an active phase in the fight against the use of other people's accounts may coincide with a moderate recession in the US, which is our basic macroeconomic scenario. According to management, extensive initiatives in this area will start later in the current quarter. As previously stated, the company has ceased to publish the growth forecast for subscribers, but continues to issue guidance on revenues, operating margins and net profits. The decision was made because revenue was becoming a more important indicator against the backdrop of advertising on the service, and the growth trajectory of subscribers is difficult to predict even by the company itself. This increases the volatility of shares. In the first quarter of 2023, Guydens ' revenue management almost coincided with a consensus projection ($8,172 billion versus $8.15 billion), while the operating profit benchmark of $1.625 billion looks markedly weaker than expectations ($1,755 billion). In the first quarter of 2023, an important statement was made about the growth trajectory of subscribers: in the first quarter, management expects moderate growth, but suspects that a significant expansion of the audience at the end of 2022 could result in a "demand transfer" effect. In other words, some of the potential customers who might have been able to sign in the first quarter have already done so in 2022. Netflix's management expected the free flow of money (FCF) to be about $1 billion in the 2022 round, so the actual result is estimated to be $1.6 billion. In addition, in 2023, management is awaiting the resumption of the equity buyback programme, thanks to the projected growth of the FCF to at least $3 billion. The company's balance sheet currently has just over $6 billion and short-term investments, while debt repayments are not planned this year. According to the report's comments, the savings of over $5.5 billion to $6 billion required for business operations (conforms to two months' revenues) will be used to finance the return of paper. We expect a very limited impact on stocks from the estimated volume of Buy Back (perhaps not more than $2 billion a year). By raising the target price of NFLX paper from $275 to $300, we keep a neutral projection for quotations. We appreciate Netflix's long-term growth potential as a new source of revenue for the company (the potential market is estimated at $180 billion), but we believe that the shares of the striming company are already characterized by premium value multipliers (EV/EBITDA NTM about 21.5x), so further increases in quotations are considered to be unsustainable. Our target price suggests that shares will be traded with EV/EBITDA NTM some 16s by the end of 2023, and EBITDA will be $9 billion in 2024 (consensus projection: $8.7 billion). The following key medium-term risks remain to be seen: Increased competition by other video-street players: Walt Disney (Disney+, ESPN+, Hulu), Warner Bros. Discovery (HBO Max, Discovery+), Apple (Apple TV+), Amazon (Amazon Prime Video). Macroeconomic uncertainty. record.header: Wednesday helped Netflix beat forecasts
record.subheader: The series "Wednesday" became the third in the internal popularity rating in the entire history of the company
record.content: Netflix (NFLX) reported better than expected for the fourth quarter of 2022, but we maintain a neutral projection of the movement of quotations. Reed Hastings, who founded Netflix in 1997, resigns from the post of CEO, which he shared with Ted Sarandos, and will become Executive Chairman of the Board of Directors. Sarandos will continue to run the company with Greg Peters, who formerly held the position of operations director. We assume that nothing will change in the company's strategy because all changes in the management team look like long-term planned actions. Netflix's loan increased by 1.9 g/g, to $7.852 billion (consensus projection: $7.84 billion). Management noted that without the influence of a strong US dollar, sales would have increased by more than 10 per cent g/g by increasing the number of subscribers by 4 per cent and increasing ARM (the average income per customer) by 5 per cent. The fairly robust pace of business expansion continues to be masked by the firm's unfavourable strengthening of the United States dollar in 2022. The EPS GAAP dropped to $0.12 last year's $1.33, but it is worth noting that the result was affected by the negative revaluation of the euro-nominated debt, which reduced the GAP profit by $462 million. Reduction of operating margins by 1.2 p.m. (c) The right to freedom of opinion and expression (art. g/g was due to the strengthening of the dollar: almost all of the company ' s expenditures are nominated in that currency, while 60 per cent of the revenue is generated abroad. In 2022, the operational margin was 18%, compared to 21% in 2021. However, given the adjustment for currency fluctuations and the one-time costs of restructuring experienced in the second quarter of 2022, the margin result coincided with the upper limit of the target management range set in January 2022 (20 per cent). Thus, investors were further confirmed that the company's management could effectively control costs even under conditions of high inflation. The increase of 7.66 million subscribers far exceeded the expectations of investors (4.57 million). It is noteworthy that the expansion of the audience was recorded in all geographical segments. The series and films were quite successful in the past quarter. The new "Wensday" series, which became the third-highest in the company's history, was launched in November in 12 countries (including the United States). Management is satisfied with the primary results, highlighting three points: - the tendency to switch from more expensive subscriptions to BWA is still low; - the youth economy in BWA meets expectations, that is, it is no worse than that of subscriptions without advertising; - the involvement of BWA subscribers is comparable to other categories of users, indicating a good perception of advertising. In our view, these three factors confirm that the long-term development initiative in advertising revenue is promising, and its speed encourages investors (from the minimum of 2022 shares doubled), but the predictability of future advertising revenues remains extremely low due to the lack of disclosure by the company. We are also concerned that Netflix's transition to an active phase in the fight against the use of other people's accounts may coincide with a moderate recession in the US, which is our basic macroeconomic scenario. According to management, extensive initiatives in this area will start later in the current quarter. As previously stated, the company has ceased to publish the growth forecast for subscribers, but continues to issue guidance on revenues, operating margins and net profits. The decision was made because revenue was becoming a more important indicator against the backdrop of advertising on the service, and the growth trajectory of subscribers is difficult to predict even by the company itself. This increases the volatility of shares. In the first quarter of 2023, Guydens ' revenue management almost coincided with a consensus projection ($8,172 billion versus $8.15 billion), while the operating profit benchmark of $1.625 billion looks markedly weaker than expectations ($1,755 billion). In the first quarter of 2023, an important statement was made about the growth trajectory of subscribers: in the first quarter, management expects moderate growth, but suspects that a significant expansion of the audience at the end of 2022 could result in a "demand transfer" effect. In other words, some of the potential customers who might have been able to sign in the first quarter have already done so in 2022. Netflix's management expected the free flow of money (FCF) to be about $1 billion in the 2022 round, so the actual result is estimated to be $1.6 billion. In addition, in 2023, management is awaiting the resumption of the equity buyback programme, thanks to the projected growth of the FCF to at least $3 billion. The company's balance sheet currently has just over $6 billion and short-term investments, while debt repayments are not planned this year. According to the report's comments, the savings of over $5.5 billion to $6 billion required for business operations (conforms to two months' revenues) will be used to finance the return of paper. We expect a very limited impact on stocks from the estimated volume of Buy Back (perhaps not more than $2 billion a year). By raising the target price of NFLX paper from $275 to $300, we keep a neutral projection for quotations. We appreciate Netflix's long-term growth potential as a new source of revenue for the company (the potential market is estimated at $180 billion), but we believe that the shares of the striming company are already characterized by premium value multipliers (EV/EBITDA NTM about 21.5x), so further increases in quotations are considered to be unsustainable. Our target price suggests that shares will be traded with EV/EBITDA NTM some 16s by the end of 2023, and EBITDA will be $9 billion in 2024 (consensus projection: $8.7 billion). The following key medium-term risks remain to be seen: Increased competition by other video-street players: Walt Disney (Disney+, ESPN+, Hulu), Warner Bros. Discovery (HBO Max, Discovery+), Apple (Apple TV+), Amazon (Amazon Prime Video). Macroeconomic uncertainty. We believe that a decline in real consumption in the US and Europe could have a negative impact on Netflix business in 2023, as part of households will optimize the cost of entertainment services by reducing the number of subscriptions available, and advertising budgets will remain under pressure.

record.header: The sale of the property of the daughter of the former deputy mayor of Moscow has been extended until July 24
record.subheader: The Moscow Arbitration Court has extended the sale of the property of the bankrupt ex-president of the Lights of Moscow Bank, the daughter of the former vice-mayor of Moscow, Maria Roslyak, for six months.
record.content: On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU, the Court of Arbitration of Moscow, extended the sale of the property of the bank's declared bankrupt ex-President Ogny Moscow, daughter of the former vice mayor of Moscow, Maria Roslák, for a period of six months. The next report of the financial manager of Eugenia Semchenko on the bankruptcy procedure was appointed on 24 July, reports to the court's website. On 14 August 2017, the capital arbitration, on the application of the development capital bank, recognized Roslak as bankrupt; the court then included in the creditor registry its debt to the development capital bank, amounting to approximately 24.9 million roubles.5 On December 2017, the court included in its creditor registry the Proford Investments Limited claim of 354 million roubles, and on 22 December 2017, the Ogny Moscow claim of 6,027 million roubles. In February 2016, the Basman Court of Moscow sentenced Roslyak to four years' imprisonment in the case concerning the embezzlement of the Bank of Ogny Moscow, which was suspended for 14 years because of the pregnancy of the convicted person and the presence of two minor children. The Fires of Moscow lost their licence in May 2014. In June 2014, the Court of Arbitration of Moscow declared the Bank to be bankrupt and appointed the AV to be a competitive manager. Roslák, daughter of Yuri Roslák, who in 1995-2010 was Deputy and First Deputy Mayor of Moscow, then Senator, Auditor of the Court of Accounts, CEO of Roskosmosmos and Deputy Director of the Khruníkov Centre.

en.header: The Pentagon supported Kiev's intention to return Crimea "by any means"
en.subheader: The Ukrainian military has the right to conduct operations in Crimea, and the United States supports them in their quest to return the peninsula, a Pentagon spokeswoman said. The Russian authorities promise a response, as well as the protection of the territory "by all means and means"
en.content: The Ukrainian military has the right to conduct operations in Crimea, and the U.S. supports them in an effort to recover the peninsula, the representative of the Pentagon said, and the Russian authorities promise to respond, as well as to protect the territory "by all means and by all means", the U.S. supports Ukraine's intention to return Crimea to the country, and stated to journalists at the briefing the Deputy Press Secretary of the Pentagon Sabrin Singh. Singh was asked to comment on the words of the Ukrainian authorities about the willingness to use American weapons for this purpose. In December, the head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Dmitri Kuleb, said that Washington did not prohibit Kiev from using it against Crimea. "We support Ukrainians in returning their territory by any means and any weapons they use," she said. According to Singh, if the Ukrainian military decides to carry out any operations on Crimea territory, they are "fully entitled to do so." As The New York Times reported the previous day, President Joe Biden's administration of the United States is inclined to have the opportunity to attack Crimea territory if it strengthens Ukraine's position in any future negotiations, while Washington initially refused to provide Kiev with weapons that could be used for this purpose for fear of escalation. Russia joined Crimea on the basis of the results of the referendum held in spring 2014. The Ukrainian authorities and most countries did not recognize its results. The Russian authorities have called the question of the territorial identity of the peninsula closed. President Vladimir Putin has said that the conditions for the return of Crimea to Ukraine "does not exist and cannot exist." Russian Security Council Vice-President Dmitrymedev warned that if the U.S.U. uses American weapons against Russian territories, Moscow would "act to defeat the decision-making centres" and hide from Russia's response to a potential attack by Crimea would be "very difficult." Putin has stated that Russia's territory would be protected "by all available forces and means." Vladimir Zelensky, President of Ukraine, last August, expressed his willingness to return Crimea "by any means deemed to be "right". Later, he said he was ready to consider the option of non-military return of the peninsula, and Zelensky then said that "there would be only a "yes" if someone proposed a peaceful solution to the issue. A month later, the Ukrainian leader said that the Crimea return operation had already "started in the heads of people".

ru.header: В Пентагоне поддержали намерение Киева вернуть Крым «любыми средствами»
ru.subheader: Украинские военные имеют право проводить операции в Крыму, и США поддерживают их в стремлении вернуть полуостров, заявила представитель Пентагона. Власти России обещают ответ, а также защиту территории «всеми силами и средствами»
ru.content: Украинские военные имеют право проводить операции в Крыму, и США поддерживают их в стремлении вернуть полуостров, заявила представитель Пентагона. Власти России обещают ответ, а также защиту территории «всеми силами и средствами»США поддерживают намерение Украины вернуть Крым в состав страны, заявила журналистам на брифинге заместитель пресс-секретаря Пентагона Сабрина Сингх.Сингх попросили прокомментировать слова представителей властей Украины о готовности использовать для этих целей американское оружие. В частности, в декабре глава МИДа Дмитрий Кулеба говорил, что Вашингтон не запрещает Киеву использовать его против Крыма.Представитель Пентагона в ответ на это подчеркнула, что США считают Крым частью Украины. «Мы поддерживаем украинцев в возвращении своей территории любыми средствами и любым оружием, которое они используют», — сказала она. По словам Сингх, если украинские военные решат проводить какие-либо операции на территории Крыма, они «в полном праве сделать это».Как накануне сообщила The New York Times, администрация президента США Джо Байдена склоняется к тому, что украинские военные должны получить возможность наносить удары по территории Крыма, если это укрепит позиции Украины на любых будущих переговорах. При этом изначально Вашингтон отказывался предоставлять Киеву оружие, которое можно использовать для этих целей, опасаясь эскалации.Россия присоединила Крым по результатам референдума, прошедшего весной 2014 года. Власти Украины и большинства стран не признали его результаты. Российские власти называют вопрос территориальной принадлежности полуострова закрытым. Президент Владимир Путин говорил, что условий для возвращения Крыма в состав Украины «не существует и не может существовать».Замглавы Совета безопасности России Дмитрий Медведев предупреждал, что, если ВСУ используют американское оружие против российских территорий, Москва будет «действовать на поражение центров принятия решений», и укрыться от российского ответа на потенциальную атаку Крыма будет «очень сложно». Путин заявлял, что территория России будет защищена «всеми имеющимися силами и средствами».Президент Украины Владимир Зеленский в минувшем августе выражал готовность вернуть Крым «любыми средствами», которые Киев сочтет «правильными». Позднее он сказал, что готов рассмотреть вариант возвращения полуострова невоенным путем. Зеленский говорил тогда, что «будет только «за», если кто-то предложит мирное решение вопроса. Месяц спустя украинский лидер сказал, что операция по возвращению Крыма уже «началась в головах людей».

en.header: Nothing Outlaws Crypto in India if Legal Procedures Are Followed, Says Government Official – Regulation Bitcoin News
en.subheader: An Indian government official says that there is currently nothing that outlaws crypto "as long as you follow the legal process."
en.content: An Indian government official says that there is currently nothing that outlaws crypto in India “as long as you follow the legal process.” Meanwhile, the country’s central bank, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), has stressed that “cryptocurrency does not have any underlying value.”Indian Government Official on CryptoIndian government official Rajeev Chandrasekhar talked about cryptocurrency Thursday at an event in Bengaluru. Chandrasekhar currently serves as both India’s Minister of State for Electronics and Information Technology and Minister of State for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. He is also a member of Rajya Sabha, the upper house of parliament.He explained that India has no issue with cryptocurrencies if all laws are followed, Reuters reported, quoting him as saying:There is nothing today that outlaws crypto as long as you follow the legal process.The Indian government has not yet established a regulatory framework for cryptocurrency. In December last year, the government told parliament that crypto legislation “can be effective only with significant international collaboration.” Indian Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman recently said the government plans to discuss crypto regulations with the G20 countries.However, crypto income is already taxed at 30% in India, and a 1% tax deducted at source (TDS) is levied on crypto transactions. Earlier this month, the government revealed that it is launching a crypto awareness campaign.Meanwhile, India’s central bank, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), has recommended a complete ban on cryptocurrencies such as bitcoin and ether. RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das said last week that “Cryptocurrency does not have any underlying value,” warning that “it will undermine the authority of the RBI and lead to the dollarization of the economy.” He even expects crypto to cause the next financial crisis if it is not banned.
en.summary: An Indian government official says that there is currently nothing that outlaws crypto in India “as long as you follow the legal process.” Meanwhile, the country’s central bank, the Reserve Bank of India, has stressed that “cryptocurrency does not have any underlying value”

record.header: UAE and India are discussing the issue of non-oil trade in rupees and dirhams - UAE Minister
record.subheader: According to Bloomberg, the total volume of bilateral trade between the UAE and India amounted to almost $64 billion in 2021.
record.content: MOSCOW, 20 January - RIA News/Prime. The United Arab Emirates and India are still discussing ways to stimulate non-oil trade in rupees and dirhams, as reported by the Foreign Trade Minister of the United Arab Emirates, Tani Al-Zeyudi. "We are still at an early stage of discussing with India the issue of trade in dirhams and rupees... it is only non-oil trade," said the Minister to the Bloomberg Agency. Bloomberg explains that the third-largest OPEC manufacturer has long supported the currency-to-dollar linkage, and most of the trade in the Persian Gulf is in United States currency. According to data collected by Bloomberg, the total bilateral trade between UAE and India amounted to nearly $64 billion in 2021, and the United Arab Emirates was seeking to increase trade with key partners and had signed several economic pacts last year with countries such as India, Indonesia, Turkey, Israel and Ukraine. Tani Al-Zeyoudi added that in the coming months the UAE expected similar agreements with Cambodia and Georgia; economic agreements would increase the country ' s GDP by 3.4 to 3.8 per cent by 2030; the Minister also reported that the cryptators would play an important role in future UAE trade; and that the Emirates, in particular Dubai, were working to attract the world ' s largest companies to adopt its favourable policies.

en.header: The US issued a warning to China after Xi Jinping's conversation with Putin
en.subheader: The United States, after a conversation between Putin and Xi Jinping, expressed concern about the ties between China and Russia
en.content: The US is concerned about the cooperation between the PRC and Russia and warns Beijing of the consequences of Moscow's assistance in circumventing sanctions, states the representative of the State Department, commenting on the 30 December conversation between Russian President Vladimir Putin and the leader of the PRC, Xi Jinping. "We are closely following Beijing's activities. Those on the Moscow side of this [conflict] will inevitably be on the wrong side of history," said the representative of the Department (quoted on CNN). In the State Department, they noted that they saw the continued close ties between Moscow and Beijing, although China claims to be neutral. In this regard, the US reminded the PRC of the consequences of "the provision of military assistance to Russia for [war action] against Ukraine or systematic assistance in the evasion of sanctions" on 30 December, Chinese and Russian leaders spoke via video link. Putin, during the interview, noted that Moscow and Beijing have the same view of "the causes, progress and logic of the ongoing transformation of the global geopolitical landscape" and have defended their interests and those who are "in support of a truly democratic world order and the right of countries to freely determine their destiny." The Chairman of the PRC pointed out that Beijing and Moscow should develop strategic coordination in order to bring greater benefits to the two peoples and bring more stability to the world. Xi Jinping noted that China is ready to cooperate with Russia and all the progressive countries in the world that oppose hegemony and power politics in order to jointly confront unipolarism, protectionism and intimidation, and firmly defend sovereignty, security and their interests.

record.header: Blinken announced a "decrease in temperature" in US-China relations
record.subheader: Secretary of State Blinken: The US and China managed to "lower the temperature" in relations
record.content: U.S. and China managed to reduce the temperature a little bit in the relationship, said U.S. Secretary of State Anthony Blinken during his speech at the University of Chicago, Illinois. "When we meet a lot, we talk a lot, that's what happens. You can feel that the temperature has dropped slightly to a certain degree," said Blinken in response to a question about whether the U.S. and China have been able to "decelerate the temperature" in the relationship.

ru.header: США сделали предупреждение Китаю после беседы Си Цзиньпина с Путиным
ru.subheader: США после беседы Путина и Си Цзиньпина заявили о беспокойстве из-за связей КНР и России
ru.content: США обеспокоены из-за сотрудничества КНР и России и предупреждают Пекин о последствиях в случае помощи Москве в обходе санкций, заявил представитель Госдепартамента, комментируя прошедший 30 декабря разговор между российским президентом Владимиром Путиным и лидером КНР Си Цзиньпином.«Мы внимательно следим за деятельностью Пекина. Те, кто на стороне Москвы в этом [конфликте], неизбежно окажутся на неправильной стороне истории», — заявил представитель ведомства (цитата по CNN).В Госдепе отметили, что видят сохранение тесных связей между Москвой и Пекином, хотя Китай утверждает, что придерживается нейтралитета. В этой связи США напомнили КНР о последствиях «предоставления России военной помощи для [боевых действий] против Украины или систематической помощи в уклонении от санкций».30 декабря китайский и российский лидеры поговорили по видеосвязи. Путин во время беседы отметил, что Москва и Пекин одинаково смотрят «на причины, ход и логику происходящей трансформации глобального геополитического ландшафта» и отстаивают интересы свои и тех, кто «выступает за подлинно демократическое мироустройство и право стран свободно определять свою судьбу».Председатель КНР указал, что Пекину и Москве следует развивать стратегическую координацию, чтобы принести больше пользы двум народам и привнести больше стабильности в мир. Си Цзиньпин отметил, что Китай готов сотрудничать с Россией и всеми прогрессивными странами в мире, которые выступают против гегемонии и силовой политики, чтобы совместно противостоять однополярности, протекционизму и запугиванию, твердо защищать суверенитет, безопасность и свои интересы.

en.header: Budapest demanded that Kiev stop the "atrocities" against the Hungarians
en.subheader: Hungary again demanded that Ukraine stop the oppression of the Hungarian community in Transcarpathia. Budapest stated that "constant and systematic harassment and deprivation of the rights of national minorities are unacceptable."
en.content: Hungary reiterated its demand that Ukraine cease its harassment of the Hungarian community in Zakarpatia. In Budapest, it declared that "the constant and systematic harassment and denial of the rights of national minorities are unacceptable" by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Hungary for Bilateral Relations, Tamash Menzer, published on his social media page a statement on the actions of the Ukrainian authorities in Zakarpatya against the Hungarian community. He called them unacceptable and condemned them. "Anthiwenger decisions and actions, of course, are unacceptable, we condemn what happened. We call upon the local authorities to immediately cease the atrocities against the Hungarians. We call upon the Ukrainian State authorities to do everything immediately to reverse the anti-Hungarian decisions and restore the status quo", he said. The Hungarian edition of Magyar Nemzet the previous day reported that Hungarian flags and signs in Hungarian had been removed from public institutions in the Zakarpat city of Mukachevo and local villages. For example, the Hungarian sign had been removed from the football academy established with the support of Hungary and the director of the Hungarian secondary school had been dismissed in Mukachevo himself. "In the words of the local residents, the police had travelled to the localities at night, removed the flags, folded them, then returned to check whether they had been returned to their place," reported a reporter of the publication. "If Ukraine wanted to become a member of the European Union, constant and systematic harassment and denial of the rights of national minorities were unacceptable," he commented on the actions of the Ukrainian authorities Tamash Menzer. Zakarpatje, who was now part of Ukraine, was part of Hungary until 1920. However, in the Zakarpatsk region of Ukraine, the Hungarian national minority still lives: according to the 2001 census, about 150,000 Hungarians lived in the region; for example, in the city of Beregovo, the proportion of Hungarians in the 2001 census was more than 48 per cent, while Ukrainians in the city were 38 per cent. In 2018, Magyar Hang, referring to a study by the Zakarpatsk Hungarian Institute, Ferenz Rakozi II, and the National Institute for Political Research, reported that their number in the region had decreased by 21,000 and amounted to approximately 131,000. In 2012, the local administration had granted Hungarian status to a regional language, which had made it possible to be formally applied in the documentation trade. However, in 2018, the law on regional languages had lost legal force. In Budapest, it is believed that Ukraine is harassing ethnic Hungarians. In July 2022, following Russia ' s outbreak of hostilities in Ukraine, the head of the Hungarian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Peter Siyarto, declared that Budapest was prepared to take action if it was necessary to save and protect the Hungarians living in the Zakarpatsk region. In mid-January, the head of the Hungarian Prime Minister ' s office, Gergay Guyash, stated that Budapest would not allow the transit of weapons to Ukraine through Zakarpatia for the benefit of the local Hungarian minority. He explained that "the Government ' s goal is to protect Zakarpatier from war as long as possible".
en.summary: The Hungarian side demands that Ukraine stop discriminating against the Hungarian community in the Transcarpathian region. This was stated by Hungarian Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto. According to him, Budapest demands that Kiev stop discriminating against Hungarians in Ukraine.

record.header: Zakharova ruled out negotiations with Kiev because of the "frenzied war party"
record.subheader: Zakharova: negotiations with Kiev are out of the question with the power of the "rabid war party"
record.content: Ukraine is governed by a "party of war", so the peace talks between Moscow and Kiev are impossible, stated Maria Zaharova, the representative of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia, and her comments are posted on the website of the agency. "The lost sense of reality of the naked "party of war" today sets the tone and determines the policy of the Kiev regime. Under such circumstances there can be no talk of negotiations with Ukraine", Zaharov said. She cited the position of Ukrainian President Vladimir Zelensky, his press secretary Sergei Nikiforov, and the Minister of Defence Alexei Reznikov.

ru.header: Будапешт потребовал от Киева прекратить «зверства» против венгров
ru.subheader: Венгрия вновь потребовала от Украины прекратить притеснения венгерской общины в Закарпатье. В Будапеште заявили, что «постоянная и систематическая травля и лишение прав национальных меньшинств недопустимы»
ru.content: Венгрия вновь потребовала от Украины прекратить притеснения венгерской общины в Закарпатье. В Будапеште заявили, что «постоянная и систематическая травля и лишение прав национальных меньшинств недопустимы»Госсекретарь МИД Венгрии по двусторонним отношениям Тамаш Менцер опубликовал на своей странице в соцсетях заявление о действиях украинских властей в Закарпатье в отношении венгерской общины. Он назвал их неприемлемыми и осудил их.«Антивенгерские решения и акции, конечно, неприемлемы, мы осуждаем случившееся. Призываем местные власти немедленно прекратить зверства против венгров. Призываем государственные власти Украины немедленно сделать все, чтобы отменить антивенгерские решения и восстановить прежнее состояние», — заявил он.Венгерское издание Magyar Nemzet накануне сообщило, что с общественных учреждений закарпатского города Мукачево и местных сел были сняты венгерские флаги и вывески на венгерском. Так, вывеску на венгерском языке сняли с футбольной академии, созданной при поддержке Венгрии, а в самом Мукачево был уволен директор венгерской средней школы. «По словам местных жителей, в ночное время полицейские выезжали в населенные пункты, снимали флаги, складывали их. Потом возвращались, чтобы проверить, не вернули ли их на место», — сообщал корреспондент издания.«Если Украина хочет стать членом Евросоюза, постоянная и систематическая травля и лишение прав национальных меньшинств недопустимы», — прокомментировал действия украинских властей Тамаш Менцер.Закарпатье, которое сейчас входит в состав Украины, было частью Венгрии до 1920 года. Однако в Закарпатской области Украины до сих пор проживает венгерское национальное меньшинство. Согласно переписи 2001 года, в этом регионе жили около 150 тыс. венгров. Так, в городе Берегово доля венгров в соответствии с переписью 2001 года составляет более 48%, при том что украинцев в городе 38%. В 2018 году газета Magyar Hang со ссылкой на исследование Закарпатского венгерского института имени Ференца Ракоци II и Национального института политических исследований сообщила, что их количество в регионе уменьшилось на 21 тыс. и составляет примерно 131 тыс. человек.В 2012 году местная администрация присвоила венгерскому статус регионального языка, что позволило официально применять его в документообороте. Но в 2018 году закон о региональных языках утратил законную силу. В Будапеште считают, что Украина притесняет этнических венгров. В июле 2022 года, после начала Россией военных действий на Украине, глава МИД Венгрии Петр Сийярто заявил, что Будапешт готов принять меры, если понадобится спасти и защитить венгров, живущих в Закарпатской области.В середине января глава канцелярии премьер-министра Венгрии Гергей Гуйяш заявил, что Будапешт не допустит транзита оружия на Украину через Закарпатье в интересах местного венгерского меньшинства. Он пояснил, что «цель правительства — как можно дольше защищать Закарпатье от войны».
ru.summary: Венгерская сторона требует от Украины прекратить дискриминацию венгерской общины на территории Закарпатской области. Об этом заявил глава МИД Венгрии Петер Сийярто. По его словам, Будапешт требует от Киева прекратить дискриминацию венгров на Украине.

record.header: Passengers of the liner damaged in Turkey will be sent to the Russian Federation by planes
record.content: Moscow. On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU - Lyner Astoria Grande, who had been damaged in an attempt to dock at a Turkish port in a storm, would remain in Turkey for repair, Russian passengers would be sent to Sochi by flights, informed the "Interfax" representative of the shipowner in Sochi. "People will send the planes, we will send them all today and tomorrow. Ship's shipment has already begun. Ship's departure for repairs in Turkey," he said. According to the shipowner's representative, another cruise from Sochi on the Astoria Grande ship scheduled for 21 January, will therefore be cancelled. The company operator is prepared to return the money to the tourists who booked the tours. He added that the cruise programme was scheduled to continue in April: on 18 January, a cruise ship, Astoria Grande, in an attempt to dock in the storm, was hit by the cruise protection of the dock of the Turkish port of Amasra. The port was located in northern Turkey in Bartin province. 385 Russian tourists and 283 crew members were on board, none of whom were injured. For a while, the cruiser drifted near the harbour to wait the weather, he was able to dock at the port on 19 January. According to the Turkish agency Anadolu, an insurance company following an inspection of the vessel following an incident in Amasra, stated that it was not safe for passengers to continue to travel. "In this connection, it was decided to send 385 Russian passengers to Sochi by special flights. They are scheduled to take place on Friday and Saturday from Merzifon International Airport in Amassie or Zonguldak Airport," says the agency. According to the publication, the airliner will be refurbished at Tuzla Shipyard in Istanbul. Since July 2022, Astoria Grande has been performing cruises from Sochi to Turkey's coast.

ru.header: Раненую в Соледаре журналистку Readovka доставили в Москву
ru.content: Военного корреспондента Readovka Анастасию Елсукову, которая получила ранение в Соледаре, доставили спецбортом в Москву, сообщается в заявлении редакции издания в телеграм-канале.«Медики приняли решение доставить Настю в больницу на вертолете. На данный момент ей ничего не угрожает», — говорится в сообщении.Журналистке сделали две операции: первую — «в прифронтовой зоне», вторую — в больнице в Луганске. Оттуда ее доставили в Ростов-на-Дону, где посадили на спецборт до Москвы.Материал дополняется

en.header: Crypto to play 'major role' in UAE trade: foreign trade Minister
en.subheader: UAE’s minister of state for foreign trade Thani Al-Zeyoudi noted that as the country has attracted a lot of talent from the crypto sector, the UAE now needs to roll out the correct regulation to support further growth.
en.content: UAE’s minister of state for foreign trade Thani Al-Zeyoudi noted that as the country has attracted a lot of talent from the crypto sector, the UAE now needs to roll out the correct regulation to support further growth.NewsOwn this piece of historyCollect this article as an NFTCrypto will play a “major role” in the United Arab Emirates' global trade moving forward, says the UAE’s minister of state for foreign trade Thani Al-Zeyoudi.Speaking with Bloomberg on Jan. 20 in Davos Switzerland — where world leaders are currently gathered for the 2023 World Economic Forum — Al-Zeyoudi provided a host of updates regarding the UAE’s trade partnerships and policies heading into 2023.Commenting on the crypto sector, the minister stated that “crypto will play a major role for UAE trade going forward,” as he outlined that "the most important thing is that we ensure global governance when it comes to cryptocurrencies and crypto companies.”Al-Zeyoudi went on to suggest that as the UAE works on its crypto regulatory regime, the focus will be on making the Gulf country a hub with crypto-friendly policies that also have sufficient protections in place:“We started attracting some of the companies to the country with the aim that we’ll build together the right governance and legal system, which are needed.”The comments from Al-Zeyoudi come just a week after the UAE Cabinet introduced new regulation which essentially ensures that entities engaging in crypto activities must secure a license and approval from the Virtual Asset Regulatory Authority (VARA).If companies fail to do so they will face fines of up to $2.7 million under the new law. The move adds to the “Guiding Principles” for digital asset regulation and supervision that were published by the financial regulator of Abu Dhabi’s Global Market free economic zone in September.The principles outline a friendly stance towards crypto while also pledging to comply with international standards in Anti-Money Laundering (AML), combating the financing of terrorism (CFT) and supporting financial sanctions.The UAE’s minister of state for artificial intelligence and the digital economy, Omar Sultan Al Olama also appeared at the World Economic Forum as part of a crypto-focused panel on Jan. 19.Al Olama noted that while the FTX debacle was a major concern, the UAE still wants to be a hub despite the whole ordeal.“Them [crypto companies] calling the UAE home is definitely a positive thing,” he said.The minister also distanced the UAE from assertions that its cities like Dubai tend to become key spots for disgraced crypto figures to flee to, arguing that “bad actors don’t have a nationality and don’t have a destination.”He did stress however that governments do need to work together to stop bad actors from going awol overseas.“You will see them everywhere. You will see them in the Bahamas, you will see them in New York, London, and what we need to do as governments is to work together, with the industry as well, to ensure that if someone does something wrong he can't move from one place to the other,” he said.
en.summary: Minister of State for foreign trade says crypto will play ‘major role’. UAE needs to ‘roll out the correct regulation’, he says

record.header: Davos 2023: Banking Panel Reinforces the Need for Crypto Regulation
record.subheader: A group of global banking experts hosted by the World Economic Forum (WEF) convened about the need for global crypto regulation.
record.content: A group of global banking experts hosted by the World Economic Forum (WEF) convened about the need for global crypto regulation, including stablecoins and unbacked crypto assets. The panel agreed there must be at least some kind of base regulation for these assets and bank-equivalent regulation for blockchain applications seeking to offer products similar to what traditional banking offers.WEF Global Banking Panel Seeks More Crypto RegulationGlobal bankers have agreed on the need for more clear regulations for cryptocurrencies. In a panel titled “Banking in the Eye of the Storm,” part of the Davos 2023 meetings of the World Economic Forum (WEF), directives of central and private banks examined the cryptocurrency market after the events that unfolded during 2022, including the fall of cryptocurrency exchange FTX.François Villeroy de Galhau, governor of the Central Bank of France, explained that regulation for crypto markets was key for controlling the possible damage these might bring to investors in the future. Villeroy de Galhau stated:The question is not whether we have to regulate or not... for sure we have to regulate. Some even say it’s not a question of regulating, is a question of prohibiting.Villeroy de Galhau also pushed for the alliance of central banks and private banking institutions to partner in promoting innovation, including the adoption of CBDCs (central bank digital currencies).The governor of the Central Bank of France also expects the implementation of the finalized Basel Committee rules in all jurisdictions, which were approved in December and offer directives for the exposure of banks to cryptocurrency assets.A Base Level of RegulationWhile all panelists agreed on the need for at least a minimal level of regulation, including anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) measures for all assets, Tharman Shanmugaratnam, senior minister of Singapore, stated that some assets would better be unregulated, clarifying the risks that investing in these assets might bring possible investors.However, he clarified that any cryptocurrency and blockchain-based tech that aimed to offer comparable services to banks, including stablecoins, should be regulated in the same way traditional financial institutions are.Shanmugaratnam believes the answer of banks to crypto and blockchain innovation should be the linkage of local domestic systems with today’s global payment systems, to help immigrants and SMEs, which are currently served by cryptocurrency alternatives.

Some even say it’s not a question of regulating, is a question of prohibiting.Villeroy de Galhau also pushed for the alliance of central banks and private banking institutions to partner in promoting innovation, including the adoption of CBDCs (central bank digital currencies).The governor of the Central Bank of France also expects the implementation of the finalized Basel Committee rules in all jurisdictions, which were approved in December and offer directives for the exposure of banks to cryptocurrency assets.A Base Level of RegulationWhile all panelists agreed on the need for at least a minimal level of regulation, including anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) measures for all assets, Tharman Shanmugaratnam, senior minister of Singapore, stated that some assets would better be unregulated, clarifying the risks that investing in these assets might bring possible investors.However, he clarified that any cryptocurrency and blockchain-based tech that aimed to offer comparable services to banks, including stablecoins, should be regulated in the same way traditional financial institutions are.Shanmugaratnam believes the answer of banks to crypto and blockchain innovation should be the linkage of local domestic systems with today’s global payment systems, to help immigrants and SMEs, which are currently served by cryptocurrency alternatives.

en.header: Nearly $700M Worth of Assets Linked to Sam Bankman-Fried, FTX Seized by US
en.subheader: The assets, including more than 55 million shares in Robinhood, were seized as part of the case against the FTX founder and former CEO.
en.content: United States prosecutors have seized nearly $700 million worth of assets either owned by collapsed crypto exchange FTX or tied to founder and former CEO Sam Bankman-Fried, authorities disclosed in a Friday court filing.Federal authorities in the Southern District of New York have seized just over $698 million worth of assets linked to the disgraced crypto founder, according to the filing, which was first reported on by CNBC.The bulk of the value comes from a stack of shares that Bankman-Fried purchased in Robinhood, the stock and crypto trading app, allegedly using stolen FTX customer funds.The document submitted by U.S. Attorney Damian Williams details the holdings, with nearly 55.3 million shares of Robinhood stock seized on January 4. As of this writing, the shares are collectively worth about $526 million. They were held by Emergent Fidelity Technologies, a shell company that Bankman-Fried created with FTX co-founder Gary Wang.In a December affidavit, Bankman-Fried wrote that he and Wang formed the new company—using funds loaned by FTX sister company Alameda Research—to acquire shares in Robinhood Markets Inc. totaling $546.4 million. FTX customer funds were reportedly used to plug a trading hole in Alameda's balance sheet last summer, ahead of the exchange's eventual collapse.Other funds seized on January 4 include $20.7 million held by Emergent at ED&F Man Capital Markets, Inc, and another $49.9 million at Farmington State Bank, held under FTX Digital Markets. Between January 11 and 19, authorities seized just over $100 million of FTX’s funds held in Silvergate Bank.Today’s court filings also list three accounts held at rival cryptocurrency exchange Binance and its Binance US affiliate. However, the value of the assets in those accounts was not specified.FTX and Alameda filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in November following a liquidity crisis at FTX, with billions of dollars apparently missing from the once-popular crypto exchange. Bankman-Fried now faces various charges from the U.S. Department of Justice, Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), and Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) related to his actions at the companies.The FTX restructuring team, led by new company CEO John J. Ray III, said last week that it has separately recovered more than $5 billion worth of company assets between cryptocurrency, cash, and liquid investments in securities.
en.summary: Prosecutors say they have seized nearly $700 million. Bankman-Fried is accused of defrauding FTX and its customers

record.header: U.S. Lays Claim to $700 Million of Assets Linked to Bankman-Fried, FTX
record.subheader: The U.S. seized $700 million of former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried’s assets and is now seeking their forfeiture.
record.content: The U.S. government wants to take control of nearly $700 million of assets it seized earlier this month from former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried, according to court filings Friday.Included in the property are over 55 million Robinhood shares worth about $525 million. Bought with borrowed Alameda money, those shares were at the center of a fight between Bankman-Fried, FTX Group and BlockFi. Officials are also moving to claim $171 million in cash from a series of bank accounts linked to Bankman-Fried’s web of companies.The government seized those assets and more in early January and are now seeking their forfeiture, per a bill of particulars filed late Friday in Bankman-Fried’s criminal case.“We believe that these assets are not property in the bankruptcy estate” or are subject to exemptions, meaning they don't have to be frozen like most FTX assets are, pending wind-up, a government lawyer previously told the judge in this case.

en.header: Blinken said that the degree of tension in US-Chinese relations has somewhat decreased.
en.subheader: US Secretary of State Anthony Blinken said that there is currently an easing of tensions between the United States and China.
en.content: Moscow, 21 January, INTERFAX.RU, United States Secretary of State Anthony Blinken, stated that there was now a reduction in tensions between the United States and China. In response to the question of whether tensions between countries had decreased during Blinken's presentation at a Chicago University event, he said, "I think yes, because when you discuss it, it is involved, it has a tendency to have that effect." The American Secretary of State added that "the temperature seems to have fallen to a certain degree." "The rest of the world expects us to manage this relationship responsibly. The way in which we deal with it is known to have a real impact on it," Blinken added. The diplomat noted Washington's concern over Taiwan, and he said that China's recent actions show that Beijing "is no longer satisfied with the status quo (...), which has been successful in terms of relations between our countries and in managing a complex situation." Blinken noted that in response to China's statements that consider the Taiwan problem to be its internal business, the US says that it "is of interest to the United States and countries around the world." The Secretary of State referred to the Chinese theme in the run-up to Beijing, which, according to the media, refers to official representatives, is scheduled to be held from 5 to 6 February this year.
en.summary: The US Secretary of State said that now there is a "soft" easing of tension in relations between the US and China.

record.header: Japan and the Netherlands are close to agreeing on restrictions for China on chip-making equipment
record.content: Moscow – January 20, INTERFAX.RU – The United States has an opportunity at the end of January to finalize the restrictions that these two countries will impose on exports to the PRC of chip-making equipment, reports Bloomberg with reference to sources. "In the words of people familiar with this issue, Japan's and the Netherlands' export control regimes can be negotiated and approved before the end of January. Earlier in January, Japanese premier Fumio Kisida and the Prime Minister Mark Rutte discussed these plans with US President Joe Biden in the White House." The agency notes, however, it explains that Japan and the Netherlands are unlikely to impose the same strict restrictions on China as they did last October. However, Beijing could be cut off from technology and knowledge to create the most modern semiconductors needed for micro-scheme production. On October 7, 2022, the United States Mintorg banned the sale to China of state-of-the-art chips, as well as equipment, components and software for their production, with particular emphasis on technology related to artificial intelligence and potential military applications. Japan's Tokyo Electronic Ltd and the Netherlands' ASML Holding are two of the most important suppliers of products that the US needs to effectively implement sanctions against China. According to analysts, given these companies, as well as restrictions on related deliveries from United States companies, Appled Materials, Inc. , Lam Research Corporation and KLA Corporation, Chinese firms will find it extremely difficult to produce the most modern chips. On Friday, Akira Amari, an influential member of Japan's Liberal Democratic Party responsible for the development of Japan's semiconductor industry, stated that Tokyo needed to join the US policy to curb China's ambitions in that industry. He warned, however, that sanctions must be carefully checked to avoid a threat to global economic stability, and the representative of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China, Wang Wenbin, accused the United States of seeking benefits from its allies. In December, Bloomberg reported that Japan and the Netherlands had agreed to apply some restrictions on exports to the PRC of the most advanced chip production equipment. One of the Agency ' s sources noted that the Japanese government had had to overcome resistance from Japanese companies that did not wish to lose the Chinese market.

ru.header: Блинкен заявил, что градус напряженности в американо-китайских отношениях несколько снизился
ru.subheader: Госсекретарь США Энтони Блинкен заявил, что в настоящее время наблюдается смягчение напряженности в отношениях между Соединенными Штатами и Китаем.
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Госсекретарь США Энтони Блинкен заявил, что в настоящее время наблюдается смягчение напряженности в отношениях между Соединенными Штатами и Китаем.В ответ на вопрос, снизилась ли напряженности в отношениях между странами, заданный во время выступления Блинкена на мероприятии в Чикагском университете, он сказал: "Я думаю, что да, потому что, когда вы это обсуждаете, вовлечены, это имеет тенденцию оказывать такой эффект".Американский госсекретарь добавил, что "по ощущениям, температура упала до определенного градуса"."Остальной мир ожидает, что мы будем ответственно управлять этими отношениями. Известно, что то, как мы справляемся с этим, на самом деле повлияет и на него", - добавил Блинкен.Дипломат отметил озабоченность Вашингтона ситуацией вокруг Тайваня.По его словам, действия Китая в последнее время свидетельствуют, что Пекин "больше не устраивает статус-кво (...), который был успешным с точки зрения отношений между нашими странами и управления сложной ситуацией".Блинкен отметил, что в ответ на заявления Китая, который считает тайваньскую проблему своим внутренним делом, США говорят, что она "представляет интерес для Соединенных Штатов и стран по всему миру".Госсекретарь коснулся китайкой темы в преддверии визита в Пекин, который, как сообщают СМИ, ссылаясь на официальных представителей, намечен на 5-6 февраля текущего года.
ru.summary: Госсекретарь США заявил, что сейчас в отношениях между США и Китаем наблюдается «мягкое» смягчение напряженности.

en.header: Blinken announced a "decrease in temperature" in US-China relations
en.subheader: Secretary of State Blinken: The US and China managed to "lower the temperature" in relations
en.content: U.S. and China managed to reduce the temperature a little bit in the relationship, said U.S. Secretary of State Anthony Blinken during his speech at the University of Chicago, Illinois. "When we meet a lot, we talk a lot, that's what happens. You can feel that the temperature has dropped slightly to a certain degree," said Blinken in response to a question about whether the U.S. and China have been able to "decelerate the temperature" in the relationship.

record.header: Peskov complained that so far there is no hope for better relations between the Russian Federation and the United States.
record.subheader: In the Kremlin, it is believed that the Russian Federation and the United States, which are historically at the lowest point, are not expected to improve their relations, in the foreseeable future, have been announced by Russian President Dmitry Peskov's press secretary.
record.content: Moscow – January 20, INTERFAX.RU – In the Kremlin, it is believed that the hopes of improving Russia's relations with the US, which are historically at the lowest point, do not exist in the foreseeable future, have been stated by Russian President Dmitri Peskov's press secretary. "The past two years have been, despite the initial sombre hopes of Geneva (the Russian Federation-United States summit in Geneva on June 16, 2021 – IF) and so on, they have been very bad for bilateral relations. Bilateral relations are now, perhaps, at the lowest point historically, unfortunately. "There is no prospect of improvement," said Peskov to journalists on Friday, so the press secretary of the President of the Russian Federation responded to the journalists' request to comment on the state and prospects of Russian-American relations following Joe Biden's two-year tenure as President of the United States.

ru.header: Блинкен заявил о «снижении температуры» в отношениях США и Китая
ru.subheader: Госсекретарь Блинкен: США и Китаю удалось «снизить температуру» в отношениях
ru.content: США и Китаю удалось немного «снизить температуру» в отношениях, заявил госсекретарь США Энтони Блинкен во время своего выступления в университете Чикаго (штат Иллинойс). Трансляция велась на YouTube-канале Госдепартамента.«Когда мы много встречаемся, много разговариваем, то результат оказывается именно таким. Можно почувствовать, что температура несколько снизилась до определенного градуса», — сказал Блинкен в ответ на вопрос, удалось ли США и Китаю «снизить температуру» в отношениях.Материал дополняется
