Another DeFi report suggests that decentralized forex could reduce costs by as much as 80%.The top 100 DeFi tokens saw a second week of bullish price action, with a majority of the tokens trading in the green on the weekly charts.SushiSwap’s new DEX aggregator will ‘10x our market share’ — head chefJust a month after warning of a “significant deficit” in its treasury, the CEO of decentralized exchange SushiSwap has shared several planned updates to the platform, which he said are intended to “10x” its market share in 2023.SushiSwap CEO, Jared Grey, laid out the plans for the DeFi platform in a Jan. 16 Medium post, saying it will focus on its product stack in line with prior plans to make Sushi more sustainable.Continue readingDeFi should complement TradFi, not attack it: Ava Labs CEO | Davos 2023DeFi is moving from becoming a small niche within the financial industry to something TradFi is trying to incorporate.In an interview with Cointelegraph at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, Emin Gun Sirer, the co-founder and CEO of Ava Labs, spoke on DeFi’s role in TradFi ecosystems and what users can expect in a future where both are center stage.Continue readingDecentralized forex will reduce costs by as much as 80%: ReportIf the foreign exchange market starts using DeFi protocols instead of the current centralized systems, the cost of remittances could be reduced by “as much as 80%,” according to a Jan. 19 paper jointly published by researchers at Circle and Uniswap.The authors studied the trading activity of Circle’s USD Coin (USDC) and Euro Coin (EUROC) on Uniswap from July 2022 to January 2023. They found that the coins had $128 million in total volume, with trading volume as high as $8 million on some days.Continue readingRaydium exploiter moves $2.7M to crypto mixer Tornado CashIn an alert, blockchain security firm CertiK reported that the Raydium protocol exploiter had sent 1,774.5 Ether (ETH) to the Tornado Cash cryptocurrency mixer. The amount is worth around $2.7 million at the time of writing.While security teams from various exchanges continue to combat the efforts of hackers, funds continue to flow to the sanctioned Tornado Cash.Continue readingDeFi market overviewAnalytical data reveals that DeFi’s total market value remained over $40 billion this past week, trading at about $44.9 billion at the time of writing. Data from Cointelegraph Markets Pro and TradingView show that DeFi’s top 100 tokens by market capitalization had a bullish week, with nearly all the tokens breaking past multi-week highs.Convex Finance (CVX) was the biggest gainer on the weekly charts, registering a 37% price surge over the last seven days, followed by Kava (KAVA) with a 34% surge. Synthetix (SNX) recorded a 29% surge on the weekly charts, while the rest of the tokens in the top 100 also saw bullish gains over the past week.Thanks for reading our summary of this week’s most impactful DeFi developments. record.header: DeFi Forex to Cut Costs By 80%: Research
record.content: Ifeanyi Egede - BlockchainReporterFull disclaimer: This platform includes third party opinions. We do not endorse their accuracy. Digital asset prices can be volatile. Do your own research.See full terms here.According to a joint research paper published by Circle and Uniswap on January 19th, utilizing decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols in the foreign exchange market could potentially decrease the cost of remittances by up to 80%.The research paper, entitled “On-chain Foreign Exchange and Cross-border Payments,” was authored by Austin Adams (Uniswap Data Scientist), Gordon Liao (Circle Chief Economist), and others.The research paper’s authors analyzed the trading activity of Circle’s USDC and EUROC on Uniswap from July 2022 to January 2023. They discovered that the digital currency had a total transaction volume of $128 million, with certain days recording the trading activity of up to $8 million.According to the research, during the period studied, USDC and EUROC traded at rates very close to exchange rates discovered in the large-scale forex market for the USD and EUR, respectively. The authors believe that the DeFi currency exchange provides a credible alternative to conventional forex, with competitive pricing and price efficiency, even though its trading activity is still relatively small.The researchers seek to look into the potential cost reductions that could be realized in the foreign exchange market using decentralized finance protocols like Uniswap. To do this, they compared the costs associated with the conventional correspondent banking system of forex versus those related to DeFi forex.The researchers used data from the World Bank to calculate the cost of a $500 remittance conducted via the international banking system. They then contrasted this price to purchasing a stablecoin (either USDC or EUROC) on an exchange, using Uniswap to exchange it for the other coin, transferring it to another individual, and having that person swap it back for the original currency on an exchange.The researchers concluded that while the DeFi model does involve various fees, including exchange fees, network fees, DeFi trading fees, and costs associated with sending and receiving money from an exchange. According to the World Bank estimates, these fees are still significantly lower, up to 80%, than the average remittance cost.Decentralized finance, or DeFi for short, is revolutionizing how we think about traditional financial systems. By leveraging blockchain technology and smart contracts, DeFi platforms can offer various financial services without the need for centralized intermediaries. This has led to an explosion of innovation in the space and a growing number of users drawn to the transparency, security, and accessibility of DeFi platforms.One of the most exciting aspects of DeFi is the ability for anyone with an internet connection to access a wide range of financial services. This includes everything from lending and borrowing to trading and investing to insurance and savings. By removing the need for traditional intermediaries like banks and financial institutions, DeFi platforms can offer these services at significantly lower costs and with greater transparency.Another key aspect of DeFi is smart contracts, which are self-executing contracts with the terms of the agreement directly written into lines of code. This allows for the automation of many financial processes and can help to reduce the risk of fraud and errors. Additionally, smart contracts can help ensure users’ privacy and security by storing all data on a decentralized blockchain network.The growth of DeFi has been phenomenal, with the total value locked in DeFi platforms reaching over $30 billion in 2021, and the number of users on these platforms is growing at an equally rapid rate. This has led to an influx of institutional investors and traditional financial companies looking to get in on the action.

en.header: The movement of MCC trains on the Khoroshevo - Krymskaya section will be suspended for a day
en.content: Moscow: On 21 January, INTERFAX.RU - The Moscow Central Ring Train (MRC) will not travel from 21 to 22 January on the "Korosevo Crimea" section in connection with the installation of the overflight structures for the future pedestrian tunnel, informed Interfax in the Moscow Railway (MZR). "The IDC train movement between Khorosevo Crimea stations will be temporarily suspended from 21 to 22 January for the installation of special engineering structures - overflight structures during the tunnel construction period under the tracks", said the agency's counterpart. "The ICK Lasts will follow at 8 minutes intervals during the 24-hour period. The anti-clockwise train will follow only to Khoroshevo and the clock to Crimea Stations of Shelejik, Business Centre, Kutuzovi, Lujniki and Gagarina Square will be temporarily closed," specified by the MAC. It is noted that the new tunnel will in the future link the Testo station of IDC-1 and the northern lobby of the same name station of IDC-4. A winged pedestrian gallery will be organized along the platform to move from the housing complex to the subway of the International and the IDC of the Business Centre. The southern lobby will also be integrated with the IDC and the metro.

record.header: The Crimean bridge was opened to traffic after repairs two hours earlier than planned
record.subheader: The Crimean bridge was opened on Friday for traffic on the highway after stopping for several hours for repairs, the press service of the Ministry of Transport of the Russian Federation reports.
record.content: On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU - Crimean Bridge opened on Friday for traffic on the road after a few hours' stop for repair, reports the Ministry's press service. "Today, at 4:05, the traffic of cars and buses on the Crimean Bridge, previously suspended for repair and rehabilitation work," says a press release posted on the Ministry's television channel, previously reported that the bridge would be completely closed for traffic from 1 p.m. to 6 p.m. On the morning of Friday, the bridge was closed to dismantle the last one damaged by the explosion on 8 October 2022 on the left side of the Crimea road bridge towards Crimea in Krasnodar province, previously reported in Rosautdor. The last time road traffic on the Crimean bridge was limited to four hours on Tuesday to carry out repairs, the third damaged passage of that part of the bridge was dismantled on that day. The first two damaged passages on the left side of the bridge were dismantled and removed on 19 and 21 December. Two new flights were carried over on 10 and 14 January. In February, all four new flights would be placed in the project provision on 5 December, Russian President Vladimir Putin passed through the restored right-hand side of the Crimean bridge, listened to the report on the work carried out and, at the opening of the movement, charged the left, less damaged, part of the bridge with a regulatory status. He said that the repair of the road part of the bridge would be completed in general in March. The right side of the road, which had taken over the main shock wave from the explosion on 8 October last year, had been restored within 56 days. The re-established flights were opened on 7 December, after which the bridges began work on the off-the-road left side.

ru.header: Движение поездов МЦК на участке "Хорошево - Крымская" приостановят на сутки
ru.content: Москва. 21 января. INTERFAX.RU - Поезда Московского центрального кольца (МЦК) с 21 по 22 января не будут ходить на участке "Хорошево - Крымская" в связи с работами по установке пролетных строений для будущего пешеходного тоннеля, сообщили "Интерфаксу" в Московской железной дороге (МЖД)."Движение поездов МЦК между станциями Хорошево - Крымская будет временно приостановлено 21-22 января для установки специальных инженерных сооружений - пролетных строений на период строительства тоннеля под путями", - сказал собеседник агентства."В течение суток "Ласточки" на МЦК будут следовать с интервалом 8 минут. Курсирующие против часовой стрелки поезда станут следовать только до Хорошево, а по часовой - до Крымской. Станции Шелепиха, Деловой центр, Кутузовская, Лужники и Площадь Гагарина будут временно закрыты", - уточнили в МЖД.Отмечается, что новый тоннель в будущем свяжет станции "Тестовская" МЦД-1 и северный вестибюль одноименной станции МЦД-4. Вдоль платформы будет организована крытая пешеходная галерея для перехода от жилого комплекса к метро "Международная" и МЦК "Деловой центр". Южный вестибюль также интегрируют с МЦК и метро.Работы по установке пролетных строений будут проводиться с 3:00 21 января до 3:00 22 января в выходные дни, когда пассажиропоток минимален.

The last time road traffic on the Crimean bridge was limited to four hours on Tuesday to carry out repairs, the third damaged passage of that part of the bridge was dismantled on that day. The first two damaged passages on the left side of the bridge were dismantled and removed on 19 and 21 December. Two new flights were carried over on 10 and 14 January. In February, all four new flights would be placed in the project provision on 5 December, Russian President Vladimir Putin passed through the restored right-hand side of the Crimean bridge, listened to the report on the work carried out and, at the opening of the movement, charged the left, less damaged, part of the bridge with a regulatory status. He said that the repair of the road part of the bridge would be completed in general in March. The right side of the road, which had taken over the main shock wave from the explosion on 8 October last year, had been restored within 56 days. The re-established flights were opened on 7 December, after which the bridges began work on the off-the-road left side.

en.header: Scientists have proposed to estimate GDP growth by street lighting
en.subheader: Data on the country's illumination obtained from satellite images may reflect the dynamics of GDP growth. The correlation between these data helps to identify the distortion of real economic growth rates in official reports, scientists say.
en.content: Data on the lighting of the country from satellite images can reflect the growth of GDP. Correlation between these data helps to detect the distortion of the real growth of the economy in official records, is seen by scientists as the dynamics of the country ' s light at night from satellite imagery can prove the falsification of economic growth data, a study by the University of Chicago, conducted by Dr. Luis Martinez, published in October last year and highlighted by The Wall Street Journal. Martinez ' s theory is based on the assumption that the dynamics of the gross domestic product can be measured by the change in the country ' s light. "As the economy grows, more houses, more factories, more streetlights appear. As early as 2012, economists at Brown University and the National Bureau of Economic Research reported that a statistical basis had been developed to estimate GDP growth based on satellite imagery. At the time, the discrepancy between the estimates obtained from the images and the official figures was estimated at no more than 3 p.p. per year. Data on the night coverage of countries can be obtained from the images taken by the U.S. Air Force Defense and Meteorological Satellite Programme. The images are available from 1992 to 2013. Although it is not possible to determine the exact GDP from these data, comparing the light dynamics with the country's official statistics can show the discrepancy between official data and reality. Martinez argues that the discrepancies between the official data on the country's GDP and the estimates of its dynamics from satellite imagery are well visible in the case of authoritarian countries; Martinez examined the correlation between the data obtained from satellite data analysis and the official figures of countries' GDP and compared it to the classification of countries by "freeness and freedom", which is calculated by American think tanks; he estimates that on average the discrepancy between official data on GDP growth in countries that are considered by American experts to be authoritarian and data obtained from satellite imagery analysis is 35 per cent. In the case of "free" countries where such a discrepancy exists, Martínez refers, for example, to India; among the "free" countries, Russia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and Qatar. WSJ also notes that there is another controversial issue in the study, which may be affected by single infrastructure projects, such as the introduction of a new major lighting highway.

record.header: The "ceiling" does not put pressure on the markets. The problem of public debt worries investors less than the Fed rate
record.subheader: The United States reached the debt ceiling much earlier than economists expected. How did the stock market react to this fact?
record.content: The US has reached the debt limit, but this news is still under political discussion. What concessions will the Democrats make to the Republicans to agree to raise the ceiling again? For investors, the key risk remains the further tightening of the US Fedreserve's monetary policy. The expensive dollar does not benefit US exporters, who account for a significant portion of S&P corporations. It does not benefit the commodity economies, because a strong dollar makes the goods less accessible to the issuers of other currencies. However, it does not look safe for markets to reach the limit. The US reached the cap on public debt on January 19, 2023. This was much earlier than the economists expected. Share markets reacted to the news with a moderate negative view of the fact as a new one. U.S. key stock indicators ended Thursday's trade session with a decline of 0.76-0.96 per cent. Much more investors are now concerned about the Fed's February meeting and the extent to which interest rates could be raised. But in the debt market, returns have crawled upward. US 10-year bond rates have risen by 0.89 per cent and now amount to 3.429 per cent. The debt, unlike shares, is not perceived by investors as a real asset. Experts believe that, as confidence in the states of developed countries increases, capital migrates in part. However, it is unlikely that the debt market will expect "the crisis of the century." But why does the entire financial world keep track of US debt? This "drama" repeats quite regularly, but each time the Data X triggers a surge in media activity. It is a dollar. U.S. dollar is the world's main reserve currency. If the US Treasury runs out of cash, the US will not be able to pay on debt. The loss of confidence in US debt is thus a price tag for a riskless asset for the world, leading to a surge in borrowing costs and a collapse in financial markets. The crisis will spread from financial markets to the real sector as well. So the US default will draw the world economy into a deep recession. For commodity economies, this will translate into a weakening of national currencies, an increase in inflation, a prolonged decline in production. A political performance called Data X once again raises the question of the role of the dollar in the global economy. Shouldn't the world financial system reduce the dollar's role in favour of other currencies tied to real assets? The answer to this question was the search for economists from the Swiss bank Credit Suisse. Shortly, the chances of a new hemonic currency are going to be zero. Credit Suisse, in a report entitled "The Future World Monetary System", considered three scenarios for the development of the financial system when the dollar loses its status as a key reserve currency. Not one of them is going to have to give up the dollar completely. Yes, its role may diminish, but it is unlikely to go out of international trade. It is enough to look at the share of the dollar in the world's foreign exchange reserves. As of the third quarter of 2022, the dollar accounts for 59.8 per cent of the reserve basket. According to Credit Suisse experts, it is most likely that a multipolar monetary system will emerge in the future. What is the next plan? After reaching the ceiling, further developments will develop in a well-known way. The US Department of Finance will begin to use "emergency measures" to continue payments on government obligations and delay the announcement of default. In Minfin's arsenal, not only accounting manoeuvres, but also the suspension of investments. In a letter to Congress dated 19 January, Minister Janet Yellen announced that the emergency measures would be in place until 5 June. This time, the Presidential Administration could use for negotiations that would end (under the law of genre) happy end, i.e. concessions by a party in exchange for a further increase in the borrowing limit. However, if agreement could not be reached, the Government would not be able to fulfil its obligations and would be forced to default. In the twentieth century, the United States announced a technical default twice - in 1933, in the period of Great Depression, and in 1971, when the gold-exchange standard was abolished. Since then, the US budget has almost always been scarce. Debt-control negotiations have always drawn attention to a possible economic disaster, encouraging Republicans to use it as leverage. In 2011, the Republicans and Democratics' fight for sovereign debt almost ended with a default.The S&P agency first lowered the long-term credit rating of the US to AA+ from the maximum AAA, drawing attention to the growing sovereign debt, as well as the insufficient effectiveness of the United States Government's debt-related measures. At that time, the country's debt was $14.3 trillion. As a result of long negotiations, US President Barack Obama agreed to limit future spending in exchange for the lifting of the cap. Since then, the government's debt limit has increased repeatedly and reached $31.4 trillion in 2022. On Thursday, January 19, 2023, this threshold was crossed. Both parties contributed to the budget drama. The Reds have repeatedly reduced taxes and the Blues have expanded spending programmes, increasing the federal budget deficit. Both parties have approved large economic assistance packages after the 2008 crisis and during the COVID-19 pandemic. Economists warn that the country risks a financial crisis and other immediate economic problems if legislators do not raise the limit before the Ministry of Finance has exhausted its opportunities to win more time. We wait until June for the responsibility for lifting or suspending the borrowing limit to the Congress, which must receive a simple majority in both the House of Representatives and the Senate to vote for any change in the debt limit. Republicans, who now control the House of Representatives, insist that the increase in the debt limit be linked to "structural expenditure reform". Many Republicans in the House of Representatives call the current level of spending and the US debt burden a threat to economic growth. The Reds have not yet made formal demands for an increase in the ceiling, but insist that it be linked to a significant reduction in expenditure and the adoption of a balanced budget. Meanwhile, the White House had stated that the debt ceiling should be increased without conditions, and management had made it clear that they would not negotiate on the issue. President Joe Biden of the United States stated that he would oppose any attempt to link spending cuts to debt ceilings. The White House Press Secretary, Karin Jean-Pierre, also reported that the White House would not negotiate, and for Congress "the resolution of issues with the ceiling of public debt is its basic responsibility". The White House's position increases the likelihood of long-term confrontation, but a compromise will eventually be found. Perhaps the US debt limit will be raised in the first half of this year. Meanwhile, while the next "Save America from Defolt" show is in progress, gold has become the main beneficiary of the events. As the Eugene Cogan investor noted, "the longer the kids will be scared, the more it will grow." The expert looks forward to the growth of the Dragmetals and their extracting companies, Newmont Goldcorp Corporation, Kinross Gold Corp, as well as the "gold" ETF (NUGT, JNUG), a couple of bitcoin/gold and other "useful" shiny things.

ru.header: Ученые предложили оценивать рост ВВП по освещению на улицах
ru.subheader: Данные об освещенности страны, полученные со спутниковых снимков, могут отражать динамику роста ВВП. Корреляция между этими данными помогает выявлять искажение реальных темпов роста экономики в официальных отчетах, считают ученые
ru.content: Данные об освещенности страны, полученные со спутниковых снимков, могут отражать динамику роста ВВП. Корреляция между этими данными помогает выявлять искажение реальных темпов роста экономики в официальных отчетах, считают ученыеДанные о динамике освещенности страны ночью, полученные со спутниковых снимков, могут доказать фальсификацию данных об экономическом росте, показало исследование Чикагского университета, проведенное доктором Луисом Мартинезом. Материалы исследования были опубликованы в октябре прошлого года, на них обратила внимание The Wall Street Journal.Теория Мартинеза основана на предположении, что динамику внутреннего валового продукта можно оценить на основании изменения освещенности страны. «По мере роста экономики появляется больше домов, больше фабрик, больше уличных фонарей. Все это производит свет», — поясняет идею Мартинес. Это предположение основано в том числе и на предыдущих работах ученых в этой сфере. Еще в 2012 году экономисты Брауновского университета и Национального бюро экономических исследований США сообщили о разработке статистической основы для оценки роста ВВП по данным спутниковых снимков. На тот момент расхождение между оценкой, полученной с помощью снимков, и официальными данными они оценивали не более чем в 3 п.п. в год.Данные о ночной освещенности стран можно получить из базы снимков, сделанных аппаратами Программы оборонных и метеорологических спутников ВВС США. Снимки доступны за период с 1992 по 2013 год.Хотя определить на основании этих данных точный показатель ВВП невозможно, сравнение динамики освещенности с официальной статистикой страны может показать расхождение официальных данных с реальностью. Мартинес утверждает, что расхождения между официальными данными о ВВП страны и оценками его динамики, данными с помощью спутниковых снимков, хорошо заметны на примере авторитарных стран.Мартинес изучил корреляцию данных, полученных с помощь анализа спутниковых данных, с официальными показателями ВВП стран и сравнил ее с классификацией стран «по уровню свободы и несвободы», который расчитывают американские аналитические центры. По его оценкам, в среднем расхождение между официальными данными о росте ВВП у стран, которые американские эксперты, считают авторитарными и данными, полученными с помощью анализа спутниковых снимков, составляет 35%.Среди «свободных» стран, у которых наблюдается такое расхождение, Мартинес называет, например, Индию. Среди «несвободных» — Россию, Азербайджан, Казахстан и Катар. WSJ отмечает также, что в исследовании есть еще один спорный момент. На рост освещенности могут повлиять единичные инфраструктурные проекты — например, ввод в строй новой крупной автострады с освещением.

en.header: Scaramucci's SkyBridge to Buy Back FTX Stake; Says Claims Against SBF ‘Very Clear’
en.subheader: Skybridge Capital, the company founded by Anthony Scaramucci, has disclosed plans to repurchase a 30% stake it sold to FTX in the coming
en.content: The investment company has termed FTX’s case as outright fraud.Before the collapse, SkyBridge had acquired $10 million worth of FTT tokens.Skybridge Capital, the company founded by Anthony Scaramucci, has disclosed plans to repurchase a 30% stake it sold to FTX in the coming months. Scaramucci – who served as White House Director of Communications – told CNBC that Sam Bankman-Fried and his collapsed exchange may have committed fraud.‘I think it’s very clear now that there was a fraud. We will, of course, have to let the legal system determine all of those things. “We are waiting for the clearance from the bankruptcy people, the lawyers, and the investment bankers to figure out exactly what we will be buying back and when,” Scaramucci said.In September, SkyBridge invested $10 million in FTT as part of the deal that would see the exchange acquire 30% of the investment firm. Two months later, FTX filed for bankruptcy, going down with an estimated loss of $10 million in investor’s funds. Amid the chaotic collapse of the exchange, Scaramucci – who flew to the Bahamas on a rescue mission – said then he was distressed but did not want to call it a fraud yet.SkyBridge Invested $10M in FTX Before the Bankruptcy, per ReportsDescribing the situation, he remarked: “...when I got to the Bahamas, it became clear, at least from some of the people that worked on the legal and compliance team, that perhaps there was more going on than it being a rescue situation. Therefore, when I left the Bahamas in the afternoon, I was actually distressed.”Recovery efforts for the alleged stolen funds that moved from FTX to its trading arm Alameda are ongoing, although the exact amount of losses and the creditors owed remains unclear. This month, bankruptcy attorney Adam Landis told the court that FTX had recovered over $5 billion besides $425 million held by the Bahamian Securities Commission.Landis added that evidence pointed to the misappropriation of funds in parties, purchase of planes, houses, and political donations. Part of the funds also went to sport sponsorship deals, including FTX Arena naming rights in Miami, recounts the attorney. Judge John Dorsey has set until March to estimate recoveries and reorganize how the victims could get back their funds.
en.summary: Skybridge Capital, the company founded by Anthony Scaramucci, has disclosed plans to repurchase a 30% stake it sold to FTX in the coming months. The investment company has termed FTX’s case as outright fraud. Before the collapse, SkyBridge had acquired $10 million worth of FTT tokens.

record.header: SEC Under Fire: FOX's Gasparino Accuses Agency of Mishandling Ripple Case, Deaton Responds
record.content: The SEC filed a lawsuit against Ripple Labs Inc., the firm behind the XRP cryptocurrency, in December 2020, saying that the company engaged in an unregistered securities offering of XRP for $1.38 billion. The case is still ongoing, and the conclusion could have far-reaching consequences for the XRP cryptocurrency and the broader crypto sector.Moreover, by the end of 2022, FTX collapsed and filed for bankruptcy. The FTX collapse was not the result of bad management or oversight, but of deliberate fraud. Another description of the alleged crimes is that they are “one of the biggest financial frauds in American history.”Could the FTX collapse and people losing millions be prevented if the SEC had focused on the right people? Let’s seeGasparino Criticizes SEC’s JudgmentCharles Gasparino is an American journalist, blogger, and radio host. On the Fox Business Network, he participates on panels frequently. In a recent tweet, he criticized the SEC’s judgment to go after crypto companies.He has revealed how Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of FTX, had two meetings with the SEC. He continues by saying that the SEC botched its regulatory strategy by going after Ripple over unregistered XRP when there were significant concerns about potential fraud with exchanges.The more I delve into the @SBF_FTX implosion and hear how he met w @SECGov not once but twice, it's hard not to realize that the SEC really botched its regulatory agenda going after @Ripple over unregistered XRP when serious issues of potential fraud always resided w exchanges— Charles Gasparino (@CGasparino) January 18, 2023In response to this tweet, John E Deaton, the CryptoLaw founder has stated that it’s not just Ripple that has become a target of SEC’s poor regulatory agenda. The SEC sued LBRY, a small company in New Hampshire in another non-fraud case over the LBC token. Then there’s dragonchain whose DRGN token is governed by the Ethereum Blockchain and also with respect to Kim Kardashian. Pointing out the incompetence and failure of the SEC Chairman, Gary Gensler.The SEC brought an enforcement action against LBRY in March 2021, claiming that LBRY had offered and sold LBC as an unregistered security in violation of Sections 5(a) and 5(c) of the Securities Act.Further, The Securities Exchange Commission pursued charges against blockchain-company Dragonchain, alleging that the 2017 ICO and subsequent offers and sales of their DRGN token, which raised over $16.5 million in proceeds, were illegal sales of unregistered securities.The Securities and Exchange Commission in October 2022, announced charges against Kim Kardashian for touting on social media a crypto asset security offered and sold by EthereumMax without disclosing the payment she received for the promotion.Community Reaction to thisThe majority of the community believes that if SEC had focused its attention on potential fraud by FTX and SBF, it could have prevented severe losses suffered by the FTX collapse.The majority agrees with Charles Gasparino and John E Deaton and has expressed their disappointment with SEC and Gary Gensler.

en.header: The Ukrainian general allowed the encirclement of the Armed Forces of Ukraine in the event of the loss of Artemovsk
en.subheader: Ukrainian General Krivonos: the loss of Artemovsk can create conditions for the encirclement of the Armed Forces of Ukraine
en.content: The loss of Artemovska (the Ukrainian name Bakhmut) could create conditions for a group of Ukrainian military personnel, stated in an interview with the "Prima" television channel former Deputy Secretary of the Security Council of Ukraine (2019 - 2020), General Sergei Krivonos. Video published by InoSMI. "In the case of Bakhmut, it can be used as a springboard for the development of Russian offensives in the Slavian and Zaporodian directions. In addition, certain preconditions may be created for the environment of the UIA group in eastern Ukraine", said Krivonos, noting that the threat to the environment would become real if Russian troops were to move actively in the Kharkiv direction. The founder of PMK, Wagner Evgeny Prigozhin, in early January, compared the battles for Artemovsk with the Kulykov field, calling the city "the meeting of two troops" and noting that "one army must destroy the other." He expressed confidence that the Russian side was successfully dealing with "the destruction of the other army." Artamovsk is in the north of the Donetsk People's Republic, 50 km north of Donetsk. The Russian Ministry of Defence and the DNR authorities have been claiming an offensive in the town area since the beginning of December. The Ukrainian side has reported the plight of the military in Artemovsk.

record.header: Spiegel learned about the concern of German intelligence about the losses of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in Artyomovsk
record.subheader: Spiegel: German intelligence is concerned about the heavy losses of the Ukrainian Armed Forces near Artemivsk
record.content: The Ukrainian army in the struggle for Artemovsk (the Ukrainian name is Bakhmut) has suffered a great deal of casualties, Spiegel reported with reference to the German Federal Intelligence Service (BND), which she submitted to the Bundestag deputies. According to the paper, the paper states that the UPU loses "three-digit numbers of soldiers per day in battle for the city." The BND indicated that the transition of Artemovsk to Russian control would lead to the consequences of "the entire Ukrainian defence line." Material is being supplemented.

ru.header: Украинский генерал допустил окружение ВСУ в случае потери Артемовска
ru.subheader: Украинский генерал Кривонос: потеря Артемовска может создать условия для окружения ВСУ
ru.content: Потеря Артемовска (украинское название — Бахмут) может создать условия для окружения группировки украинских военных, заявил в интервью телеканалу «Прямой» бывший замсекретаря Совета безопасности Украины (в 2019–2020 годах) генерал Сергей Кривонос. Видео опубликовало ИноСМИ.«Если говорить о Бахмуте, то его можно использовать в качестве плацдарма для развития наступления россиян на славянском и запорожском направлениях. Кроме того, могут быть созданы определенные предпосылки для окружения группировки ВСУ на востоке Украины», — заявил Кривонос, отметив, что угроза окружения станет реальной, если российские войска будут активно продвигаться на харьковском направлении.Основатель ЧВК Вагнера Евгений Пригожин в начале января сравнил бои за Артемовск с Куликовым полем, назвав город местом «встречи двух войск» и отметив, что «одна армия должна уничтожить другую». Он выразил уверенность, что российская сторона успешно справляется с «уничтожением другой армии».Артемовск находится на севере Донецкой народной республики, в 50 км к северу от Донецка. Минобороны России и власти ДНР с начала декабря прошлого года заявляют о наступлении в районе города. Украинская сторона сообщала о тяжелом положении военных в Артемовске. Президент Украины Владимир Зеленский говорил, что ситуация в Артемовске «тяжелая и мучительная», а в его офисе заявили, что ВСУ несут в боях за город тяжелые потери.

en.header: Bitcoin Soars Over $22K to Reach Four-Month High
en.subheader: Bitcoin rose over 5% and hit its highest level since mid-September. Market watchers will be eyeing the Federal Reserve’s next utterances.
en.content: Bitcoin soared past $22,000, its highest level since mid-September, as the broader cryptocurrency market continued its unexpected 2023 rally.The largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization was recently trading as high as $22,387, up 5.4% over the previous 24 hours, shrugging off the announcement late Thursday that Genesis Global Holdco LLC, the parent company of troubled cryptocurrency lender Genesis Global Capital, had filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection late Thursday (Genesis and CoinDesk are owned by Digital Currency Group).Edward Moya, senior market analyst for foreign exchange market maker Oanda, noted Thursday that investors had priced in Genesis’ looming problems. The company has been swept up in the fallout from the collapses of crypto hedge fund Three Arrows Capital last spring, and more recently, crypto exchange giant FTX.Ether (ETH) followed a similar path, recently rising 5.2% from Thursday, same time, to $1,640. The CoinDesk Market Index (CMI) was up 4.1%.BTC has climbed 11% in the past seven days and is up 34% for the year. ETH has jumped 12% over the past week and is up 37% since Dec. 31.Crypto-related stocks also benefited from the rally Friday: Exchange Coinbase (COIN) was recently up 10% while bitcoin miner Marathon Digital Holdings (MARA) surged 9%.Traditional markets also edged up, with the S&P 500 index up 1.9%, as investors processed a flurry of mixed earnings reports from big banks.This week’s larger-than-expected decline in the producer price index (PPI) indicated the U.S. central bank’s monetary hawkishness has been taming inflation, buoying investors. The CME FedWatch tool currently shows that traders see roughly a 97% chance that the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will raise rates by just 25 basis points (0.25 percentage point) at its next meeting in February – slowing from the 50 basis-point hikes in the December meeting.Sheraz Ahmed, managing partner at STORM Partners, told CoinDesk that while recent macro data – “including a modest pullback in inflation, downwards-trending wage and employment data and a seemingly weaker dollar”– have induced some market relief, how the Fed will handle monetary policy while balancing economic data and recession fears will have a big impact on the market overall."Post-rally euphoria is always a great feeling but it should be treated with caution to avoid mistakes whether prices continue to rise or fall,” Ahmed said.Oanda’s Moya said in a Friday note that if more tightening goes beyond the March meeting, “risky assets broadly, including crypto, could be vulnerable to major selling pressure.”
en.summary: Largest cryptocurrency has climbed 11% in past seven days.

en.header: Early Q1 2023 Crypto Prices Rally On Favourable US Inflation Data
en.content: Thursday, January 12, 2023, saw the release of December 2022 US inflation figures by the Bureau of Labor Statistics. The Consumer Price Index (CPI) dropped by 0.1% in December 2022 largely due to declines in both the gasoline and energy indices. Annual Headline CPI rose by 6.5% and the December 2022 unemployment rate was down to 3.5% from 3.6% reported in November 2022.The start of 2023 has been marked with minimal price movements across most of the cryptocurrencies. However, on January 13, 2023, major cryptocurrencies rallied to the US inflation data, with Bitcoin testing the US$19,000 mark, Ether at US$1,400, and XRP and Cardano at $0.38 and $0.33, respectively, according to CoinGecko data.The crypto rally continued on January 14, 2023, with Bitcoin trading at US$21,000, Ether trading above US$1,500 and XRP trading at US$0.40 The recent rally has seen the global cryptocurrency market cap reach the US$ 1 trillion mark, a rise of about 25%  since the beginning of 2023.Several events may impact crypto prices within Q1 of 2023. The next Fed interest rate announcement is scheduled for February 1, 2023. The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) has a scheduled release of its minutes on February 22, 2023. The FOMC minutes have provided investors with some of the rationales behind the Fed’s latest policy decisions.Another Fed interest rate announcement is scheduled for March 22, 2023. Investors and traders will closely watch how regulators respond to the latest inflation data.Some of the crypto challenges seen in 2022 are already spilling over into 2023. Crypto companies announcing more job cuts in 2023 include Crypto.com, Huobi, Coinbase, SuperRare, and Blockchain.com.The contagion from the collapse of FTX carries over with the former CEO of FTX, Sam Bankman-Fried (SBF) set to go on trial in October 2023. Two of SBF’s former associates, co-founder Gary Wang and the former chief executive of Alameda Research Caroline Ellison have already pleaded guilty to fraud charges. Other former executives are reportedly cooperating with federal prosecutors and investigators on the dealings within FTX.Global Crypto regulation is, in general still fragmented and some way from implementation. During Q1 of 2023, the European Parliament is expected to vote on the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) Regulation that will take effect in 2024. MiCA is aimed at creating a harmonised crypto legal framework across the European Union (EU) and closing gaps in the existing EU financial services regulation.The above events are likely to shape crypto price movements in 2023. It is not clear how long this crypto rally may last but the crypto markets are in much need of positive news following the challenges of 2022.
en.summary: The start of 2023 has been marked with minimal price movements across most of the cryptocurrencies. The Consumer Price Index (CPI) dropped by 0.1% in December 2022 largely due to declines in both the gasoline and energy indices. The next Fed interest rate announcement is scheduled for February 1, 2023. The European Parliament is expected to vote on the Markets in Crypto-Assets

en.header: Mishustin instructed to update the documents on the preferential mortgage program
en.subheader: Mishustin instructed the government to submit documents to update the preferential mortgage program
en.content: The Head of Government, Michael Mischustin, instructed the Government to submit documents to update the concessional mortgage programs from the beginning of 2023, which he said at a meeting of the Cabinet of Ministers. "The initiative of the Head of State to extend the concessional mortgage throughout Russia until 1 July 2024 at a rate of up to 8 per cent of the year," said Mishustin. Also for the inhabitants of the new regions — DNR, LND, Zaporozhsk and Herson oblasts — loans will be granted for the purchase of housing in new buildings at 2% on December 15th, President Vladimir Putin announced an extension of the concessional mortgage until July 2024, with an increase of 8%, while access to concessional mortgages will be extended to the residents of the late September territories. The concessional mortgage programme began in the spring of 2020 and was originally issued at 6.5% annually. It was created as an anti-crisis measure in the midst of the coronavirus pandemic. In March 2022, the mortgage rate was raised to 12% due to the central bank's increase of the key rate to 20% in February. Later, the rate was reduced according to the key rate. In June, Putin proposed to reduce it to 7% to "help citizens in solving housing problems".
en.summary: The government will submit a package of documents to the government by December 20 to update the preferential mortgage program from the beginning of 2020. The corresponding order was signed by Prime Minister Dmitry Medvedev.

record.header: Developers and banks in December began to refuse to issue mortgages at reduced rates
record.content: Moscow. On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU - Builders and banks began to refuse to issue a reduced mortgage in December, which in the short term may contribute to some increase in credit rates in the primary market, says the BEC's commentary on "Money and credit conditions and the transfer mechanism of monetary policy." According to preliminary data, retail lending continued to increase in December, mainly through a long-term segment, owing to the continued high demand for mortgage due to the expectation of a reduction in the concessionary mortgage programme on the noormation. "In December, there was a tendency to phase out both developers and banks from providing a reduced mortgage, which could contribute in the short term to a slight increase in credit rates in the primary market," the commentary states. In conjunction with the decision in mid-December to extend the concessional mortgage for the renovation until 1 July 2024, the increase in the mortgage rate by 1 p.p. and the expansion of the family mortgage parameters, one can expect to stabilize or to reduce some of the demand for the mortgage under the BDS, the BC indicates. However, part of the solvent demand can be reallocated to the extended family mortgage programme, thus maintaining a high level of credit activity in the mortgage segment. "In the coming months, it can be expected that moderate debt movements for other consumer loans can be maintained, given the population's increased tendency to save and the introduction of macroprudential limits from the beginning of 2023 on certain high-risk operations in the unsecured consumer credit segment," says the regulator's comments.

ru.header: Мишустин поручил обновить документы по программе льготной ипотеки
ru.subheader: Мишустин поручил правительству внести документы для обновления программы льготной ипотеки
ru.content: Глава правительства Михаил Мишустин поручил до 20 декабря внести в правительство документы для обновления льготных ипотечных программ с начала 2023 года. Об этом он сказал на заседании кабинета министров.«В короткие сроки предстоит обеспечить выполнение инициативы главы государства по продлению льготной ипотеки по всей России до 1 июля 2024 года по ставке до 8% годовых», — заявил Мишустин. Он попросил Министерство финансов внести нормативные документы в правительство, чтобы с нового года «все ипотечные программы действовали на таких условиях».Мишустин добавил, что к программе семейной ипотеки будут добавлены семьи, у которых как минимум два ребенка младше 18 лет, — им будут давать ипотеку под 6% годовых. Также для жителей новых регионов — ДНР, ЛНР, Запорожской и Херсонской областей — будут предоставляться кредиты на покупку жилья в новостройках под 2%.15 декабря президент Владимир Путин сообщил о продлении льготной ипотеки до июля 2024 года с ростом ставки до 8%. При этом будет расширен доступ к льготной ипотеке жителям присоединенных в конце сентября территорий.Программа льготной ипотеки действует с весны 2020 года и изначально выдавалась под 6,5% годовых. Она была создана как антикризисная мера в разгар пандемии коронавируса. В марте 2022 года ставка по ипотеке была повышена до 12% из-за повышения Центробанком ключевой ставки до 20% в феврале. Позже ставка снижалась в зависимости от ключевой ставки. В июне Путин предложил снизить ее до 7%, чтобы «помочь гражданам в решении жилищных проблем».
ru.summary: Правительство до 20 декабря внесет в правительство пакет документов для обновления льготной ипотечной программы с начала 2020 года. Соответствующее распоряжение подписал премьер-министр Дмитрий Медведев.

en.header: Ransomware Payments Decreased By 40% In 2022, Chainalysis Reports
en.content: As with many other sectors, the crypto industry has attracted hackers and cybercriminals. Consequently, the growing ransomware attacks and money laundering activities turned financial watchdogs on their toes to regulate the industry more tightly.As global regulators strive to bring transparency in the crypto sector, an annual report from on-chain analytics firm Chainalysis on the ransomware attack highlights a significant decrease in these activities. As per the report, the revenue of ransomware attacks fell by 40.58% in 2022.More specifically, the total funds from ransomware that hackers received from victims plummeted to $456 million in 2022 from $765.6 million in 2021. However, Chainalysis claims that the amount could be much higher as not all addresses linked to attacks have been identified.Interestingly, the revenue dropped for cybercriminals is tied to the regulator’s move to push organizations to apply stricter cybersecurity measures, not due to the hackers limiting their efforts to target victims. The latter’s convictions to choose to stand up to criminals instead of paying them contributed to this decreasing trend.The report reads:That doesn’t mean attacks are down, or at least not as much as the drastic dropoff in payments would suggest. Instead, we believe that much of the decline is due to victim organizations increasingly refusing to pay ransomware attackers.Ransomware Payments Plummet SignificantlyIn contrast to the recent stats, ransomware payment barriers have increased significantly. For example, 76% of victims fulfilled the demands of attackers after hitting a ransomware attack in 2019, while 24% of victims preferred to stand up to the bad actors, per the report. While in 2022, 59% of the victims refused to pay the extortions, representing a notable change in the trend.In ransomware attacks, bad actors control a user’s system using malware software and then lock it to deny access or threaten to leak sensitive information if the victim does not fulfill the attacker’s demand. Cyber attacks usually include digital extortion; phishing attacks are this field’s most widely used vectors.Additionally, the research firm unveiled that criminals used centralized exchanges, crypto mixer tools, and gambling websites to launder illegal funds from the ransomware attacks of 2022. The report added;The share of ransomware funds going to mainstream exchanges grew from 39.3% in 2021 to 48.3% in 2022, while the share going to high-risk exchanges fell from 10.9% to 6.7%.In the report, Chainalysis uncovered that the use of the Ethereum-based mixer tool Tornado Cash has increased from 11.6% to 15.0% in 2022. It is the same privacy tool the U.S. Treasury imposed sanctions to in August last year. Officials alleged that criminals laundered over $7 billion using this protocol.
en.summary: Revenue from ransomware attacks fell by 40.58% in 2022. Regulators pushed organizations to apply stricter cybersecurity measures

record.header: Revenues from Ransomware Attacks Plunged 40% Last Year, Chainalysis Says | CoinMarketCap
record.subheader: Estimates from Chainalysis claim $457 million was extorted by ransomware attackers in 2022. In both 2020 and 2021, this figure stood roughly at $765 million.
record.content: Some rare good news in the battle against ransomware — according to Chainalysis, the amount extorted by attackers in 2022 actually tumbled by 40% compared with the year before.The blockchain analytics firm says it's been an "impactful year" in tackling those who deceive victims, encrypt files, and then demand cryptocurrency in exchange for unlocking them.Estimates from Chainalysis claim $457 million was extorted by ransomware attackers in 2022. In both 2020 and 2021, this figure stood roughly at $765 million.But researchers did warn that the true totals are likely to be much, much higher — for several reasons. Firstly, there will be cryptocurrency addresses tied to cybercriminals that simply haven't been identified yet, while some victims may have kept a low profile after being targeted.To put this into context, 2021's estimate for ransomware payments had stood at $602 million at this point last year — but later ballooned by close to 30%.Overall though, Chainalysis maintains that there's a lot to be upbeat about — and the trend is clear: "Ransomware payments are significantly down."The driving force behind declining revenues for ransomware attackers is actually pretty interesting; Chainalysis believes this is down to the fact that victims are refusing to pay. Whereas 76% ended up submitting to a ransom in 2019, this dwindled to 41% in 2022.A lot of this might be down to the fact that cyber insurance firms are now much less likely to offer payouts in order to meet a ransom — with companies being urged to take responsibility by beefing up their security measures and introducing backups.And it seems that life is getting harder for malicious actors in other ways, too. Whereas the typical lifespan of a ransomware strain was a whopping 3,907 days back in 2012, this figure has fallen pretty consistently over the past decade — dwindling to just 70 days today. All of this means that criminals need to work a lot harder for their ill-gotten gains.And while the dizzying array of different strains may make it seem like the ranks of cybercriminals are growing, this may not be the case — with the report presenting this analogy:"We can think of it as the gig economy, but for ransomware. A rideshare driver may have his Uber, Lyft, and Oja apps open at once, creating the illusion of three separate drivers on the road — but in reality, it’s all the same car."Chainalysis' data also includes some alarming statistics for centralized exchanges. Some 48.3% of stolen funds were funneled through mainstream platforms in 2022, compared with 39.3% the year before.

Instead, we believe that much of the decline is due to victim organizations increasingly refusing to pay ransomware attackers.Ransomware Payments Plummet SignificantlyIn contrast to the recent stats, ransomware payment barriers have increased significantly. For example, 76% of victims fulfilled the demands of attackers after hitting a ransomware attack in 2019, while 24% of victims preferred to stand up to the bad actors, per the report. While in 2022, 59% of the victims refused to pay the extortions, representing a notable change in the trend.In ransomware attacks, bad actors control a user’s system using malware software and then lock it to deny access or threaten to leak sensitive information if the victim does not fulfill the attacker’s demand. Cyber attacks usually include digital extortion; phishing attacks are this field’s most widely used vectors.Additionally, the research firm unveiled that criminals used centralized exchanges, crypto mixer tools, and gambling websites to launder illegal funds from the ransomware attacks of 2022. The report added;The share of ransomware funds going to mainstream exchanges grew from 39.3% in 2021 to 48.3% in 2022, while the share going to high-risk exchanges fell from 10.9% to 6.7%.In the report, Chainalysis uncovered that the use of the Ethereum-based mixer tool Tornado Cash has increased from 11.6% to 15.0% in 2022. It is the same privacy tool the U.S. Treasury imposed sanctions to in August last year. Officials alleged that criminals laundered over $7 billion using this protocol.
ru.summary: Доходы от атак программ-вымогателей упали на 40,58% в 2022 году. Регулирующие органы подталкивали организации к применению более строгих мер кибербезопасности

record.header: Revenues from Ransomware Attacks Plunged 40% Last Year, Chainalysis Says | CoinMarketCap
record.subheader: Estimates from Chainalysis claim $457 million was extorted by ransomware attackers in 2022. In both 2020 and 2021, this figure stood roughly at $765 million.
record.content: Some rare good news in the battle against ransomware — according to Chainalysis, the amount extorted by attackers in 2022 actually tumbled by 40% compared with the year before.The blockchain analytics firm says it's been an "impactful year" in tackling those who deceive victims, encrypt files, and then demand cryptocurrency in exchange for unlocking them.Estimates from Chainalysis claim $457 million was extorted by ransomware attackers in 2022. In both 2020 and 2021, this figure stood roughly at $765 million.But researchers did warn that the true totals are likely to be much, much higher — for several reasons. Firstly, there will be cryptocurrency addresses tied to cybercriminals that simply haven't been identified yet, while some victims may have kept a low profile after being targeted.To put this into context, 2021's estimate for ransomware payments had stood at $602 million at this point last year — but later ballooned by close to 30%.Overall though, Chainalysis maintains that there's a lot to be upbeat about — and the trend is clear: "Ransomware payments are significantly down."The driving force behind declining revenues for ransomware attackers is actually pretty interesting; Chainalysis believes this is down to the fact that victims are refusing to pay. Whereas 76% ended up submitting to a ransom in 2019, this dwindled to 41% in 2022.A lot of this might be down to the fact that cyber insurance firms are now much less likely to offer payouts in order to meet a ransom — with companies being urged to take responsibility by beefing up their security measures and introducing backups.And it seems that life is getting harder for malicious actors in other ways, too. Whereas the typical lifespan of a ransomware strain was a whopping 3,907 days back in 2012, this figure has fallen pretty consistently over the past decade — dwindling to just 70 days today. All of this means that criminals need to work a lot harder for their ill-gotten gains.And while the dizzying array of different strains may make it seem like the ranks of cybercriminals are growing, this may not be the case — with the report presenting this analogy:"We can think of it as the gig economy, but for ransomware. A rideshare driver may have his Uber, Lyft, and Oja apps open at once, creating the illusion of three separate drivers on the road — but in reality, it’s all the same car."Chainalysis' data also includes some alarming statistics for centralized exchanges. Some 48.3% of stolen funds were funneled through mainstream platforms in 2022, compared with 39.3% the year before.

en.header: Despite FTX's Collapse, Miami's Mayor is Still a Bitcoin Believer
en.subheader: Mayor Suarez thinks a lot of the panic surrounding FTX and crypto is “media driven.”
en.content: Miami’s Bitcoin-bullish Mayor, Francis Suarez, remains faithful to the asset after the collapse of one of the world’s largest crypto exchanges shook confidence in the industry.The mayor suggested that Bitcoin can still provide numerous benefits not offered by the fiat currency system.Could Bitcoin Replace the Dollar?During an interview with CNBC on Friday, Suarez was asked if he believed regulators were to blame for allowing the FTX catastrophe to develop and eventually explode. Certain industry leaders, such as Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong, have blamed a lack of regulatory clarity in the U.S. for driving the industry to unregulated markets overseas.Suarez, however, chose not to point fingers.“When people lose money, and things don’t go the way that they expect, everyone wants to blame someone,” the mayor said. “We live in a capitalist country, where people risk capital. Sometimes it works out for them, sometimes it doesn’t.”Part of Suarez’s enthusiasm around Bitcoin from a belief in its potential to spread free market principles across the world. In December 2021, he claimed Bitcoin could “eradicate communism on the planet, liberate people and democratize their choices,” thanks to its immunity to monetary debasement.Some have even cited this quality when theorizing about how Bitcoin could replace the dollar – something Suarez’s interviewer called a “ridiculous notion.” Although Suarez hesitated to back that claim, he acknowledged Bitcoin for having advantages over the fiat currency system. Those include the blockchain’s ability to create “efficient transactions,” and aid in cross-border remittances.Suarez also pointed to the growing momentum in favor of digitizing the dollar through stablecoins – cryptocurrencies backed 1:1 with hard currency.“A lot of this is media driven,” said Suarez regarding recent panic around crypto and FTX. “Maybe in 6 months, bitcoin is at 30,000, or 40,000. Are you going to have me back on and say ‘Mr. Mayor, you’re super smart?’Miami’s Bitcoin InitiativesSuarez found himself in competition with New York City mayor Eric Adams in 2021 to prove which politician was most devoted to Bitcoin. After Suarez promised to receive his next paycheck in BTC, Adams announced that he’d receive his following three paychecks in the top two cryptocurrencies.Suarez later topped the then-newly elected mayor, promising to accept his entire salary in Bitcoin.At Miami’s Bitcoin conference in April of last year, Suarez voiced plans to integrate Bitcoin into “every aspect of society.”
en.summary: Miami Mayor Francis Suarez believes Bitcoin can still provide numerous benefits not offered by the fiat currency system. Suarez was asked if he believed regulators were to blame for allowing the FTX catastrophe to develop and eventually explode.

record.header: Miami mayor says salary increased since he began earning Bitcoin despite bear market
record.subheader: Miami Mayor Francis Suarez has revealed that he still receives his salary in Bitcoin (BTC), despite the extended bear market.
record.content: Miami Mayor Francis Suarez has revealed that he still receives his salary in Bitcoin (BTC), despite the extended bear market, noting that the decision has been ‘a good investment.’According to Suarez, his salary has increased since making the shift while stating the rise has emerged from taking advantage of price fluctuations, considering he earns after every two weeks, he said during an interview on CNBC’s Squawk Box show on January 19.“Sometimes people misunderstand that you’re buying it every two weeks, you’re buying it in the fluctuations. Since I bought it or since I started taking my salary in Bitcoin, my salary is up; it’s been a good investment. I think that’s part of the problem with this conversation about Bitcoin,” Suarez said.However, he clarified that the salary increment is not a result of trading. Suarez also pointed out there is a need for patience when dealing with Bitcoin and blockchain technology due to the early stages of development.Growing confidence in BitcoinAlthough Suarez’s decision was initially viewed as unusual, it is a testament to the growing acceptance of cryptocurrencies and their potential as an investment. In this line, a Finbold report indicated that crypto adoption accelerated in 2022 despite the prevailing bear market.Suarez’s decision to receive a portion of his salary in Bitcoin is a notable move, as it highlights public officials’ and institutions’ growing acceptance of cryptocurrencies.For instance, New York City’s mayor Eric Adams also announced that he would receive his first three paychecks in Bitcoin as a vote of confidence in the maiden cryptocurrency.Miami’s crypto city initiativeIt is worth noting that the mayor of Miami has been advocating for crypto businesses to set up bases in the city, aiming to make it a digital asset capital of the United States.As reported by Finbold, Suarez was at some point influential in attempting to lure Chinese Bitcoin miners into setting up shop in the city after the activity was banned in the Asian country.The official indicated he would spur conversations with power distributors to lower energy prices, considering miners prefer operating in regions with cheaper electricity.

en.subheader: As Bitcoin (BTC) price makes a new record this year by breaching the $22K price level, analysts predict BTC to hit $35K in near future.
en.content: On January 18, the price of Bitcoin (BTC) recovered all of its previous losses caused by the FTX epidemic and reached its highest point at $22,106 in the past four months. The asset’s rise to a level of more than $22,000 caused market participants to experience heightened levels of euphoria, even while behemoths like Genesis filed for bankruptcy proceedings.Bitcoin (BTC) Price To Hit $35K?Bitcoin recently surpassed the $420 billion market cap as its trading volume zoomed past 10% to $23 billion in the course of the past 24 hours. This has led many to believe Bitcoin’s (BTC) price to hit the coveted $25K price mark in the coming days if the crypto market is devoid of any further black swan events. However, according to the prominent crypto analyst, Michael Van De Poppe, the price of the flagship cryptocurrency might reach as high as $35,000. According to his analysis, there will most likely be a period of time this year ranging from two to four months during which the markets will see a significant relief rally. It’s possible that the scenario is already set in motion at the present time.This year we'll probably have a window of 2-4 months in which the markets are having a strong relief rally.Might actually be the case right now already.A rally towards $35K is therefore possible for #Bitcoin.Be ready, maximize, accumulate this year and you'll be golden.— Michaël van de Poppe (@CryptoMichNL) January 20, 2023Massive BTC Whale ActivityThis seems to hold true as reports of massive whale accumulation have also been tracked down. According to on-chain data, there has been an increase of more than 3% in the count of BTC whales owning 100 to 1,000 BTCs, in the recent two months. A notification was sent out by Ju in the form of a tweet indicating that miners participating in the 1THash pool had sent 3,336 Bitcoins to the Binance exchange.As things stand, the Bitcoin (BTC) price is currently being traded at $22,106. record.header: Bitcoin (BTC) Price Would Have Surged Beyond $22,500 Till Now-Here’s What Went Wrong!
record.content: Bitcoin price has been testing the crucial resistance at $21,000 multiple times and failed to sustain above the gained levels. However, the price has again made an attempt to surge beyond the same levels which is yet again facing acute bearish action. Surprisingly, huge BTCs left exchanges immediately after the price rose close to $21,500 which had almost nullified the selling pressure.But the BTC price continues to struggle around the same levels which indicates some level of distortion going on within the space. One of known analyst discovered the exchange reserve balance of all spot exchanges and Binance specifically and released some of his observations.As soon as the Bitcoin price raised beyond $21,000, a huge outflow of nearly 20,000 BTC was recorded in the past 6 days.This had almost killed the selling pressure in the market which would have raised the BTC price beyond $22,500 by now. But, the bears suddenly jumped in and are attempting to dominate the rally. The main reason observed by the analyst here is the BTC flowing back into Binance.The analyst observed that at the times when BTC recorded massive spot outflows, Binance register almost the same amount of inflows at the same time. This might have ceased the buying pressure which had mounted significantly but the FUD compelled the price to hover within the narrow ranges.Therefore, with the above observation, it is pretty clear that the Bitcoin (BTC) price was on its way to registering a significant upswing. This would have revolved into a bull rally in the near future, but Binance appears to have ruined the entire plot. Hence the markets now require to wait until the new bullish volume kicks in.

en.header: The United States accused two businessmen of withdrawing Vekselberg's yacht from sanctions
en.subheader: The US Department of Justice accused two businessmen of trying to withdraw Vekselberg's yacht from sanctions
en.content: The U.S. Department of Justice charged a 51-year-old Russian businessman, Vladislav Osipov, and a 52-year-old British businessman, Richard Masters, with attempting to exonerate a Tango yacht, which allegedly belongs to a sanctioned Russian businessman, Victor Wexelberg. According to a report on the agency's website, businessmen tried to hide the yacht and exploit it through the company and the U.S. financial system. Masters was detained in Spain and threatened with extradition. A Russian arrest warrant has been issued against him. "Today's indictments and arrests by Spanish law enforcement agencies show the FBI's constant attention to tracking and bringing to justice those who assist Russian oligarches who have been sanctioned," said Deputy Director Paul Abbate of the FBI. The material is being supplemented.
en.summary: The US Department of Justice has indicted two Russian businessmen in an attempt to withdraw the yacht "Yacht Vekselberg" worth $1.5 billion from US sanctions. According to the US Department of Justice, businessmen are charged with illegal interference in American elections.

record.header: The Embassy called the plan to transfer Russian assets to Ukraine discrediting the United States
record.subheader: Russian Embassy: The United States discredits itself with plans to transfer Russian assets to Ukraine
record.content: Plans to hand over confiscated Russian assets to Ukraine discredit the financial system of the United States, declared at the Russian Embassy in Washington. The statement was published in a diplomatic television channel. "The White House does not bend the Femid to serve its own narrow-minded interests. <> Such dangerous precedents only discredit the United States as a notorious "oplot" of free business," says the Embassy. In a report, the Dipmission claims that the US leadership "with its own hands" undermines confidence in the international financial system and the security of dollar jurisdiction. The plans to hand over Russian assets to Ukraine were described by diplomats as disregarding "not only the generally accepted legal norms" but also the American value of protecting the right to private property on 19 January by the head of the US Department of Justice's working group to identify and arrest US-retributed Russian assets Andrew Adams announced the transfer to Ukraine of some frozen Russian assets. The US has previously opposed the confiscation of Russia's assets, calling it legally impossible, that Russia's frozen funds may be used for the reconstruction of Ukraine, also referred to the head of the Euro-Council, Charles Michel, who is currently on an official visit to Kiev, who stated that in Europe, I have frozen 300 billion Russian assets that "should and will be used" in Ukraine. The Kremlin called the freezing of Russian assets theft. "These are absolutely illegal acts, they are contrary to international law, it is nothing but an attack on property, in this case State property, and on private property", said Russian President Dmitry Peskov's spokesman.

ru.header: США обвинили двух бизнесменов в выводе из-под санкций «яхты Вексельберга»
ru.subheader: Минюст США обвинил двух бизнесменов в попытке вывести из-под санкций «яхту Вексельберга»
ru.content: Минюст США предъявил российскому бизнесмену 51-летнему Владиславу Осипову и британскому бизнесмену 52-летнему Ричарду Мастерсу обвинения в попытке вывести из-под санкций яхты Tango, которая, как утверждается, принадлежит находящемуся под санкциями российскому бизнесмену Виктору Вексельбергу.Согласно сообщению на сайте ведомства, бизнесмены пытались скрыть принадлежность яхты и обеспечить ее эксплуатацию через компанию и финансовую систему США.Мастерса задержали в Испании, ему грозит экстрадиция. В отношении россиянина выписан ордер на арест.«Сегодняшние обвинительные заключения и арест, произведенный испанскими правоохранительными органами, демонстрируют неизменное внимание ФБР к выслеживанию и привлечению к ответственности тех, кто помогает российским олигархам, попавшим под санкции», — заявил заместитель директора ФБР Пол Эббейт.Материал дополняется.
ru.summary: Министерство юстиции США предъявило обвинения двум российским бизнесменам в попытке вывода из-под американских санкций яхты «Яхта Вексельберга» стоимостью $1,5 млрд. По данным американского минюста, бизнесменам инкриминируется незаконное вмешательство в американские выборы.

en.header: Three vessels will deliver food from Ukraine to China, India and Spain
en.subheader: Three dry cargo ships with corn, wheat, barley and sunflower oil left the Ukrainian ports on Friday, the Joint Coordination Center (JCC) reports.
en.content: On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU - Three dry loads of corn, wheat, yachts and sunflower oil came out of Ukrainian ports on Friday." On 20 January, three ships left Ukrainian ports, carrying a total of 128,600 tons of grain and other food as part of the Black Sea Grains Initiative," said the report. The port of Odessa was followed by a dry cargo on Friday along the maritime humanitarian corridor. 86 applications for participation in the initiative were submitted to the SCC. record.header: All pipe gas suppliers, except the Russian Federation, reduced supplies to China in November
record.subheader: Gas supplies from the Russian Federation at the level of over 1.3 billion cubic meters. m
record.content: On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU - All pipeline gas suppliers to China except Russia in November 2022 saw a marked reduction in the supply of natural gas, as evidenced by data from the PRC customs. Local buyers continued to increase their activity in the spot market in November, including by purchasing goods of LNG from the European market.Summarno gas pipelines dropped by 2% in November – to 160 million cubic metres from an average of 163 million cubic metres in October. In November 2022, PRC received 4.785 billion cubic metres in gas pipelines. In November 2021, gas supplies from Turkmenistan dropped to 2.7 billion cubic metres after almost 3 billion cubic metres in October; supplies from Uzbekistan fell more than twice – below 200 million cubic metres; supplies from Kazakhstan have been below 200 million cubic metres since September. The shipment from Myanmar – declined to about 200 million cubic metres from 300 million cubic metres in October. The role of LNG in the market As previously reported, the purchase of LNG in November 2022 reached a new peak in 2022 – 6.6 million tonnes (8.583 billion cubic metres). It is estimated that a total of 6,424 million tons were recovered in October, after regasification, compared to 6,424 million tons in October. The figure falls far short of the November 2021 result (7.629 million tons). The main reason for the decline in energy imports by year is the imposition of severe restrictions to prevent the spread of coronavirus infection. The "zero tolerance" policy for COVID-19 (restriction of the spread of the virus through strict "locodowns" and mandatory quarantine for those in contact with infected citizens) was part of the preparations for the Winter Olympics in February, but the authorities continued this practice after the end of the competition. The PRC is now gradually removing restrictions. China ' s buyers, against the background of domestic anti-coquid restrictions and the hot demand for LNG in Europe, were able to manoeuvre in the spot market, reaching the optimum price of gas supply. After Europe filled its PHG before it refused, the PRC took advantage of falling prices and increased procurement at the end of the year. The increase in the number of LNG suppliers indicates an increase in the number of spot market purchases. 9 countries supplied gas in September, 13 in October, and 14 in November. One shipment in November was delivered to China by Equatorial Guinea, UAE, Trinidad and Tobago, as well as European resellers France and Spain (a partial batch). Russian supplies doubled to approximately 0.9 billion cubic metres by November 2021 (this is about 10 shipments). In Russia, large tonized LNG produces Sahalian energy plants (co-owners Gazprom, Mitsui and Mitsubishi), as well as Yamal SPG (participants) (participants NATEC, TotalEngies, Chinese CNPC and SRF). This fuel is also produced by the Gazprom medium ton plant at the Portoje compressor station, the Kriogas-Vysotsk gas plant (NOATEC SP) and the Gazprombank.

ru.header: Три судна доставят продовольствие с Украины в Китай, Индию и Испанию
ru.subheader: Из украинских портов в пятницу вышли три сухогруза с кукурузой, пшеницей, ячменем и подсолнечным маслом, сообщает Совместный координационный центр (СКЦ).
ru.content: Москва. 20 января. INTERFAX.RU - Из украинских портов в пятницу вышли три сухогруза с кукурузой, пшеницей, ячменем и подсолнечным маслом, сообщает Совместный координационный центр (СКЦ)."20 января три судна покинули украинские порты, они перевозят в общей сложности 128,6 тыс. тонн зерна и другого продовольствия в рамках черноморской зерновой инициативы", - говорится в сообщении.Сухогруз Zheng Yao (29,3 тыс. тонн кукурузы, 27,8 тыс. тонн ячменя и 9,4 тыс. тонн пшеницы) отправился в Испанию. Судно Mrc Sedef переправит в Индию 43 тыс. тонн подсолнечного масла. Судно Aviva доставит в Китай 19,1 тыс. тонн подсолнечного масла.В порт Одессы следует сухогруз, который в пятницу прошел по морскому гуманитарному коридору.В СКЦ сообщили, что "было подано 86 заявок на участие в инициативе"."По состоянию на 20 января общий тоннаж зерна и другой агропродукции, экспортированной из трех украинских портов, составляет 18 179 860 тонн. Всего на данный момент было разрешено движение 1 322 сухогрузов: 655 на прибытие в украинские порты и 667 - на выход из них", - резюмировали в СКЦ.
ru.summary: Из украинских портов вышли три судна с зерном, пшеницей и кукурузой, сообщили в Совместном координационном центре (СКЦ). Москва. 19 января.
