As the true depth of the malpractice and poor decisions has become evident, trust in these companies has been substantially eroded.Trust in ecosystems will be hard to recoverAsset prices may rise and fall, but most assume that the underlying fundamentals of market construction and mechanics will still hold. This has been the core problem in this bear market. As it turns out, manipulation, collusion and inside deals were the norm. And the behavior was not relegated to new companies — it seems most industry players participated at some level or another. Such is the case with DCG. Bad loans, poor risk management and obfuscated financial reporting are coming home to roost.Crypto prices will eventually return, and new companies will enter the market. Let’s hope that the collective memory of the industry extends a bit. A return to deep due diligence and default skepticism is needed. The onerous should be on the companies to earn trust through their actions. This seems obvious, but it’s clear we’ve forgotten.We are left with an unfortunate reality. Trust will not only need to be rebuilt in the companies operating in the space, but it will also need to be rebuilt in the ecosystem that enables the companies.Joseph Bradley is the head of business development at Heirloom, a software-as-a-service startup. He started in the cryptocurrency industry in 2014 as an independent researcher before going to work at Gem (which was later acquired by Blockdaemon) and subsequently moving to the hedge fund industry. He received his master’s degree from the University of Southern California with a focus on portfolio construction and alternative asset management.

record.header: Top 3 Reasons Why Crypto Prices Are Not Plummeting After Genesis Bankruptcy News
record.subheader: There are many reasons why the crypto markets aren't suffering that much despite the news that Genesis has filed for bankruptcy.
record.content: Genesis is one of the largest companies in the Bitcoin and crypto space, and has this morning announced that they are to be entering into a chapter 11 bankruptcy filing, after many of the loans that they issued to various parties in the crypto space soured.Many in the cryptocurrency space are lamenting the degree to which figures that love criminality and taking huge risk have been plaguing the cryptocurrency space over the course of 2022, andThe collapse is already priced inOne of the main reasons why the price hasn't responded significantly to the news is the fact that the market has already priced it in.After the collapse of FTX, it became obvious to investors that there would be a further series of collateral damage rippling across the industry, and the market prepared for this.In a worst case scenario, DCG could choose to unwind some of the Greyscale Trust's assets in order to reimburse some of their creditors, which would incur significant further selling pressure, depending on how it would be done - it could either be achieved by disbursing the Bitcoin held in the trust to creditors, or (as is traditional) liquidating the assets and disbursing the dollar value.Sellers are exhaustedFurthermore, after well over a year of a brutal bear market, most sellers are already completely exhausted.With each bear market, the hodlers become more hardened and determined, and those who hold throughout the bear market to make it to other side are well-equipped to deal with everything that could be thrown at them moving forward. en.header: SEC Sues Eisenberg for Draining Mango Markets, Alleges MNGO a Security
en.subheader: It’s the latest case to emerge from Avraham Eisenberg’s “highly profitable trading strategy.”
en.content: The Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday charged DeFi trader Avraham Eisenberg over his draining of $116 million from Solana-based decentralized exchange Mango Markets.The SEC’s charges rest on the agency’s assertion that MNGO, Mango Markets’ governance token, is a security. Holders of MNGO can use their tokens to vote in decisions governing Mango Markets’ operations.Eisenberg already faced criminal commodities fraud charges for his admitted role in orchestrating the “highly profitable trading strategy” against Mango Markets last October.This story will be updated
en.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday charged DeFi trader Avraham Eisenberg over his draining of $116 million from Mango Markets. Eisenberg already faced criminal commodities fraud charges for his admitted role in orchestrating the “highly profitable trading strategy”

record.header: SEC charges Mango Markets exploiter for allegedly stealing $116M in crypto
record.subheader: The SEC has accused Avraham Eisenberg of manipulating the Mango Markets platform by manipulating the MNGO token, which the company allegedly sold as a security.
record.content: The SEC has accused Avraham Eisenberg of manipulating the Mango Markets platform by manipulating the MNGO token, which the company allegedly sold as a security.Breaking newsOwn this piece of historyCollect this article as an NFTThe United States Securities and Exchange Commission has followed the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and others in filing parallel charges against the crypto user allegedly behind a multimillion dollar exploit of decentralized exchange Mango Markets.In a Jan. 20 notice, the SEC alleged Avraham Eisenberg manipulated Mango Markets’ MNGO governance token, allowing him to steal roughly $116 million worth of cryptocurrency from the platform. According to the complain, Eisenberg allegedly executed a series of large MNGO purchases in order to artificially raise the price of the token relative to USD Coin (USDC), then drained the assets from Mango Markets.“Eisenberg engaged in a manipulative and deceptive scheme to artificially inflate the price of the MNGO token, which was purchased and sold as a crypto asset security, in order to borrow and then withdraw nearly all available assets from Mango Markets, which left the platform at a deficit when the security price returned to its pre-manipulation level,” said David Hirsch, head of the SEC’s Crypto Assets and Cyber Unit.The SEC has charged Eisenberg with violations of the anti-fraud and market manipulation provisions of securities laws. According to the financial regulator, it will be seeking “permanent injunctive relief, a conduct-based injunction, disgorgement with prejudgment interest, and civil penalties”.This story is developing and will be updated.

en.header: The deputy reported on the letter of the head of the General Staff about the PMC fighter Wagner
en.subheader: The Ministry of Defense refused to deal with issues related to the Wagner PMC fighters, since the military company is not part of the Russian Armed Forces.
en.content: The Ministry of Defence refused to deal with matters relating to the MKK Wagner, because the military company is not part of the Russian armed forces, Wagner is not a member of the Russian armed forces, and the Ministry of Defence does not deal with matters relating to citizens who have entered the army, as indicated in the reply of the head of Genstab, the commander of the joint group of troops in Ukraine, Valeria Gerasimov, to a request by MP Mosgaromou of the CLCF of Eugenia Stopin, a copy of which Stupin ' s reply was published on his television channel, and the deputy ' s request was related to an attempt to ascertain the fate of those who had entered the KZK at the request of their relatives. According to Stupin, he refused to provide information to a private military company on missing persons, after which he decided to refer to the Ministry of Defence. "The organization you call the PMK "Vagner" is not part of the structure of the Russian Armed Forces. The circumstances in question preclude any official contact between relatives of its employees and the employer with the assistance of the Ministry of Defence," says Gerasimov. "The private military company "Vagner" (Vagner) was founded by businessman Eugenia Prigozhny, its fighters are taking part in hostilities in Ukraine. In October, Prigozhin supported criticism of Colonel Alexander Lapin, who then commanded a group of Russian troops at the Centre. On 11 January, he reported that the city had been taken over; the Ministry of Defence officially reported that Soledar had been taken over only on 13 January; the Ministry of Defence ' s first communication on the taking of Soledar CPV Wagner did not mention, but noted the activities of the VJV units that had blocked the city. Shortly thereafter, Prigozhin stated that the Wagner troops had "a constant attempt to steal victory" and to subdue their merit in a military operation. On the evening of the same day, the Ministry of Defence issued a new report stating that the task of storming the city "was successfully accomplished by the courageous and selfless actions of the CZK troops." The Kremlin of the report of the conflict between the Ministry of Defence and the CZK Wagner called "information manipulation". "We think that most of this conflict is in the information space," said Dmitri Peskov.

record.header: The Deputy Minister of Defense of Russia discussed with the head of the ICRC the treatment of prisoners
record.content: Moscow: 20 January: INTERFAX.RU, Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation, Alexander Fomin, at a meeting in Moscow with the President of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), Mirjana Spolarić-Egger, discussed issues of cooperation on the Ukrainian track, informed the Russian Ministry of Defence. "The parties discussed the most relevant issues of cooperation between the Ministry of Defence of Russia and ICRC on the Ukrainian track, including respect for international humanitarian law, the treatment of prisoners of war, the search for missing persons", said in a press release. Spolaric-Egger assumed the position of President of ICRC in October 2022, replacing Peter Maurer, who last visited Moscow in late March 2022.

ru.header: Депутат сообщил о письме главы Генштаба про бойца ЧВК Вагнера
ru.subheader: В Минобороны отказались заниматься вопросами, связанными с бойцами ЧВК Вагнера, поскольку военная компания не входит в состав Вооруженных сил России
ru.content: В Минобороны отказались заниматься вопросами, связанными с бойцами ЧВК Вагнера, поскольку военная компания не входит в состав Вооруженных сил РоссииЧВК Вагнера не входит в состав Вооруженных сил России, в связи с чем Минобороны не занимается вопросами, связанными с гражданами, поступившими туда на службу. Об этом говорится в ответе главы Генштаба, командующего объединенной группировкой войск на Украине Валерия Герасимова на запрос депутата Мосгордумы от КПРФ Евгения Ступина. Копию ответа Ступин опубликовал в своем телеграм-канале.Запрос депутата был связан с попыткой выяснить судьбу поступивших на службу в ЧВК по просьбе их родных. Как рассказал Ступин, предоставить информацию в частной военной компании о пропавших отказались, после чего он решил обратиться в Минобороны.«Организация, именуемая Вами как ЧВК «Вагнер», в структуру Вооруженных сил РФ не входит. Приведенные обстоятельства исключают возможность налаживания при содействии Минобороны РФ каких-либо официальных контактов родственников ее сотрудников с работодателем», — говорится в ответе Герасимова.Частная военная компания «Вагнер» (ЧВК Вагнера) была основана бизнесменом Евгением Пригожиным, ее бойцы принимают участие в боевых действиях на Украине. В октябре Пригожин поддержал критику Рамзана Кадырова в адрес генерал-полковника Александра Лапина, который тогда командовал группировкой российских войск «Центр».На фоне боев в Соледаре, активировавшихся в январе, Пригожин неоднократно заявлял, что в штурме города принимают участие только бойцы ЧВК. 11 января он сообщил, что город взят. Минобороны официально сообщило о взятии Соледара под контроль только 13 января. В первом сообщении Минобороны о взятии Соледара ЧВК Вагнера не упоминалась, зато отмечались действия подразделений ВДВ, блокировавших город. Вскоре после этого Пригожин заявил, что у вагнеровцев «постоянно пытаются украсть победу» и принизить их заслуги в рамках военной операции. Вечером того же дня Минобороны опубликовало новое сообщение, в котором говорилось, что задача по штурму города «была успешно решена мужественными и самоотверженными действиями добровольцев штурмовых отрядов ЧВК Вагнера».Кремль сообщения о конфликте между Минобороны и ЧВК Вагнера называл «информационными манипуляциями». «Мы думаем, что в основном этот конфликт [существует] в информационном пространстве», — сказал Дмитрий Песков.

record.header: SEC Under Fire: FOX's Gasparino Accuses Agency of Mishandling Ripple Case, Deaton Responds
record.content: The SEC filed a lawsuit against Ripple Labs Inc., the firm behind the XRP cryptocurrency, in December 2020, saying that the company engaged in an unregistered securities offering of XRP for $1.38 billion. The case is still ongoing, and the conclusion could have far-reaching consequences for the XRP cryptocurrency and the broader crypto sector.Moreover, by the end of 2022, FTX collapsed and filed for bankruptcy. The FTX collapse was not the result of bad management or oversight, but of deliberate fraud. Another description of the alleged crimes is that they are “one of the biggest financial frauds in American history.”Could the FTX collapse and people losing millions be prevented if the SEC had focused on the right people? Let’s seeGasparino Criticizes SEC’s JudgmentCharles Gasparino is an American journalist, blogger, and radio host. On the Fox Business Network, he participates on panels frequently. In a recent tweet, he criticized the SEC’s judgment to go after crypto companies.He has revealed how Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of FTX, had two meetings with the SEC. He continues by saying that the SEC botched its regulatory strategy by going after Ripple over unregistered XRP when there were significant concerns about potential fraud with exchanges.The more I delve into the @SBF_FTX implosion and hear how he met w @SECGov not once but twice, it's hard not to realize that the SEC really botched its regulatory agenda going after @Ripple over unregistered XRP when serious issues of potential fraud always resided w exchanges— Charles Gasparino (@CGasparino) January 18, 2023In response to this tweet, John E Deaton, the CryptoLaw founder has stated that it’s not just Ripple that has become a target of SEC’s poor regulatory agenda. The SEC sued LBRY, a small company in New Hampshire in another non-fraud case over the LBC token. ru.header: sec обвиняет эксплуататора mango markets в том, что он якобы украл 116 миллионов долларов в крипте
ru.subheader: SEC обвинила Авраама Айзенберга в манипулировании платформой Mango Markets путем манипулирования токеном MNGO, который компания якобы продала в качестве ценной бумаги.
ru.content: The SEC has accused Avraham Eisenberg of manipulating the Mango Markets platform by manipulating the MNGO token, which the company allegedly sold as a security.Breaking newsOwn this piece of historyCollect this article as an NFTThe United States Securities and Exchange Commission has followed the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and others in filing parallel charges against the crypto user allegedly behind a multimillion dollar exploit of decentralized exchange Mango Markets.In a Jan. 20 notice, the SEC alleged Avraham Eisenberg manipulated Mango Markets’ MNGO governance token, allowing him to steal roughly $116 million worth of cryptocurrency from the platform. According to the complain, Eisenberg allegedly executed a series of large MNGO purchases in order to artificially raise the price of the token relative to USD Coin (USDC), then drained the assets from Mango Markets.“Eisenberg engaged in a manipulative and deceptive scheme to artificially inflate the price of the MNGO token, which was purchased and sold as a crypto asset security, in order to borrow and then withdraw nearly all available assets from Mango Markets, which left the platform at a deficit when the security price returned to its pre-manipulation level,” said David Hirsch, head of the SEC’s Crypto Assets and Cyber Unit.The SEC has charged Eisenberg with violations of the anti-fraud and market manipulation provisions of securities laws. According to the financial regulator, it will be seeking “permanent injunctive relief, a conduct-based injunction, disgorgement with prejudgment interest, and civil penalties”.This story is developing and will be updated.
ru.summary: SEC обвинила Авраама Айзенберга в манипулировании платформой Mango Markets. Айзенберг якобы совершил серию крупных покупок MNGO, чтобы искусственно повысить цену токена.

en.header: Bad Vibes from the Word “Crypto” Have Some Calling for a Rebrand
en.subheader: Money-making associations with cryptocurrencies misrepresent them as just currencies and fail to acknowledge the diverse applications of the technology.
en.content: Forget the Great Reset. Members of the industry known as “crypto” (or is it “blockchain,” “digital assets” or “distributed ledger technology?”) attending this week’s World Economic Forum under the shadow of the crisis known as “FTX” are spurring a great rebrand.In the wake of the Bahamas-based exchange’s meltdown, “crypto” and “NFTs” (non-fungible tokens) have become trigger words for skeptics who dismiss this technology as hot air with no utility – much as “blockchain” was viewed in 2018 around the initial coin offering (ICO) bubble, when, in one notorious case, the Long Island Iced Tea company infamously renamed itself Long Blockchain Corp.Hence, there was talk of a new lexicon (we’re stuck with “crypto” for now) as business leaders tried to convince policymakers attending the talkfest in Davos, Switzerland, of the need for constructive regulation or sought deals, engagement or just acceptance by leaders of mainstream companies who’d also turned out in force.You’re reading Money Reimagined, a weekly look at the technological, economic and social events and trends that are redefining our relationship with money and transforming the global financial system. Subscribe to get the full newsletter here.I’m sure many readers of this column will recoil at this effort. Some may even see it as a centralizing power grab.Maybe that’s fair. This annual gathering in the Swiss Alps, often cited for hypocrisy, empty talk and elitism, is a lightning rod among many who believe in the potential for cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies to upend the existing, inequitable global economy. You don’t have to share the conspiracy theorists’ views of WEF founder Klaus Schwab’s “Great Reset” idea to have concerns about the many Davos member companies and institutions whose business models perpetuate that system’s exploitative, centralized power structure.But it’s also clear that “crypto” is now being widely associated with “have-fun-staying-poor” crypto bros and with what MIT Digital Currency Initiative Director Neha Narula calls “token casinos.” That the word now makes policymakers and executives squeamish is a barrier to progress for any crypto industry leader looking to engage with them.It might not be such a bad idea to find words that don’t sound so foreign or threatening, words that encapsulate more universally and positively recognized ideas.Brynly Llyr, the head of blockchain and digital assets at the World Economic Forum, suggested “decentralized systems” as a phrase that’s accurately descriptive of the function this technology plays without risking a negative association with crypto culture.Others are simply resurfacing “blockchain,” hoping it will be more palatable to businesses that want to use these systems to manage enterprise needs. (One concern here is that word was associated with the “permissioned” blockchain systems once favored by business consortia, systems which weren’t really decentralized and added no real value as a result. Nowadays, with businesses increasingly building Web3 strategies on permissionless layer 1 protocols such as Ethereum, the retrograde connotation of “blockchain” may not be so bad.)The industry’s language problem goes beyond the negative connotations of “crypto.” It’s also that catchall words lack precision and vital nuance.For example, there are multiple types of tokens. These include commodity tokens like ether (ETH) that power public blockchains; store-of-value assets such as bitcoin (BTC); payment tokens such as USDC; and NFTs, which are essentially markers of scarce digital objects. All are often lumped under the label “cryptocurrencies,” which fosters an association with the traditional idea of “currencies” and carries distinct legal and political connotations.This imprecision creates problems for participants in this industry when they negotiate over rules or terms of service with each other and with policymakers and non-crypto businesses.“Too often we’re talking past each other,” says David Treat, senior managing director of Accenture’s blockchain practice. “People apply an argument about one domain which doesn’t really work with all the others.”Treat is looking for a taxonomy framework that “allows us to see the interplay between the tokenization of identity, money and objects so that we don’t get sucked into one myopic facet of this and miss the wider, important conversation.”Obsessing about words in this way might seem beside-the-point when the most important thing is to come up with protections against the kind of malfeasance that led to the FTX collapse. But amid reports that compliance officers are now giving banks blanket instructions to block services to any entity that’s touched” crypto” – if taken literally, a group that includes the likes of Microsoft, Starbucks and, ironically, BNY Mellon – it’s clear that we all need to get clearer with our words.Who decides, though? This is not a central marketing department or chief brand officer that can dictate what brand labeling this industry should use. The market will decide which words to use.So, for now, we’re stuck with “crypto.”
en.summary: "Crypto" and "NFTs" have become trigger words for skeptics who dismiss this technology as hot air with no utility. Money-making associations with cryptocurrencies misrepresent them as just currencies and fail to acknowledge the diverse applications.

en.header: FTX Debtors' List of Assets Omits Mention of Large Stash of NFTs and ENS Names Owned by Alameda
en.subheader: FTX's inner circle and the quantitative trading company Alameda Research were heavily involved in the non-fungible token scene.
en.content: This week, FTX debtors issued a press release and a 20-page document noting that bankruptcy administrators had located $5.5 billion in liquid assets. The document details that investigators discovered fiat currencies, crypto assets, and securities as part of FTX’s and Alameda Research’s cache. However, the disclosure to unsecured creditors does not mention the extremely large stash of non-fungible tokens the company had accrued over the years.FTX and Alameda’s Liquidated Assets Include Thousands of NFTs and ENS NamesFTX’s inner circle and the quantitative trading company Alameda Research were heavily involved in the non-fungible token (NFT) hype that began in 2021. In fact, after FTX and Alameda filed for bankruptcy protection, our news desk parsed through a large number of Alameda/FTX-associated wallets and discovered thousands of NFTs and Ethereum Name Service (ENS) names.The discoveries were derived from wallets labeled by Block researcher Larry Cermak and parsed data from the crypto monitoring application Arkham Intelligence and dappradar.com‘s portfolio viewer. For example, the Alameda-linked address “0x116” holds around $100,000 in crypto tokens, but it also holds 107 ENS names. It’s possible that Alameda thought it could flip ENS names in the future, as the firm obtained a great number of common names.Alameda and now the liquidators own ENS names such as “tickets.eth,” “payment.eth,” “network.eth,” “dungeon.eth,” “packager.eth,” “nootropic.eth,” “breakfast.eth,” and many more. Most are not worth very much, but some of the specific ENS names like “payment.eth” and “network.eth,” have sold for close to $9,000 per name. Alameda’s ENS name collection is not mentioned in the 20-page presentation shown to FTX’s unsecured creditors.Last year in January, there were a lot of controversies when a few mirrored non-fungible token (NFT) collections appeared on the scene, copying the artwork of Cryptopunks and Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC) NFTs. Interestingly, Alameda’s ETH address “0x0f4” holds a massive quantity of unofficial “flipped” Cryptopunks and “mirrored” BAYC NFTs.The “0x0f4” address holds 2,447 NFTs in the wallet from 629 different NFT collections. Alameda’s “0x0f4” collected NFTs from compilations such as Time Frog, Party-Animals, Metawarden, Shrouded Playground, and many more from dozens of relatively unknown NFT collections.Alameda collected blue-chip non-fungible tokens (NFTs) as well, and records show the firm obtained 11 legitimate Cryptopunks, which are collectively worth an estimated $784,000. The trading platform purchased seven different Art Blocks Curated, which have an estimated value of around $1.47 million on Jan. 20, 2023.Alameda and now the liquidators own 81 land NFTs from The Sandbox, which are collectively worth an estimated $155,000. Alameda obtained two Otherdeeds as well, which are now worth around $25,000, and 12 different Meebits, which are valued at an estimated $88,000 today. A great deal of blue-chip NFTs can be found in the ETH address “0xca4.”That specific wallet holds some of Alameda’s most valuable NFTs, including the Otherdeed land titles and two Mutant Ape Yacht Club (MAYC) NFTs worth roughly $50,000 in combined value. Larry Cermak’s Alameda address list highlights approximately 29 different Ethereum addresses. Furthermore, Arkham Intelligence data indicates that there are 68 addresses tied to the quantitative trading platform Alameda Research.Out of the large swath of Alameda addresses, a decent handful of the wallets own NFTs. Most of these wallets are assumed to be controlled by the FTX bankruptcy team and liquidators. Just in tokens alone, Alameda’s 68 tethered Ethereum-based wallets indicate a net value of around $189.12 million.
en.summary: FTX and Alameda filed for bankruptcy protection in March. FTX and Alameda were heavily involved in the NFT hype

Price Floor.Based on Yuga Labs’ 5% creator royalty fee, secondary sales for the collection have already netted them revenues of over $1.2 million.Virtual pet website Neopets — which was popular throughout the 2000s — has raised $4 million from the gaming and blockchain investors with plans to create its own metaverse.Some of the companies providing the funding are venture capital firm Polygon Ventures, investment firms HaskKet Capital and IDG Capital, gaming company NetDragon Websoft and Avalanche's development fund Blizzard Avalanche Ecosystem Fund.According to the announcement, ‘Neopets Metaverse’ will be a play-and-earn virtual pet game based on the original, and would allow players to “raise, care for, customize, and battle with their Neopets” on the blockchain.In the announcement, HashKey Capital’s investment director Xao Xiao notes: “We believe that GameFi plays a crucial role in the larger metaverse narrative, serving as the interactive layer in the value chain and a key driver of traffic across web 2 and web 3.”Neopets was founded in 1999, and the company is hopeful that Neopets Metaverse will bring “the magic of Neopets in a positively fresh light to old-time players, as well as attracting and nurturing a new generation of Neopians.”The community has had an underwhelming response to the announcement, with some suggesting its previous effort at creating a Neopets metaverse had been a flop.actually hilarious news on the migration considering being based on solana was one of their main selling points to avoid the environmental controversy. desperate rats trying to squeeze something out of a big fail— no (@RED0KT0BERFEST) January 16, 2023The company had initially launched an NFT collection using the Solana network on Nov. 12, 2021, which allegedly went so poorly that it resulted in the hashtag #NoNeoNFT trending on Twitter.A team of researchers from the National University of Singapore (NUS) have created a pair of haptic gloves which it believes can bring the sensation of touch to the metaverse.The invention, called the HaptGlove, is an untethered and lightweight glove that will allow metaverse users to interact with virtual objects in a much more realistic fashion by conveying touch and grip.A professor who is working on the HaptGlove wearing it. Source: NUSnews.When users put on the HaptGlove, they are able to sense when their virtual avatar’s hand touches something, as well as tell how hard and what shape the object is as a result of the HaptGlove restricting the user’s finger positions.NUS claims that the HaptGlove will also be useful in other areas, such as education and medicine, by allowing surgeons to prepare for surgeries in a “hyper-realistic environment” or giving students a hand-on learning experience.While the concept of haptic gloves is not new, for example Meta is working on their own version of them, NUS claim that theirs is able to provide users with a much more realistic sense of touch compared to others that exist today.Those working on metaverse games have suggested that as virtual reality is such an immature technology, it is difficult to incorporate it into metaverse products, so existing games like The Sandbox and Decentraland are yet to fully incorporate virtual reality clients.On Jan. 18 NFT marketplace Rarible announced that it would be expanding its marketplace builder to include Polygon-based NFT collections. The builder will allow artists and projects to customize their own marketplace, with its CEO Alexei Falin believing that community marketplaces would become the future of NFT buying and selling.Crypto exchange Binance announced on Jan. 19 that it would be tightening its rules for NFT listings, requiring sellers to complete Know Your Customer (KYC) verification and have at least two followers before listing on the platform. The firm plans to “periodically review” NFT listings that do not “meet its standards” and recommend them for delisting.

record.header: Zadornov presented arguments against the merger of Otkritie Bank with VTB
record.subheader: The head of Otkritie, Mikhail Zadornov, in a letter to the Ministry of Finance, called the advantages of joining the bank to VTB controversial and listed the disadvantages of the transaction under discussion. In his opinion, despite the sanctions, Otkritie can still be sold to investors.
record.content: Michael Zadornov, the head of the Open, in a letter to the Ministry of Finance, described the benefits of the bank's accession to the VTB as controversial and listed the disadvantages of the transaction under discussion. In his view, despite the sanctions, the Open could still be sold to investors Michael Zadornov The Open Bank's open-up deal will not achieve the objectives of increasing the capital sustainability and efficiency of the banking sector, and has "a few significant disadvantages." This is stated in Michael Zadornov's letter to the Minister of Finance, Anton Siluanov, the text of which is available to RBC and confirmed the source in the financial market. "We are not familiar with this letter. The decision is being taken by the President. The decision is under way," reported WTB to RBC. The Government's press service sent a request to the Ministry of Finance. The Ministry's spokesman noted that the issue of bank integration was being addressed "in accordance with the President's instructions." The CEC did not respond to the RBC's request. How did the "Open" decide not to sell, but to join the WTB Bank "Open" in 2017 as a result of sedation. After financial recovery, the regulator announced its intention to sell the asset in 2021, but the deal had to be postponed because of the coronavirus pandemic. In the summer of last year, the BEC again announced the start of pre-market preparations for "Open" with two scenarios being considered: the sale of 50 per cent plus one to a strategic investor, or the initial placement of a share in a bank on the stock exchange (IPO). At the end of 2021, Zadornov stated that the applicants at the "Open" were on February 24, 2022, Russia had launched a military operation in Ukraine, and on the same day, the "Open" bank was under United States block sanctions. At the end of April, it was known that the head of the BTB, Andrei Costin, had invited the Government to join its bank (also under U.S. block sanctions) "Open" and the Crimean RNSB. This would save on the costs of specific banks, as well as reduce the cost of the budget "to stabilize the banking sector" in the context of the crisis, writing "Commersant" at the end of April. According to the publication, the idea was endorsed by President Vladimir Putin. The head of the CEC, Elvira Nabiullina, supported the consolidation in public. "We do not see the possibility of selling the Open Bank to the market in the foreseeable future either," she explained. The letter from Zadornov provides both financial and legal arguments against the transaction. Openness's accession to the VTB will not significantly improve the latter's performance or guarantee greater operational efficiency of the business, I think Zadonnov. The Openup estimates that its own capital will not result in a tangible increase in the adequacy of the combined bank's capital (maximum +0.4 p.). (c) The right to freedom of opinion and expression (art. to standard H1.0. According to the annex to the letter, as at 1 February, the regulatory capital of WTB was 1.7 trillion roubles. and the ratio of self-sufficiency H1.0 to 10.2 per cent (this is below the required level of 11.5 per cent, but for banking groups the standard of H20.0, calculated differently, is used. On the same date, the Open figures were 368.7 billion roubles and 13 per cent. This means that the standard of capital adequacy of the combined bank would be only 10.6 per cent. The Openship Manual states that the past experience of the WTB in consolidating the subsidiary retail bank, VTB24, failed to produce the desired effect. "The declared synergy from the unification of banks between 2018 and 2019 was not confirmed in practice — total expenditure, on the other hand, increased sharply," the letter states. Prior to the transition to the Open, Zadornov led the WTB24: at the end of 2017, after 12 years of work at the bank, he resigned early due to the accession of the "dog" to the VTB, and in January 2018, he headed the "Open". There are legal risks of integration with the VTB. The State Bank was the stockholder of the "Open" with a 7% share prior to its disposition, and the bankruptcy law "has an explicit ban on the owners of more than 1% of the shares of the banked banks to participate in their subsequent acquisition" is stated in the letter. The circumvention of the bankruptcy law by some legislative changes, in the view of Revelation, sets a negative precedent and "transmitting to the market, the ex-owner acquires a fiscally held asset", indicates Zadronov. In addition, the Revelations believe that the VTB "will not be motivated to complete the trials" against the former owners of the Revelation, Binbank and Rosgostrah. Once the CEC has been cleared, as the new owner of the asset, the court tries to recover the funds withdrawn from the bank. With it, the "Trust" non-core asset bank is running a process to which problematic assets have been transferred from the balance sheet of banked private banks. en.header: Portugal will transfer M-113 armored personnel carriers to Ukraine

en.content: On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU, the Portuguese authorities, decided to transfer 14 M113 armoured personnel carriers to Ukraine, reporting to the EFE agency on Friday with reference to the Portuguese Minister of Defence, Elena Carreirash. record.header: Lithuania will transfer two MI-8 and anti-aircraft helicopters to Ukraine
record.subheader: Lithuania will hand over two MI-8 helicopters and L-70 anti-aircraft guns to Ukraine, reporting on social media to the Lithuanian Minister of Defence, Arvidas Anushauskas.
record.content: On 20 January, INTERFAX.RU - Lithuania would hand over to Ukraine two MI-8 helicopters and L-70 anti-aircraft guns, reported on social media to the Lithuanian Defence Minister Arvidas Anushauskas. "The new Lithuanian aid package for Ukraine includes more than ten L-70 anti-aircraft guns, ammunition and two Mi-8 helicopters. The total cost of this shipment is approximately 125 million euros", he specified. The Lithuanian army has a total of three MI-8 Soviet-made helicopters and three European Dauphin helicopters acquired almost ten years ago. Lithuania therefore buys four UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters. Anushauskas said in December that Lithuania ' s military assistance to Ukraine amounted to 240 million euros.Kiev has transferred various weapons, ammunition, thermal sensors, drones and anti-drones. Lithuania is also training Ukrainian soldiers.

en.header: US inability to pay debts will lead to recession and global crisis - Yellen
en.subheader: The minister added that all Americans will feel the consequences of these events and many will lose their jobs.
en.content: Washington, 20 January - RIA News. The inability of the U.S. government to pay its obligations would lead to a recession in the US economy and could trigger a global financial crisis, reported the U.S. Secretary of Finance Janet Yellen. "It is impossible to make scheduled payments, whether they are bondholders or recipients of social protection, or our military, without any doubt would lead to a recession in the US economy and could cause a global financial crisis," said Yellen in an interview with CNN. The Minister added that all Americans would feel the consequences of these events and many would lose their jobs. "If that happens, the cost of borrowing will rise for us and every American will see that their borrowing costs will also increase," he said. Yellen also pointed out that, as a result of the inability to pay the bills, the United States debt rating could be lowered. "This would definitely undermine the role of the dollar as a reserve currency used in world operations", the Minister concluded. Yellen informed Congress on Thursday of the commencement of "extraordinary measures" in connection with the calculation of the public debt ceiling and called on legislators to quickly increase borrowing limits to avoid default. The "Extraordinary Measures" is that the Ministry of Finance suspends payments in the form of special treasury obligations for the period from 19 January to 5 June to two social funds that serve budget holders, the Civil Service Pension and Disability Fund, as well as the Fund for Medical Benefits for Pensioners of the Postal Service. She assured that the suspension would not affect the payment of funds to beneficiaries, the Department would fully recover the lost investment when Congress authorized the raise of the government debt ceiling from the current $31.381 trillion. She had previously warned that the Department ' s reserves would be sufficient before the summer, and then a default would be possible. President Joe Biden ' s administration refused to discuss with Congress on Thursday the terms of the raise of the state debt ceiling and called for an immediate decision to raise it.
en.summary: The United States could face a recession if it does not pay its debt obligations, said US Treasury Secretary Christine Lagarde.

record.header: A possible US default will pull the stock market to the bottom?
record.subheader: While the yields of treasuries are gradually starting to grow, and the shares do not seem to notice what is happening
record.content: The U.S.'s debt has again reached its ever-increasing ceiling. This is like a series in which the series comes out once a year. The problem is that the Republican-Democrat conflict is slowing down the ceiling. Janet Yellen, the head of the Ministry of Finance, is trying to buy time and therefore has announced that the debt has stopped issuing before June 5th. The White House, in turn, refused to take part in the debate and retreated. How does the stock market react? So long as the profits of the traders are gradually rising and the stocks seem to ignore what is happening. Democratic-Republican disputes are an age-old situation, but markets respond differently each time. For example, in 2011, the S&P 500 index lost as much as 17% because of similar uncertainties with the ceiling. When was the last time the government's debt increased? Right, December 2021. But then, the market was at its peak, the intra-day falls were played out immediately, the shares were left on the "haia." What happens now? The US economy remains very fragile on the brink of recession. Trend will be formed exclusively from future data on inflation, unemployment, and, of course, the Fed's rates. Business activity is slowing very quickly, the fall of S&P 500 is imminent, and the ceiling of public debt is a secondary problem. And sooner or later, the parties will come together. As always, default will be avoided. Probably... the source.

ru.header: Невозможность США платить долги приведет к рецессии и глобальному кризису - Йеллен
ru.subheader: Министр добавила, что все американцы почувствуют на себе последствия этих событий и многие потеряют работу
ru.content: ВАШИНГТОН, 20 янв - РИА Новости. Невозможность правительства США платить по своим обязательствам приведет к рецессии в американской экономике и может спровоцировать глобальный финансовых кризис, сообщила министр финансов страны Джанет Йеллен."Невозможность проводить запланированные платежи, независимо от того, идет ли речь о держателях облигаций или о получателях социальной защиты, или о наших военных, без сомнения приведет к рецессии в экономике США и может спровоцировать глобальный финансовый кризис", - заявила Йеллен в интервью CNN.Министр добавила, что все американцы почувствуют на себе последствия этих событий и многие потеряют работу."Если это случится, стоимость заимствований для нас вырастет и каждый американец увидит, что их расходы на заимствования также увеличатся", - отметила он.Йеллен также подчеркнула, что в результате невозможности платить по счетам рейтинг долговых обязательств США может быть понижен."Это определенно подорвет роль доллара как резервной валюты, которая используется в операциях по всему миру", - заключила министр.Йеллен в четверг уведомила конгресс о начале применения "экстраординарных мер" в связи с расчетным достижением потолка государственного долга и призвала законодателей оперативно увеличить лимиты заимствований во избежание дефолта."Экстраординарные меры" сводятся к тому, что министерство финансов на период с 19 января по 5 июня приостанавливает отчисления в виде специальных казначейских обязательств в два социальных фонда, которые обслуживают бюджетников - Фонд гражданской службы по пенсиям и нетрудоспособностям, а также Фонд медицинских льгот пенсионеров почтовой службы.Она заверила, что приостановка не затронет выплаты бенефициарам фондов, министерство полностью возместит недополученные инвестиции, когда конгресс санкционирует повышение потолка госдолга с нынешних 31,381 триллиона долларов. Ранее она предупреждала, что имеющихся у министерства резервов хватит до начала лета, после чего становится возможен дефолт.Администрация президента США Джо Байдена в четверг отказалась обсуждать с конгрессом условия повышения потолка госдолга и призвала немедленно принять решение о повышении его уровня.
ru.summary: США могут столкнуться с рецессией, если не будут платить по своим долговым обязательствам, заявила министр финансов США Кристин Лагард.

en.header: Coinbase, Circle Back Former FTX US President’s New Crypto Venture
en.subheader: Harrison told Decrypt about the latest $5 million raise for his project Architect and called an FTX reboot an “interesting possibility.”
en.content: The former President of FTX.US Brett Harrison is back with a new venture for crypto traders.And despite his ties to the defunct exchange empire, he’s landed support from key players.Architect, the name of Harrison’s new project, has raised $5 million in funding from the likes of Coinbase Ventures, Circle Ventures, and former White House press secretary under Trump Anthony Scaramucci, among others.Architect is a software company building Web3 trading infrastructure. Its products will largely be intended for the B2B market but may also see adoption from high-volume traders, Harrison told Decrypt in an interview.Harrison said that the firm’s primary clients will turn to Architect to quickly and seamlessly trade across multiple crypto platforms through a single interface. He suggested, for example, how Architect might create one API that combines trading across Coinbase and Uniswap.As Architect looks to develop products for big-name industry clients, it’s also making trust and safety “key components.”“We’re hoping to design Architect such that clients can trade without having to rely on us to store or safeguard their private information, for example, [or] exchange API keys or wallet keys. So we think that a decentralized solution in some way is going to be important for the design,” Harrison said.Crypto raises return to earthHarrison says the crypto venture capital world has been brought “back to a more normal state” since Terra’s implosion in May 2022.“There was a huge bubble,” he said of the venture capital space. Now, investors are taking more time to vet and investigate prospective targets. “That’s actually a very good thing for private markets.”The deflation of the latest bubble, along with the collapse of FTX, made raising capital for Architect difficult, he added. But Harrison believes the project raised its seed funding because of his long-term connections to his investors.“Many of these partners are people who have known me for a while now and have worked with me for a while now,” he said.Still, while Architect may be looking toward the future of Web3, many on Twitter immediately raised concerns about Harrison’s past, citing his prior role at FTX US.Harrison’s ties to FTXA week ago, Harrison published a nearly 50-part Twitter thread detailing his departure from FTX.US in September 2022. He said that by the time he left, his relationship with then-FTX International CEO Sam Bankman-Fried had “reached a point of total deterioration, after months of disputes over management practices at FTX.”1/49 Many have asked questions about my time at FTX US and why I left when I did. As I indicated earlier this week, I’m happy to begin sharing my experiences and perspective publicly.— Brett Harrison (@BrettHarrison88) January 14, 2023While FTX’s bankruptcy filing came just two months after Harrison’s departure, the executive said his desire to leave the company had solidified “much earlier.”When asked for his thoughts on the possibility of an FTX International “reboot,” Harrison told Decrypt the idea was an “interesting possibility.”“I think that if there was some possible way to bring it back online with good management who's able to really clean it up, I think that would be an interesting possibility, both for the kind of recovery of profits for the sake of paying back customers, but also for the sake of people having another option to trade on again,” he said.As for whether FTX.US is as “solvent” as Sam Bankman-Fried claims it is, Harrison is much less sure, but remains cautiously optimistic.“It’s impossible to say,” he told Decrypt. “I think we all have to wait.”
en.summary: Brett Harrison, former President of FTX.US, has raised $5 million for his new project Architect. Architect is a software company building Web3 trading infrastructure. Harrison says the venture capital world has been brought “back to a more normal state”

record.subheader: John Ray also attacked Sam Bankman-Fried in an interview, saying: "We don't need to be dialoguing with him. He hasn't told us anything that I don't already know."
record.content: FTX International could be revived, according to the doomed exchange's new CEO.Speaking to The Wall Street Journal, John Ray revealed that a taskforce has been established to see whether the trading platform could one day open its doors to customers once again.Of course, the unknown quantity here is whether retail investors would ever be willing to put their trust in the company again — with billions of dollars in customer funds allegedly misused by sister trading firm Alameda Research.Ray claimed that some customers have praised FTX's infrastructure and indicated that they would like to see the exchange make a return, adding:"Everything is on the table. If there is a path forward on that, then we will not only explore that, we'll do it."A key reason for examining whether FTX should be revived is this: Millions of customers who are frozen out of their savings could end up getting more of their crypto back.The interview with Ray also uncovered some staggering revelations — including the fact that "there was no centralized register that identified where the company stored its funds."He also had some choice words for Sam Bankman-Fried, who has been questioning the decisions made by FTX's new management in Substack posts."We don't need to be dialoguing with him. He hasn't told us anything that I don't already know."This led to a sharp response from SBF in a text message obtained by the WSJ, where he said:"This is a shocking and damning comment from someone pretending to care about customers."Ray also dismissed claims that FTX US is solvent and customers can be made whole immediately — as Bankman-Fried has repeatedly suggested. Warning that this would involve compensating users with funds belonging to international account holders, the new CEO said:"This is the problem. He thinks everything is one big honey pot."Another bone of contention concerns how much Ray is being paid — with court filing showing that he gets a whopping $1,300 per hour for serving as FTX's chief restructuring officer. He's also brought in many of his own (expensive) people because there are some existing employees he struggles to trust. When asked about the fact these funds could be put toward making customers whole, he responded:"Crime is very expensive. It does a lot of damage to people. And one of the damages is that people like me have to come in and fix it."

ru.header: coinbase, верните новое крипта-предприятие бывшего президента сша ftx
ru.subheader: Харрисон рассказал Decrypt о последнем привлечении 5 миллионов долларов для своего архитектора проекта и назвал перезагрузку FTX “интересной возможностью”.
ru.content: The former President of FTX.US Brett Harrison is back with a new venture for crypto traders.And despite his ties to the defunct exchange empire, he’s landed support from key players.Architect, the name of Harrison’s new project, has raised $5 million in funding from the likes of Coinbase Ventures, Circle Ventures, and former White House press secretary under Trump Anthony Scaramucci, among others.Architect is a software company building Web3 trading infrastructure. Its products will largely be intended for the B2B market but may also see adoption from high-volume traders, Harrison told Decrypt in an interview.Harrison said that the firm’s primary clients will turn to Architect to quickly and seamlessly trade across multiple crypto platforms through a single interface. He suggested, for example, how Architect might create one API that combines trading across Coinbase and Uniswap.As Architect looks to develop products for big-name industry clients, it’s also making trust and safety “key components.”“We’re hoping to design Architect such that clients can trade without having to rely on us to store or safeguard their private information, for example, [or] exchange API keys or wallet keys. So we think that a decentralized solution in some way is going to be important for the design,” Harrison said.Crypto raises return to earthHarrison says the crypto venture capital world has been brought “back to a more normal state” since Terra’s implosion in May 2022.“There was a huge bubble,” he said of the venture capital space. Now, investors are taking more time to vet and investigate prospective targets. “That’s actually a very good thing for private markets.”The deflation of the latest bubble, along with the collapse of FTX, made raising capital for Architect difficult, he added. But Harrison believes the project raised its seed funding because of his long-term connections to his investors.“Many of these partners are people who have known me for a while now and have worked with me for a while now,” he said.Still, while Architect may be looking toward the future of Web3, many on Twitter immediately raised concerns about Harrison’s past, citing his prior role at FTX US.Harrison’s ties to FTXA week ago, Harrison published a nearly 50-part Twitter thread detailing his departure from FTX.US in September 2022. He said that by the time he left, his relationship with then-FTX International CEO Sam Bankman-Fried had “reached a point of total deterioration, after months of disputes over management practices at FTX.”1/49 Many have asked questions about my time at FTX US and why I left when I did. As I indicated earlier this week, I’m happy to begin sharing my experiences and perspective publicly.— Brett Harrison (@BrettHarrison88) January 14, 2023While FTX’s bankruptcy filing came just two months after Harrison’s departure, the executive said his desire to leave the company had solidified “much earlier.”When asked for his thoughts on the possibility of an FTX International “reboot,” Harrison told Decrypt the idea was an “interesting possibility.”“I think that if there was some possible way to bring it back online with good management who's able to really clean it up, I think that would be an interesting possibility, both for the kind of recovery of profits for the sake of paying back customers, but also for the sake of people having another option to trade on again,” he said.As for whether FTX.US is as “solvent” as Sam Bankman-Fried claims it is, Harrison is much less sure, but remains cautiously optimistic.“It’s impossible to say,” he told Decrypt. “I think we all have to wait.”
ru.summary: Бретт Харрисон, бывший президент FTX.US , собрал 5 миллионов долларов для своего нового архитектора проекта. Architect - это компания-разработчик программного обеспечения, создающая торговую инфраструктуру Web3. Харрисон говорит, что мир венчурного капитала был возвращен “в более нормальное состояние”.

en.header: Turkey accused Greece of attempting to intercept combat aircraft
en.subheader: Turkish Defense Ministry: Greece tried to intercept Turkish warplanes over the Aegean Sea
en.content: The Greek armed forces attempted to intercept Turkish combat aircraft while carrying out missions within the framework of a NATO mission in international airspace, declared the Ministry of National Defence of Turkey; combat aircraft, Turkish military support aircraft and long-range radar detection aircraft carried out a NATO training mission, Nexus Ace, over the Aegean Sea; missions in international airspace attempted to disrupt Greek aircraft, but were successfully completed, reported to the Ministry of Defence; relations between Turkey and Greece (both in NATO) have deteriorated over the past few months owing to the dispute over the status of the Dodecanes islands in the Aegean Sea, which were long under the control of the Ottoman Empire, Italy between 1912 and 1947, and subsequently transferred to Greece, in accordance with the Paris Peace Treaty. At the end of August, CNN Turk reported that Turkish F-16 aircraft had flown in international space in the Aegean Sea and the Eastern Mediterranean, while Greece had fired missiles from the C-300 air defence system. In the Greek Ministry of Defence, statements by the Turkish side had been rejected and called myths. Two States had accused each other of violating airspace on several occasions in recent months. In particular, on 4 May, the Greek Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesman Alexandros Papaioannu described the violations by Ankara as unprecedented.
en.summary: The Turkish Ministry of National Defense has accused Greece of trying to intercept Turkish military aircraft in the Aegean Sea. The Turkish military claims that Greek warplanes tried to intercept Turkish Air Force planes.

record.header: Erdogan threatened Greece with a march of "rabid Turks"
record.subheader: Turkish President Erdogan threatened Greek Prime Minister Mitsotakis with a march of "rabid Turks"
record.content: Turkish President Recep Tayip Erdogan warned the Greek Prime Minister, Kiriakos Mitsotakis, about the march of the "fucking Turks." On the contrary, he denied plans to strike Athens with a designed Typhoon missile if Greece "act wisely." Erdogan accused the country of arming its islands in the Aegean Sea. "Mitsotakis, you say there, there, there, there, but know that if you're wrong, the rabid Turks will march," Erdogan threatened. Material is being supplemented.

ru.header: Турция обвинила Грецию в попытке перехвата боевых самолетов
ru.subheader: Минобороны Турции: Греция пыталась перехватить турецкие боевые самолеты над Эгейским морем
ru.content: Вооруженные силы Греции пытались перехватить турецкие боевые самолеты во время выполнения ими заданий в рамках миссии НАТО в международном воздушном пространстве, заявило Министерство национальной обороны Турции.Боевые самолеты, самолеты обеспечения турецких ВВС и самолеты дальнего радиолокационного обнаружения выполняли учебно-тренировочную миссию НАТО Nexus Ace над Эгейским морем. Миссии в международном воздушном пространстве попытались помешать греческие самолеты, но она была успешно завершена, сообщили в Минобороны.Отношения между Турцией и Грецией (обе состоят в НАТО) ухудшились в последние несколько месяцев из-за спора о статусе островов Додеканес в Эгейском море, которые долгое время находились под контролем Османской империи, в 1912–1947 годах — Италии, а затем перешли Греции, согласно Парижскому мирному договору. Анкара и Афины спорят о делимитации территориальных вод и воздушного пространства.В конце августа канал CNN Turk сообщил, что самолеты ВВС Турции F-16 выполняли полеты в международном пространстве в Эгейском море и Восточном Средиземноморье, а Греция навела на них ракеты из системы противовоздушной обороны С-300. В Минобороны Греции заявления турецкой стороны отвергли и назвали мифами.Два государства за последние месяцы несколько раз обвиняли друг друга в нарушении воздушного пространства. В частности, 4 мая представитель МИД Греции Александрос Папаиоанну назвал нарушения со стороны Анкары беспрецедентными». Турция отвергла «беспочвенные» обвинения и заявила о «провокационных нарушениях», которые якобы допустили ВВС Греции.
ru.summary: Министерство национальной обороны Турции обвинило Грецию в попытке перехватить турецкие военные самолеты в Эгейском море. Турецкие военные утверждают, что греческие военные самолеты пытались перехватить самолеты ВВС Турции.

en.header: 21Shares Introduces Digital Currency Staking ETP On BX Swiss Exchange
en.content: 21Shares recently announced its operation on the local stock exchange known as BX Swiss. This event recently occurred as the company released a digital currency staking index that primarily tracks about 10 Proof-of-Stake (PoS) cryptocurrencies.Primarily, 21Shares specializes in creating and managing exchange-traded products (ETPs) that track the value of various cryptocurrencies. A few examples are Bitcoin and Ethereum. The company provides investors with an easy and convenient way to invest in cryptocurrencies through traditional financial markets.Some of its activities include creating and listing ETPs on stock exchanges, managing their underlying assets, and providing investors with market data and other information.Introduction Of 21Shares ETPs On BX Swiss ExchangeAfter releasing the Staking Basket Index ETP with the STAKE ticker, they immediately began trading on BX Swiss, a local stock exchange. Following the launch, the ETPs could track up to 6 cryptocurrencies, including Cardano, Binance Coin, Polkadot, Cosmos, Tezos, and Solana.The addition of the STAKE ETP has brought the total number of digital currencies ETPs from 21Shares and 21.co to 47. In the meantime, about 12 exchanges in 9 different countries now offer ETPs.Through these products, investors can gain more exposure to the crypto space in a safe environment. Additionally, ETPs serves as an excellent alternative to regular digital currency investment.Details On Exchange-Traded ProductExchange-traded products (ETPs) are securities that track an underlying asset, such as an index, commodity, or currency. Crypto traders and investors can perform transactions with these instruments on stock exchanges, like stocks they buy and sell throughout the trading day.Generally, ETPs come in various forms, including exchange-traded funds (ETFs), exchange-traded notes (ETNs), and commodity-based trust exchange-traded funds (ETCs). However, ETFs are the most common type of ETP, and they typically track an index such as the S&P 500.ETNs, on the other hand, are debt securities that track a particular index or benchmark. Furthermore, ETCs are similar to ETFs, but they track the price of a commodity, such as gold and oil.More Reports On 21Shares ETPsExchange-traded products offer investors a cost-effective way to gain exposure to diverse assets and markets. Investors can get more value with the STAKE ETP through the assets of the ETPs, which allows them to generate side income.According to the ETP director at 21.co, Arthur Krause, this advantage could help them contribute to the network’s security.Meanwhile, the idea of STAKE ETP has been in the pipeline; its release followed the staking experiments of ETPs from 21Shares after a few years. In 2019, the firm first introduced the Tezos ETP, and in June 2021, it launched the Solana ETP.2022 was an unfavorable year for both products, recalling the broad decline of the digital currency market. The event resulted in the significant loss of their values throughout this period.Moving on to 2023, both ETPs displayed a notable positive turn in their values. From the start of the year, ASOL has surged by about 78%. AXTZ, on the other hand, has increased by 38%, showing a solid start.
en.summary: Company recently launched Staking Basket Index ETP. ETPs can track up to 6 cryptocurrencies, including Cardano

record.header: Trouble in Ethereum? Devs Divided Over Staking Withdrawals in Shanghai Upgrade
record.subheader: Some Ethereum core devs have expressed concern that Shanghai is launching too quickly for fear of public pressure over staking withdrawals.
record.content: Following the success of the Ethereum merge upgrade in September, all eyes are back on the network as it prepares to roll out its next big update.This one, dubbed Shanghai, promises to deliver something Ethereum users have been eagerly awaiting: a way to get back the $25 billion worth of ETH that they have pledged to the network through its staking program. There’s just one problem: Ethereum’s core devs, the small group of coders responsible for making changes to the network, are butting heads about how and when the upgrade should be implemented.Ethereum moved to a proof-of-stake system just months ago through the merge, an event that fused the Ethereum mainnet with the Beacon Chain, a preliminary proof-of-stake version of Ethereum launched in December 2020. Proof-of-stake networks allow users to deposit funds to become validators and help authenticate on-chain transactions; such users accrue rewards in the form of newly generated tokens. Since December 2020, users have been able to stake their ETH and earn rewards. Now, with Shanghai, users will finally be able to access those rewards, and their original ETH deposits.By all accounts, Shanghai appears ready to launch by March. But recently, a vocal minority of Ethereum’s core developers has begun voicing concerns that the upgrade is being rolled out too quickly, out of fear of public reprisal, at the expense of technical costs that could have lasting impact on the network.“It feels like we’re not thinking about the long-term health of Ethereum,” core developer Micah Zoltu cautioned on an all core developers’ call Thursday. “We’re thinking, ‘How do we do what the public wants, today?’”Zoltu and a few of the network’s other 30-odd core developers are worried that a recent decision to forego a technical adjustment to Shanghai will expose Ethereum to unnecessary technical debt, with unknown implications for the years and decades ahead. The tweak would have taken an extra two to four weeks to implement by these developers’ estimates, an amount of time the rest of Ethereum’s core developers weren't willing to keep the public waiting.Technical debt refers to future work or headaches created when software developers prioritize the speed of a product’s release over perfect code. In this case, Ethereum’s developers decided not to make ETH withdrawals compatible with simple serialize, or SSZ, a flexible, modern encoding method described by developers as “the future of Ethereum encoding.” Instead of using SSZ, Ethereum is sticking with recursive-length prefix serialization, or RLP, an existing encoding method that may eventually be phased out and retired.While the difference there is highly technical and seemingly semantic, it could create unending headaches for Ethereum’s developers down the road. A large contingent of Ethereum’s core developers have signaled their willingness to switch ETH withdrawals over to the new encoding method in the upgrade following Shanghai, which is being called “Cancun.”But such a fix would still mean that any withdrawal activity initiated between Shanghai and Cancun would have been encoded with the old method. And thanks to the immutable Ethereum ledger, that activity—even if it took place within a few months—could keep on living on the Ethereum blockchain, forever.So, developers will have to eventually translate all that encoding from the old method to the new, a laborious endeavor. Beyond that, though, the mismatch created by encoding early withdrawals with the old RLP method, and the rest with the new SSZ, could have further-reaching repercussions.“There could be unknown unknowns around what this mismatch means—with withdrawals, design problems, vulnerabilities,” Matt Nelson, another Ethereum core developer, told Decrypt. “We just don't know.”At their meeting Thursday, Tomasz Stańczak, another core developer, pushed back against these concerns, stating that it wasn’t even certain yet if Ethereum was going to fully switch over to the new encoding method, SSZ.“A delay now for the sake of a better long-term network would be very convincing. But this particular change will be part of a larger process. Of thinking, of designing,” he said. “I would prefer us to look at this holistically, and give ourselves the proper time, in preparation for Cancun.”Zoltu found arguments Thursday about the uncertainty of SSZ’s future to have potentially been made in bad faith, as he considers it a settled fact that Ethereum will eventually switch its execution layer over to SSZ.“Introducing code that we know is going to be replaced in the near future means we are adding technical debt that could be avoided,” he told Decrypt.Why then, are most Ethereum developers so reluctant to spend a few extra weeks preventing an untold amount of future hassle? To Nelson, the answer has a lot to do with recent history.The merge, Ethereum’s historic transition to proof-of-stake, was first discussed over 5 years ago. In the years following, the network’s leadership routinely found itself justifying the upgrade’s long roadmap to disgruntled investors and community members; after plans for the merge became more concrete in 2021, the upgrade’s launch date was repeatedly punted, due to technical considerations, before its eventual release in September 2022.“I think [the current Shanghai] timeline definitely was driven by a lot of the scrutiny that was somewhat justly put on the merge, which was delayed countless times for the right reasons, but was still delayed,” Nelson said.Ethereum’s developers, says Nelson, are reluctant to again attract the ire of the masses. That’s in part understandable to him; Shanghai will impact tens of billions of dollars worth of funds, some portion of which has been locked up with the network for years.The tension reveals the unique role played by Etthereum’s cadre of core developers: their job is, first and foremost, to architect a blockchain as close to flawless as possible. But there’s no escaping the pressures that also stem from being charged with designing the network behind the world’s second-largest cryptocurrency. Ethereum currently boasts a market capitalization of $189 billion.While Nelson would have rather prioritized Ethereum’s technical needs, he understands why Ethereum’s developers decided Thursday to proceed without making requested changes.“In this case, we have a choice where we can be expedient without sacrificing too, too much,” he said. “And so that choice was made.”

In the years following, the network’s leadership routinely found itself justifying the upgrade’s long roadmap to disgruntled investors and community members; after plans for the merge became more concrete in 2021, the upgrade’s launch date was repeatedly punted, due to technical considerations, before its eventual release in September 2022.“I think [the current Shanghai] timeline definitely was driven by a lot of the scrutiny that was somewhat justly put on the merge, which was delayed countless times for the right reasons, but was still delayed,” Nelson said.Ethereum’s developers, says Nelson, are reluctant to again attract the ire of the masses. That’s in part understandable to him; Shanghai will impact tens of billions of dollars worth of funds, some portion of which has been locked up with the network for years.The tension reveals the unique role played by Etthereum’s cadre of core developers: their job is, first and foremost, to architect a blockchain as close to flawless as possible. But there’s no escaping the pressures that also stem from being charged with designing the network behind the world’s second-largest cryptocurrency. Ethereum currently boasts a market capitalization of $189 billion.While Nelson would have rather prioritized Ethereum’s technical needs, he understands why Ethereum’s developers decided Thursday to proceed without making requested changes.“In this case, we have a choice where we can be expedient without sacrificing too, too much,” he said. “And so that choice was made.”

en.header: The United States assured that it does not force partners to supply Ukraine with this or that weapon.
en.content: Moscow. January 20th. INTERFAX. RU – The U.S. Administration and its foreign partners are not putting pressure on each other to get Ukraine to supply some kind of weapon, announced the White House National Security Council Strategic Communications Coordinator, John Kirby, on Friday. "We don't twist people's hands on this issue. And no one is twisting our hands," he said at a briefing in Washington, responding to a journalist's question about the FRG's reluctance to allow the transfer of Leopard 2 tanks to Ukraine. The head of the Pentagon, Lloyd Austin, had previously stated that when considering the issue of military assistance to Ukraine, it was wrong to suggest the need to place some specific weapons on Kiev, such as Leopard 2 tanks." It should not be about some kind of weapon alone," he said at a press conference in the Federal Republic of Germany, responding to a question about Germany's position not currently permitting the supply of Leopard 2 tanks to Ukraine." We have nothing to announce about M1 Abrams tanks," Austin added, but he recalled that Western countries are supplying Ukraine with other types of armoured equipment, and the head of the Pentagon assured that the FRG, despite its position on tanks, is providing very substantial assistance to Ukraine.
en.summary: The US administration is not exerting pressure on each other to get arms supplies to Ukraine, said John Kirby, coordinator for strategic communications cooperation at the US National Security Council, on Friday.

record.header: Berlin does not condition the transfer of tanks to Ukraine with the same supplies from the United States
record.content: Moscow – January 20, INTERFAX.RU - Berlin does not require the US to transfer US tanks to Ukraine as a condition for approving the supply of German Leopard tanks to Kiev. On Friday, German government spokesman Steffen Hebeschtreit stated. "It is hard for me to imagine that the German Chancellor would make any demands or conditions to the President of the United States," he quoted Dow Jones as saying. He stressed that Chancellor Olaf Scholtz had taken key decisions regarding support for Ukraine only after consultation with President Joe Biden of the United States. On the question of Berlin's position, if Poland put German-made tanks to Ukraine without Berlin's permission, Hebeshtreet replied that in Berlin "religion to the rules and all its partners clearly want to act in a law-abiding manner". The previous day, the new FRG Minister of Defence, Boris Pistorius, had stated that Germany itself could offer tanks to Ukraine or allow countries armed with Leopard tanks to re-export them to Ukraine. This week, Chancellor Scholtz of Germany said that he was consulting with allies on the possible transfer of tanks to Ukraine, and any announcements in this area should be agreed with partners. Vice Chancellor Robert Habek, in turn, noted that Berlin would be easier to decide on the supply of tanks if its tanks were first transferred to the United States. Western media clarified that although Poland and Finland had expressed a desire to supply German-made Leopard tanks to Ukraine, they needed Berlin ' s permission because of the restrictions on arms exports adopted by the Federal Republic of Germany. In the past, however, Prime Minister Mateusz Moravecki of Poland had suggested that Warsaw could simply ignore any restrictions by Germany on the re-export of German-made tanks.

ru.header: В США заверили, что не принуждают партнеров поставлять Украине то или иное вооружение
ru.content: Москва. 20 января. INTERFAX.RU - Администрация США и ее иностранные партнеры не оказывают друг на друга давление, чтобы добиться поставки Украине тех или иных видов вооружения, заявил в пятницу координатор по стратегическим коммуникациям в Совете национальной безопасности Белого дома Джон Кирби."В этом вопросе мы не выкручиваем никому руки. И никто не выкручивает руки нам", - заявил он на брифинге в Вашингтоне, отвечая на вопрос журналиста о нежелании ФРГ разрешать передачу танков Leopard 2 Украине.Ранее глава Пентагона Ллойд Остин заявил, что при рассмотрении вопроса оказания военной помощи Украине неправильно рассуждать о необходимости поставить какое-то определенное вооружение Киеву, например - танки Leopard 2."Речь не должна идти лишь о каком-то определенном виде вооружений", - сказал он на пресс-конференции в ФРГ, отвечая на вопрос о позиции Германии, на данный момент не разрешающей поставки Украине танков Leopard 2."Наверное, вы слышали заявления Германии, что они не приняли решение о поставках своих танков... А нам нечего объявить по поводу танков M1 Abrams", - добавил Остин. При этом он напомнил, что западные страны поставляют Украине другие виды бронетехники.Глава Пентагона заверил, что ФРГ, несмотря на свою позицию по танкам, оказывает очень существенную помощь Украине.
ru.summary: Администрация США не оказывает друг на друга давления, чтобы добиться поставок Украине вооружений, заявил координатор по вопросам стратегического коммуникационного сотрудничества в Совете нацбезопасности США Джон Кирби в пятницу.
